- To prepare this healthy sandwich, take a pan and add water in it. Heat it over high flame and bring to a boil. Soak the sprouts in this boiled water for about 15 minutes and drain well. Mix in salt with the sprouts and grind to a coarse paste in a jar.

- Now take a wok and heat little oil in it over moderate flame. Add the ground sprouts paste in the wok and stir-fry it for a while Stir-fry for a minute or two and remove.

- To prepare the green chutney, combine coriander leaves, green chillies and little salt in a blender and grind to a fine paste. Spread this green chutney on the bread slices. This will add a great flavour to the sandwiches. Now spread a layer of ground sprout paste evenly with onion, tomato and capsicum (on top of the green chutney).

- Heat a tawa over medium flame and place the prepared sandwiches to toast them. Apply little oil around the edges to make the sandwiches crispier. Cook for a minute on both sides and remove. If you don't have a tawa, you can also place them on a sandwich maker and cook.

- Healthy and delicious mixed sprouts sandwich is ready to eat. Sprinkle oregano and chilli flakes on the sandwiches to give it a more yummy taste.

name: Mixed Sprouts Paratha
ingredients:
- 50 grams boiled and coarsely crushed mixed sprouts (moong, matki, chana etc)

- 30 grams whole wheat flour (gehun ka atta)

- ¼ tsp chilli powder

- ¼ tsp turmeric powder (haldi)

- ¼ tsp garam masala

- salt to taste

- ¼ tsp whole cumin(jeera) powder whole wheat flour (gehun ka atta) for rolling

- 1 tsp oil for cooking
method:
- Combine all the ingredients in a deep bowl and knead into a semi soft dough using enough water.

- Roll a portion of the dough, lightly fold from one end to the other to make a roll.

- Roll it over again from one end to the other end to form a swiss roll and seal the open end tightly at the bottom in the centre.

- Turnover the swiss roll so that the sealed side faces upwards and again gently roll into using a little whole wheat flour for rolling.

- Heat a non-stick tava (griddle) and cook the paratha, using 1/4 tsp of oil, till golden brown spots appear on both the sides.

- Serve immediately with curd.

name: Chickpea Salad With Vegetables
ingredients:
- 30g chickpea

- 15g chopped onion

- 10g chopped carrot

- 10g chopped tomato

- 10g cucumber

- 1 tbsp coriander leaves

- 1 tsp salt

- ½ tsp pepper powder

- ½ tbsp lemon juice
method:
- In a large bowl, add chickpeas, cucumber, onions, tomatoes, carrot and coriander leaves.

- Then squeeze fresh lime juice and add seasonings like salt and black pepper powder.

- Toss everything well and serve immediately.

name: Pongal Khichdi
categories: Breakfast, Lunch, Dinner, Sim's Family Recipes
ingredients:
- 1 ½ cup rice

- ½ cup moong dal

- 3 tbsp refined oil/ghee

- ¼ tsp asafoetida

- ½ tsp whole cumin

- ½ tsp mustard seeds

- 1 tsp whole peppercorns

- 1 tbsp of raw urad dal

- 8-10 cashews

- 12-15 curry patta

- few slitted green chillies

- according to taste

- 2 tsp fi ely chopped ginger (optional)

- salt to taste

- 4 cups of water
method:
- Dry roast the dal and rice in a pan on low flame for 7-10 mins.

- Once done, remove the pan from the heat and let the dal and rice cool down.

- Once it has cooled wash it a few time and then add to a pressure cooker. ( if you have gut issues see notes).

- Add 4 cups of water (can add more or less depending on the consistency you would like ).

- Add a salt to taste. The water should taste salty like sea water.

- Place the lid and weight of the pressure cooker and cook on medium heat for 1 whistle

- Once the whistle goes off, switch off the heat and set aside to allow the pressure cooker to release pressure.

- Carefully open once all the pressure has been released.

- Keep the cooker aside.

For the tarka

- Take a kadhai add 3 tbsp of refined oil/ghee.

- When the oil is warm add ¼ tsp asafoetida and ½ tsp whole cumin.

- Then add ½ tsp mustard seeds. Stir for few seconds and add 1 tbsp of raw urad dal ,8-10 cashews and 1 tsp whole peppercorns.

- Stir and add 12-15 curry patta leaves and few slitted green chillies (chillies optional).

- Roast everything for few minutes till the cashews start changing colour.

- Now add the tarka to the cooker and mix it into the cooked rice and dal.

- Taste the pongal for salt. If you need to add more salt, dissolve it in a little water and then add to the pongal.

- If the dal and rice is too thick, you can add a little hot water to give it a softer consistency, like khichdi.

- Serve with a side of vegetables or raita.

Notes

- Thin sliced ginger : this is optional but can be added at the tadka stage or with the dal and rice while cookering.

- Green chillies : optional.

- If you have gut issues it is best to soak all grains before cooking. Here you can wash and soak it for atleast 30 minutes.

name: Bhindi And Soya Nuggets Gravy
ingredients:
- 50g soya chunks

- 50g Ladies finger

- 30g onion roughly chopped

- 1 clove of garlic

- 2 teaspoon roughly chopped ginger

- 30g tomato roughly chopped

- 1-2 green chilies

- 2 tbsp chopped coriander leaves optional

- ½ TSP black peppercorns

- ½ tsp cloves

- ½ TSP bay leaf

- ¼ teaspoon whole cumin

- ¼ tbsp coriander powder

- ¼ teaspoon garam masala

- ¼ teaspoon turmeric powder

- Salt as per taste

- 1 tsp mustard oil/ any cooking oil of your choice

- water adjust to get the desired consistency
method:
- Wash the soya chunks and soak in boiling water for around 10-15 minutes. After 15 minutes squeeze out all the water from the chunks and keep aside.

- In a grinder make a paste of onion, ginger, and garlic. Take out the paste. Keep aside. In the same jar make a paste of tomato and green chilies. Keep that aside too.

- Heat oil in a pot and add whole cumin, bay leaf, peppercorns, and cloves. Saute for a few seconds till the spices become fragrant.

- Add the onion paste and fry till it turns golden brown. In between if the paste starts sticking to the bottom of the pot, add around 2 tablespoons of water and continue cooking.

- Add turmeric powder, salt, and coriander powder and about 2 tablespoons of water. Stir fry for about a minute and then add the tomatoes. Cook the tomatoes nicely till they change color and turn mushy and cook for about 1-2 minutes.

- Add ladyfinger cubes, soya chunks, and coriander leaves. Mix everything. Cook for about 2 minutes without water.

- Add water, mix and cover the pot. Cook till ladyfingers are done.

- Finally, add garam masala, mix and simmer for around 2 minutes. Switch off the gas.

- Garnish with some chopped coriander leaves and serve with roti/ paratha/ rice.

name: Beetroot Roti
ingredients:
- 20g beetroot peeled and finely chopped or grated

- 3 tbsp Water

- 10g whole wheat flour + more for dusting to roll roti

- salt to taste

- 1 tsp Oil
method:
- Wash and peel the beetroot, finely chop or grate them.

- Take into grinder jar along with 2 tablespoons of water and make smooth puree.

- In a large bowl, mix atta and salt.

- Add prepared puree and mix using your fingertips.

- Now add little water at a time and keand into soft and smooth dough.

- Cover it and let it rest for 10 minutes.

- Drizzle a teaspoon of oil on the dough and knead it again to smooth out.

- Make smooth balls. Flatten them between your plam one by one.

- Take one flattened disc, dip both sides into the dry flour and roll.

- Heat the tawa or pan on medium heat. Once hot place rolled roti.

- After few seconds, as you see few bubbles flip it and cook other side same way..

- Serve with raita or chutney of your choice .

name: Broccoli Daliya
ingredients:
- 100 grams broccoli

- 1 tsp whole cumin (jeera)

- Handful of coriander

- 30g broken/cracked wheat(daliya)

- salt to taste

- 1 tsp oil

- ¼ tsp red chilli powder
method:
- Wash the cracked wheat thoroughly in cold water and keep aside.

- Wash broccoli and chop them roughly. Add these to a blender. Add in 1/2 tsp cumin seeds and Coriander too. Grind with as little water as possible to make a smooth paste.

- Take a deep saucepan. Heat 1 tsp oil in it. Then add ½ tsp whole cumin and let them brown a little. Then add the broccoli paste to the pan. Add in the cracked wheat also to the pan. Add one cup of water to this and salt to taste and give everything a good mix. You can also use a little chili powder to add some more spice.

- Let the wheat cook well. Close the lid but keep checking in between. Depending on the consistency of the paste you added, you might need to add some more water.

- Wheat should get fully cooked in about 15-20 minutes. Once cooked, you will see that the grains puff up and are soft. Check to see if the salt and spice are good. Turn off the heat once the wheat is cooked. Optionally you can add in some lime juice at this stage. Serve hot with yogurt or any side of your choice.

name: Mushroom Curry
ingredients:
- 200 grams button mushrooms chopped into bite size pieces

- 100g onion roughly chopped

- 100g tomato roughly chopped

- 1-2 large garlic cloves roughly chopped

- 1 inch ginger piece roughly chopped

- 1-2 green chili peppers roughly chopped

- chopped coriander leaves

- 1 tbsp whole cumin

- 1 green cardamoms

- ½ bay leaf

- 2-3 black pepper corns

- 2 cloves

- ½ tsp coriander powder

- ½ tsp red chili powder

- 1/8 tsp turmeric powder

- ¼ tsp garam masala

- ¼ tsp kasoori methi

- salt as per taste

- 1 tsp cooking oil
method:
- Heat around ½ tsp of oil in a pan. Add onion, garlic, and ginger. Cook until the onion starts turning brown.

- Add chopped tomato, green chilies, and some salt. Cover the pan and cook until the tomatoes turn mushy. Switch off the gas and allow the mixture to reach room temperature.

- Put the cooked onion tomato mix in a grinder or food processor and make a smooth paste.

- Heat the remaining 1/2 tsp of oil in a pan. Add whole cumin, bay leaf, pepper, cloves, green, and black cardamom. Saute for a few seconds or until the spices become fragrant.

- Add onion tomato paste, remaining salt, turmeric powder, coriander powder, and red chili powder. Mix and cook for 5-6 minutes.

- Add mushrooms, mix, and cover the pan. Cook until the mushrooms get nicely cooked. If you feel the gravy is too thick add some water to get the desired consistency and cook for another 2-3 minutes.

- Finally, add kasoori methi and garam masala. Mix everything and cook for a minute and then switch off the gas.

- Garnish with coriander leaves. Serve hot with roti, naan, or rice.

name: Grilled Mushroom And Veg Salad
ingredients:
- 1 tbsp vinegar

- ½ tbsp soy sauce

- 2 cloves garlic, minced

- freshly ground black pepper

- 200g mushrooms

- freshly chopped coriander, for garnish

- 50g cucumber

- 50g lettuce

- 50g onion

- 50g tomato
method:
- In a large bowl, whisk together vinegar, soy sauce, garlic, and pepper. Add mushrooms and marinate 20 minutes.

- Heat grill to medium-high. Grill the mushrooms 2 to 3 minutes per side.

- Garnish with parsley before serving.

- Serve with veg salad.

name: Chilli Popcorn
ingredients:
- 30g Corn kernels

- 1tsp red chilli powder

- ¼tsp red chilli flakes

- 5ml oil
method:
- You can make all seasoning when you put the corn kernels along with the salt in the pot as mentioned above. Put the oil, kernels, spices in the pot at the same time and stir well.

- When all the corn kernels are popped, serve them hot.

name: Chatpata Tomato Slices
ingredients:
- 100g tomato

- 1 tbsp coriander

- ½ tsp chaat masala

- 1 tsp lemon juice
method:
- Cut the Tomato into thin slices

- Place on the plate, add lemon juice, sprinkle chaat masala

- Garnish with coriander and serve

name: Green Loaded Omelette
ingredients:
- 1 whole egg

- 10g fresh fenugreek leaves

- ¼ tsp red chilli flakes

- 1 tbsp water

- 1 tsp oil

- salt to taste
method:
- Take bowl add little water, salt to taste, red chilli flakes, 1 whole egg and blend it well

- Wash Fenugreek leaves and keep it aside

- Heat oil in a pan transfer the egg mixture and top it with Fenugreek leaves and cook it well on both side

- Once it's cooked transfer to a serving plate and sprinkle red chilli flakes and serve hot

name: Pesto Pasta
ingredients:
- 30g durum wheat pasta

- 50g sweet basil leaves

- 4 almonds

- 4 cashews

- 1 tsp olive oil

- ½ tsp red chilli flakes

- ½ tsp black pepper

- salt to taste

- water for cooking
method:
- Soak almonds and cashews for 2 two hours.

- Clean and discard the basil stem and soak basil leaves in water for 15 minutes.

- Take a blending jar add basil leaves, almonds, cashews, olive oil and blend all the ingredients well, add some water if required.

- Then heat water in a cooking bowl, when you see bubbles add the wheat pasta and keep mixing to avoid sticky pasta .

- Cook until it is soft and cooked well.

- Now drain the water and take pasta in a serving plate top it with pesto sauce and mix it well and serve pesto pasta.

name: Oats Khichdi
ingredients:
- 20grams oats

- 1 tbsp moong dal

- 50g finely chopped onion

- 50g finely chopped tomatoes

- 1tsp fine chopped coriander

- 1 finely chopped green chilli

- ¼ tsp ginger garlic paste

- ¼ tsp red chilli powder

- ¼ tsp coriander powder

- ¼ tsp turmeric powder

- ¼ tsp mustard seeds

- ¼ tsp whole cumin

- 1 inch dry red chilli

- pinch of asafoetida

- 1 tsp oil

- salt to taste

- water for cooking
method:
- Wash and soak moong dal for 2 hours .

- Heat oil in a pressure cooker add mustard seeds and allow it to crackle, then add whole cumin , dry red chilli, asafoetida, red chilli powder, coriander powder, turmeric powder, ginger garlic paste and cook all the ingredients .

- Now add finely chopped onion, finely chopped tomato, green chilli and saute for a while and then add salt, water cook for a while.

- Finally add oats and moong dal and close the pressure cooker and cook for 1 whistle.

- Once it's cooked add come coriander leaves and serve hot oats moong khichdi.

name: Methi Roti
ingredients:
- 30g wheat flour

- 50g methi leaves finely chopped

- ¼ tsp carom seeds

- salt to taste

- water for kneading

- 1 tsp oil

- 1 tbsp curd

- pinch of chaat masala

- pinch of whole cumin

- pinch of red chilli powder
method:
- Take clean bowl add wheat flour, salt, carom seeds, finely chopped methi and dry mix all the ingredients once.

- Add warm water as per the requirement for knead and knead it well to form a soft dough.

- Once the dough is prepared, divide it into 2 portion and roll it to form roti.

- Heat tava and cook roti evenly on both the sides and transfer to a serving plate.

- Take curd in a cup add chaat masala, pinch of cumin seeds, red chilli powder, salt and mix well.

- Serve methi roti with chatpata curd.

name: Dal Sambar
ingredients:
- 1 tomato

- 30g toor dal

- ¼ tsp whole cumin seeds

- 2 cloves of garlic

- pinch turmeric

- 1 tsp oil

- ¼ tsp mustard seeds

- 2 tbsp of fine chopped onion

- 1 green chilli

- 1 tsp finely chopped coriander

- pinch of asafoetida

- 2-3 curry leaves

- ¼ tsp red chilli powder

- salt to taste

- water for cooking
method:
- Soak toor dal for 30 minutes.

- Heat water in a pressure cooker add tomato, garlic cloves, whole cumin seeds, pinch of turmeric and cook for 2 whistles once it's cooled down blend it in a mixer jar and transfer to a cook bowl.

- Heat oil in a pan add mustard seeds and allow it to crackle, then add 1 inch dry red chilli, finely chopped onion, curry leaves, pinch of asafoetida and fry these for a while and then add to the cooked dal.

- Finally add chopped chilli and coriander and enjoy dal sambar.

name: Chicken Shawarma
ingredients:
Ingredients

- 100 grams chicken

- 50g curd

- ½ tbsp ground cumin

- ¼ tbsp turmeric powder

- ½ tbsp ground coriander

- ½ tbsp garlic and ginger paste

- ½ tsp pepper

- 25g large onion, thinly sliced

- 25g Tomato

- ½ large lemon, juice of

- 5ml oil

for Pita bread

- water

- yeast

- pinch sugar

- whole wheat flour 30g

- salt

Metho0d

- Knead flour with yeast salt, pinch sugar with required water and set aside for 1 hour Then make a dough and cook in the pan.

- In a small bowl, mix the cumin, turmeric, coriander, garlic and ginger and paste and pepper.Pat the chicken and season with salt on both sides and set aside for 1hour.

- Grill the chicken and then cut into small pieces. Toss with Onion, Tomato

- Spread the marinated chicken with the onions, tomato in Pita Bread and spread yoghurt sauce or tahini. Roll it and serve.

Ingredients

- 50g curd

- ½ tbsp ground cumin

- ¼ tbsp turmeric powder

- ½ tbsp ground coriander

- ½ tbsp garlic and ginger paste

- ½ tsp pepper

- 25g large onion, thinly sliced

- 25g Tomato

- ½ large lemon, juice of

- 5ml oil

for Pita bread

- water

- yeast

- pinch sugar

- whole wheat flour 30g

- salt

Metho0d

- Knead flour with yeast salt, pinch sugar with required water and set aside for 1 hour Then make a dough and cook in the pan.

- In a small bowl, mix the cumin, turmeric, coriander, garlic and ginger and paste and pepper.Pat the chicken and season with salt on both sides and set aside for 1hour.

- Grill the chicken and then cut into small pieces. Toss with Onion, Tomato

- Spread the marinated chicken with the onions, tomato in Pita Bread and spread yoghurt sauce or tahini. Roll it and serve.

name: Moringa Leaves Sabzi
ingredients:
- 100g moringa leaves

- 25g onion finely chopped

- 2 green chillies

- 3-4 garlic pods

- ¼ tsp turmeric powder

- ½ tsp whole cumin

- 15g moong dal

- salt to taste

- 5ml Oil
method:
- Heat oil in a pan and add whole cumin and saute on a medium flame. Add chopped onion and fry till it gets translucent.

- Now add chopped green chilli with chopped garlic and saute for a min.

- Add moringa leaves along with soaked moong dal salt and mix well.

- Now add 1/2 cup water and mix well, cover with the lid and cook on a medium flame for 7 to 8 mins or till the leaves get properly cooked. Sabji is ready to serve with rice dal and chapati.

name: Ragi Dosa
ingredients:
- 20g ragi flour

- 1 tbsp gram flour

- 1 finely chopped green chillies

- ¼ tsp cumin powder

- pinch of baking soda

- salt to taste

- water for cooking

- 1 tsp oil
method:
- In a bowl add ragi flour, gram flour, cumin powder, salt, finely chopped green chilli and mix all the ingredients, add water as required to form a running consistency and allow it to rest for 15 minutes.

- After 10 minutes add pinch of baking soda and mix it well.

- Heat a pan and pour half the batter and spread as dosa and cook on both the sides.

- And serve with any chutney of your choice.

name: Palak Khichdi
ingredients:
- 30g rice

- 15g moong dal

- ¼ tsp turmeric

- 5ml ghee

- 1 tsp cumin / jeera

- 1 cardamom

- 1 inch cinnamon

- 1 bay leaf

- 1 dried red chilli

- 25g onion (finely chopped)

- ½ tsp ginger garlic paste

- 1 green chilli (slit)

- 25g tomato (finely chopped)

- 100g palak

- salt
method:
- In a kadai, heat 1 tbsp ghee and saute 1 tsp cumin, 1 cardamom, 1 inch cinnamon , 1 bay leaf and 1 dried red chilli.

- Also saute the onion, till they turn slightly golden.

- Additionally, saute ½ tsp ginger garlic paste and 1 green chilli.

- Now add tomato and saute till the tomatoes turn soft and mushy.

- Add palak puree and cook for 5 minutes or till palak changes colour. Now add pressure cooked rice and moong dal, add 1 cup water and salt, simmer and boil for 5 minutes or till khichdi absorbs palak flavour.

name: Radish Sambar
ingredients:
- 100g radish

- 25g onion (cubed)

- 25g tomato

- few curry leaves

- ¼ tsp turmeric

- ½ cup tamarind extract

- salt

- 30g cup toor dal

- 2 tsp coriander powder

- 1 tsp cumin/jeera powder

- 1 tsp mustard and urad dal for seasoning

- ¼ tsp methi/fenugreek powder

- 2 dried red chilli

- 5ml oil
method:
- In a kadai add radish and onion.

- Add few curry leaves, ¼ tsp turmeric and 1 cup water.

- Mix well, cover and boil for 5 minutes or till the radish gets half cooked.

- Further add ½ cup tamarind extract, and 1 tsp salt. mix well.

- Continue to boil for 5 more minutes or till the radish gets cooked well.

- Now add pressure cooked toor dal and prepared masala powders.

- Mix well, adjusting consistency as required.

- Boil for 5 minutes or till the raw smell goes off.

- Pour the tempering over sambar and mix well.

- Finally, serve radish sambar with hot steamed rice.

name: Garlic Chicken
ingredients:
- 100 grams chicken small pieces

- 1/2 tablespoons garlic finely chopped

- 20g onions finely chopped

- 25 small tomato finely chopped

- 1/4 tablespoon crushed dry chillies

- 1 green chillies thinly sliced

- 1/2 tablespoon vinegar

- salt to taste

- 10ml oil

- spring onions optional
method:
- Finely chop onions, tomato and garlic. Lightly crush the garlic. Marinate the chicken pieces with the crushed dry chillies, vinegar, garlic and salt. Mix well, and let it sit for an hour.

- Heat some oil in a thick-bottomed pan. Add chopped onions and cook on a medium flame while stirring occasionally.

- When the onions start turning brown, add the chopped tomatoes, and cook further.Combine well. Add salt. Switch off when the water starts to disappear.Transfer the contents to a bowl.

- Use the same pan, add a little oil, and braise the marinated chicken on a high flame. Lower the flame, and cook with the lid closed for about 10 minutes. Open the lid, add the onion-tomato paste back to the pan, mix well, and cook on a low flame.Add salt if required.

- Cook until the chicken pieces are evenly coated. Add the chopped green chillies, and a tablespoon of finely chopped spring onions.

name: Cabbage Salad
ingredients:
- 100g shredded cabbage

- 20g Onion chopped

- 10g capsicum chopped

- 2 green chillies chopped

- ½ tsp chilli powder

- 2 tbsp coriander leaves chopped

- 1 tsp salt

- 1½ tsp lemon juice
method:
- In a bowl add shredded cabbage, onion, capsicum, chopped coriander, green chillies, ½ tsp chilli powder, salt and mix thoroughly.

- After the cabbage is mixed with all the other ingredients and spices, sprinkle 1½ tsp lemon juice and mix well.

name: Ragi Porridge With Curd
ingredients:
- 30g ragi flour

- 50ml curd

- 1 tsp whole cumin seeds

- ½ tsp carom seeds(ajwain)

- ¼ tsp jeera powder

- ½ tsp salt

- 2½ cup water
method:
- Heat 2 cups of water in a pan.

- Add the ragi flour to the remaining ½ cup of water along with whole cumin seeds, ajwain and salt. Stir well to dissolve it completely, till no lumps remain.

- Once the water in the pan starts boiling, slowly add the ragi mixture, stirring constantly to ensure that there are no lumps.

- Cook and stir for 1-2 minutes.

- After the ragi porridge is cooked add the curd into the ragi porridge and stir continuously.

- Simmer for about 3 minutes and turn off the heat.

- Transfer it into a serving bowl, sprinkle some jeera powder on top (optional) and serve hot.

name: Stuffed Idli
ingredients:
- 30g rice

- 15g urad dal

- 15g onion chopped

- 15g tomato chopped

- 15g capsicum chopped

- 15g beans

- 2 green chillies chopped

- 3 tbsp coriander leaves chopped

- ½ tsp jeera

- ½ tsp mustard seeds

- ½ tsp chilly powder

- 1 tsp salt (add it to the batter)

- 2.5 ml oil
method:
- Soak rice and dal for 5-6 hours, grind it into a batter and leave it overnight to ferment.

- Mix together all the chopped vegetables and keep it aside.

- Heat oil in a pan, once the oil is heated, add ½ tsp mustard seeds and jeera and let it splutter.

- Then add vegetables into it and mix well. Add salt, give it a mix and turn off the flame.

- Let the vegetable mixture cool a bit.

- Now grease the idli maker with a little amount of oil.

- Add half ladle of the batter into it, then place the vegetables on that in between and then pour another half ladle of the batter on it.

- Steam the idlis for about 10-15 minutes.

- Turn off the flame and serve hot.

- It can be served with coriander or mint chutney or vegetable sambar.

name: Pepper Brinjal Sabzi
ingredients:
- 100g brinjal

- 20g chopped onion

- ½ tbsp ginger garlic paste

- 2 Cardamom

- 1 tbsp pepper powder

- ½ tsp Jeera

- ½ tsp jeera powder

- 1/2tsp tsp chilli powder

- ½ tsp turmeric powder

- 2 tsp salt

- 1 tsp oil
method:
- Cut the brinjal into small cubes and marinate with salt and keep it aside for 15- 20 minutes.

- Then squeeze the brinjal and remove the water and stir fry on a pan or kadhai using ¼ tsp oil and keep it aside.

- Now add the chopped onions into the mixer and make a fine paste.

- Add oil into the kadhai, once the oil heats up a bit, add 2 cardamom and ½ tsp jeera.

- Now add the onion paste and cook for 5 minutes, then add ginger- garlic paste and add for another 5 minutes.

- Now add pepper powder, turmeric powder, chilli powder, jeera powder and salt, and mix well and cook for 15 minutes on slow flame.

- Then add the marinated brinjal cubes and mix thoroughly with the onion mixture and spices for about 10 minutes.

- Turn off the flame, sprinkle some pepper powder and serve hot.

name: Brinjal Curry
ingredients:
- 100g brinjal

- 20g onion

- 100g tomato

- 2 green chilly

- 1 tsp dhania powder

- 1 tsp whole cumin seeds

- ½ tsp jeera powder

- 1 bay leaf

- ½ tsp chilly powder

- 1 tsp turmeric powder

- 1 tsp ginger-garlic paste

- 1 tbsp chopped coriander leaves

- ½ tsp oil

- 1 tsp salt
method:
- Cut the end of the brinjal (in plus + shape so that the spices go inside the brinjal), marinate with salt and ½ tsp turmeric powder and keep aside for 5 mins. Then fry the marinated brinjal in oil for 10- 15 minutes or until the brinjal becomes soft. Take it out on a plate.

For the gravy

- Add roughly chopped onion, tomato, green chilli and coriander leaves into the mixer and grind it into a smooth paste.

- In a pan/ kadhai add oil, then add bay leaf and whole cumin seeds, after the seeds splutter, add the grinded mixture into it.

- Add ginger-garlic paste, chilly powder, turmeric powder, jeera powder, dhania powder and salt, mix all together well.

- Now cook the gravy for 15- 20 minutes on low flame.

- Add 250 ml water to it and stir. Once it starts boiling, add the fried brinjal, give it a mix and close the pan/kadhai with a lid and let it cook for about 10 minutes.

- Turn off the flame, garnish it with coriander leaves and serve hot.

name: Sattu Paratha
ingredients:
- 30 gms sattu

- 50 gm wheat flour

- 10 gm onion

- A inch of ginger

- 2 garlic

- ¼ tsp dry mango powder

- ½ tsp red chilli powder

- 1 tsp lemon juice

- salt
method:
- Take a bowl and add sattu along with one tspn of water to make the stuffing moist, so that it's easy to fill. add crushed garlic, chopped onion, coriander leaves,green chillies, ajwain, mango powder, lime/lemon juice and salt and mix well.

- Make a dough from wheat flour. Cover the dough for half an hour and allow it to rest.

- Now divide the dough into two equal portions.

- Roll it into a medium sized roti and add stuffing and roll the paratha to CD size.

- Heat a tawa and cook each side of the paratha until golden brown, add a few drops of oil while on tawa.

- The paratha is ready to serve with chutney or curd.

name: Vegetable Daliya Poridge
ingredients:
- 30 gms wheat daliya

- 30 gms moong dal

- 20 gms capsicum

- 20 gms egg plant

- 20 gms tomato

- 10 onion

- ½ tsp jeera

- 1 green chilli

- ½ tsp red chilli powder

- 10 gms coriander

- ½ tsp oil
method:
- Heat a pan, roast the daliya for 5 minutes till the daliya turns aromatic.

- In a cooker, heat 1 tsp oil, add jeera and pinch of hing

- Saute till the jeera splutters.

- Add ½ tsp ginger garlic paste, chopped green chilli, tomato and saute it till it turns soft and mushy.

- Now add all the chopped vegetables, turmeric and salt to taste.

- Saute for a minute and add soaked moong dal and dalia.Add enough water to it.

- Cover and pressure cook for 3- 4 whistles or till dalia gets completely cooked.

- Ready to serve.

name: Stuffed Karela Paratha
ingredients:
- 50 gms whole wheat flour

- 50 gms karela

- 10 gms onion

- 1 tsp amchoor powder

- ½ tsp fennel seeds crushed

- ½ tsp coriander powder

- 10 gms coriander leaves.

- ½ tsp red chilli powder

- ½ tsp oil

- salt according to taste
method:
- In a bowl add wheat flour, salt mix well and knead it into a dough.

- Add little salt in grated karela and keep aside for 15 minutes.

- Now squeeze the water completely.

- Heat oil in a pan and add fennel seeds and stir.

- Now add amchoor powder and grated bitter gourd, coriander powder and stir it.

- Make equal size balls from dough and keep aside.

- Take a dough bowl. Flatten it slightly and add stuffing.

- Close it again and make a neat ball.

- Dust the stuffed dough ball with some dry flour and then roll to make a paratha.

- Put the rolled paratha on a hot tawa and cook from both sides.

- Paratha is ready to serve. serve with curd or raita.

name: Guava Lassi
ingredients:
- 60 gms guava

- 120 gms curd

- 1 tsp honey

- ½ cup ice cubes

- pinch of nutmeg/cardamom powder
method:
- Wash guava and chop them into cube.

- Add guava into blender and make Puree with the cardamom and yogurt. Add little water and 1 tsp honey to it.

- Pour the lassi into a glass and serve it with ice cubes.

name: Mushroom Sabzi
ingredients:
- 100 gms Mushroom

- 30 gms onion

- ½ tsp ginger garlic paste

- 100 gms tomato

- 4-5 curry leaves

- 1 green chilli

- ½ tsp red chilli powder

- ½ garam masala

- ½ lemon juice

- coriander leaves

- ½ Pepper

- ½ tsp oil
method:
- Heat oil in a pan, add mustard and whole cumin.

- Once they crackle add green chilli and ginger garlic paste and saute it.

- Fry finely chopped onions.

- Add tomato puree to it. Saute it until the raw smells go off the mixture.

- Add curry leaves, red chilli powder, salt, garam masala and turmeric.

- Saute it and add mushrooms.

- Stir fry 2-3 minutes. Cover and cook on a low flame until the mushrooms are cooked.

- Add lemon juice, coriander leaves and serve.

name: Kasuri Methi Paratha
ingredients:
- 25 gms kasuri methi

- 50 gms wheat flour

- pinch of turmeric powder

- ½ tsp green chilli paste

- ½ tsp red Chilli powder

- ½ tsp oil

- salt
method:
- Soak kasuri methi in half a cup of boiling water.

- In a bowl, combine flour, green chilli paste, red chilli powder, coriander powder and salt.

- Remove kasuri methi from water and add that too.

- Knead this together with water to make smooth, firm dough.

- Heat a tawa or griddle. Take some dough and roll it out in a circle.

- Place this on griddle and apply oil and cook until it becomes golden brown.

- Serve hot.

name: Gobi Roti
ingredients:
- 50g wheat flour

- 100g finely grated cauliflower

- 1 tsp chilli powder

- ½ tsp dhania powder

- ½ tsp carom seeds (ajwain)

- 1 finely chopped green chilli

- 1 tbsp chopped coriander leaves

- ½ tsp salt
method:
For the dough

- In a bowl mix together atta, oil and salt. Add water little by little and mix.

- Knead to form a smooth and soft dough. Cover and let the dough rest for 15-20 minutes.

- Divide the dough into 2 equal parts.

For the stuffing

- For the stuffing, mix the grated cauliflower (grate using a grater or use a food processor) along with chilli powder, coriander powder, chopped green chilli, ajwain seeds and chopped coriander.

- Do not add the salt at this point. Meanwhile heat a tawa on high-medium heat.

For the roti

- Take one of the dough balls and using your rolling pin roll it into a circle. And place the stuffing in the center.

- Sprinkle salt on top.

- Now take all the sides of the dough and pinch it all together.

- Press the pinched dough down to seal all the gaps.

- Now using your rolling pin, roll the dough again to a circle.

- Transfer the rolled roti onto the hot tawa.

- Cook the side for a minute or two and then flip over.

- Press with a spatula and cook the roti till both sides have golden brown spots on them.

- Gobi roti is now ready.

- Serve it with yogurt or any vegetable chutney.

name: Mooli Kadhi
ingredients:
- 100g radish

- 1 cup curd

- 15g besan

- 1 tsp ginger-garlic paste

- ¼ tsp fenugreek seeds

- ½ tsp turmeric powder

- ½ tsp whole cumin seeds

- 3-4 curry leaves

- ½ tsp mustard seeds

- 1 chopped green chilli

- ½ tsp salt

- ½ tsp oil
method:
- In a bowl mix besan with curd until no lumps are formed and keep it aside.

- Heat the oil in a pan. Temper the mustard seeds. Once these crackle, add the whole cumin seeds, methi seeds and curry leaves.

- Once this is done, add the ginger- garlic paste along with the green chillies and turmeric powder.

- Once the raw smell goes, add the grated radish and cook covered with a bit of water and add salt.

- Once this is cooked, add curd and besan mixture after taking the pan off the heat.

- Cook till it comes to a boil and let it further cook for a few more minutes.

- Turn the flame off and let it sit for a few minutes. It will thicken slightly.

- Serve hot garnished with some chopped green chillies.

name: Green Gram Brinjal Dal
ingredients:
- 30 gm green gram dal

- 100 gms brinjal

- 20 gm onion

- 30 gm tomato

- ½ tsp ginger garlic paste

- pinch of turmeric

- pinch of asafoetida

- coriander leaves

- salt

- ½ tsp oil
method:
- Pressure cook dal with salt and turmeric for 3 whistles. Keep it aside once cooked.

- Heat oil in a pan, add jeera and then onion. Saute it till it becomes golden brown.

- Add chopped tomatoes, ginger garlic paste, red chilli powder and saute till the water from tomatoes loosen up.

- Add dry spices to it and cook for 2 minutes more.

- Add chopped brinjal along with half cup water and mix it well, cover the pan and let it cook.

- Once cooked add cooked green gram dal and mix well.

- Let it simmer for 2-3 minutes.

- Add coriander leaves and serve it.

name: Dahi Chicken
ingredients:
- 100 gms chicken

- 100 gm curd

- 1 tsp ginger garlic paste

- 20 gms Onion

- 50 gms tomatoes

- ½ tsp turmeric powder

- 1 green chilli

- ½ tsp red chilli powder

- 1 tsp chicken masala

- ¼ tsp kasuri methi

- ½ tsp oil

- salt to taste
method:
- Take curd, add cumin powder, red chilli powder, ginger garlic paste, chicken powder and turmeric. Mix it, add washed chicken in it and marinate it for a minimum of 1 hour.

- Heat oil in a pan, add bayleaf and jeera, add chopped onions and saute it till it becomes golden brown.

- Add tomatoes and salt and cook it till the water from tomates loosen up.

- Now add marinated chicken and cook it for 5 -10 minutes till tge chicken turns soft.

- Lower the flame, cover it and cook for 15 minutes.

- Sprinkle some kasuri methi and serve.

name: Vegetable Open Toast With Hummus
ingredients:
- ½ tsp sesame seeds

- 15 gms chickpeas

- a clove of garlic

- ½ tsp olive oil

- 30 gms green capsicum

- 30 gms cabbage

- 20 gms cucumber

- ½ tsp lemon juice

- ½ tsp cumin powder

- 2 whole wheat bread

- salt to taste

- black pepper
method:
For hummus

- Soak chickpeas in water for 8 hours.

- Add the soaked chickpeas in a pressure cooker with water, salt .Pressure cook on medium flame for 15- 20minutes.

- Heat a pan, roast white sesame seeds till they crackle and become crisp.

- Mash the cooked chickpeas with a spoon.

- In a mixer grinder, grind the sesame seeds till it becomes fine.

- Add chopped garlic to it, lemon juice, cumin powder and olive oil to it.

- Sprinkle salt as per the taste and grind it.

- Next add cooked and mashed chickpeas and grind till smooth.

- If required, add 2-3 tbsp water.

- Sprinkle some paprika powder.

For open toast

- Take hummus in a small bowl and add all the chopped veggies in it. And spread it on a Bread slice, sprinkle some black pepper powder.

- Ready to serve.

name: Chana Dal Lemon Rice
ingredients:
- 3 cups cooked rice (i used left over rice )

- 1 onion chopped

- 10-12 curry patta leaves

- 2 tbsp of finely chopped coriander leaves

- few slitted green chillies as per taste

- Juice of 1 lemon (or according to personal choice )

- ½ tsp black mustard seeds

- 2 tsp raw urad dal

- 2 tsp of raw channa dal

- 2 tbsp of grated fresh coconut

- 2 tbsp of refined oil

- salt to taste

- ¼ tsp turmeric powder
method:
- Put oil in a kadhai and let it warm a little.

- Put the mustard seeds .

- Then in few seconds add the raw urad dal and channa dal .

- Stir for few seconds .

- Then add the chopped onions and curry patta .

- Stir for few minutes till onion becomes a little translucent.

- Now add the slitted green chillies.

- Stir for few seconds.

- Now add the sliited green chillies and the chopped coriander leaves .

- Stir for few seconds .

- Now add the turmeric powder and the grated coconut .

- Stir for few seconds.

- Now add the cooked rice and salt and mix it in well.

- When the rice has been throughly mixed with the masala.

- Now add the lemon juice spreading it all over the rice.

- Mix well and stir for few minutes .

- Done .

Note
If you like can add 2 tbsp of raw peanuts ,which will have to be added with the urad and channa dal .

name: Bhindi Rice
ingredients:
- 30g Rice

- 100g okra/ lady's finger/ bhindi

- 20g onion

- ½ tsp chopped ginger

- ½ tsp chopped garlic

- ½ tsp fennel seeds

- 1 green cardamom

- 2 cloves

- ½ inch cinnamon

- ½ tsp mustard seeds

- ½ tsp whole cumin seeds

- 1 bay leaf

- 4-5 curry leaves

- 2 chopped green chilli

- ½ tsp salt

- ½ tsp oil
method:
- Rinse rice first very well in water. Then soak for 30 minutes. After 30 minutes, drain all the water from the rice. Keep the rice aside.

- Rinse okra in water. Wipe them dry and then chop them in 1 to 1.5 cm roundels. Keep aside. (Note: Use the okra that is fresh and tender. Avoid using stringy or dense okra) On full flame, heat water in a pan. Add whole cumin seeds, bay leaf and salt into the water.

- Bring the water to a boil.

- Then add the rice and lightly stir. do not reduce the flame.

- Cook the rice till it’s completely done. Do not cover the pan with a lid while cooking rice.

- The rice has to be completely cooked.

- Strain in a colander. Keep the cooked rice aside.

- In a mortar-pestle/ mixer, add chopped garlic, ginger, cloves, cinnamon, fennel seeds, cardamom and cloves.

- Crush to a semi-fine paste.

- In a kadai or pan, heat oil. Keep the heat low to medium. Add mustard seeds and let them crackle.

- Then add chopped onions and stir them, until they turn translucent.

- Now add the crushed semi-fine paste.

- Next add curry leaves and 2 green chilli, chopped.

- Stir and saute till the raw aroma of ginger-garlic goes away.

- Now add turmeric powder and red chilli powder. Quickly stir.

- Immediately add the chopped okra.

- Lightly mix with the rest of the ingredients.

- Add salt and mix everything very well.

- Without covering with a lid, on a low flame to medium flame, saute the okra. Stir at intervals. Also do not add any water. Regulate flame as required.

- Stir often and saute till the okra is cooked well.

- Now add the rice in parts to the okra.

- The cooked rice has to be warm or at room temperature when you add it to the okra.

- Mix the rice with the okra very well. Switch off the flame.

- Serve okra rice hot or warm accompanied with a vegetable salad, raita or curd.

name: Chicken Curry
ingredients:
- 100g chicken

- 25g onion

- 50g tomato

- 1 tbsp ginger-garlic paste

- 1 tbsp chopped coriander leaves

- 1 tsp chilli powder

- ½ tsp turmeric powder

- 1 tsp dhania powder

- 2 chopped green chillies

- ½ tsp whole cumin seeds

- 1 tsp salt

- 1 cardamom

- 1 cinnamon stick

- 1 bay leaf

- 1 tsp oil
method:
- Add roughly chopped onion, tomato, green chilli and coriander leaves into the mixer and grind it into a smooth paste.

- In a pan/kadai add oil, then add bay leaf, cardamom, cinnamon stick and whole cumin seeds, and ginger-garlic paste, after the seeds splutter, add the grinded mixture into it.

- Then add chilli powder, turmeric powder, dhania powder and salt to the mixture and mix well and cook for 10 minutes.

- Then add the pieces of chicken to it, mix well and close it with a lid and let it cook for 10 minutes.

- Take off the lid and cook for another 30 minutes.

- Garnish it with coriander leaves and serve.

name: Mooli Paratha
ingredients:
- 30g wheat flour

- 50g mooli

- ¼ tsp red chilli powder

- ¼ tsp coriander powder

- pinch of haldi

- ¼ tsp amchur powder

- 1 grated garlic

- ½ inch grated ginger

- Pinch of chat masala

- 1 finely chopped green chilli

- 1 tsp finely chopped coriander

- salt to taste

- 1 tsp oil

- water for kneading dough
method:
- Take a bowl add wheat flour, pinch of salt and water as required to knead the dough once soft dough is prepared keep it aside for rest

- Wash and peel radish and grate it in a bowl and squeeze it to ooze out the excess water in it and then add red chilli powder, coriander powder, turmeric powder, amchur powder, grated ginger and garlic, chat masala, salt, finely chopped green chilli, coriander and mix all the ingredients well

- Now take the prepared dough and divide it into two halves and roll it out into 2 thin roti, place 1 roti and spread the radish filling even on the roti and top it with the other roti and roll it once to make it even

- Heat tava and apply some oil and cook the roti well on both the sides serve hot with chapata curd

name: Lasuni Dal Palak
ingredients:
- 20g toor dal

- 50g finely chopped spinach

- 1 medium size tomato

- 5-6 cloves of garlic

- ¼ tsp cumin seeds

- pinch of turmeric

- ¼ tsp red chilli powder

- ¼ tsp coriander powder

- ¼ tsp mustard seeds

- 1 inch dry red chilli

- 1 finely chopped green chilli

- 50g onion

- 1 tsp oil

- pinch of asafoetida

- water for cooking

- salt to taste
method:
- Wash and soak toor dal for ½ an hour.

- Heat water in a pressure cooker add the toor dal, chopped tomato, finely chopped spinach, 3 garlic cloves, pinch of turmeric, salt and close the lid and allow it to cook for 1 whistle and turn of the flame.

- Heat oil in a kadai add mustard seeds and allow it to crackle and then add cumin seeds, dry red chilli and fry it for a while, now add finely chopped onion, finely chopped green chilli and fry it for a while and then add red chilli powder, coriander powder, asafoetida, garlic cloves and give it a nice mix for tadka and turn of the flame .

- Open the pressure cooker once the pressure it released and then give it a mix and transfer it to a serving bowl and top it with the fried garlic tadka .

name: Soya Biryani
ingredients:
- 30g soya chunks

- ¼ tsp red chilli powder

- ¼ tsp coriander powder

- ¼ tsp turmeric powder

- 30g basmati rice

- 100g onion

- 100g tomato

- ½ tsp ginger garlic paste

- 1 green chilli

- 2 tbsp curd

- ½ tsp garam masala powder

- 1 tbsp fine chopped coriander leaves

- 3-4 mint leaves

- 1 tsp oil

- water for cooking

- salt to taste
method:
- Wash and soak soya chunks in warm water for 1 hour and discard the excess water and then squeeze out the excess water from the soya chunks and then add curd, red chilli powder, coriander powder, turmeric powder, salt and mix all the ingredients and allow it to marinate for an hour.

- Heat oil in a pan add finely chopped onion and saute it well then add ginger garlic paste and mix it well then add tomato and cook it for a while.

- Now add garam masala powder, green chilli, salt and cook for a while .

- Then add marinated soya chunk and cook it well for a while.

- Finally wash rice and add to the soya broth and then add 100ml water, finely chopped coriander, mint and mix all the ingredients well and close it with a lid and allow it to cook for 10 minutes at low flame .

- Once rice is cooked well transfer to a serving plate and enjoy soya Biryani .

name: Khichdi
ingredients:
- 30g rice

- 15g moong dal

- 5ml ghee

- ¼ tsp turmeric

- 1 tsp whole cumin

- 1 bay leaf

- pinch of hing

- 25g onion (finely chopped)

- 1 tsp ginger garlic paste

- 25g tomato (finely chopped)

- 1 chilli

- salt to taste

- coriander (finely chopped)
method:
- In a large bowl rinse and soak rice, moong dal for 10 minutes and pressure cook the rice and dal

- In a large kadai, heat ghee. add 1 tsp cumin, 1 bay leaf and pinch hing.

- Saute on low flame until the spices turn aromatic.

- Now add onion, 1 tsp ginger garlic paste and saute well.

- Further, add tomato and saute until the tomato turns soft and mushy.

- Keeping the flame on low, add ¼ tsp turmeric, 1 chilli , and salt.

- Saute for 2 minutes or until the spices turn aromatic.

- Now add cooked rice and dal .Also, add water and mix well adjusting consistency as required.

- Cover and simmer for 5 minutes or until the flavours are absorbed well.

- Finally, add 2 tbsp coriander.

name: Oats Ladoo
ingredients:
- 4 crushed almonds

- 3 crushed pistachios

- 3 crushed cashews

- 30g oats

- 5ml ghee

- 5g powdered jaggery

- 1tsp powdered green cardamom
method:
- Dry roast the oats and grind to a coarse powder.

- Dry roast the nuts and grind to a coarse powder. Combine ground nuts and oats in a large bowl.

- Heat ghee in a pan and mix jaggery powder with it. Add the oats and nuts mixture and cook for 2-4 minutes.

- Now let it cool down a bit. Make small laddoos, keep them on a plate and allow them to set.

name: Brinjal Drumstick Sabzi
ingredients:
- brinjal - 100g

- drumstick - 100g

- onion – 25g

- tomato – 25g

- ginger garlic paste- ¼ tsp

- turmeric - ¼ tsp

- tamarind extract - ¼ tsp

- chilli powder- 1 tsp

- salt to taste

- oil - 5 ml

- mustard seeds - ¼ tsp

- urad dal - ¼ tsp

- channa dal - ½ tsp

- hing - pinch

- curry leaves
method:
- Heat a pan with oil, add the mustard and once it sputters,add urad dal and chana dal.add the curry leaves, onion and saute until the onion turns translucent. Add hing.

- Add the tomato, salt and give a quick stir. Add the ginger garlic paste and saute until the tomato turns mushy.

- Now add the brinjal, drumstick and stir until well mixed. Then add tamarind water along with the turmeric and chilli powder, mix well and cook covered in low-medium flame until the water has evaporated. The veggies would be almost done by now. Turn off the flame.

name: Capsicum Mutton Curry
ingredients:
- 100 gm mutton pieces

- 60g Capsicum

- clove, cardamom, cinnamon stick- each 1

- fennel seeds - ½ tsp

- 1 tsp fresh ginger - garlic paste

- 25g onion - sliced

- 25g tomato - sliced

- 1 red chilli

- a pinch turmeric powder

- ½ tsp pepper powder

- 1 tsp or needed salt

- 5ml oil

- few curry and coriander leaves
method:
- Heat oil in a pressure pan, add the crushed clove + cardamom + cinnamon stick.Then, add the sliced onions,ginger-garlic paste,curry leaves and sliced tomatoes.Saute this for 2 more mins.

- Add the mutton pieces and 1 cup water and the mutton masala powder,turmeric powder and salt.

- Mix the pieces well with the spices.Cover and pressure cook for 12 mins on good flame or upto 5 whistles.

- Meanwhile, Saute the Capsicum slices in the oil with a pinch of turmeric, red chillies and a pinch of salt.After stirring it for 2-3 mins add and stir it for a min.

- Then open the Pressure pan lid and add it to the Capsicum pieces and saute it till it becomes dry or semi-dry - adding coriander leaves and 1/2 tsp white pepper powder and stir-cook for 5 more mins on good flame till oil separates on top.

name: Chilli Prawns
ingredients:
- 100g prawns

- 5 ml Oil

- 50g onion

- 2-3 red chillies

- 1 inch Ginger

- 2-3 cloves garlic

- ½ tsp red chilli powder

- salt to taste

- ½ tsp soya sauce

- ½ tsp green chilli sauce
method:
- Clean, wash and marinate the prawns for 30 mins with soya sauce, green chilli sauce and salt.

- Heat a pan, add oil. Once it's hot add the ginger and garlic, saute till golden brown.

- Add onion and chillies and saute.

- Add the marinated prawns and cook on a medium flame.

- Once cooked, serve hot.

name: Carrot Chips
ingredients:
- 200g carrots

- 1tsp oil

- salt to taste

- ¼ teaspoon ground cumin

- ¼ teaspoon ground cinnamon
method:
- Preheat the oven to 425 degrees F. Line several large baking sheets with parchment paper and set aside.

- Trim the carrot tops off. Starting on the thick end, slice the carrots paper-thin on the bias to create elongated slices. You can do this with a chef's knife, but it's better to use a mandolin slicer on the smallest setting. When you get down to the thin end, stop and save them to use in soup or salad.

- Place the carrot slices in a large bowl and add the oil, salt, cumin, and cinnamon. Toss well to thoroughly coat. Then lay the slices in a single layer on the baking sheets.

- Bake for 12-15 minutes, until the edges start to curl up and turn crisp. Then flip all the chips over and bake for another 5-8 minutes to crisp the bottoms. Once cool, store in an airtight container for up to 2 weeks.

name: Dal Pakoda
ingredients:
- 30g moong dal petite yellow lentils

- ¼ tsp ginger

- ½ green chili

- ¼ tsp garam masala

- ¼ turmeric

- salt to taste

- ¼ tsp baking powder

- 1 tsp oil

- water as needed

- 1 tbsp coriander

- 20g finely chopped onion heaped

- 0.5 cloves garlic minced
method:
- Soak the Mung dal in hot water for 15 minutes or 1 hour. Longer works best. Drain and add to the blender. Add ginger, chili, garam masala, turmeric, salt, baking powder, oil and water. Blend to a smooth thick batter. Add more water if needed. Keep the batter thick.

- Add the chopped cilantro, greens, onion and garlic and fold in.

- Make these in aebleskiver/appe pan drop ladleful of batter in a greased pan over medium heat. Cover and cook for 3 to 5 minutes, flip and cook for 2 to 3 minutes.

- Lightly spray oil on top.

- Add a sprinkle of chaat masala on the fritters (optional). Serve with chutneys Mint Cilantro Chutney or tomato chutney or add to kadhi (non dairy yogurt sauce) or curry.

name: Jowar Methi Roti
ingredients:
- 25g Jowar Flour (Sorghum)

- 5g whole wheat Flour

- 20g methi leaves (fenugreek leaves), chopped

- 1 cup lukewarm water

- salt if required

- 1 teaspoon Oil
method:
- To begin making Jowar Methi roti, heat water in a pan and add salt and oil. Mix it well. The water has to be lukewarm to knead the flour.

- In a mixing bowl, add the jowar flour, wheat flour, methi leaves and salt and knead well. Keep adding a little lukewarm water at a time until the dough becomes soft and non-sticky.

- It should be kneaded properly, as we will make the roti immediately without giving any resting time to the dough.

- Keep the dough covered with clean damp cloth so that it does not dry. The next step is to cook the rotis. Keep an iron tawa/griddle on medium flame.

- Dust your rolling surface with little whole wheat flour.

- Now we will start making the rotis using our hands. Divide the portions and roll out a portion of the dough into a round and thick roti using your hands. You can shape the roti by pressing out a circle with your fingers as well.

- Place the roti over the preheated skillet and cook it for a few seconds on one side or till a few bubbles appear on top.

- Turn over the roti and cook the other side for a few more seconds until it's cooked.

name: Paneer Roti
ingredients:
- 20g grated paneer

- 2 tsp chilli powder

- 1 tsp garam masala

- salt

- ½ tsp ginger

- 5g coriander leaves

- 20g wheat flour

- water
method:
- In a bowl add wheat flour, planner, green chillies, ginger, garam masala, chilli powder, salt, coriander leaves.

- Add water kneed well and make a dough and oil and leave for 5-10 minutes.

- Take a small dough and make ball add wheat flour and roll it to round shape.

- Add cook on pan on both sides.

name: Peas Pulao
ingredients:
- 30g rice

- 20g peas

- 50g tomato

- 10g capsicum

- 50g ridge gourd

- 50g onion

- 2 cinnamon

- 1/8 tsp jeera

- 1 clove

- 1tsp chopped coriander

- 2-3 mint leaves

- salt to taste

- 1tsp oil
method:
- Heat the pressure cooker add oil, jeera, cinnamon and cardamom.

- Add onion and cook it for few minutes then add ginger garlic paste, turmeric powder and chilli powder.

- Add all the vegetables and cook for 2minutes.

- Add peas and rice mix well and add salt and water.

- Pressure cook it for 2-3 whistles.

- Serve hot.

name: Palak Kadhi
ingredients:
- 20g gram flour

- 20ml curd

- Water

- 1 tsp Oil

- 1 green chillies

- 20g Palak

- 5g red chillies

- ½ tsp mustard seeds

- ½ tsp Jeera

- 10g onion

- Salt

- ¼ tsp turmeric powder

- 5g ginger
method:
- In grinder add palak and ginger and grind it.

- In a bowl take curd and add the grinded palak.

- In pan add oil, jeera, mustard seeds, red chilli, onion and stir well.

- Then add the curd mixed with palak, salt and turmeric powder.

- Again add the chopped palak to it and cook for few minutes.

- Serve hot.

name: Sarson Ka Saag
ingredients:
- 20g mustard leaves

- 20g spinach

- 5g garlic

- 5g ginger

- 10g onion

- 5g corn meal

- 5 ml ghee

- hing

- salt to taste

- 5g green chillies

- water
method:
- In a pressure cooker add chopped mustard leaves, spinach leaves, ginger, garlic, onion, salt green chillies and add water.

- Cook for four whistles.

- Blend it well to a paste, add corn meal and mix well.

- In a pan add ghee, ginger, garlic, saute well.

- Then add chopped onion, green chillies, saute till it turns golden brown.

- Later transfer the blended paste into the pan, add salt and cook for 5min.

name: Lauki Masala Curry
ingredients:
- 20g bottle guard

- 10g onion

- 1tsp ginger garlic paste

- 1tsp jeera

- salt to taste

- ¼ tsp turmeric powder

- 5g green chillies

- ½ tsp chilli powder

- 1tsp oil

- 1tsp sesame powder

- curry leaves

- 1tsp garam masala

- water

- 5g Coriander leaves

- ½tsp Jeera powder
method:
- In a pan add oil, jeera, onion, green chillies, curry leaves saute well.

- Then add ginger garlic paste, turmeric powder, add chopped bottle guard mix it well.

- Add salt, red chilli powder, mix it and add water allow it to cook for 5-10 minutes.

- Later add sesame powder, garam masala, jeera powder again cook for 5min and add coriander leaves on top.

- Serve hot.

name: Coriander Millet Roti
ingredients:
- 20g bajra

- water

- salt

- ½ tsp turmeric powder

- ½ tsp chilli powder

- ½ tsp black pepper powder

- 5g coriander leaves
method:
- Firstly in a pan add water, salt boil and then add bajra to it and close the lid and heat for 1 minute.

- Stir well the bajra and allow it cool.

- Add coriander, turmeric powder, chilli powder, black pepper powder and knead well and make a soft dough.

- Take a small dough and make it as a ball, add bajra flour and roll it to round.

- Add cook both sides on pan.

name: Rajma Curry
ingredients:
- 20g soaked rajma

- 10g tomato and green chilli paste

- 1tsp oil

- 5g coriander leaves

- ½ tsp cumin powder

- ¼ tsp garam masala

- 2tsp coriander powder

- ½ tsp turmeric powder

- hing

- ½ tsp red chilli powder

- salt to taste

- baking soda
method:
- In a pressure cook add soaked rajma, salt, baking soda, water and close the lid and cook for 1 whistle and after that boil it for 6-7 minutes in the same cooker.

- In a pan heat oil add hing, jeera, turmeric, tomato-green chilli paste, coriander powder, red chilli powder, jeera powder stir it well.

- Add rajma to the masala, then add salt and garam masala, coriander leaves on top.

name: Ridge Gourd Sabzi
ingredients:
- 20g ridge gourd

- ½tsp red chilli powder

- ¼tsp turmeric Powder

- ½tsp garam masala

- salt tp taste

- 1tsp oil

- 10g onion

- ½tsp whole cumin

- 5g green chilli
method:
- In a pan add oil, whole cumin, green chilli, onion, salt saute well till it turns golden brown.

- Add turmeric, garam masala, red chilli powder mix it well.

- Then add ridge gourd and cook till it becomes soft.

- Serve hot.

name: Capsicum Raita
ingredients:
- 5g capsicum

- 5g red chillies

- 10ml curd

- salt to taste

- 1 tsp oil

- ½ tsp whole cumin seeds

- ½ tsp mustard seeds

- 5g green chillies

- ½ tsp grated ginger

- 5g curry leaves
method:
- In a pan add oil, whole cumin seeds, mustard seeds, let it splutter add red chillies, green chillies and stir well.

- Then add curry leaves, ginger, capsicum, salt mix and cook for 5-6 minutes.

- Then add this mixture to a curd.

name: Bathua Paratha
ingredients:
- 20g bathua

- 20g wheat flour

- 1 tsp oil

- 1/ tsp jeera

- hing

- salt

- ½ tsp chilli powder

- 1 green chilli

- 1 chopped ginger
method:
- In a bowl add wheat flour, green chillies, ginger, red chilli powder, jeera, hing, salt and bathua mix well and add oil.

- Add water kneed well and make a dough.

- Take small dough and make a ball, add flour and roll it round.

- Then cook on pan on both sides.

name: Kadhi Chawal
ingredients:
- 1 tsp oil

- 20g gram flour

- 1 onion

- salt to taste

- ½ tsp red chilli powder

- ½ tsp coriander powder

- ½ tsp garam masala

- 5g coriander leaves

- water

- 1 tsp ginger garlic paste

- 1 tsp coriander seeds

- 25ml curd

- ¼ tsp turmeric powder

- 1 tsp kasturi methi

- 1 tsp jeera

- 20g soaked rice
method:
- Firstly in a bowl add besan, onion, salt, red chilli powder, coriander powder, garam masala and add water and mix well.

- In a pan add oil and put a pokara mixture and prepare pokara.

- Next in a pan add oil, ginger garlic paste, coriander seeds roast it well then add chilli powder, salt, turmeric powder, coriander powder and garam masala mix well and roast for a minute.

- Then add a curd mixed with besan add water make a thin consistency.

- After 15 minutes add roasted kasuri methi cook for 10-15 minutes to prepare kadhi.

- In another pan add oil, jeera, rice and water required for cooking of rice, salt cook rice for 10 minutes.

- Later add pokara to the kadhi stir well and cook for a minute.

- Both rice and kadhi are done.

name: Singhara Methi Roti
ingredients:
- 25g singhara

- 10g methi

- salt to taste

- 10g boiled potatoes

- ½ tsp black pepper powder

- 1 chopped green chillies

- 5g coriander leaves

- 1 tsp oil
method:
- In a bowl add singhara, methi, green chillies, black pepper powder, salt, coriander leaves, smashed potatoes and mix well, knead well and make a dough.

- Add oil on the dough and keep for 20 minutes.

- Take some dough and make small ball, add wheat flour and roll it to round shape.

- Cook on pan both sides.

name: Quinoa Paneer With Sauteed Vegetables
ingredients:
- 20g peas

- 15g quinoa

- 5g capsicum

- 5g onion

- 5g carrot

- 5g cauliflower

- ½tsp red chilli powder

- ½tsp cumin powder

- ½tso black pepper powder

- 1tsp oil

- ½tsp turmeric powder

- salt according to taste

- ½tsp whole cumin

- 1/2tsp mustard seeds

- 1 green chillies

- ½ tsp ginger

- 5g coriander leaves

- lemon juice
method:
- Firstly wash the quinoa and add water to it and allow to soak for 20min.

- Then discard the water and boil quinoa with water for 15-20minutes,remove water and leave for 30minuteds.

- Coat the paneer with Turmeric powder, chilli powder and salt.

- Heat the oil on a pan and roast the paneer on both sides till it turns golden brown and transfer it to a plate.

- In the same pan add cumin seeds, mustard seeds saute it, then add onion, green chilli, ginger and all the vegetables mix it well.

- Then add pepper powder, turmeric powder, salt, quinoa and cook for 5minutes, then add coriander leaves and lemon juice mix well.

- Transfer it to a plate and add roasted paneer to it.

name: Millet Chilla
ingredients:
- 20g gram flour

- 20g bajra flour

- 10g chopped onions

- 10g chopped tomatoes

- ½ tsp chopped ginger

- ½ tsp chopped coriander leaves

- 1 chopped green chilies

- ½ tsp carom seeds

- 5g curd

- 1tsp oil

- salt to taste
method:
Making the batter

- Take a big bowl add gram flour, bajra flour, carom seeds, all the vegetables and Mix well, so all the flour is coated to veggies.

- Then mix in curd. Add little water at a time and make lump free batter.

- Batter should be runny, adjust the water to get right consistency of batter, also do a taste test to check salt.

- Heat the pan or tawa on medium heat. Once hot drizzle about a tsp of oil and let it get heat up.

- Once oil is hot, pour the ladleful of batter and spread it to make round shape pancake.

- Let the cheela gets cook on one side about 2 minutes or till gets golden brown.

- Drizzle some oil on top (optional) and then flip it using spatula.

- Cook other side for 1-2 minutes.

- Once both sides are cooked, remove it to plate and serve.

name: Paneer Cutlet
ingredients:
- 20g grated paneer

- 10g smashed potatoes

- 10g onion

- 5g carrot

- 5g capsicum

- 5g Green chillies

- 5g Coriander leaves

- ½ tsp chat masala

- ½ tsp garam masala

- 5g corn flour

- salt to taste

- 5g gram flour

- bread crumbs

- 1tsp oil
method:
- Firstly heat the pan with oil, add onion, carrot, capsicum, green chillies cook lightly and allow to cool.

- Then in a bowl add panner, smashed potato, coriander , corn flour, add cooked vegetables, salt, garam masala, chat masala and mix well.

- Then make a round cutlet.

- Then in a bowl prepare a binding of gram flour and water and dip the cutlet in it and bread crumbs.

- Then on pan cook the cutlet on both sides till it turns golden brown.

name: Mix Veg Sabzi
ingredients:
- 5g chopped potato

- 5g carrot

- 5g capsicum

- 5g cauliflower

- 5g beans

- 5g peas

- ½ tsp ginger

- 5g green chilli

- ½ tsp garlic

- 10g onion

- 10g tomato

- 1 tsp oil

- ½ tsp whole cumin

- ¼ tsp turmeric powder

- 1 tsp red chilli powder

- ½ tsp cumin powder

- ½ tsp coriander powder

- ½ tsp garam masala

- salt
method:
- In a pan add oil, ginger, garlic, onion, green chilli mix well and fry for half minute.

- Add tomato cook till it becomes soft, allow it to cool and grind it.

- Again add oil in a pan, jeera and add all the vegetables and cook for 4-5 minutes.

- Then add the blended paste, mix it well, then add chilli powder, turmeric, jeera powder, coriander powder mix it.

- Cook for 2-3 minutes and add water, salt, garam masala mix it well and cook for a minute.

- Serve hot.

name: Kodo Millet Dosa
ingredients:
- 25g kodo millet

- 10g urad dal

- 1 tsp fenugreek seeds

- water

- 25g boiled rice

- salt

- baking soda
method:
- In a bowl add kodo millet, fenugreek seeds, and wash with water twice-thrice.

- Discard the water and again add water and soak for 6 hours.

- After soaking for 6 hours add rice and mix well.

- Then grind it smoothly and prepare a dosa batter.

- Add salt and baking soda mix well ferment for overnight.

- Next day pour the batter on pan and spread gently and sprinkle oil on top.

- Cook till it turns golden brown.

name: Veg Momos With Paneer
ingredients:
for dough

- 20g wheat flour

- water as required

- salt

for stuffing

- 1 tsp oil

- 2 garlic clove finely chopped

- 1 inch ginger finely chopped

- 1 green chilli finely chopped

- ½ tsp pepper crushed

- 5g onion finely chopped

- 5g spring onion finely chopped

- 5g cabbage finely chopped

- 15g grated paneer

- salt to taste
method:
Momos dough preparation

- Firstly, take a large mixing bowl take wheat flour and salt.

- Add water and knead the dough

- Knead to a smooth and soft dough adding water as required.

- Cover the dough and rest for 20 minutes.

Paneer momos stuffing preparation

- Prepare the stuffing by heating oil and sauté garlic, ginger and 1 chilli.

- Also, add spring onion and sauté well.

- Further, add onion and sauté until onions shrink slightly.Now add cabbage. sauté until cabbage shrink slightly.

- Also add paneer, crushed pepper, salt to taste and sauté well.

- Mix until the paneer and spices are well combined. Allow the stuffing to cool completely.

paneer momos shaping

- Firstly, knead the dough again slightly and pinch a small ball sized dough. Dust with wheat flour and roll thin.

- Place a tbsp of prepared paneer stuffing in centre.

- Start pleating from one side.

- Pleat until you reach ¾ of the circle.

- Now seal the pleated part with other part and secure tight.

- Heat a steamer and arrange the momos in the tray without touching each other.

- Furthermore, steam momos for 12-15 minutes or till shiny sheen appears over it.

- Finally, paneer momos recipe is ready to enjoy with momos chutney.

name: Rajma Taco With Cabbage And Capsicum
ingredients:
- 10g cabbage

- 10g capsicum

- 10g tomato

- 10g onion

- 5g green chillies

- 5g coriander leaves

- ¼ tsp chilli flakes

- ¼ tsp black pepper powder

- salt

- ½ tsp red chilli powder

- 1 tsp lemon juice

- green chutney

- 5ml curd

- 15g wheat flour

- 10g corn flour

- 1 tsp oil

- water

- ½ tsp

- ½ tsp ginger garlic paste

- ¼ tsp turmeric powder

- ½ tsp coriander powder

- ½ tsp garam masala

- 20g rajma
method:
- In a bowl add onion, tomato, cabbage, capsicum, chilli flakes, salt, black pepper powder, red chilli powder, lemon juice mix well and prepare a salad.

- To prepare a chutney add curd and green chutney in a bowl and mix well.

- In another bowl add wheat flour, corn flour, salt, little oil and mix it well.

- Then add water and make a dough and leave for 20 minutes.

- For stuffing in a pan add oil, onion add saute it, add tomato, green chilli, ginger garlic paste saute well till tomato becomes soft.

- Later add turmeric, chilli powder, coriander powder, garam masala, salt , boiled and smashed rajma, lemon juice and coriander leaves mix well.

- After 20 minutes knead the dough and take a small a ball and make a roti and cut into 3 small circle roti and prick with forks.

- In a pan add oil and prepare tacos.

- Then for stuffing, add rajma stuff, chutney, salad.

name: Spinach Chilli Chicken
ingredients:
- ½ kg chicken (to be marinated with 2 tsp cornflour and pinch if salt and pepper .Then put in an air fryer and cook till done or put 1 1/2 tbsp of oil in a pan or kadhai add the chicken and cook on slow flame till done .Keep the chicken aside .

- ½ kg spinach
(wash and cut the bottom part of the stem .Blanch the spinach by placing the cut spinach in a
pan and place on low flame ,cover the pan ,cook for 2 minutes turn the spinach and keep for a minute or so .Remove from flame and keep aside .When the spinach cools down put it in a grinder add 2 tsp chopped coriander leaves and few green chillies according to taste and grind to a paste. Keep aside when done )

For the final cooking

- 1 ½ tbsp of oil

- 1 tsp ginger paste

- 1 tsp garlic paste

- few slit green chillies

- 2 medium size onions cut into 4 pieces and opened .

- salt to taste

- ¼ tsp pepper

- 1 tsp tomato sauce

- 1 ½ -2 tsp light soya sauce

- ½ tsp sugar
method:
- Add the the oil in the same pan in which the chicken was cooked . When the oil is warm

- Add the ginger garlic paste. Saute for few minutes till raw smell goes.

- Add few slit green chillies as per taste. Stir fry for few seconds

- Add the ground spinach. Stir fry for few seconds.

- Add the onions. Stir fry for few seconds .

- Add pepper and stir fry for few seconds .

- Add the tomato sauce. And stir for few seconds .

- Add the cooked chicken and the light soya sauce. Stir fry for few seconds .

- Add sugar and mix it in.

- Check for salt add according to taste.Stir fry for few seconds .
Done

Note

The cooking has to be done on medium to low flame .

name: Purple Potato Soup
categories: Sim's Family Recipes, Lunch, Dinner, Evening Snack, Rainbow Week
ingredients:
- 4–5 cups medium-sized purple cauliflower florets

- 2 cups purple sweet potato, peeled and chopped (or purple potatoes)

- 2 large purple carrots, peeled and chopped

- ½ small purple onion, peeled and chopped

- 4–6 cloves garlic, peeled and chopped

- 1.5 litre low-sodium chicken or vegetable broth

- salt and pepper to taste

- ¼ teaspoon ground cloves

- ¼ cup low-fat cream

- swirl of olive oil

- chopped thyme for garnish
method:
- Rinse all the vegetables.

- Place cauliflower, sweet potato, carrots, onion, and garlic in an 8-quart
stock pot. Add the low-sodium broth.

- Bring the broth and vegetables to a boil and reduce heat to medium.
Simmer until potatoes and carrots are soft, approximately 10–20 minutes.
Once potatoes and carrots are soft, remove from heat and allow to cool
completely to room temperature.

- Pour the cooled mixture into a high-powered blender and puree until
smooth and creamy. If you have an immersion blender, you can blend it
right in the pot.

- Pour the soup back into the original pot and add salt, pepper, and
cloves.

- Swirl in cream and reheat to serve.

- Serve hot with chopped thyme leaves or a swirl of olive oil.

Note

- For a lower-sodium version, use water instead of broth.

name: Overnight Dessert Oats
ingredients:
- 2 tablespoons quaker oats

- 6 tablespoons of yogurt

- ½ tsp cinnamon powder/vanilla powder

- 1 tsp flaxseed powder (optional)
method:
- Mix all the ingredients together. The yogurt mixture should be runny like a thin milkshake.
Layer in a glass alternating the yogurt mixture with layers of fruit. Top with fruits and chopped nuts or granola(Or just add yogurt mixture to glass a d top with fruit).

- Store overnight in the fridge.

Fruit

- One small banana + half an apple chopped small

- One small banana + half a mango

Notes

- Other combinations could be adding cocoa powder to the yogurt or coffee
Variations chocolate banana
Coffee choco almond
Vanilla strawberry white chocolate
Vanilla and mixed berries.

- Can also do one tablespoon of oats + one tablespoon of chia seeds.
However chia seeds should be consumed in moderation by people who are on bp meds.

name: Eggplant Lasagna
categories: Rainbow Week, Dinner, Lunch, Sim's Family Recipes
ingredients:
Lasagna

- 2 medium-sized eggplants, cut into rounds or strips

- 1 teaspoon olive oil

- 1 tablespoon Italian seasoning

- ½ cup reduced-fat mozzarella cheese

- black pepper, chilli flakes to taste

- nonstick cooking spray (optional)

- ¼ cup fresh basil, chopped (optional)

Sauce

- 2 tablespoon low-sugar marinara sauce

- ⅓ cup mushrooms, diced

- 1 small sweet onion, diced

Topping

- ¼ cup low-fat parmesan cheese

- ¼ cup almond flour
method:
- Rinse all the vegetables and preheat oven to 400 F.

- Cover two baking sheets with foil, spray with nonstick cooking spray.

- Remove the ends of the eggplants (you do not need to peel the
eggplant) and cut into rounds or long strips.

- Place the eggplant on the baking sheets and brush with olive oil.

- Sprinkle with Italian seasoning and black pepper. Bake 20–25 minutes.

- In a saute pan, add the mushrooms and onions and cook until the onions
are just beginning to get soft.

- Put the marinara sauce into a medium-size bowl. Mix the mushrooms
and onions into the marinara sauce.

- Spray an 8 x 8 glass baking dish with cooking spray. Add ⅓ of the
marinara sauce and vegetables mixture to the bottom of the pan. Add a layer of
eggplant rounds or strips to cover. Sprinkle with ½ the mozzarella cheese.
Add another layer of sauce and eggplant then, another layer of sauce and
mozzarella.

- In a small bowl, mix together Parmesan cheese and almond flour.

- Sprinkle over top of lasagna.

- Cover the baking dish with foil and bake for 20 minutes until cheese is
browned or top begins to crisp.

- Serve with fresh basil.

Note

Press eggplant strips with paper towel to remove excess moisture.

name: Purple Sandwich
categories: Rainbow Week, Sim's Family Recipes, Lunch, Dinner
ingredients:
- 1.5 tablespoon canola oil

- 1 ½ tablespoons ground cumin

- salt to taste

- freshly ground pepper

- 2 medium eggplants, sliced crosswise ¼ inch thick

- 1 avocado

- 1 tablespoon fresh lime juice

- 4 wheat breads, toasted

- shredded cabbage, cilantro leaves and pickled jalapeños and carrots, for serving
method:
- Heat a grill pan. In a large bowl, whisk the oil with the cumin and season with salt and pepper.

- Add the eggplants to the bowl and toss to evenly coat. Working in batches, grill the eggplants over moderate heat, turning, until tender, about 5 minutes per batch.

- In a small bowl, mash the avocado with the lime juice. Spread the mashed avocado on the bottom buns.

- Top with the eggplants, cabbage, cilantro and pickled jalapeños and carrots, close the buns and serve.

name: Brinjal Chutney
ingredients:
- 1 medium size brinjal

- 1 medium size tomato

- 1 green chilli

- 2 garlic cloves

- ¼ tsp roasted cumin powder

- ¼ tsp garam masala powder

- 1 tsp coriander

- ½ tsp oil

- salt to taste
method:
- Wash and clean brinjal, tomato, green chilli and garlic cloves.

- Apply oil on all the vegetables.

- Turn on the stove to low flame and place a grill pan or grill tray on the flame and place all the vegetables.

- Grill the vegetables on all the sides and once it's done turn off the flame and allow it to cool down.

- Once it's at room temperature peel off the skin from brinjal and tomato.

- Take a masher and mash brinjal, tomato, green chilli, garlic and make a thick paste.

- Add cumin seed power, garam masala powder, salt and brinjal chutney is ready to serve.

name: Lobia Brinjal Curry
ingredients:
- 15g white cowpea

- 100g brinjal

- 100g tomato

- 50g onion

- 1 green chilli

- ¼ tsp red chilli powder

- ¼ tsp coriander powder

- ¼ tsp turmeric powder

- ¼ tsp whole cumin seeds

- ¼ tsp fenugreek seeds

- ¼ tsp mustard seeds

- 2 garlic cloves

- 4-5 curry leaves

- ½ inch tamarind

- salt to taste

- 1 tsp oil

- water for cooking
method:
- Soak white cowpea for 2-3 hours, and pressure cook it for upto 3-4 whistles, turn off the flame and keep it aside.

- Soak tamarind in water for 10 minutes.

- Add chopped onion, tomato soaked tamarind in a blender and blend it well to make it a puree.

- Heat oil in a vok add mustard seeds, whole cumin seeds, fenugreek seeds and allow them to splutter, now add finely chopped garlic cloves, curry leaves and saute for a while.

- Then add onion, tomato, tamarind puree, green chilli, red chilli powder, coriander powder, turmeric powder, salt, some water and allow it to cook.

- Now add sliced brinjal and cook for 5 minutes until the brinjal becomes soft.

- Finally add cooked cowpea and mix all the ingredients well.

- Cook for 6-7 minutes at low flame.

- Enjoy lobia Brinjal curry with rice.

name: Scrambled Egg Roll
ingredients:
- 1 egg

- 30g wheat flour

- 50g finely chopped tomato

- 50g finely chopped onion

- 1 finely chopped green chilli

- pinch of black pepper powder

- pinch of garam masala

- pinch of red chilli flakes

- salt to taste

- 1 tsp oil

- water for cooking
method:
- Take a bowl add wheat flour, pinch of salt and water as required to knead a soft dough.

- Once the dough is ready keep it aside for 10 minutes.

- Then roll it out into a roti.

- Heat a pan and cook roti on both the sides and keep it aside.

- Now take another Bowl add 1 whole egg, whisk it well, add a pinch of salt, finely chopped tomato, onion and green chilli.

- Heat oil in a pan transfer the egg and veggies mixture to the pan and give it a nice whisk on the pan so it's scrambled well.

- Cook for a while and turn off the flame.

- Place the pre prepared roti and in between the roti add the scrambled egg and veggies mixture, sprinkle red chilli flakes, black pepper powder, garam masala, add some more finely chopped tomato and green chilli.

- Finally wrap the roti with scrambled egg-vegetables and divide it into 2 halves and serve it.

name: Roasted Poha
ingredients:
Ingredients

- 30g poha

- 1 tsp pumpkin seeds

- 1 tsp sunflower seeds

- 3 cashew nuts

- 1 tsp ghee

- ¼ tsp mustard seeds

- pinch of turmeric powder

- salt to taste

Ingredients

- Heat a pan add poha, pumpkin seeds, sunflower seeds, cashew nuts and dry roast for 2 minutes and turn off the flame.

- Transfer the roasted ingredients to a plate.

- Heat ghee in the same pan and then add mustard seeds and allow it to crackle and then add pinch of turmeric and salt .

- Now add the dry roasted ingredients and saute well for a while.

- Enjoy roasted poha.
full_text:
Ingredients

- 30g poha

- 1 tsp pumpkin seeds

- 1 tsp sunflower seeds

- 3 cashew nuts

- 1 tsp ghee

- ¼ tsp mustard seeds

- pinch of turmeric powder

- salt to taste

Ingredients

- Heat a pan add poha, pumpkin seeds, sunflower seeds, cashew nuts and dry roast for 2 minutes and turn off the flame.

- Transfer the roasted ingredients to a plate.

- Heat ghee in the same pan and then add mustard seeds and allow it to crackle and then add pinch of turmeric and salt .

- Now add the dry roasted ingredients and saute well for a while.

- Enjoy roasted poha.

name: Tomato Poha
ingredients:
- 30 grams poha / beaten rice / avalakki, thick variety must

- 20 grams onion, chopped

- 25 grams tomatoes, finely chopped

- 2-3 no green chilli, slit

- 2-3 cloves garlic, finely chopped

- 1 small piece ginger, finely chopped

- 1/2 tsp turmeric powder /haldi

- 1 tsp red chilli powder

- 1/2 tsp garam Masala powder

- few pudina / mint leaves, optional

- few coriander leaves, finely chopped

- salt to taste

To temper

- 3-4 tsp oil

- 1 bay leaf / tej patta

- 1/2 tsp fennel seeds saunf

- 1 tsp whole cumin seeds / jeera
method:
- Wash the poha in water and drain it using a strainer and keep aside.

- Heat oil in a kadai. Add bay leaf, saunf and jeera . Let it crackle.

- Add chopped onion, ginger garlic, green chilli and green peas. Saute for 2-3 minutes till raw smell goes.

- Add in chopped tomatoes, saute till it becomes mushy. Add little salt while sauteing .. speeds up the process of cooking.

- Once the tomatoes are mushy, Add few pudina leaves, haldi, salt, red chilli powder and garam masala powder. Saute for a minute.

- Add in the drained poha and mix everything gently.

- Sprinkle little water, cover it with a lid and let it cook for 5-10 minutes or until the poha is cooked completely. Once done, garnish with coriander leaves, mix well and turn off the heat.

- Enjoy the tomato poha hot as such or with raita.

name: Kadhi
ingredients:
- 15g besan flour

- ½ tsp turmeric

- 1 tsp kashmiri red chilli powder

- ¼ tsp ajwain

- ½ tbsp ginger garlic paste

- 1 tsp salt

- 100g cup curd

- 5ml oil

- ½ tsp methi / fenugreek

- 1 tsp whole cumin / jeera

- ½ tsp pepper

- 1 tsp coriander seeds

- 1 dried red chilli

- pinch of hing

- 25g onion

- 1 chilli (slit)

- coriander (finely chopped)
method:
- In a large bowl take 15g besan, ½ tsp turmeric, 1 tsp chilli powder, ¼ tsp ajwain, ½ tbsp ginger garlic paste, salt and curd, mix well forming a smooth paste.

- To this, add water and mix well, keep aside.

- In a large kadai, heat oil and add ½ tsp methi, 1 tsp whole cumin, ½ tsp pepper, 1 tsp coriander seeds, 1 dried red chilli and pinch hing.

- Splutter the tempering without burning the spices. Add onion, chilli and saute until onions soften.

- Further, add prepared besan-curd mixture and mix well, keep stirring until the mixture comes to a boil.

- Now half cover the kadai and simmer for 30 minutes, stir in between to prevent from burning.

- Add water as required and adjust the consistency. Kadhi is ready to serve.

name: Clear Veg Soup
ingredients:
- 5ml oil

- 2 cloves garlic (finely chopped)

- 1/2 inch ginger (chopped)

- 20g spring onions (finely chopped)

- 25g carrots (thinly sliced)

- 25g cabbage (roughly chopped)

- 25g beans

- 25g cauliflower

- 15g baby corn

- coriander leaves few

- salt to taste

- 1 tsp pepper (crushed)

- 1 tbsp lemon juice
method:
- In a pan heat oil, saute garlic and ginger on high flame for a minute.

- To this, add spring onions and continue to saute. Alternatively use onions, if you do not have spring onions.

- Now add cauliflower and continue to saute for 2 minutes.

- Add vegetables and add salt and saute on high flame for 2 minutes.

- Now add water. Get the soup to boil for 10 minutes or till vegetables are partially cooked, add pepper and mix well.

- Simmer for 5 minutes adjusting the desired consistency.

- Serve the clear veg soup, after adding few drops of lemon.

name: Grated Cauliflower Rice With Poached Egg
ingredients:
- 5ml oil

- 1 tsp whole cumin seeds

- curry leaves

- 1 green chilli

- 25g onion
