- 100g cauliflower

- salt

- ¼ tsp turmeric

- ½ tsp kashmiri red chilli powder

- ¼ tsp garam masala

- 30g rice

- few coriander leaves

- egg for poaching
method:
- In a large kadai heat oil add 1 tsp wholecumin and few curry leaves. Additionally, saute 1 green chilli and onion until the onions turn translucent.

- Add grated cabbage, ¼ tsp salt and saute 3 minutes or until it cooks well.

- Also add ¼ tsp turmeric, chilli powder and tsp garam masala. saute on low flame till spices turn aromatic. add cooked rice, ¼ tsp salt and mix gently.cover and simmer for 3 minutes or till rice absorbs spices.

- Now, add coriander leaves. Mix well.

Poached egg

- Pour boiling water into a shallow pan or frying pan, bring back to the boil then reduce to a simmer.

- Crack each egg into a cup, then gently dip, simmer for 2 minutes.

- Carefully remove the poached egg with a slotted spoon and serve immediately.

name: Paneer Shawarma
ingredients:
- 100g paneer

- ½ tbsp ground cumin

- ¼ tbsp turmeric powder

- ½ tbsp ground coriander

- ½ tbsp garlic and ginger paste

- ½ tsp pepper

- 25g large onion, thinly sliced

- 25g tomato

- ½ large lemon juice

- 5ml oil

For pita bread

- water

- yeast

- pinch sugar

- whole wheat flour 30g

- salt
method:
- Knead flour with yeast salt, pinch sugar with required water and set aside for 1 hour then make a dough and cook in the pan.

- In a small bowl, mix the whole cumin, turmeric, coriander, garlic and ginger and paste and pepper. Marinate paneer and season with salt and set aside.

- Grill the paneer and then toss with onion, tomato.

- Spread the paneer with the onions, tomato in Pita Bread and spread yogurt sauce or tahini. Roll it and serve.

name: Mooli Raita
ingredients:
- 100g curd

- 100g radish thinly sliced

- ¼ teaspoon Red Chilli powder

- 1 teaspoon cumin powder (Jeera)

- 1 green Chilli , finely chopped

- coriander Leaves

- salt
method:
- Whisk the yogurt in a bowl until smooth.

- Add the remaining ingredients (raddish, red chilli powder, cumin powder, green chillies, coriander leaves and salt ) to the yogurt and whisk well.

- Check the salt and spices and adjust to suit your taste. Serve chilled.

name: Cabbage Rice
ingredients:
- 30g rice

- 5ml oil

- ¼ mustard seeds

- 1 tsp whole cumin seeds

- curry leaves

- 1 green chilli

- 25g onion

- 20g capsicum

- 100g cabbage

- salt

- ¼ tsp turmeric

- ½ tsp kashmiri red chilli powder

- ¼ tsp garam masala

- few coriander leaves
method:
- In a large kadai heat oil and splutter mustard seeds, 1 tsp whole cumin and few curry leaves. Additionally, saute 1 green chilli and onion until the onions turn translucent.

- Add capsicum. Saute and cook well.

- Now add finely chopped cabbage, ¼ tsp salt and saute 3 minutes or until it cooks well.

- Also add ¼ tsp turmeric, chilli powder and tsp garam masala, saute on low flame till spices turn aromatic.

- Now, add cooked rice, ¼ tsp salt and mix gently. Cover and simmer for 3 minutes or till rice absorbs spices.

- Finally, add coriander leaves. Mix well.

name: Chickpea Stir Fry
ingredients:
For the sauce

- 1 tsp oil

- 1 tsp soy sauce

- water as required

- ½ tsp sesame seeds

- ½ tsp ginger, fresh; minced

- ¼ tsp chili sauce

For stir fry

- 30g chickpeas

- 1 tsp oil

- 20g onion

- 0.5 cloves garlic, chopped

- 20g spring onion

- 15g capsicum

- coriander

- salt to taste
method:
- Place chickpeas in water in a pot and bring to boil. Boil for 2 minutes, turn off heat, cover and let stand for 1 hour. Keep beans covered and cook over low flame until desired tenderness is reached. Drain and keep aside.

- In a small bowl, whisk together the oil, soy sauce, water, sesame seeds, ginger, chilli sauce and set aside.

- In a large pan or wok, heat the oil over medium high heat. Add chopped garlic and cook for about 1 minute.

- Add all vegetables except the chickpeas and cook 3 minutes over medium high heat. Add the sauce and stir-fry until the sauce glazes the vegetables and until vegetables are just tender but still crisp, about 4-5 minutes.

- Remove the pan from the heat and stir in the chickpeas and basil.Serve and enjoy!

name: Kheema With Vegetables
ingredients:
- 100g mutton kheema

- 3 garlic cloves

- 1 green chilli

- 1 tsp coriander leaves

- ¼ tsp garam masala

- ¼ tsp coriander powder

- pinch of turmeric powder

- pinch of red chilli powder

- 50g finely chopped onion

- 50g finely chopped capsicum

- salt to taste

- 1 tsp ghee

- 1 cup water

- 1 tsp steamed sweet corn (optional)
method:
- Take a blending jar, add minced mutton, garlic cloves, green chilli, coriander and blend all the ingredients well.

- Heat ghee in a pan transfer the blended mutton kheema and saute well, then add garam masala, coriander powder, red chilli powder, turmeric powder, salt and saute well.

- Now add 1 cup water and cook mutton kheema for 5-6 minutes at low flame.

- Once the water in absorbed add finely chopped onion, capsicum and then add some more water and cook until it's dry and serve with a little sweet corn topping.

name: Seed Crackers
ingredients:
- 1 tbsp pumpkin seeds

- 1 tbsp sunflower seeds

- 1 tsp chia seeds

- 1 tsp flax seeds

- 1 tsp psyllium husk

- pinch of garam masala

- pinch of Italian herbs

- pinch of garlic powder

- pinch of ginger powder

- salt to taste

- 2 tbsp water
method:
- Heat pan add pumpkin seeds, sunflower seeds, chia seeds, flaxseeds and dry roast them for 2 minutes and turn of the flame .

- Take a bowl transfer the roasted seeds and add 1 tsp husk, pinch of garam masala, pinch of Italian herbs, pinch of ginger garlic powder, salt, warm water and mix all the ingredients and allow it to soak in water for ½ an hour.

- Preheat oven at 180 degree celsius for 10 minutes.

- Transfer the seeds mix on a baking tray and spread it evenly and bake it for 25 minutes at 180 degree celsius.

- Once it's baked allow it to cool down and enjoy crunchy crackers.

name: Hot And Sour Mushroom Soup
ingredients:
- 5ml oil

- 1 clove garlic (finely chopped)

- ½ inch ginger (finely chopped)

- 1 chilli (finely chopped)

- 25g spring onion (chopped)

- 100g mushroom (chopped)

- ½ tbsp soy sauce

- ½ tsp pepper powder

- ½ tsp salt

- ½ tbsp corn flour
method:
- Heat oil and stir fry garlic, ginger and 1 chilli, to this add spring onion and stir fry until it softens.

- Add Mushroom.stir fry for 2 minutes or until half cooked, add water, soy sauce, ½ tsp pepper powder, salt.

- Boil for 3 minutes or until the flavour is absorbed well.

- Now prepare corn flour slurry by mixing cornflour in ¼ cup water, pour the slurry into the soup and mix well.

- Continue to boil for 2 more minutes or until the soup thickens slightly and serve.

name: Blue Love Pancake
ingredients:
- 2 eggs(1 whole egg+ 1 egg white)

- ¼ tsp salt

- 1 tsp maple syrup/dates syrup/stevia

- 2 cups of skimmed milk/oatmilk/soymilk/almond milk

- 2 tsp oil

- 2 ½ cups of whole wheat flour/oatflour/buckwheat flour
½ tsp baking powder

- for blue colour put fresh or frozen blueberries/jamun (fruit)/pomegranate pulp/beetroot pulp/black grapes/plums in a piece of cheesecloth or muslin and squeeze the juice out of it or puree in a blender or food processor and strain.
method:
- In a large bowl, break the eggs, and beat them with a whisk until they're light
lemon yellow, and fluffy.

- Add the milk, and stir.

- Add the Oil, salt and sugar, and whisk together.

- Add the Flour and baking powder, and whisk together just until ingredients are
mixed. (Batter may be a little lumpy, but that's okay).

- Now add food colouring to make the batter a little darker than the medium
colour.

- You should have the original batter in the big bowl, a light blue batter in the
first bowl, a medium blue in the second, and a darker blue in the third.
With the heat on a medium setting, drop the batter for the pancakes with either a
ladle, or ice cream scoop, and cook until golden brown.

- Flip the pancakes with a pancake turner, and remove to a plate to serve.

name: Blue Rice
ingredients:
- 3 cups cooked rice

- 3 tablespoon oil

- ½ teaspoon mustard seeds

- ½ teaspoon whole cumin seeds

- 2 tablespoons peanuts

- 2 dried red chillies

- 8-10 curry leaves

- ½ teaspoon turmeric powder

- ⅛ teaspoon hing (asafoetida)

- 1 ½ cups purple cabbage thinly sliced

- ½ cup capsicum (green bell pepper) thinly sliced

- salt to taste

- 1 teaspoon red chilli powder

- 1 teaspoon coriander powder

- ½ teaspoon garam masala

- 2 tablespoons desiccated coconut

- ½ teaspoon lemon juice or Lime juice

- 2 tablespoons cilantro or coriander leaves finely chopped
method:
- Use the leftover rice or cook the basmati rice beforehand and let the rice cool
down before using in the recipe.

- Heat the oil in a pan on medium heat. Once hot add mustard seeds. As soon as they
start to crackle, add cumin seeds and let them sizzle.

- Then add peanuts, dried red chillies, and curry leaves. Saute till peanuts are light
golden in color.

- Add turmeric powder and hing.

- Immediately add cabbage, bell pepper, and salt, mix well. Cover and cook till
vegetables are soft and tender.

- Add red chilli powder, coriander powder, garam masala, and desiccated coconut.
Mix well and cook for a minute.

- Add cooked rice and mix really well. Cook for 2 minutes or till the rice gets heated
through.

- Lastly, add lemon juice and cilantro, stir and serve.

Notes

- Instead of bell pepper, you can add other vegetables like green peas, julienned carrots or skip the addition of other vegetables and use cabbage only.

name: Two Tone Potato Salad
ingredients:
- 1 small purple cabbage, cut

- 4 medium potatoes, scrubbed

- 2 cups hung curd, preferably homemade

- 2 lemon juice

- 1 cup paneer, grated

- fistful peanuts

- 2 teaspoons salt

- 2 teaspoons fresh dill

- ¾ teaspoon freshly ground pepper

- 2 large celery ribs, cut into ¼ inch dice (optional)

- ½ cup minced red onion

- ½ cup minced chives, plus more for garnish

- smoked paprika (optional) and lemon wedges, for serving
method:
- Put the purple cabbage in a medium saucepan and the potatoes in a large saucepan
and cover both with water.

- Bring to a boil and simmer the potatoes until just
tender, about 15 minutes for the cabbage and 20 minutes for the potatoes. Drain
both and let cool to room temperature. Peel and cut into 1/2-inch dice.

- In a large bowl, whisk the hung with the lemon juice, relish, cocktail onions, salt,
dill and pepper. Fold in the potatoes, celery, red onion and 1/2 cup of chives.

- Refrigerate the potato salad until cold. Add paneer and peanuts to it.

- Spoon the potato salad onto a platter and garnish with chives and paprika. Serve cold or slightly chilled, with lemon wedges.

name: Go Green Guacamole
ingredients:
- 3 ripe avocados, peeled and pitted

- 1 jalapeño, cored and finely diced (add more or less to taste)

- ½ cup finely diced red onion

- 1 tablespoon fresh lime juice

- ⅓ cup fresh cilantro leaves, finely chopped

- ½ teaspoon fine sea salt

- ¼ teaspoon ground cumin

- optional 1 tomato, cored and chopped
method:
- In a medium mixing bowl, use a fork or a potato masher to mash the avocados to
your desired consistency.

- Stir in the jalapeño, onion, lime juice, cilantro, salt, cumin until well-mixed. (If
adding tomatoes, stir them in at the very end.)

- Taste and season with extra salt (plus extra lime juice, jalapeño and/or cilantro) if
needed.

- Serve immediately and enjoy.

Note
Storage Instructions To store this guacamole, cover the bowl with plastic wrap (so that
the plastic is literally touching the entire top layer of the guacamole) and refrigerate for
up to 2 days before serving.

name: Brussel Sprouts Dip
ingredients:
- 3 garlic cloves

- 500 grams brussel sprouts, thawed

- ⅔ cup plain Low fat greek yogurt

- 100 grams tofu/panner/chicken

- 2 tablespoons shredded parmesan cheese

- ¾ teaspoon salt

- ¼ teaspoon black pepper

- 1/8 teaspoon cayenne pepper
method:
- Preheat oven to 350°F.

- Add garlic to food processor and pulse until minced. Add half of Brussel sprouts, yogurt,
tofu, ⅓ cup parmesan cheese. Blend until smooth. Transfer to a medium bowl.

- Take the remaining brussel sprouts; fold into yogurt mixture. Add salt, black pepper,
and cayenne.

- Divide dip among 4 (200 grams) ramekins. Top evenly with remaining ⅓ cup
Parmesan. Bake at 350°F until bubbly, about 30 minutes.

- Turn broiler to high; cook until tops are golden, about 5 minutes. Serve warm.

name: Crunchy Oven Fried Okra
ingredients:
- 4 cups fresh-cut okra

- 4 tablespoons cornmeal

- 6 tablespoons breadcrumbs

- ½ teaspoon salt

- ½ teaspoon pepper

- 1 tablespoon grated parmesan cheese

- 2 eggs, beaten

- 3-4 tablespoons canola oil
method:
- Preheat the oven to 425 degrees. Combine the cornmeal, panko, salt, pepper, and
parmesan cheese in a gallon-size ziplock bag.

- In a separate bowl, gently toss the okra with the beaten eggs until evenly coated.

- Pour oil onto a rimmed baking sheet (15x10x1) and place in the preheated oven for
just a few minutes to warm up the oil, be careful to not let it start to smoke.

- In the meantime, add the wet okra a little at a time to the bag and shake until
coated. If needed, you may add additional cornmeal and panko breadcrumbs, if
the okra isn't coated as much as you like. Carefully add the okra to the hot baking
sheet.

- Bake for 15-20 minutes, or until tender, turning the okra halfway through baking.

- To get a nice golden brown, increase oven heat to broil and watch carefully, stirring
as needed.

name: Lemon Chickpea Bruschetta
ingredients:
- 2 cups dried chickpeas, soaked in cold water overnight and drained

- 1 small carrot

- 1 celery rib

- 1 small onion, halved

- 1 small fennel bulb, halved

- 5 garlic cloves

- 3 thyme sprigs

- 1 bay leaf

- ½ cup extra-virgin olive oil

- kosher salt and freshly ground pepper

- ½ cup chopped flat-leaf parsley

- 1 preserved lemon pulp discarded and peel finely chopped

- 2 tablespoons fresh lemon juice
method:
- In a saucepan, cover the chickpeas with water. Add the carrot, celery, onion,
fennel, garlic, thyme, bay leaf and ¼ cup of the olive oil.

- Bring to a simmer, cover and cook over low heat until the chickpeas are tender, about 1 hour.

- Let the chickpeas cool in the liquid to room temperature, then drain, reserving ¾
cup of the cooking liquid. Discard the vegetables and herbs.

- Set aside ½ cup of the chickpeas. In a food processor, puree the remaining
chickpeas with the reserved ¾ cup of cooking liquid and the remaining ¼ cup
of oil. Season with salt and pepper.

- Scrape the puree into a large bowl, stir in the parsley, preserved lemon peel, lemon juice and the reserved ½ cup of chickpeas and serve.

name: Roasted Squash Soup With Bananas
ingredients:
- one 2-pound butternut squash, halved lengthwise and seeded

- kosher salt

- ½ cup pecans

- 1 banana, scooped into balls with a melon baller or sliced ½ inch thick

- 1 tablespoon pure maple syrup

- 1 cup water

- ½ cup low fat cream

- pinch of ground cinnamon

- 8 small watercress sprigs
method:
- Preheat the oven to 375°. Butter a medium baking dish. Season the squash with
salt and set it cut side down in the baking dish. Bake for about 1 hour and 10
minutes, until the squash is very tender. Let cool slightly.

- Meanwhile, spread the pecans in a pie plate and toast for about 7 minutes, or
until fragrant. Let cool, then coarsely chop and transfer to a medium bowl. Add
the banana and maple syrup and stir to coat.

- Peel the squash. In a blender, puree the squash, water, low fat cream and
cinnamon until very smooth. Transfer to a medium saucepan and warm over low
heat.

- Ladle the soup into bowls, garnish with the banana-nut topping and
watercress and serve hot or at room temperature.

name: Saffron Lassi
ingredients:
- large pinch of saffron threads

- 3 tablespoons water

- 2 tablespoons sugar

- 1 ½ cups plain whole-milk yogurt
method:
- In a small bowl, crumble the saffron into 1 tablespoon of the water and let stand
for 5 minutes.

- Meanwhile, in a small, microwave-safe bowl, combine the remaining 2
tablespoons of water with the sugar and microwave for about 1 minute, until the
sugar is dissolved. Transfer the bowl to the freezer until the syrup is cold.

- In a bowl, whisk the yogurt with the saffron water and sugar syrup. Refrigerate, whisking a few times, until cold and brightly colored, about 1 hour.

- Pour into medium glasses and serve.

name: Red Vegetable Pizza
ingredients:
- 4 large whole-wheat flour tortillas

- 2 red peppers, cut into strips

- 1 medium red onion, diced

- 2 tablespoons extra-virgin olive oil

- ½ cup unsalted tomato sauce

- 1 cup spinach

- ¾ cups of part-skim mozzarella shredded cheese

- ¼ cup finely grated Parmesan cheese
method:
1. In a small bowl, combine shredded mozzarella cheese and grated Parmesan
cheese.
2. Heat a large skillet over medium-high heat. Add 1 tablespoon olive oil, and toss
the red pepper and red onion for 7-10 minutes (or until soft).
3. Turn on broiler.
4. Place two tortillas on a rimmed baking sheet. Brush with olive oil. Broil for 2
minutes or until browned. Remove from heat, flip over, and set aside.
5. Spoon 2 tablespoons of tomato sauce on the non-brown side of the tortilla.
6. Top with peppers and onions, spinach, and cheese (about ½ cup of cheese
blend per pizza).
7. Place pizzas back on baking sheet and broil for 2 minutes or until cheese melts.
8. Repeat with remaining two tortilla pizzas.

name: Strawberry Crumble
ingredients:
Strawberry rhubarb Filling

- 2 cups whole strawberries, halved lengthwise

- 1 ¼ cups frozen sliced cranberries, thawed

- 3 tablespoons coconut

- 1 ½ tablespoons unsalted butter

- 1 ½ tablespoons cornstarch

- cooking spray

Oat streusel topping

- 1 cup oats

- ¼ cup whole-wheat flour

- 2 tablespoons honey

- 1 teaspoon ground cinnamon

- ¼ cup coconut sugar

- 1 ½ tablespoons unsalted butter, melted
method:
1. Preheat oven to 400 F.
2. Coat an 8-inch glass baking dish with cooking spray.
3. In a saucepan, on medium-high heat, combine strawberries, rhubarb, coconut sugar, butter, and cornstarch. Stir for approximately 9 minutes, or until fruit begins to soften and sugar is dissolved. Remove from heat.
4. Make the streusel topping by stirring together oats, whole-wheat flour, honey, cinnamon, coconut sugar, and melted butter, in a bowl. Once the mixture is crumbly, set aside.
5. Pour the strawberry-rhubarb mixture into the prepared baking dish. Top with crumbled oat mixture.
6. Bake for 16 minutes.

name: Watermelon Salsa
ingredients:
- 4 cups seedless watermelon, diced

- 1 cup red onion, diced

- 1 cup cucumber, peeled and diced

- 1 cup red bell pepper, diced

- ⅓ cup cilantro, finely chopped

- ¼ cup mint leaves, finely chopped

- 1 lemon juice and zest
method:
- In a medium bowl, combine watermelon, red onion, cucumbers, and bell peppers.

- Sprinkle cilantro and mint, stir to distribute evenly.

- Add lime juice and zest, stir gently.

- Serve chilled with no-salt tortilla chips or as a side salad.

name: Pumpkin Rice Pudding
ingredients:
- 2 cups water

- 1 cup rice

- 3 cups low fat (2%) milk

- 1 cup solid-pack pure pumpkin (not pumpkin pie filling)

- ¾ cup honey

- 1 teaspoon vanilla extract

- ¾ teaspoon ground cinnamon, plus more for garnish

- ¼ teaspoon ground ginger

- ¼ teaspoon ground nutmeg

- ¼ teaspoon salt

- ⅓ cup heavy whipping cream, whipped
method:
- Preheat the oven to 375F.

- Bring the water to a boil in an ovenproof 4-quart saucepan. Stir in the rice and cover.

- Reduce the heat to low and simmer until the rice is nearly cooked, about 20 minutes.

- In a large bowl, whisk together the milk, pumpkin, honey, vanilla, cinnamon, ginger,
nutmeg, and salt.

- While the rice is still hot, add the pumpkin mixture to the saucepan and stir well to
combine.

- Cover and transfer to the oven. Bake until the liquid has reduced by about a
third and the mixture is foamy and bubbling, 45 to 50 minutes. Remove from the oven
and stir well to combine all the ingredients.

- Transfer to a large bowl, then cover and chill in the refrigerator for at least 8 hours or overnight.

- The pudding will keep for up to 4 days in an airtight container in the refrigerator. Serve with a dollop of whipped cream and a sprinkling of cinnamon.

name: Apricot Oats Bar
ingredients:
Filling

- 1 ¼ cups apricots pureed (approx.)

- 8 dried apricots, chopped into ¼ inch pieces (about ⅓ cup)

Crust

- 1 ¾ cups Wheat flour

- 2 tablespoons light brown sugar

- 1 teaspoon ground cinnamon

- ¾ teaspoon fine sea salt

- ¾ teaspoon baking soda

- 1 ¾ cups old-fashioned oats

- 1 cup coarsely chopped walnuts

- 2 tablespoons unsalted butter, melted

- 1 egg at room temperature, beaten

- 1 teaspoon pure vanilla extract
method:
- Put an oven rack in the center of the oven. Preheat the oven to 350 degrees F. Spray a
9 by 13 by 2-inch metal baking dish with vegetable oil cooking spray. Line the bottom
and sides of the pan with parchment paper.

- Spray the parchment paper with vegetable oil cooking spray and set aside.

- Filling In a small bowl, mix together the puree and the apricots. Set aside.

- Crust In a large bowl, whisk together the flour, sugar, cinnamon, salt and baking soda.

- Stir in the oats and walnuts. Add the butter, egg and vanilla and stir until incorporated.

- Using a fork or clean fingers, lightly press half of the crust mixture onto the bottom of the
prepared pan. Using a spatula, spread the filling over the crust leaving a ½ inch border
around the edge of the pan.

- Cover the filling with the remaining crust mixture and gently press to flatten. Bake until light golden, about 30 to 35 minutes. Cool for 1 hour.

- Cut into bars and store in an airtight container for up to 3 days.

name: Roasted Spaghetti Squash With Garlic And Kale
ingredients:
- 1 medium spaghetti squash

- 3 tablespoons olive oil

- ½ yellow onion, diced

- 8 cloves garlic, peeled

- ⅓ cup sun-dried tomatoes, drained

- 3 cups kale, chopped

- ¼ cup chicken broth

- ½ teaspoon sea salt, or to taste

- ½ teaspoon black pepper or to taste
method:
- Preheat the oven to 400 F.

- Roast the spaghetti squash.

- Cut the tip and tail off the squash. Cut in half lengthwise.

- Scoop out the seeds and discard.

- Rub the insides of the squash halves with 2 tablespoons of olive oil, as well as the salt and pepper.

- Place the squash halves on a rimmed baking sheet, cut side up.

- Bake for 30–50 minutes or until tender. Baking less time will result in firmer noodles.

- While the squash bakes, heat 1 tablespoon olive oil in a large pan over medium heat.

- Add the onion, garlic, and sun-dried tomatoes, and saute for 4–5 minutes.

- Add the kale and chicken broth. Cook 3–4 minutes or until the kale is wilted.

- When the squash is done baking, take it out of the oven. Use a fork to shred the insides of the squash it will separate into noodle like strands.

- Add the squash to the pan and toss it with the other ingredients.

- Drizzle with remaining olive oil, if desired. Add salt and pepper to taste.

name: Modak
ingredients:
The usual dough

- 1 cup fine rice flour

- 1 cup water

- ½ tsp ghee

- ¼ tsp salt
method:
- Heat the water, ghee and oil till it starts boiling.

- Add the rice flour and mix well.

- Cover and let rest for 5 minutes.

- Transfer to a clean surface and knead till it turns soft (about 5 to 7 minutes).

- Your dough is ready to be rolled, filled and steamed.

Simple healthy twist dough

- Make half the recipe mentioned above.

- Grind ¾ th cup of crumbled paneer with 1 date in a mixer grinder. Add another date if you want it sweeter.

- Add this to your ready rice dough and knead together to get an extremely soft dough.

- Use this as an alternative to the regular dough.

Gooey and crunchy center

- This needs a little prepping ahead but so worth it. Here are 2 fillings. you can make them individually or even combine them.

Crunchy Dry Fruit Filling
Ingredients

- ½ cup grated and roasted coconut

- 3 medium dates chopped small

- 6 almonds roasted and chopped small

- 10 cashews roasted and chopped small

- 1 tsp flax seeds

- ½ tsp ghee

- pinch of salt

- pinch of cardamom powder

- 1 tsp dried rose petals (optional )

Method

- chop the nuts small and dry roast them on low flame. Remove and keep aside dry roast the coconut on low flame.

- Add the nuts and remaining ingredients and roast for 2 to 3 minutes.

- The ghee adds a lovely aroma and the dates add the required sweetness. Since there is no added sweetener of any sort. This will give you a non sticky mixture.

- To fill a modak you could roll out the dough like you would for an aloo paratha, add the filling and pinch the sides together. Alternatively, you could also add a little dough to a modak mould, push it down making a dent in the middle.

- Add some of the filling and cover it with more dough. The modak mould will seal the filling in.

- Add a little oil to a plate or an idli maker and steam for 15 minutes.

- If you don’t want to make all this effort just mix the filling into the dough itself. Shape into a modak and steam it. I prefer to do this with the next filling in the center.

Cashew coconut cream filling
Ingredients

- ¼ cup cashews

- ¼ cup coconut milk

- 1 date

- 10 roasted chopped almonds

Method

- Add the cashews, coconut milk and date to a mixer grinder or food processor and blend till you get a smooth liquid consistency.

- Pour into a bowl and mix in the chopped and roasted almonds. Cover and freeze for 3 hours or overnight till it is hard like ice cream.

- Prepare your modak dough and keep it ready.

- Grease a modak mould with ghee or oil.

- Stuff the dough into the mould walls.

- Use a tiny measuring spoon to scoop out the cold filling like you would ice cream.

- Place the small scooped mixture in the center.

- Close the mould tightly.

- If there is excess dough coming out the bottom of the dough try gently pushing in as much as possible. Stuff the rice flour dough into the mould walls.

- Scrape off the excess from the sides.

- Unmould it gently and place on a lightly oiled steel plate. Ensure you leave sufficient space between each modak.

- Steam for 10 to 15 minutes or until the modak gets. Shiny texture.

- Ensure you work quickly to prevent the filling from melting at room temperature. You can also keep it in the freezer and use a little at a time. I prefer to add a generous helping of the coconut cashew cream filling.

- Stuff it any way you are comfortable. I have added my personal preference at the end.

name: Beetroot And Carrot Kanji
ingredients:
- 3 medium size beetroot (peel and cut into thick strips like French fries )

- 3 medium size carrots (peel and cut into thick strips like french fries)

- 2 tsp of ground mustard powder

- 2 tsp of black salt

- 1 tsp of red chilli flakes

- 5 cups of water
method:
- In a jar/bottle put the beetroot and carrot sticks.

- Add the ground mustard powder, salt and red chilli flakes.

- Add the water.

- Mix it well.

- Place the jar somewhere safe and also where there is sunlight.

- Keep in sunlight for 3 days.

- Ready to have.

- Can keep in fridge and have it cold.

name: Tomato And Chicken Meatball Soup
ingredients:
- 100 gms chicken minced

- 150 gms tomatoes

- 1 slice bread crumbs

- 30 gms onion

- 1 tsp olive oil

- black pepper

- salt
method:
- Wash chicken and mince it in a blender.

- In a large bowl combine chicken, bread crumbs and black pepper and salt.

- Mix thoroughly and make small balls out of it.

- In a non-stick pan, heat the oil, add onion, capsicum and salt.

- Cover and cook until the mixture is dry. Add chopped garlic,add veg broth and tomatoes, bring to a simmer over medium heat.

- Use the blender to puree the soup, now add the meatballs and cook .

- Cook it until the meatballs are cooked.

- Ready to serve.

name: Prawn Vegetable Soup
ingredients:
- 100g prawns

- 50g capsicum, chopped into cubes

- 50g tomato, chopped

- 3 garlic cloves, chopped

- 1 green chilli, chopped

- 1 tsp oil

- 1 tsp pepper powder

- 1 tsp fennel seed powder

- ½ tsp lemon juice

- coriander leaves (for garnishing)

- 1 tsp salt
method:
- Wash and clean the prawns and keep aside.

- Remove the shells of the prawn thoroughly and keep it aside.

- Heat a pan, add oil.

- Once the oil heats up, add the chopped garlic and chilli, then add the prawns and cook for 8-10 minutes.

- Then add the chopped vegetables, mix well and cook.

- Add salt and fennel seed powder. Cook until the prawns become soft or are completely cooked.

- Add 1 cup water or as required. Mix well.

- Add pepper powder and let it simmer.

- Turn off the flame and add lemon juice.

- Garnish it with coriander leaves.

name: Egg Drop Soup
ingredients:
- 1 whole egg

- 1 egg white

- 30 gms capsicum

- 20 gms carrot

- 30 gms mushroom

- 20 gms cabbage

- 30 gms onion

- ½ tsp ground ginger

- 1 tbsp cornstarch

- ½ tsp soya sauce

- pinch of garlic powder

- 1 bayleaf

- thyme

- black pepper

- salt
method:
For vegetable broth

- Heat the oil in a pot, add garlic, onion and other vegetables cooked until they become soft add water, bayleaf, thyme. Reduce heat to low and simmer it for an hour.

- Pour the broth through a fine mesh strainer into a large heat-proof bowl or pot; discard solids.

- Once the broth has cooled, transfer it to a small bowl.

For soup

- Whisk together veg broth/chicken broth, cornstarch, ginger and garlic powder. Heat over high heat until the stock comes to simmer, stirring occasionally.

- Meanwhile, whisk together the eggs and egg whites in a small measuring cup or bowl.

- Once the broth reaches a simmer, use a whisk to stir the broth in a circular motion. Then slowly pour the whisked eggs into the soup as you continue stirring, in order to create long egg ribbons.

- Remove the pan from heat. Stir green coriander until combined. Season with salt and pepper to taste.

- Serve immediately, sprinkled with additional green onions.

name: Tofu Minestrone Soup
ingredients:
- 50 gms tofu

- 30 gms whole wheat pasta

- 30 gms red kidney beans

- 50 gms capsicum

- 50 gms tomato puree

- 30 gms cabbage

- 20 gms onion

- ½ tbsp chopped garlic

- ½ tsp soy sauce

- ½ tsp garlic powder

- ½ tsp oregano

- ¼ chilli flakes

- ¼ tsp black pepper

- ½ tsp oil

- salt
method:
- Dice tofu into small cubes and transfer it into a bowl. Pour ½ tsp soya sauce, mix it and saute it on non stick pan with very minimal oil.

- Pressure cook red kidney beans for 4- 5 whistles.

- Once the beans are cooked, drain the water and keep it aside.

- In a pot boil the water, add salt and cook pasta in it.

- Once cooked, strain the pasta using seiver and keep aside.

- Heat ½ tsp of oil in a heavy bottomed pot over medium heat.

- Add chopped onions, garlic and saute it.

- Now, add capsicum, cabbage, saute for 3-5 minutes.

- Add tomato puree, dried oregano, black pepper, chilli flakes and salt as per taste.

- Mix well and cook for one to two minutes. Cooking the tomato makes the flavor more intense.

- Add 1 cup vegetable stock or water.

- Cover the pan and let vegetables simmer.

- Check a couple of times that vegetables don’t get overcooked.

- Add the cooked beans, tofu and then pasta.Mix gently and simmer for a minute.

- Ready to serve.

name: Crispy Chicken And Egg Sandwich
ingredients:
- 2 slice whole wheat bread

- 50 gms chicken thighs

- 1 whole egg

- 2 tbsp curd

- 50 gms tomato

- 50 gms capsicum

- 50 gms onion

- 1 small garlic clove

- lemon zest

- ½ tsp lemon juice

- pinch of Black pepper

- chilli flakes

- ½ tsp oil

- salt
method:
- In a small bowl, combine curd, garlic and lemon zest. Season it with pepper and salt.

- In a non-stick skillet, heat the oil over medium heat. Season chicken and cook until the chicken is golden brown for about 6 minutes and then flip the chicken and cook until it is cooked through.

- Transfer chicken to a plate and drizzle lemon juice.

- Brush the oil in a pan, break egg on it, sprinkle pepper and salt on it.

- Let it cook for 2 minutes.

- Assemble sandwich with bread, chicken, egg and vegetables

- Can serve with green chutney.

name: Lamb Korma
ingredients:
- 20g chopped onion

- 50g lamb

- 1 chopped ginger

- 1 chopped garlic

- 1 green chilli

- water

- 1 tsp oil

- ½ tsp coriander powder

- ½ tsp turmeric powder

- ½ tsp chilli powder

- salt

- ½ tsp garam masala

- 2-3 cinnamon

- 1 cardamom

- 2-3 clove

- 4 pepper seeds

- 5ml curd
method:
- Firstly grind ginger, garlic and green chillies with little water and make a paste.

- Then add oil in a pan and fry the onion till it turns golden brown and grind the fried onion without water.

- In a pan add oil, ginger garlic, chilli paste, curd, coriander powder, turmeric powder, red chilli powder, cloves, cinnamon, cardamom, pepper, and add lamb mix it well.

- Cover the lid and cook for 10-15 minutes.

- After cooking after 15 minutes add salt and cook for other 10 minutes.

- Now add grinded onion paste to it and mix it nicely and hot water stir and cook well.

- After lamb cooks completely add salt, garam masala mix well.

- Serve hot.

name: Lauki Mutton Curry
ingredients:
- 20g mutton

- 20g lauki

- ½ tsp red chilli powder

- ¼ tsp turmeric powder

- ½ tsp coriander powder

- ¼ tsp garlic paste

- ¼ tsp ginger paste

- ½ tsp fresh coriander leaves

- 1 green chilli

- 10g tomatoes

- 10g onion

- 1-inch cinnamon stick

- salt to taste

- 1 tsp oil
method:
- Wash and peel the lauki. Cut in to halves and wash and then keep a side.

- Heat oil in a wok and add cinnamon stick, black cardamom and finely chopped onions, fry onions till golden brown.

- Add the meat and sauté. Add ginger garlic paste and mix.

- Add coriander, turmeric, red chilli powder along with salt and fry all of these spices.

- Add chopped tomatoes and cook, followed by lauki and continue cooking with little water.

- Let it simmer until the mutton is cooked.

- Now add water depending on how thin you want the gravy.

- Serve garnished with fresh coriander leaves.

name: Coriander Chicken
ingredients:
To be ground to paste

- 10g coriander leaves

- 1 green chilli

- 2 garlic cloves crushed

- 1 inch ginger grated

- ¼ tsp turmeric powder

- salt to taste

- 30g chicken with bone, cut into small pieces

Other ingredients

- 1 tsp oil

- 10g onions, chopped fine

- 10g thick coconut milk

- spice paste

- ½ tsp poppy seeds

- 1 cardamom

- 1 cloves
method:
- Take a blender and add all the ingredients listed under “to be ground to a paste”. Add ¼ cup of water and grind to a fine paste. Add it to the chicken pieces and mix well to coat. set aside.

- Heat oil in a pan and add in the onions. Fry for few minutes till the onions are soft.

- Add in the chicken mixture to the pan. Cook the mixture on medium flame for 4 whistles in the pressure cooker. Switch off the flame and wait for the pressure to release naturally.

- Dry roast the poppy seeds, cloves and cardamom until fragrant. Grind the spice mixture with ¼ cup of water to a fine paste. Add the spice paste to the cooked chicken gravy. Add coconut milk. Bring the mixture to a mere simmer. Do not let the mixture to boil for a long time. Switch off the flame.

- Serve with rice or chapati.

name: Chicken Biryani
ingredients:
- 50g chicken

- 50g rice

- 10g onion

- 10g tomato

- 5g coriander leaves

- 5g mint leaves

- 2 tsp oil

- green chillies

- ½ lemon

- 1 tsp chilli powder

- 1 tsp garam masala

- 1 tsp chicken masala

- 2 tsp ginger garlic paste

- 1 tsp coriander powder

- 4 cloves

- 2 cinnamon

- 2 tsp curd

- kasturi methi

- 1 tsp jeera seeds

- ½ tsp turmeric powder

- 2 pulao leaf

- 2 stone flower

- 2 cardamom

- salt to taste
method:
- In a cooker add oil, jeera seeds, cinnamon, pulao leaf, cardamom, cloves, kasuri methi, star flower saute it well.

- Then add onion saute it well till it turns golden brown, add tomato, green chilli saute till tomato becomes soft.

- Then add chicken, ginger garlic paste, red chilli powder, garam masala, coriander powder, turmeric, chicken masala, salt, curd, lemon juice mix well and cook for 10 minutes.

- Then add rice and water required and add coriander leaves, mint leaves and cook for 2-3 whistles.

- Serve hot.

name: Egg Paratha
ingredients:
- 30g wheat flour

- warm water as required

- 50g egg

- 10g onion

- 1 green chilli

- 1 tsp oil

- ¼ garam masala

- ¼ of turmeric powder

- ½ tsp of coriander leaves

- salt to taste
method:
- In a mixing bowl, add flour, salt and oil, and knead the mixture into a smooth dough using warm water. You can add in a little more water if the dough seems dry. Knead well.

- Divide the dough into 2 balls.

- Roll out the dough ball evenly using a rolling pin, then fold it twice to form a triangle. Roll it out again to make a triangular sheet. Repeat the process with the remaining dough.

- In a bowl, whisk the eggs well along with onions, chilli, coriander leaves, garam masala, turmeric powder and salt. Keep aside.

- Place the rolled dough on a hot tawa, and let it cook for 1-2 minutes on both sides.

- As the edges start to crisp, quickly make a slit using a sharp knife along the folds and pour in half the quantity of egg. Tilt the paratha a little so that the egg mix slides in. Then flip it over and repeat the process on the other side.

- Drizzle some oil on the paratha (optional) and press the surface gently using the back of your spoon. Turn up the heat and continue cooking the paratha until it fluffs up and turns crisp brown.

- Serve hot egg paratha.

name: Phulka Veg Egg Roll With Yogurt
ingredients:
- 20g wheat flour

- salt

- 1 tsp oil

- water

- 80g egg

- 10g onion

- ½ tsp chilli powder

- ½ tsp coriander powder

- ½ tsp cumin powder

- 1 tsp chat masala

- 10g carrot

- 5g capsicum

- 5g Coriander leaves

- home made tomato sauce
method:
- In a bowl add wheat flour, salt, oil mix well and smooth dough rest for 10 minutes.

- Take a small part of dough, make a ball and roll it to round.

- Heat the pan and cook on both sides and prepare phulka.

- In another pan add oil, onion saute till it turns golden brown, add salt, chilli powder, coriander powder, cumin powder, chat masala add little water mix well and cook well for 5 minutes.

- Then add carrot, capsicum cook for 5 minutes, 2 eggs saute for 5 minutes, add coriander leaves, keep aside.

- On the phulka add tomato sauce and fill the stuffing and roll the phulka.

name: Lamb Tikka Masala
ingredients:
- 30g lamb

- 5 green chillies

- 1 tsp garam masala

- 1 tsp chilli powder

- salt

- ½ tsp chat masala

- 1 tsp coriander powder

- ½ tsp cumin powder

- ½ tsp turmeric powder

- ½ tsp ginger garlic paste

- ½ tsp black pepper powder

- lemon juice

- 5ml curd

- 1 tsp oil

- 10g onion paste

- 10g tomato

- 1 tsp fenugreek seeds

- water
method:
- In a bowl add green chilli, garam masala, chilli powder, salt, chat masala, coriander powder, cumin powder, turmeric powder, ginger garlic paste, black pepper powder, lemon juice, curd, mix well and marinate for 2 hours.

- Heat the pan and add oil, marinated lamb and cook till it dry.

- In a pressure cooker add oil, onion paste, saute till it turns golden brown, then add tomato paste cook well.

- Add lamb tikka mix well cook for 2 minutes, add fenugreek seeds mix it, add water and salt.

- Cook for 1 whistle and lamb tikka masala is ready.

name: Grilled Veg Sabzi With Kheema
ingredients:
- 5g beans

- 5g carrot

- 5g capsicum

- 10g tomatoes

- 5g cabbage

- salt

- ½ tsp black pepper powder

- 2 tsp chilli powder

- chat masala

- 1 tsp garam masala

- 1 tsp oil

- bay leaf

- 2-3 cinnamon

- 4-5 pepper seeds

- 2-3 clove

- 1 cardamom

- 1 tsp Jeera

- 10g onion

- 15g kheema

- 1 tsp ginger garlic paste

- ½ tsp turmeric powder

- 1 tsp coriander powder

- 1 green chilli

- water
method:
- In a bowl add beans, carrot, capsicum, cabbage, then add salt, chilli powder,. Pepper powder, chat masala, garam masala to it and mix well.

- On griller add oil and grill the vegetables for 5 minutes.

- In pan add oil, jeera, cinnamon, cardamom, clove, bay leaf, pepper, onion and stir well till turns golden brown.

- Then add kheema fry with onion for 4-5 minutes, add ginger garlic paste, chilli powder, garam masala, turmeric powder, coriander powder, salt , green chilli and tomato saute for 1 minutes .

- Then add water and cook for 10 minutes.

- Later add the grilled vegetables into the kheema.

name: Mango Lassi
ingredients:
- 20g pulpy mango

- 5g sugar

- 30ml curd

- 1 cardamom
method:
- To a large bowl, add fresh mango pulp and blended in a blender to make it smooth.

- o the same bowl, now add yogurt. use plain whole milk yogurt or any other.

- Now add cold water. Add this to thin out the lassi a bit. Also add the sugar and the cardamom powder.

- Blend everything until well combined.

- Pour the mango lassi into serving glasses and chill before serving. Garnish with pistachios, saffron strands before serving.

name: Fruit Popsicle
ingredients:
- 5g apple

- 5g mango

- 5g banana

- 5ml tender coconut water

- 5ml honey
method:
- Mix the tender coconut water and honey.

- Fill the fruits inside the popsicles then add mixture of honey and coconut water.

- Freeze overnight.

name: Yogurt Pikelets
ingredients:
- 10g wheat flour

- ½ tsp baking soda

- salt

- 10ml yogurt

- 50g egg
method:
- In a bowl add wheat flour, baking soda, salt, yogurt, eggs whisk well and prepare a batter.

- Place a batter on griller and cook both sides.

name: Strawberry Lassi
ingredients:
- 10g strawberry

- 10ml yogurt

- water

- 5g sugar
method:
- In a bowl add strawberry, yogurt, water blend it.

- Then add sugar and mix well and garnish with strawberry.

name: Egg Taipo
ingredients:
- 50 gms wheat flour

- 2 boiled egg white

- 100 gms cabbage

- 50 gms onion

- ½ tsp oil

- ¼ tsp instant dry yeast

- Salt

For tomato chutney

- 100 gms tomato

- 1 garlic clove

- 3 - 4 dry red chillies

- Salt
method:
- For dough Take ½ cup water, add salt and ¼ tsp yeast and mix it. Take wheat flour in a bowl and knead a dough using yeast water.

- Keep it aside for 1 and half hour so that the dough becomes double in size.

For the filling

- Take minced cabbage, onion and boiled whole eggs in a bowl, add salt to it. Heat the oil in a pan, add the filling and cook it for 5 minutes.

- Now take a small dough, roll it in a medium sized roti and add stuffing and give it a round shape. Keep it on a steamer for 20-30 minutes.

- Ready to serve with tomato chutney For tomato chutney Blanch tomato for 2-3 minutes and remove the skin.

- Take blanched tomato in a grinder, add 1 garlic clove, red chillies and salt and grind it. Ready to serve.

name: Vegetable Egg Tikki
ingredients:
- 1 whole egg

- 35g Onion

- 30g Tomato

- 35g Capsicum

- 1 tsp besan

- 1 tbsp ginger-garlic paste

- 1 tbsp coriander leaves

- 1 green chilli

- ½ tsp chilli powder

- ¼ tsp ajwain

- ¼ tsp turmeric powder

- ½ tsp salt
method:
- Boil the egg and keep it aside. Grate all the vegetables(do not make a fine paste).

- Put it in a bowl, add all the spices, ginger garlic paste, coriander leaves and salt and mix well.

- Now break the boiled egg into small pieces and mix it with the vegetable mixture.

- Roll the mixture into a ball, coat it with besan and shape it into a tikki.

- Heat a pan, place all the tikkis and cook both the sides on low flame.

- Serve hot with coriander or mint chutney.

name: Palak Mushroom Omelette
ingredients:
- 50 gms chopped spinach

- 50 gms chopped mushroom

- 1 whole egg

- 1 egg white

- ½ tsp oil

- chilli flakes

- salt
method:
- Take a bowl, add eggs, chilli flakes and salt and whisk it till it becomes a creamy texture.

- Now heat oil in a pan, add the mushrooms and cook them till they slightly turn brown in color.

- Add chopped spinach and cook it for 5 minutes. Evenly pour the egg mixture in the pan and spread it over the tossed vegetables.

- Cook until the egg is cooked. Turn the omelette upside down and cook.

- Serve hot

name: Chole Curry
ingredients:
- 40gm chickpeas(Soak it in normal water for 7- 8 hours or overnight)

- 25 gm chopped onion

- 100gm chopped tomato

- 2-3 garlic cloves(peeled)

- ½ tsp chopped ginger

- whole garam masala( 1 each bay leaves, black cardamom, green cardamom, cinnamon)

- ½ tsp whole cumin seeds

- ½ tsp turmeric powder

- 1 tsp red chilli powder

- ½ tsp cumin powder

- ½ tsp coriander powder

- ½ tsp garam masala powder

- 1 tsp salt

- 1 tsp oil

- 3 tbsp freshly chopped coriander leaves
method:
- Put the ginger, garlic and onion in the grinding jar and grind it into smooth paste(add little water if needed).

- When paste has become smooth, take it out from the jar.

- Put the tomato in the grinding jar and grind it into paste(do not add water).

- Heat oil in a pressure cooker pan, add whole garam masala and whole cumin seeds.

- Fry it for a few seconds on medium flame and then reduce the flame to low.

- Add turmeric powder and red chilli powder, mix it and cook it for a few seconds on low flame.

- Add ginger, garlic and onion paste, cover the lid(without whistle) and cook it for one minute on medium flame.

- Put cumin powder, coriander powder and mix it properly.

- Cover the lid(without whistle) and cook it for ½ minute on medium flame.

- Add tomato paste, cover the lid(without whistle) and cook it for one minute on medium flame.

- Add soaked chickpeas, mix it and cover the pan, cook it for a minute on low flame.

- Put 1 glass of water and salt, stir it well and close the lid of the pressure cooker properly.

- Cook it for 5 whistles on low-medium flame.

- After five whistles, turn off the flame and let the pressure cooker cool down completely.

- Open it carefully and add coriander leaves, mix it well and serve.

name: Egg Ring Vegetables
ingredients:
- 1 egg yolk

- 2 egg whites

- 1 tsp ginger- garlic paste

- 25g onion finely chopped

- 20g capsicum chopped

- 60g tomatoes finely chopped/ pureed

- ½ tsp red chilli powder

- ¼ tsp cumin powder

- ½ tsp coriander powder

- 1 green chilli

- ½ tsp salt

- 1 tsp oil

- 2 tbsp fresh coriander chopped
method:
- Heat oil in a pan. Once the oil heats up, add ginger-garlic paste, then add chopped green chilli and fry for a few seconds.

- Then add in the onions and fry until they turn translucent. Add the chopped capsicum to it and cook for 1- 2 minutes. Then add chopped tomatoes or tomato puree and cook on high flame for 2 minutes.

- Add salt, chilli powder, cumin powder and coriander powder to the mixture and mix everything well. Cover and cook for 5- 7 minutes on low flame.

- In a small bowl crack egg.

- Now make a little space in the pan and pour the cracked egg.

- Sprinkle salt and black pepper on the egg. Cover it and cook for 8- 10 minutes. Can completely cook the egg or keep it half cooked, as per your preference.

- Turn off the flame and garnish it with fresh coriander leaves and serve.

name: Egg Veg Pepper Masala
ingredients:
- 1 egg yolk

- 2 egg whites

- 35g onion, diced

- 35g capsicum, diced

- 30g tomato, diced

- 2 green chillies

- 2 tsp pepper powder

- ¼ tsp chilli powder

- ½ tsp turmeric powder

- 1 tsp ginger-garlic paste

- 4- 5 curry leaves

- 1 tsp salt

- 1 tsp oil
method:
- Firstly, boil the eggs, cool them down and peel them.

- Cut the boiled eggs into two halves.

- Take a pan, add oil and heat it.

- Add some salt, turmeric powder and stir well and after adding these spices stir fry the eggs in it.

- Stir fry each side well and make sure to fry both sides as well.

- Take the boiled fried eggs out and rest aside to use it in the onion base later.

- Use the same pan and same oil, add diced vegetables.

- Saute by stirring and then add vertically slit green chillies and curry leaves into it. Saute them until they turn soft.

- Now add ginger-garlic paste, chilli powder and pepper powder and mix well.

- Saute for a minute.

- Add the fried eggs into the masala and cook each side by flipping.

- Make sure the eggs are stir fried and coated well on both sides with the masala for a few minutes.

- Switch off the flame.

- Serve with rice or roti as a side dish.

name: Vegetable Egg Roll
ingredients:
- 25g wheat flour

- 1 egg yolk

- 2 egg whites

- 30g cucumber

- 30g onion

- 20g tomato

- 20g capsicum

- 1 tbsp coriander leaves

- 1 green chilli

- ½ tsp salt

- ¼ tsp pepper powder
method:
- Knead dough, and make a roti.

- Using 2 egg whites and 1 yolk, make an omelette by adding salt and pepper powder.

- In a plate, place the roti and place the omelette on top of it, add all the chopped vegetables and coriander leaves on it, and roll it.

- Vegetable egg roll is ready. Can add mint chutney as well (optional).

name: Lentil And Paneer Soup
ingredients:
- 30 gms lentil

- 50 gm paneer

- 50 gms capsicum

- 50 gms tomatoes

- 30 gms onion

- 10 gms carrot

- 1 tsp lemon juice

- ½ tsp chilli powder

- ½ tsp garlic powder

- ½ tsp oil

- black pepper

- salt
method:
- Heat ½ teaspoon of oil in a cooker, add the onions and saute it well.

- Add the garlic and chilli powder and saute it.

- Add lentils , tomatoes, veggies and water, mix well and pressure cook for 3 whistles.

- Allow the steam to escape before opening.

- Cool slightly and blend it in the mixer.

- Transfer the puree to a pan, add salt and pepper.

- Bring to a boil and simmer it for 3 minutes.

- Brush the oil in a non-stick pan, add the paneer cubes and saute it well.

- Add the sauteed paneer and lemon juice to the soup.

- Serve it immediately.

name: Banana Flower Vada
ingredients:
- 100g banana flower

- 30g onion, chopped

- 2 green chillies, chopped

- 1 tsp ginger garlic paste

- 1 tbsp coriander leaves

- ½ tsp turmeric powder

- ½ tsp chilli powder

- ½ tsp dhanya powder

- ½ tsp jeera powder

- 1 tsp besan

- 1 tsp rice flour

- 1 tsp salt

- 2.5 ml oil
method:
- Peel the banana flower, wash it thoroughly. Add a pinch of turmeric and salt, mix well and keep it aside for 5- 7 minutes.

- In a kadhai, add the mixture, add half cup water and let it boil for 10 minutes or until the banana flower is cooked.

- Turn off the flame. Let it cool down a bit, then squeeze the water from the banana flower thoroughly, so that there is no water dripping.

- Add the squeezed mixture in a bowl, add the chopped onions, green chillies, ginger- garlic paste and the spices and mix well.

- Shape it into vada, coat it with besan and rice flour mixture.

- Heat a pan, grease it with ½ tsp oil and place the vada on it.

- Close the pan and cook for 5 minutes. Open the lid, flip and cook from both the sides.

- Turn off the flame. Serve hot with mint coriander chutney.

name: Egg Salad
ingredients:
- 2 egg whites

- 50 gm cabbage

- 50 gm capsicum

- 50 gm onion

- 50 gm tomato

- ½ tsp lemon juice

- 1 tsp mint leaves

- black pepper

- paprika

- red chilli flakes

- ½ tsp olive oil

- salt
method:
- Boil the eggs till done. Cool, peel, remove the yolk part and chop egg whites into dice and place in a bowl.

- Chop tomatoes, capsicum, onion and cabbage.

- Add the chopped tomatoes, capsicum, onion and cabbage.

- Now add mint leaves, lemon juice, black pepper, salt, paprika, chilli flakes and olive oil, give it a good toss.

- Adjust seasoning as per your taste.

- Egg salad ready to serve.

name: Veg Rolled Omelette Bites
ingredients:
- 1 whole egg

- 1 egg white

- 100 gms spinach

- 30 gms capsicum

- 30 gms cabbage

- 20 gms onion

- 20 gms tomato

- ¼ tsp black pepper

- ¼ tsp chilli powder

- ¼ tsp chilli flakes

- salt

- ½ tsp oil
method:
- In a large bowl, beat egg, salt and pepper. Add finely chopped spinach and stir until combined.

- Heat a medium sized pan, grease the oil on a low medium heat. Pour about ¼ of the egg mixture making sure all of the pan is covered.

- Cook about 1-2 minutes until half cooked then start to roll gently into a log, leaving a small part unrolled. Move the egg roll to one side of the pan and grease the pan with a little bit of oil. Pour another ¼ egg mixture on the empty part, cook 1-2 minutes more, until half cooked. Repeat with the remaining egg mixture.

- Transfer to the plate and cutting board and slice.

name: Vegetable Corn Soup
ingredients:
- 50g corn

- 35g beans, chopped into small cubes

- 35g capsicum, chopped into small cubes

- 30g cabbage, chopped

- 1 tsp garlic, finely chopped

- 1 tsp pepper powder

- 1 tsp salt

- ½ tsp oil
method:
- Cook the corn kernels in a pressure cooker, till you get 3 whistles.

- Keep about 10g of corn kernels aside, and grind the rest with ½ cup water or as required to smooth puree.

- Add oil in a pan, add the garlic and all the chopped vegetables and cook them for about 2- 3 minutes.

- Add the corn puree into the pan, add salt and a cup of water or as required.

- Allow the soup to simmer for a few minutes.

- Add the remaining corn kernels and simmer for one more minute.

- Turn off the flame. Add pepper powder and give it a mix.

- Vegetable corn soup is ready.

name: Wheat Veg Egg Dosa
ingredients:
- 25g wheat flour

- 1 egg yolk

- 2 egg whites

- 35g onion, finely chopped or grated

- 30g capsicum, finely chopped or grated

- 35g tomato, finely chopped or grated

- 1 green chilli, finely chopped

- ½ tsp salt

- ½ tsp ajwain (carom seeds)

- ½ tsp oil
method:
- In a big bowl, take 25g of wheat flour.

- Add salt and carom seeds to it and give it a mix.

- Now add all the finely chopped vegetables and mix well.

- Now add 2 egg whites and 1 yolk and mix thoroughly.

- If you feel the batter is hard, add some water and mix well until no lumps.

- The batter should be of semi- liquid consistency.

- Now heat a pan and add oil on it, spread the oil nicely on the pan and add the batter on it and spread it.

- Cook from both the sides for 2-3 minutes on medium flame.

- Turn off the flame, serve it with coriander-mint chutney or any vegetable chutney of your choice.

name: Ragi Vegetable Soup
ingredients:
- 30g ragi flour

- 25g cauliflower

- 25g beans

- 25g capsicum

- 25g onion

- 1 tsp salt

- 2 tsp black pepper powder

- ½ tsp whole cumin seeds

- 1 tsp oil

- water as needed
method:
- Make a thin paste of ragi with water and keep it aside.

- Heat oil in a pan and add whole cumin to it.

- As it sizzles add chopped onions and saute constantly until they turn translucent. Next add all the chopped vegetables.

- Add enough water to the vegetables.

- Add water and cook covered till the vegetables are soft.

- Then add the ragi paste and stir immediately. Make sure there are no lumps.

- Add pepper powder. Combine everything well and add in required water to get the soup to the right consistency.

- Turn off the flame and serve hot.

name: Mint Raita
ingredients:
- 60ml curd

- 10g onion

- 30g cucumber

- 10g mint

- 1 green chilli (deseeded and chopped )

- 1 tsp coriander leaves

- ¼ tsp cumin powder

- salt to taste
method:
- Wash and blend mint into a puree in a blender.

- Chill curd, wash and chop onion, cucumber and green chillies, coriander leaves.

- Add curd, mint puree and salt to a mixing bowl and whisk them until smooth.

- Add cucumber, onion, green chilli, coriander leaves and stir.

- Sprinkle cumin powder on top.

name: Egg Idli
ingredients:
- 1 egg yolk

- 2 egg whites

- 20g onion, finely chopped

- 20g tomato, finely chopped

- 20g capsicum, finely chopped

- 20g beans, finely chopped

- 20g spring onion

- ½ tsp ginger-garlic paste

- 1 tbsp coriander leaves chopped

- ½ tsp salt

- 1 tsp red chilli powder

- ½ tsp turmeric powder

- ½ tsp dhania powder

- ½ tsp mustard seeds

- 1 tsp oil
method:
- In a pan, add oil, once the oil heats up, add mustard seeds and let it crackle.

- Then add ginger- garlic paste. Now add all the finely chopped vegetables and mix well.

- Add salt, chilly powder, turmeric powder and dhania powder, and mix well.

- Cook on medium flame until the vegetables are a little soft.

- Turn off the flame and let it cook down a bit.

- In a bowl break 1 whole egg and 2 egg whites, add a pinch of salt and mix well.

- Add the vegetable mixture to it and mix.

- Now grease the idli mould and pour in the vegetable mixed egg batter into it.

- Add chopped coriander leaves on top. Place it in the pressure cooker (without the whistle) and cook for 10 minutes, check in between if it’s cooked.

- After it's cooked, unmold it and serve hot.

name: Chana Chat
ingredients:
- 30g chana

- 10g onion

- 10g tomato

- 20g cucumber

- 5ml curd

- ½ tsp lemon juice

- ½ tsp green chutney

- ¼ tsp tamarind chutney

- ¼ tsp red chilli

- black salt to taste

- salt to taste
method:
- Soak chana in water for 2 hours. Pressure cook and drain the water and keep aside.

- Chop onion, tomato, cucumber into small cubes and add them in a bowl .

- To the vegetables add chana, curd, green chutney, tamarind chutney, lemon juice, salt, red chilli powder and mix well.

- Chana chat is ready to serve. Garnish with chopped coriander leaves or mint leaves.

name: Bhel Puri
ingredients:
- 20g puffed rice

- 10g onion

- 10g tomato

- 20g cucumber

- 5ml curd

- ½ tsp lemon juice

- ½ tsp green chutney

- ¼ tsp tamarind chutney

- ¼ tsp red chilli

- black salt to taste

- salt to taste
method:
- Take puffed rice in a bowl.

- Chop onion, tomato, cucumber into small cubes and add them into the puffed rice bowl.

- To the vegetables and puffed rice add curd, green chutney, tamarind chutney, lemon juice, salt, red chilli powder, black salt and mix well.

- Bhel puri is ready to serve. Garnish with chopped coriander leaves or mint leaves.

name: Drumstick And Mutton Curry
ingredients:
- 1 tsp dry coconut powder

- 50g tomatoes(chopped)

- ½ tsp ginger garlic paste

- ¼ tsp turmeric powder

- 50g onion chopped

- 5ml oil

- ¼ tsp whole cumin seeds

- 100g mutton

- 50g drumsticks

- ¼ tsp garam masala powder

- coriander leaves (chopped)

- salt to taste

- ¼ tsp coriander powder

- ¼ tsp red chilli powder
method:
- First, cook the meat in a pressure cooker till 70% cooked.

- Heat oil in a pan add whole cumin seeds, chopped onions, salt, cook this till onions are golden in color, add turmeric, ginger garlic paste, cook it till raw flavor is gone.

- Add drumstick, coriander powder, red chilly powder, tomatoes, put the lid on let it cook for 3 to 4 minutes, add dry coconut powder mix it up and add mutton (70% cooked) put the lid on and cook it for 10 minutes.

- Then add garam masala powder, coriander leaves, switch off the flame.

- Serve it with rice or roti.

name: Tawa Pulao
ingredients:
- 30g rice

- ¼ tsp turmeric powder

- salt

- 5ml ghee

- 1 tsp whole cumin

- 30g beans

- 25g onion

- 25g tomato

- 30g capsicum

- 1 tsp ginger garlic paste

- ¼ tsp kashmiri red chilli powder

- coriander (finely chopped)

- 1 tbsp lemon juice
method:
- In a kadai heat ghee and saute whole cumin until it turns aromatic.

- Now add onion and ginger garlic paste. Saute well.

- Keep the flame on medium and add capsicum, beans and salt.

- stir-fry for 3 minutes or until vegetables are cooked slightly.

- Now add tomatoes and saute until the tomato turns soft and mushy and add chilli powder.

- Saute until the oil is released from the masala paste.

- Now add in cooked rice.

- Mix gently without breaking rice.

- add in coriander leaves and lemon juice. Mix well

name: Tomato Capsicum Curry
ingredients:
- 80g capsicum

- ½ ginger garlic paste

- 25g onion

- 50g tomato

- 1 tsp chilli powder

- ¼ tsp turmeric powder

- 1 tsp coriander powder

- ½ tsp methi leaves

- salt

- curry leaves

- 5ml oil

- coriander leaves
method:
- Heat oil in a vessel. Add chopped onions and curry leaves and fry till onions turn transparent.

- Add ginger-garlic paste and saute for 3 mins. Add red chilli powder, turmeric powder, coriander powder and salt and combine together.

- Add chopped capsicums and tomato and fry for 7-8 minutes. Add water and cook for 10 minutes with lid on low flame. Allow the gravy to thicken.

- Add kasuri methi and combine. Add coriander leaves and turn off heat. Serve with rice or rotis.

name: Brinjal Methi Pulao
ingredients:
- 30g rice

- 50g brinjal chopped

- 75g methi leaves

- 1 tsp tbsp oil

- 1 tsp mustard seeds

- ½ tsp turmeric powder

- 1 green Chillies

- few curry Leaves

- salt to taste
method:
- Cook the rice and let it cool down.

- Heat a wide pan and add about 1 tsp of oil. Add the seasoning ingredients and let it fry for about 30 seconds.

- Now add the chopped brinjal, turmeric powder and salt and fry it for about 4-5 minutes in medium flame. Make sure that the brinjals do not get mushy.

- Next add the seasoning masala powder of your choice along with the tamarind extract. Cook it covered for about 5-6 minutes until the brinjals are well cooked but still remain intact add methi leaves.

- Add the cooked rice to the brinjal mixture and gently mix to coat. Let it cook for about 2 more minutes. Check for seasoning and adjust salt if needed.

- Serve warm.

name: Tomato Chat
ingredients:
- 5ml oil

- ½ inch ginger (grated)

- ½ tsp turmeric

- ½ tsp chilli powder

- 1 tsp cumin powder

- ½ tsp coriander powder

- ½ tsp garam masala

- 1 tsp chaat masala

- 25g tomato (roughly chopped)

- salt

- 20g chickpea

- mint (finely chopped)

- coriander (finely chopped)

- 15g murmura
method:
- Heat oil in a pan and add 1 tbsp ginger.keeping the flame on low add turmeric,chilli powder,cumin powder, coriander powder, garam masala, chaat masala .Saute on low flame until the spices turn aromatic.

- Now add tomato,salt and saute for 2 minutes.

- Boil for 3 minutes or until tomatoes soften slightly.

- Further add chickpea and saute well.

- Add 1 cup water and mix well.

- Cover and boil for 5 minutes or until the oil separates.

- Further add Murmura, mint and coriander. Mix well.

name: Mutton Peas Sabzi
ingredients:
- 100 grams mutton

- 50 grams curd

- 25g onion, sliced

- ½ tbsp Ginger garlic paste

- 30g green peas

- 1 green Chilly

- ½ teaspoon Turmeric powder

- ½ tablespoons Coriander Powder

- ½ tablespoons Red Chilli powder

- salt as required

- 5ml oil

- coriander Leaves

- 1 small bay leaf

- ¼ black pepper powder

- ½ inch cinnamon Stick

- 1 cardamom, 1 cloves
method:
- Wash the mutton with water, strain and keep it aside.

- In the oil add cinnamon, clove, cardamom and bay leaves then add onions. When it turns brown add ginger garlic paste and green chillies and saute till the raw smell goes off.

- Add in the mutton and mix well. Fry for some time till the moisture goes off.

- Add curd and mix nicely. Simmer the flames. Close the lid and allow the minced mutton to cook nicely. This may take 15 to 20 minutes.

- Once the mutton mince is soft and cooked completely, add in the turmeric powder, red chilli powder, coriander powder, salt, green peas.

- Turn on medium flame till the meat starts taking a deep brown color and leaves oil from the sides.

- Turn off the gas and garnish with fresh chopped coriander.

name: Grilled Aubergine
ingredients:
- 5ml oil

- ¼ tsp crushed chilli flakes

- salt

- ½ tsp black pepper

- 200g aubergines (brinjal)

- coriander leaves for garnishing

- ½ tsp lemon juice
method:
- Cut brinjals into thin round slices and brush it with chilli flakes, pepper, and salt.

- Grill the aubergines in a grill pan until tender. Squeeze the lemon juice on top and garnish with coriander.

name: Paneer Capsicum Sabzi
ingredients:
For paneer marination

- 100g paneer

- 1 tbsp methi leaves

- ½ tsp chilli powder

- ¼ tsp turmeric powder

- salt

Other ingredients for sabzi

- 5ml oil

- 100g capsicum

- 1 tsp ginger garlic paste

- 1 tsp whole cumin seeds

- 1 chilli

- 1 tsp coriander powder

- 25g onions

- 25g tomato

- coriander leaves
method:
- Combine paneer with methi leaves, chilli powder, salt and turmeric powder and toss in a pan for 1- 2 minutes.

- Heat oil in kadai. Add whole cumin seeds, then onions. When the onion turns transparent add ginger-garlic paste, salt, chilli and tomato and saute for 2 minutes.

- Add capsicum and coriander powder and saute for 3-4 minutes. Add tossed paneer and cook for 3 minutes until raw smell goes off. Add chopped coriander leaves. Serve hot with roti or rice.

name: Grilled Rajma Sandwich With Leftover Vegtables
ingredients:
- 2 whole wheat bread

- 50g capsicum

- 25g tomato

- 25g onion

- 30g rajma

- ¼ inch ginger grated

- ½ clove garlic grated

- ¼ turmeric powder

- ½ tsp chilli powder

- ½ tsp garam masala

- salt

- 5ml oil
method:
- soak rajma overnight and cook the rajma until soft. Drain the excess water and keep aside.

- In a pan,heat oil. Add grated ginger, garlic and saute for a few seconds. Add the cooked rajma, all the masalas.

- Stir to combine all the ingredients and saute on medium heat until raw smell goes.

- To prepare grilled sandwich, place the bread slices on the grill pan. Spread a spoonful of rajma masala mixture over one slice and top it with onions, tomatoes and capsicum. Cover with another bread slice and press it down. Add oil on sides.

- Cook until crisp and serve.

name: Masala Khakhra
ingredients:
- 30g whole wheat flour

- 1 tsp besan flour

- ½ tsp whole cumin seeds

- ½ tsp chilli powder

- ¼ haldi

- ¼ hing

- 5ml oil

- salt

- 10 ml milk
method:
- To make Masala khakhra, combine all ingredients and knead into a soft dough without using water.

- Divide and roll out the dough to thin round.

- Heat tava and cook khakhra on slow flame.

- Cook until it turns crisp and brown from both sides.

name: Crispy Cabbage Taco With Rajma Masala
ingredients:
- 30g wheat flour

- 30g rajma

- 100g cabbage

- 1 tsp garlic powder

- 1 tsp paprika powder

- 1 tsp pepper powder

- 1 tsp cumin powder

- salt

- 1 tsp corn flour

- 25g onion

- 5ml oil
method:
- In a bowl add wheat flour,corn flour, salt,little oil and mix it well.

- Then add water and make a dough and leave for 20 minutes.

- For stuffing, In a pan add oil. Add onion, once it turns brown add cauliflower, boiled rajma, paprika powder, pepper powder, cumin, garlic powder, and salt. Cook until tender.

- After 20 minutes knead the dough and take a small ball and make a roti and cut into 2 small circle roti and prick with forks.

- In a pan add oil and prepare tacos.

- Then for stuffing, add the cauliflower and rajma Masala.

name: Veg Patty
ingredients:
- 40g potato

- 30g carrot

- 30g beans

- ½ tsp ginger

- ½ tsp garam masala

- ½ tsp chilli powder

- salt

- 5ml oil

- coriander leaves

- 1 tsp bread crumbs
method:
- Steam beans and carrot until soft and drain excess water and keep aside.

- Boil and peel potatoes.Then add beans, carrot, potato, salt, ginger,garam masala, chilli powder and chopped coriander in a food processor and combine well.

- Shape the mixture into patties.

- Heat oil in a pan and fry the patties until golden brown and crispy.

name: Dhaba Style Aloo/Raw Banana/ Sweet Potato Sabzi
ingredients:
- 2 sweet potato

- 1 raw banana

- 1 Potato

- ¼ tsp asafoetida

- ½ tsp panch phoren

- 2-3 whole red chillies

- 2 bay leaf

- few whole slitted green chillies according to taste

- 2 tbsp grated ginger

- salt to taste

- ¼ tsp turmeric powder

- ½ tsp chilli powder

- ½ tsp kadhmiri chilli powder (for colour)

- 2 tbsp of dry kasturi methi leaves

- 2 tbsp oil
method:
- Clean and wash the sweet potato and potato.

- Cut them both in big cubes with the jacket (in 8pcs).
Peel and cut the raw banana in medium size pieces (keep in water or will become black).

- Put oil in a kadhai and let it warm a little.Add the asafoetida.

- Add the whole red chillies.

- Add the panch phoren. Stir for few seconds ,the fragrance should come.

- Add the grated ginger. Stir for few minutes.

- Add the whole slitted green chillies. Stir for few seconds.

- Now add the cut potato ,sweet potato and raw banana. Stir for few minutes.

- Add salt according to taste, turmeric ,red chilli powder and kashmiri chilli powder.

- Mix well and stir for few minutes.

- Now add the dried kasturi methi leaves. Stir for few minutes.

- Add 2 cups of water (can add more if require to cook and for the gravy ).

- When the water starts bubbling.

- Cover and cook on low flame till all are cooked. Done.

- Serve with tandoori roti /pav or paratha with a sweet chutney.

name: Jhatpat Chicken Curry
ingredients:
- 500 gms chicken

- 2 medium size onions grated

- 1 piece ginger pounded

- 1 full clove of garlic pounded (just keep 4-5 big whole pieces aside to be put later)

- few red chillies (not green ones) made into a paste or pounded

- salt to taste

- kashmiri chilli powder according to taste

- ¼ tsp turmeric powder

- 1 big tomato cut into 4 pieces

- 2-3 tbsp of chopped coriander leaves

- 3 tbsp of oil

- 2 cups of water
method:
- Heat oil in a kadhai.

- Then add the grated onions and saute till the onions become soft.

- Now add the pounded ginger and garlic.

- Saute till it turns into a nice light brown colour.

- Add the pounded green chilli.

- Add the kashmiri red chilli powder. Saute for few minutes.

- Now add the chicken and saute for 5-10 minutes on low flame.

- Can add few tbsp of water if the masala starts getting caught at the bottom.

- Cover and cook the chicken for 5-7 minutes on low flame .

- Now add the cut tomato and stir fry for few minutes.

- Chicken will leave its own water,will cook in that.

- When the tomato becomes soft and chi Ken is ¾ done.

- Add 2 cups of water and when it starts bubbling lower the flame and cover and cook till chicken is done.

- Open and add the chopped coriander leaves, mix it well.

- Then cover and keep for few minutes. Done.

- Serve with rice or roti.

name: Moong Dal Chilla
ingredients:
- 250-300 gms moong dal

- 1 ½ tbsp ginger grated

- few green chillies

- ¼ tsp asafoetida

- salt to taste

- 1 onion chopped

- 1 tomato chopped

- 2 tbsp chopped coriander

- oil as per requirement
method:
- Wash and soak dal overnight. Drain the water and put in a grinder.

- Add few green chillies according to taste. And add the 1 ½ tbsp of granted ginger.

- Grind the dal to a smooth paste.

- Can 2-3 tbsp of water. When done remove and put in a bowl.

- Now add salt according to taste.

- Add ¼ tsp asafoetida. Mix well and beat the batter for few minutes .

- Heat a non stick tava ,add 1 tsp oil.

- When the oil gets hot put 3-4 tbsp batter with a ladle and make it like a dosa.

- Sprinkle on top,chopped onions,chopped tomato, chopped coriander leaves and

- chopped green chillies according to taste. Press the above into the batter.

- Cook on low to medium flame till the sides start leaving

- Flip it over and cook for few minutes. Done .

- Serve with coriander/mint/ garlic chutney .

Note

- Can put thinly sliced spinach,grated beetroot, grated carrots instead of the onions and tomatoes on top of the chila.

name: Special Tomato Chutney
ingredients:
- ½ kg tomatoes ,each cut into 8 pcs

- ⅓ -⅔ cup jaggery

- 2 tbsp rasins

- 5-6 dates ,deseeded and cut into strips

- 100gms sweet aampapar cut into small cubes

- 3-4 whole red chillies

- 1 tsp panch phoren

- 1 tsp panch phoren roasted and grounded

- salt to taste

- pinch of turmeric

- 1- 2 tbsp of oil
method:
- Put 1 tsp panch phoren on a tava or pan and roast it on low flame ,till you get a nice fragrance .

- Cool it down ,then put it in a mortar postal and pound it ,then keep it aside .

- Put the oil in a pan and warm the oil.

- Then add the panch phoren and whole red chillies.

- Stir for a minute or so ,till it starts spluttering or you get a nice fragrance.

- Add the chopped tomatoes and stir for few mins on medium flame.

- Add the salt and turmeric and stir for few seconds.

- Lower the flame and then cover and cook till the tomatoes become soft.

- Now add the jaggery and mix it well . Cover and cook for few minutes .

- Then add the rasins and cut dates and mix well .

- Cover and cook for few minutes in low flame .

- Add the roasted ground panch phoren and mix well.

- Now add the cubes of aampapar. Mix well.

- Cook for few minutes. Done .

Note

- This is a sweet sour chutney ,if you want chillies ,can add ½ tsp chilli powder ,with the turmeric and salt .

- Along with the rasins and date can add little cashews.

name: Dry Roast Chicken
ingredients:
- 20g chicken

- 2 tsp ginger garlic paste

- 10g onion

- 5g green chilli

- 10g tomato paste

- ¼ tsp turmeric powder

- 1 tsp chilli powder

- 1 tsp coriander powder

- 1 tsp chicken masala

- 1 tsp oil

- salt
method:
- In a pan add oil, green chillies, ginger garlic paste, chicken cook for a minute.

- Then add turmeric powder, salt, onion paste cook for 3-4 minutes.

- Add tomato paste, red chilli powder, coriander powder, salt, chicken masala and add water cook till it becomes dry.

name: Veg Manchow Soup With Grilled Chicken
ingredients:
- 10g onion

- 5g mushroom

- 10g noodles

- 5g corn flour

- 1 tsp oil

- 1 chopped ginger

- 1 chopped garlic

- 5g beans

- 5g carrot

- 5g cabbage

- home made tomato sauce

- salt

- water

- 5g coriander leaves

- 5g green chilli
method:
- In a bowl add noodles and corn flour mix well.

- Heat the oil in a pan and fry the noodles and keep aside.

- In the same pan add oil ginger, garlic, onion and stir till it turns golden brown.

- Then add beans, carrot, cabbage, mushrooms, green chilli mix well stir for a minute.

- Then add salt and tomato sauce and water mix well .

- In a bowl add corn flour and water mix and add to the soup.

- Add noodles and garnish with coriander leaves.

- Serve hot.

name: Healthy Seed Crackers
ingredients:
- 120 grams of mixed seeds

- 1 tbsp chia seeds

- 1 tbsp psyllium seed husks/isabgol (little less if you are using powder)

- 1 tsp salt

- ½ tbsp honey

- 1 tbsp melted coconut oil or ghee

- 80 ml water

Half batch

- 2 large dried fig / 2 dates chopped / dried cranberry
method:
- In a large bowl combine all dry ingredients, stirring well.

- Whisk honey, oil and water together in a measuring cup. Add this to the dry ingredients and mix very well until everything is completely soaked and dough becomes very thick (if the dough is too thick to stir, add one or two teaspoons of water until the dough is manageable).

- Divide the dough roughly in half, and set aside one half.

- Place one half of the dough back into the bowl and add any flavouring you like. Gather into a ball and place it between two sheets of baking paper. Using a rolling pin, firmly roll out into a thin sheet. Remove top layer of baking paper and using the tip of a knife, score the dough into shapes you like (I chose large rectangles but it’s up to you). Repeat with remaining half of dough. Let sit out on the counter for at least 2 hours, or all day or overnight.

- Preheat oven to 160°C. Using the baking paper, slide the dough onto a cookie sheet and bake for 15 minutes. Remove cookie sheet from oven, flip the whole cracker over (if it breaks a bit, don’t worry!) and peel the baking paper off of the back. Return to oven to bake for another 10 minutes, until fully dry, crisp, and golden around the edges.

- Let cool completely, then break crackers along their scored lines and store in an airtight container for up to 3 weeks.

Notes

- Seed mix you can buy a premixed bag else make your own mix. I used sunflower, watermelon, pumpkin, black and white sesame and flax seeds.

- Watch the crackers to ensure they don’t burn.

- You can add any flavouring of your choice to make it savoury or sweet as per your liking.

- You can make these in any shape. Use cookie cutters or make shapes of your own.

name: Amaranth Tabbouleh
ingredients:
- ¼ cup cooked and washed rajgira

- ¼ cup cucumber diced

- ¼ cup pomegranate

- ¼ cup paneer

- ¼ cup white for brown channa if allowed

- 2 tbsp seeds of choice ( i have use 1 tbsp watermelon seeds + 1 tbsp sunflower)

- 1 tbsp finely chopped coriander leaves

- lime to taste

- salt to taste
method:
- Mix all the ingredients together to form a salad.

- Add lime and salt to taste.

Notes

- I like to wash the rajgira after cooking to remove the starch. This helps to give a better texture to the salad.

name: Amaranth Pineapple Cashew Pulav
ingredients:
- ½ cup cooked amaranth

- ½ tsp jeera

- ½ tsp chopped ginger

- ½ tsp chopped green chilies

- ½ cup chopped pineapple

- ¼ cup chopped roasted cashew

- ½ tsp melted ghee

- salt to taste
method:
- Add ghee to a kadhai and add the jeera and green chillies.

- Once it splutters add the ginger.

- Cook for a minute.

- Add the roasted cashew and pineapple.

- Add the cooked and washed rajgira and mix.

- Cook till the flavours are incorporate.

Notes

- I cook a large batch of rajgira.

- wash and drain it to get a non sticky grain that can be used in many way.

name: Pan Fried Momos
ingredients:
I love momos especially pan fried momos with their crisp bottoms.

Here is a simple way to make pan fried momos and you can check step by step videos here

Ingredients for the wrapper

- 125 gms flour ( maida ), plus more for rolling and dusting

- Pinch of salt

- 1/4 cup of water + 1 tbsp (about 75 ml)

Make the momo wrapper
Mix the flour and salt in a large bowl
Create a small well and add the water 1tbsp at a time while mixing together.
You can use chopsticks, a fork or you hands to mix the water into the flour
Once the dough is well mixed, place it on a floured surface and knead for 15 to 20 mins till it is soft and elastic
Cover the dough with a damp towel and let is rest for 30 mins. This is a great time to work on your filling.
Once the dough has rested for 30 minutes, place it on a surface dusted with flour and knead for another 5 mins
Roll it out into a large log and cut out equal portions, similar in size or weight. I got 16 wrappers.
Cover the cut portions with a damp towel
Take one and press flat with your palm as you would a roti
Roll it out like a very small roti that is about 1 mm thick and about 4inch diameter.
It doesn’t need to be perfectly round but if you prefer it to be, just cut it with a cup or lid to get a perfect circle
Cover the wrappers with a damp cloth to prevent them from drying out

Make the momos
Work with one wrapper at a time.
Place a large tablespoon of your filling of choice in the centre of the momo wrapper
Dip you finger in a little water and run it over one edge
Fold the wrapper in half like a small closed taco
Press down the sides firmly
Fold the edged like a little fan. You can watch it here
Place the wrapped momos on plate and cover with a damp towel as you prep the remaining momos

Pan fry the momos
In a large non stick pan or well seasoned cast iron pan add about 1 tbsp of oil and heat at medium heat
Place the momos with the pleat side up and press them down to flatten the base.
Cook uncovered till the base has a nice brown crisp - about 3 to 4 minutes
Add 1/2 a cup of water for about 8 momos to the pan and cover with a lid
Cook for about 5 - 7 minutes
Uncover and cook till the water dries up and the base of the momos are crisp.
If you want to crisp them more, add a little oil to help crisp them up.
Serve immediately with base side up and my Chinese sweet chilli sauce

- 3 tbsp finely chopped or grated garlic

- 1 green spring onions chopped or 1 small onion

- Pinch of salt

- 250 gms chicken mince

- 1 tsp oil for the filling

Take one and press flat with your palm as you would a roti
