It doesn’t need to be perfectly round but if you prefer it to be, just cut it with a cup or lid to get a perfect circle
Cover the wrappers with a damp cloth to prevent them from drying out

Make the momos
Work with one wrapper at a time.
Place a large tablespoon of your filling of choice in the centre of the momo wrapper
Dip you finger in a little water and run it over one edge
Fold the wrapper in half like a small closed taco
Press down the sides firmly
Fold the edged like a little fan. You can watch it here
Place the wrapped momos on plate and cover with a damp towel as you prep the remaining momos

Pan fry the momos
In a large non stick pan or well seasoned cast iron pan add about 1 tbsp of oil and heat at medium heat
Place the momos with the pleat side up and press them down to flatten the base.
Cook uncovered till the base has a nice brown crisp - about 3 to 4 minutes
Add 1/2 a cup of water for about 8 momos to the pan and cover with a lid
Cook for about 5 - 7 minutes
Uncover and cook till the water dries up and the base of the momos are crisp.
If you want to crisp them more, add a little oil to help crisp them up.
Serve immediately with base side up and my Chinese sweet chilli sauce

name: Homemade Authentic Biryani
ingredients:
- 1 kg mutton/ chicken (if using chicken make slits in the chicken so that the marination goes in )

- 250 gms curd

- 1 tbsp ginger paste

- 2 tbsp garlic paste

- 1 tbsp dhaniya powder

- 1 tbsp kashmiri chilli powder

- 2-3 tsp red chilli powder

- 2 tsp biryani masala

- 500 gms onions sliced fine

- 2 tomatoes ,cut in 2 or 4

- 500 gms potatoes (optional)

- 4-6 boiled eggs (optional )

- 1 drop only of Meetha Atar (please use a dropper )

- 200 gms of ghee/oil can use bit of both in the proportion you desire .

- 4 black cardamom

- 8 green cardamom

- 2 big pieces of cinnamon stick

- 10 pieces of clove

Marination

- Marinate the meat/chicken in the curd,ginger-garlic paste,red chilli powder, kashmiri chilli powder, ½ tsp biryani masala and 1 drop of meetha atar .

- Keep aside for 20-30 minutes .

For the onions

- Cut the onions in thin slices.

- Put the oil/ghee in a kadhai and add the onions to it .(if the kadhai is not big enough ,do it in 2 lots).

- Brown the onions to a golden brown and remove from the kadhai .

- When the onions become light brown ,switch off the flame ,as it will keep cooking.

- Take care not to make the onions dark. Keep aside.

- When the onions are cooled down.

- Put in ¾ in a grinder and grind it. Keep it aside.

- Keep the sliced remaining brown onion separate.

Cooking of the meat/chicken

- In the same kadhai add all the whole garam masala.

- When the fragrance of the garam masala starts emitting.

- Add the marinated meat/chicken and stir it for few minutes.

- Now add the dhaniya powder and 1 tsp biryani masala.

- Add salt according to taste, keeping in mind that while cooking the rice salt will be put .

- Mix it in well and saute for few minutes.

- Now add the cut tomato pieces(If you are using mutton then need to transfer to a pressure cooker ,for 10 minutes on low flame after the 1 st whistle .Let the cooker open naturally .When the cooker opens transfer the mutton back onto the kadai,should be 90% done).

- Saute the meat for few minutes.

- Now remove the tomatoes from the kadhai ,put in a bowl, remove the skin and then mash the tomatoes well.

- Now add it back to the kadhai.

- Now add ¾ of the browned ground onions to the kadhai and saute for few minutes .

- When you get a nice brown colour ,switch of flame .

Cooking for potatoes

- Boil potatoes. Peel and cut in half

- Sprinkle little salt ,pinch of biryani masala and if you want pinch of orange food colour.

- Take a pan add 2 tbsp of oil/ghee in it.

- When it is warm, add the boiled potatoes. Toss it for few minutes ,so that it becomes little brown.

- Keep aside .

For the eggs if you are adding

- Boil the eggs ,peel and keep aside.

Cooking of the rice

- 750 gms of long grain rice.

- Wash and soak the rice for 20-30 minutes.

- Take a big pan add water.

- Then add 1 tsp whole cumin, ½ tsp peppercorns, 2 bay leaves, 4 green cardamom, 2 black cardamom, 2 big cinnamon stick, 6-8 cloves, 3 flat tbsp of salt.

- When the water starts boiling, add the rice. Stir it gently.

- When the rice is half cooked. Add the lemon juice.

- Cook the rice to 90%.

- Remove from fire and drain nicely(If you do not have a big pan to boil the rice ,do it in 2 lots).

Last step the layering

- Separate some of the oil from the cooked meat and keep aside for the layering.

- Take a big pan or kadhai with a lid for the assembling/layering.

- Now put some rice in the bottom of the pan.

- Spread a little of the oil all over.

- Place half the eggs and potato on it.

- Now add half the meat with the gravy on it,need to spread it all over.

- Now add the some rice,then the remaining potatoes, eggs.

- Spread a little of the oil.

- Now add the remaining ½ tsp biryani masala.

- Now sprinkle some of the brown onions.

- Now cover with remaining rice ,sprinkle the remaining brown onions and spread the remaining oil all over.

- Done.

- Cover with a lid ,place something heavy on it.

- Place a tava on medium flame.

- Place the biryani pan on it.

- When the tava becomes hot, make the flame low and cook for 20-30 minutes.

- Open when ready to serve.

Vegetarian Biryani
All the process and ingredients will be same just have to replace the non-veg with vegetables and paneer.

Ingredients

- 250-300gms carrots

- 250 gms beans

- 300-400gms cauliflower

- 300-350gms peas

- 250-300gms potatoes

- 300-400gms paneer
method:
- Cut the vegetables in cubes and saute in a kadhai with salt and a drop of meetha atar ,leave it 90% done.Keep aside .

- Cut the paneer in big cubes and stir fry in a pan and keep aside.

- Add a pinch of biryani masala on the vegetables and paneer.

- In a kadhai,add ghee When warm add ginger garlic paste.

- Saute till raw smell goes.

- Take curd and beat it well and add to the ginger garlic paste.

- Add red chilli powder and coriander powder. Saute.

- Add one tomato which should be boiled and skin peeled, and then pureed.

- When sauted nicely.

- Add the biryani masala.

- Add the cooked vegetables.

- Mix it in well. Now add the stir fried paneer,taking care not to break it .

- Add ¾ fried onions. Mix.

- Now layering to be done with the potato in the same way.

name: Navratri Dahi Potato (With Thick Gravy)
ingredients:
- 300 gms boiled potatoes

- 1 cup curd

- 1 tsp whole cumin

- ¼ tsp asafoetida

- few chopped green chillies

- salt to taste

- 2 tbsp of ghee
method:
- Whip the curd and keep aside.

- Peel the potatoes and cut into cubes.

- Now mix the cubed potatoes to the curd and mix it gently. Keep aside.

- Heat the ghee in a pan.

- When the ghee becomes warm.

- Add the asafoetida and whole cumin.

- When the cumin starts to splutter. Add the chopped green chillies. Stir for few seconds.

- Add the curd and potato and ¼ cup water.

- And keep stirring or the curd will curdle .

- Make the flame low and keep stirring gently.

- The gravy will start to thicken .

- Add salt to taste. Stir for few seconds.

- Remove from flame.

- Done.

name: Sabudana Tikiya
ingredients:
- 1 cup ready sabudana

- ½ cup roasted peanuts (crushed coarsely in a mortar pestal)

- 2 big size boiled potatoes

- 2 tbsp chopped coriander leaves

- few green chillies chopped

- salt to taste

- pinch of pepper
method:
- Soak sabudana 3-4 hours prior to cooking (use instructions on the packet,here used 1 cup raw sabudana and little less than 1 cup water).

- Boil potatoes, grate it and keep aside.

- Now mix all the ingredients together.

- Check salt.

- Now take a small ball of the mixture in your pan and flatten it out to make a small tikiya.

- Repeat with the remaining mixture .

- Take a pan add 2 tbsp oil and 2 tbsp of ghee.

- When it gets warm.

- Add the tikiyas, cook on low flame till it is slightly brown then flip and cook the other side.

- Do cover in between for few minutes the remove.

- Repeat same when you flip the tikiya.

- If you are using a big pan can put all together.

- If doing in lots use oil accordingly.

- Done.

Tip

- when making the tikiya put a drop of oil on your palm so that there is a coating on both sides of the tikiya, then it does not stick to the pan.

name: Navratri Sukha Chana
ingredients:
1 cup chana (raw) (to be washed and soaked overnight)
2 tbsp oil/ghee
¼ tsp asafoetida
1 tsp whole cumin
few slitted green chillies
few chopped green chillies
2 piece ginger julienne
¼ tsp turmeric
¼ tsp kashmiri chilli powder (for colour)
1-2 tsp of coriander powder
1 ½ tsp aamchur
2 tbsp chopped coriander leaves
method:
- Boil and cook the chana in a pressure cooker.

- Add salt to taste.

- Cook the chana in a pressure cooker for 15-20 minutes after the first whistle, on low flame.

- Remove from flame and keep aside.

- Let the cooker open naturally.

- In a pan add the oil/ ghee.

- Let the oil warm a little.

- Add the asafoetida.

- Add the whole cumin.

- When the whole cumin changes colour or starts spluttering.

- Add the slitted green chillies and the chopped green chillies. Stir fry for a minute or so.

- Add the ginger julienne. Stir for few seconds.

- Add the turmeric,coriander and red chilli powder. Stir for few seconds.

- Now add the aamchur powder.

- Mix it in and stir for few seconds.

- Now add the boiled cooked chana.

- Even the water whatever there is.

- Mix it well with the masala.

- Cover and cook on low flame for few minutes.

- Then remove cover and cook on medium flame ,let the water dry up.

- Add the chopped coriander leaves. Mix it in and cook for a minute or so.

- It's done .

name: Sabudana Khichdi
ingredients:
- 1 cup ready sabudana

- 1 potato boiled and cut in cubes

- ½ cup pumpkin cubes, boiled/steamed

- 8 tbsp roasted peanuts

- ½ tsp whole cumin

- pinch of turmeric powder

- 1 tsp grated ginger

- few green chillies chopped

- pinch of pepper

- 2 tbsp of ghee

- 2 tbsp of chopped coriander leaves
method:
- In a pan put add the ghee. When the ghee is warm add the whole cumin.

- When the cumin starts to splutter.

- Add the turmeric powder. Stir it.

- Add the grated ginger and black pepper. Stir for a minute or so.

- Add the chopped green chillies. Mix it in.

- Now add the roasted peanuts and mix it in with the masala.

- Add the cooked potato and pumpkin. Mix it in.

- Now add the sabudana. Mix it in.

- Add the sendha salt to taste. Mix and stir for few seconds.

- Cover and cook on low flame for few minutes. Stir in between.

- Add the chopped coriander leaves.

- Mix it in.

- Ready.

name: Navratri Sabudana Halwa
ingredients:
- 1 cup of soaked sabudana

- 1/2 cup jaggery

- 1 tsp powdered green cardamom

- 5-6 almonds cut in strips

- 1 walnut broken into pieces

- few rasins

- 1 ½ tbsp of ghee
method:
- In a kadhai add the ghee.

- When the ghee becomes warm.

- Add the dried fruits .

- Stir for few seconds.

- Then add the jaggery .

- Stir on low flame.

- When the jaggery starts to melt .

- Add the soaked sabudana .

- Stir it in well for few minutes on low flame .

- Add the powdered cardamom powder

- Mix it well .

- Cook on low flame for few seconds .

- Done .

name: Tahini With Sweet Potato Fries
ingredients:
- 1 cup sesame seeds

- 2 tablespoons neutral flavored oil such as grape seed, vegetable or a light olive oil ( optional)

- 1tsp of honey

- ½ tsp salt, adjust to taste
method:
- Add the sesame seeds to a wide pan over medium to low heat.

- Stir continuously until the seeds become fragrant and very lightly brown coloured (not brown) – approx. 3 to 5 mins

- Transfer the toasted seeds to a tray or large plate lined with a baking sheet or paper napkin and cool completely.

- Add the cooled sesame seeds a food processor or a mixer grinder and grind to a crumbly paste. About 1 min Stop periodically and use a spatula to push down or scrape down the bottom and side of the sesame paste.

- Add the honey, salt and 1tsp of oil and grind till you get a smooth consistency. It should be pourable with no grits or pieces. Keep grinding and scraping down the sides as you go.

- Check the seasoning and add as needed. Add a little more oil if you want a more pourable consistency.

- Process 5 to 10 seconds to mix it in.

- Serve with sweet potato fried, my seeds crackers or roasted carrots.

name: Navratri Kuttu Atta Ki Kadhi
ingredients:
For the kadhi

- 1 tbsp ghee

- 2 tbsp kuttu atta

- ½ cup curd

- 1 tsp whole cumin

- 2 slited green chillies

- 1-2 chopped green chillies

- 1 tsp grated ginger or paste

- 2-2 ½ cups of water

- salt to taste

- 1 ½ tsp of sugar

- 2 tbsp chopped coriander leaves

For the pakoda

- 1 potato cut into small cubes

- 1-2 chopped green chillies

- 1 tbsp chopped coriander leaves

- pinch of pepper

- salt to taste

- ½ tsp ginger paste

- 2 tsp of kuttu atta /flour

- 2 tsp curd
method:
For the pakoda

- Mix all the ingredients together, mix it well.

- Take a pan add 3 tbsp ghee ghee/oil.

- Warm the ghee/oil.

- Take a spoonful of the potato mixture and place in the pan.

- When the side facing down becomes beige brown.

- Flip the side and cook till it is brown.

- Remove the pakoda and keep aside.

- Repeat the process till the potato mixture finishes.

For the kadhi

- Mix the kuttu atta and curd with 2-3 cups of water and keep aside.

- In the same pan, in which the pakoda was cooked, add 1 tbsp of ghee (if ghee is left over in the pan from the pakoda cooking, no need to add more).

- When the ghee is warm.

- Add the whole cumin.

- When it starts to splutter add the slitted green chillies and chopped green chillies. Stir for few seconds.

- Add the ginger paste.

- Stir fry till the raw smell of the ginger is completely gone and it is sauted nicely.

- Now add the mixture of the kuttu flour and curd to the pan.

- Stir continuously on medium heat.

- After few minutes make the flame low.

- Add the salt and sugar.

- Cook for a minute or so.

- Add the pakodas.

- Cook for few minutes .

- Done.

name: Amaranth/Rajgira Bars
ingredients:
- ½ cup hemp seeds

- 1 cup puffed amaranth

- 2 tsp lemon zest

- ½ cup pista, finely chopped

- ½ cup dried cranberries (can be replaced with chopped raisins)

- ½ cup honey

- ½ cup almond butter/peanut butter

- ½ cup dessicated coconut (optional), roasted

- ¼ tsp black salt (optional)

- ½ cup flax seeds
method:
- Line a rectangular cake tray or baking tray with baking paper and keep aside.

- In a pan, mix the nut butter and honey. Whisk well till completely combined.

- Melt the mixture over medium heat and cool for 5 minutes.

- Chop the pista and roast in a pan. Once roasted spray with a little oil and add a little salt. (the salt is optional)

- In a large mixing bowl add the dry ingredients - the puffed amaranth, hemp seeds, lemon zest, roasted pista cranberries, flax seeds and desiccated coconut.

- Once the honey and nut mixture has cooled, mix it into the dry ingredients and stir till well combined.

- Transfer this mix to the prepare baking or dish. Press down till you get an even surface and flat layer atleast 1 cm thick. Refrigerate upto 4 hours.

- Lift the parchment paper out and place on a table top. Use a knife to cut equal sized bars.

name: Rajgira Lauki Paratha
ingredients:
- 30g rajgira flour

- 30g lauki

- ¼ tsp red chilli powder

- ¼ tsp coriander powder

- ¼ turmeric powder

- rock salt to taste

- 1 tsp ghee

- water for kneading
method:
- Take a bowl add rajgira flour, grated lauki, red chilli powder, coriander powder, turmeric powder, salt and mix all the ingredients well, now sprinkle some water and knead it into a soft dough.

- Divide the dough into two portions.

- Take a polythene sheet, divide it into two squares, place it on the roti rolling area and apply some ghee on it and then place the dough, now place the other sheet on top of the dough and roll the dough into roti, repeat the step for both the rotis*(since the dough is very sticky and non stretchy can use polythene on both the sides to avoid breakage of roti while rolling)*.

- Heat a pan, apply some ghee and cook lauki roti on both the sides, repeat the same procedure for both the rotis.

- Once it is cooked transfer both the rotis to a serving plate.

- Serve rajgira lauki paratha with green curd.

name: Kattu Pancake
ingredients:
- 30g kattu flour

- 30ml milk

- 1 tsp honey

- 2 almonds

- 1 small banana

- 1 tsp ghee

- pinch of baking soda
method:
- Take a bowl add kattu flour, milk, baking soda and mix it well.

- Heat pan apply some ghee and transfer half kattu batter and allow it to cook for 1 minute, then flip it and cook for another 1 minute, repeat the procedure for the rest batter.

- Once both the pancakes are cooked well transfer it to a serving plate.

- Top it with chopped banana, honey and chopped almonds.

- Enjoy yummy kattu pancake.

name: Rajgira Uttapam With Coriander Peanut Chutney
ingredients:
- 30g rajgira flour

- 50ml water

- salt to taste

- 1 tsp ghee

For chutney

- 2 tbsp coriander leaves

- 5 roasted peanuts

- pinch of cumin powder

- rock salt to taste

- pinch of sugar

- 2 tbsp water
method:
- Take a small bowl add rajgira flour, pinch of salt, 50ml water and mix it well into a thick batter.

- Heat Pan add 1 teaspoon of ghee and spread it evenly throughout the pan.

- Divide the batter into 2 and pour half batter and allow it to cook for 1 minute, then flip the uttapam to another side and cook it for another 1 minute, once it is cooked well, transfer to a plate.

- Repeat the same procedure for another half of the batter.

- Once both the uttapam are cooked well transfer to a serving plate.

For chutney

- Take a mixing jar, add coriander, roasted peanut, pinch of cumin powder, salt, water and a pinch of sugar and blend it well to make a fine paste of chutney.

- Serve rajgira uttapam with coriander chutney and enjoy it.

name: Rajgira Muthia
ingredients:
- 30g rajgira flour

- 30ml water

- pinch of turmeric powder

- pinch of red chilli powder

- pinch of rock salt

- ¼ tsp of white sesame seeds

- 1 tsp ghee

- 1 tbsp coriander

- 1 tbsp roasted peanut
method:
- Take rajgira flour in a bowl, add salt, turmeric powder, red chilli powder, coriander powder and sprinkle some water simultaneously and knead it slowly and make a soft dough.

- Divide the dough into 2 halves and roll it into 2 cylindrical portion.

- Heat water in a idli steamer, once it's hot apply some ghee and place the muthia on it and steam it for 10 minutes.

- Once it's steamed well allow it to cool down and cut into small cubes.

- Heat ghee in a kadai add sesame seeds, peanuts, coriander and steamed muthia and saute for 2 minutes.

- Transfer cooked muthia to a serving plate and enjoy rajgira muthia.

name: Baked Rajgira Papdi Chaat
ingredients:
- 15g rajgira flour

- 1 tsp ghee

- some water

- rock salt to taste

- 1 tsp sugar

- 2 tbsp curd

- pinch of red chilli powder

- pinch of turmeric powder

- pinch of jeera powder
method:
- Take a bowl add rajgira flour, salt and sprinkle water simultaneously and knead into a soft dough.

- Allow it to rest for 15 minutes.

- Take a polythene sheet, divide it into two squares, place it on the roti rolling area and apply some ghee on it and then place the dough, now place the other sheet on top of the dough and roll the dough into a very thin roti,*(since the dough is very sticky and non stretchy can use polythene on both the sides to avoid breakage of roti while rolling)*.

- Take a small circle shaped mould and cut out 4 circle shaped slices of roti .

- Take a baking pan apply some ghee and transfer thin rolled roti and bake it for 2 minutes at 180 degree Celsius once it's baked on one side turn off the oven and flip the papdi and bake it for another 2 minutes at 180 degree celsius.

- Once it's baked completely transfer papdi to a serving plate.

- Take a cup add thick curd, sugar, some water and mix it well.

- Top the curd sugar mix on the baked papdi and sprinkle some red chilli powder, turmeric powder, jeera powder and enjoy baked rajgira papdi chaat.

name: Shingara Ki Roti
ingredients:
- 30g shingara flour

- salt to taste

- water for kneading

- 1 tsp ghee

For coriander chutney

- 2 tbsp coriander leaves

- ¼ tsp cumin powder

- rock salt to taste

- 1 inch coconut

- water for blending
method:
- Take a bowl add singara flour, salt and sprinkle water simultaneously and knead into a soft dough.

- Allow it to rest for 15 minutes and divide the dough into 2 halves.

- Take a polythene sheet, divide it into two squares, place it on the roti rolling area and apply some ghee on it and then place the dough, now place the other sheet on top of the dough and roll the dough into a very thin roti, repeat the step for both the rotis*(since the dough is very sticky and non stretchy can use polythene on both the sides to avoid breakage of roti while rolling)*.

- Heat Pan and transfer the roti and allow it to cook apply some oil and flip it so that its cooked well on both the sides, now transfer it to a serving plate.

For chutney

- Take a mixing jar, add coriander, cumin powder, salt, coconut, water as required and blend it well to make a fine paste of chutney.

- Serve shingara roti with coriander chutney and enjoy it.

name: Paneer Rajgira Fritters
ingredients:
- 2 tbsp rajgira flour

- 15g panner

- ¼ tsp red chilli powder

- ¼ tsp turmeric powder

- ¼ coriander powder

- ¼ tsp cumin powder

- rock salt to taste

- 1 tsp ghee
method:
- Take a bowl add rajgira flour, grated paneer, red chilli powder, turmeric powder, coriander powder, cumin powder, salt and mix all the ingredients well and knead it into a soft dough.

- Divide the dough into two portions and make small patties.

- Heat a pan add ghee and place the parties and allow it to cook and then flip the patties and allow it to cook on both the sides for around 3 to 4 minutes until it is golden brown in colour.

- Once patties are cooked well, transfer it to a serving plate, enjoy paneer rajgira patties with coriander chutney or curd.

name: Shingara Paneer Paratha
ingredients:
- 30g shingara flour

- 30g paneer

- ¼ tsp red chilli powder

- ¼ tsp coriander powder

- rock salt to taste

- 1 tsp ghee

- water for kneading dough
method:
- Take a bowl add shingara flour, grated paneer, red chilli powder, coriander powder, salt and mix all the ingredients well, now sprinkle some water and knead it into a soft dough.

- Divide the dough into two portions.

- Take a polythene sheet, divide it into two squares, place it on the roti rolling area and apply some ghee on it and then place the dough, now place the other sheet on top of the dough and roll the dough into a very thin roti, repeat the step for both the rotis*(since the dough is very sticky and non stretchy can use polythene on both the sides to avoid breakage of roti while rolling)*.

- Heat a pan, apply some ghee and cook panner roti on both the sides, repeat the same procedure for both the rotis.

- Once it is cooked transfer both the rotis to a serving plate.

- Serve shingara paneer roti with green chutney or curd.

name: Makhana Sweet Potato Chaat
ingredients:
- 25g sweet potato

- 10g makhana

- 10 groundnut

- 1 tsp finely chopped coriander

- 2 tbsp curd

- 1 tsp sugar

- ¼ tsp red chilli powder

- ¼ tsp turmeric powder

- rock salt to taste

- 1 tsp ghee
method:
- Steam sweet potato and groundnuts.

- Heat ghee in a kadai add makhana, mashed sweet potato and groundnut.

- Saute these ingredients well.

- Now add red chilli powder, turmeric powder, salt and and saute for 2 to 3 minutes.

- Once it is cooked transfer this mixture to a serving plate.

- Take a cup add curd, sugar and mix it well.

- Now add the curd mixture to the potato makhana and groundnut mixture, sprinkle some coriander leaves and red chilli powder.

- Serve and enjoy makhana sweet potato chaat.

name: Steamed Groundnut Sundal
ingredients:
- 15g groundnut

- 1 tsp ghee

- ¼ tsp red chilli powder

- ¼ tsp turmeric powder

- ¼ tsp cumin powder

- 1 tsp finely chopped coriander

- rock salt to taste
method:
- Steam and de shell groundnuts.

- Heat ghee in a pan, at steamed groundnut, red chilli powder, turmeric powder, cumin powder, salt and saw it all the ingredients well for 1-2 minutes.

- Now transfer it to a serving bowl, at some coriander and enjoyed groundnut sundal .

name: Kattu Cupcakes
ingredients:
- 2 tbsp kattu flour

- ½ small banana

- 2 tsp curd

- 1 tsp honey

- 2 almonds

- ½ tsp ghee

- pinch of baking powder
method:
- Take a bowl mash banana and make it into a paste, now add curd and whisk these 2 ingredients well.

- Now add kattu flour, honey, ghee and mix it well for 2 minutes.

- Mix it vigorously, add baking soda and give it a nice whisk again.

- Grease cupcakes mould with some ghee and transfer the batter to the cupcakes mould and top it with almond powder.

- Preheat oven for 10 minutes at 180 degree celsius.

- Bake cupcakes for 10 minutes 200 degree celsius.

name: Navratri Chilla With Kala Chana
ingredients:
- 1 cup soaked Kala Chana

- 2 tbsp of sama rice

- 1 piece ginger

- few cut green chillies

- according to taste

- 2 tbsp of chopped coriander leaves

- 2-3 tbsp milk

- 1 tsp sugar

- 1 tsp whole cumin

- salt to taste

- 2 tbsp of oil
method:
- Wash and soak kala chana overnight.

- Take 1 cup of soaked kala chana and grind to a paste and keep aside.

- Grind the sama rice, green chillies and ginger together with 2 tbsp of milk and mix it with the ground kala chana.

- Let the mixture rest for ½ hour .

- Now add the salt, sugar, whole cumin and chopped coriander leaves. Mix it well.

- Take a flat pan or tava ,heat it.

- Add few drops of oil and spread it evenly all over .

- When the tava is little hot, put a ladle full in the centre and spread it outwards with a spatula, like a roti.

- When the chilla starts leaving the sides, become little brown .

- Flip it and cook the other side . Done.

- Serve with dhaniya patta chutney.

name: Navratri Sabudana And Sama Rice Dhokla
ingredients:
- ½ cup sama rice(grounded dry in grinder)

- ½ cup sabudana (grounded dry in grinder)

- 1 cup curd

- ½ cup water

- salt to taste

- 1 tsp sugar

- few green chillies finely chopped

- 2 tbsp chopped coriander leaves

- 1 tsp of eno, 5 gms

For the takda

- 1-2 tbsp of finely chopped coriander leaves

- 1 tsp whole cumin

- few green chillies chopped

- ½ tsp sugar

- 4-5 tbsp of water

- 1 tbsp of ghee/oil
method:
- Mix the ground sabudana ,sama rice ,curd ,salt ,sugar and water together. Mix it well.

- Beat it for a minute or so.

- Cover and keep for ½ hour.

- Then add chopped coriander leaves and green chillies.

- Now add the eno and mix it well. Beat it for few minutes.

- Take a flat and a little deep dish.

- Grease the dish with oil/ghee. Spread the mixture in it.

- Should be even all over need to smoothen out the top.

- Take a kadhai, place a stand in it and put water.

- Now place the dish on the stand. Water should be below the dish. Cover the kadhai.

- Cook on full flame for 15 minutes, then lower flame to low and cook for another 15 minutes. Put a toothpick in to check if cooked .

- When yoh put toothpick in ,no batter should stick to it ,when you take it out .

- When the steaming time is over. Let it remain in for sometime. Remove the dish from the kadhai . Let it cool down.

- Then take a knife ,and run it along the sides of the dish to loosen it out .

- Place a plate on top of the dish, and flip it over. Gently remove the dish .

- Now cut the ready dhokla in pieces as you prefer .

For the tadka

- First spread the chopped coriander leaves all over the dhokla.

- Take a kadhai, add ghee.

- When the ghee is warm add the whole cumin.

- When it starts to splutter add the cut green chillies.

- Now add the sugar and water

- Mix it and switch of flame .

- Now take a spoon and spread the tadka little by little all over the dhokla. Done .

- Serve with dhaniya chutney .

name: Makhana Laddu
ingredients:
- 10g makhana

- 2 tsp jaggery

- 1 tsp ghee

- 5 peanut

- 2 almonds
method:
- Dry roast makhana, peanuts, almonds and transfer it to a blending jar, blended into a fine powder.

- Heat ghee in a pan, add jaggery and melt it.

- Once jaggery starts to bubble up add the makhana, peanut, almond powder and mix it fast vigorously.

- Now turn off the flame and transfer the mixture to a plate and divide it into 2 portions.

- Apply some ghee on the palms and make it into laddu's form and serve it.

- Enjoy makhana laddu.

name: Rajgira Almond Cookies
ingredients:
- 2 tbsp rajgira flour

- 30ml milk

- 2 tsp sugar

- 1 tsp ghee

- 1 almond

- 1 walnut

- pinch of baking soda
method:
- Take a bowl add rajgira flour, sugar, almond powder, ghee, milk and mix these ingredients well.

- Add pinch of baking soda, knead it well and divide into 2 portions and make cookie shapes and top it with almond and transfer to a baking tray.

- Preheat oven at 180 degree celsius for 10 minutes.

- Bake rajgira cookies for 15 minutes at 180 degree celsius and once it's baked enjoy rajgira cookies.

name: Kattu Malpua
ingredients:
- 1 tbsp kattu flour

- 2 tsp sugar

- 30ml milk

- 1 tsp ghee

- 2 almonds

- 1 cashew
method:
- In a bowl add kattu flour, milk and mix it well to form a thin watery consistency.

- Heat pan add ghee and pour the kattu batter on the ghee and allow it to shallow fry .

- Flip and fry on both the sides until it's golden brown and transfer to a plate.

- Add 2 teaspoon sugar and 2 teaspoon water to the pan and make a sugar syrup.

- Now add the fried malpua in the sugar syrup and allow it to soak for 2 to 3 minutes.

- Once it soaks the sugar syrup, transfer it to a serving plate and top it with almonds and cashews.

- Enjoy kattu malpua.

name: Crispy Chickpeas
categories: Evening Snack, Navratri Special, Sim's Family Recipes
ingredients:
- 3 cups of cooked chickpeas

- 2 tablespoons olive oil or ghee

- 1 ½ teaspoons chili powder (optional)

- 1 teaspoon black pepper

- 1 teaspoon cumin powder

- ¾ teaspoon salt
method:
- Preheat oven to 180°C.

- Rinse and drain the chickpeas, shaking off as much water as possible.

- Place them on a towel and pat gently to dry. Place another towel on top, then use your hands to rub the chickpeas and remove as many of the chickpea skins as possible. Do this once or twice; it should only take a few minutes and it’s not necessary to remove all of the skins.

- In a small bowl, mix the chickpeas with the olive oil (ghee), chili powder, black pepper, cumin, smoked paprika, and salt.

- Place the chickpeas on a lined baking sheet and spread them out into a single layer. Avoid overcrowding

- Bake for about 45 to 60 minutes until crispy and dry, shaking the pan every 15 minutes.

- The exact bake time depends on your oven, so watch closely in the final minutes, taste test, and remove when the chickpeas are browned but before they become very dark and hard.

- Allow it to cool for about 10 minutes before storing; the chickpeas will crisp up even more as they cool.

- Allow to cool completely and store in an airtight container.

Tips:

- The main challenge in making roasted chickpeas at home is making sure they stay crispy. If you don’t bake them long enough, you’ll end up with soggy chickpeas a day later. To make chickpeas stay crispy, you’ve got to bake them long enough. You can cut the bake time if you are going to consume them right out of the oven. Because ovens can vary, the first time, just make sure to keep an eye on the oven towards the end of the cooking time: they can change quickly from browned to burnt !!

- Another tip for making crispy roasted chickpeas is to remove some of the skins before baking. The chickpea skin also retains moisture. However, you don’t have to remove bit, so don’t spend too much time on this. Here’s how to remove the chickpea skins: Drain and rinse the chickpeas. Dry them with a towel to remove as much moisture as possible. (This is also key to making totally crispy chickpeas.) Then place another towel on top of the chickpeas and rub them with your hands to loosen the skins. Do this a few times: it should only take a few minutes — and you don’t need to worry about getting all of them!

- Boil the chickpeas, drain and transfer to a towel to remove as much moisture as possible.

name: Shinghara Ka Halwa/Barfi
ingredients:
- 2 tbsp shingara flour

- 2 tbsp jaggery

- 1 tsp ghee

- 2 almonds
method:
- Heat ghee in a pan, add shingara flour and roast it for 1 minute .

- Now add jaggery powder and cook it while mixing the ingredients vigorously for 2-3 minutes, when it combines together and forms a lump turn off the flame.

- Transfer it to a plate and allow it to cool down.

- Once it is at normal temperature cut it into desired shape and top it with almonds and enjoy shingara halwa.

name: Raita Ideas
categories: Navratri Special, Sim's Family Recipes, Lunch, Dinner
ingredients:
- 1 cup curd

- pinch of roasted jeera powder

- pinch of salt to taste

- pinch of sugar / honey

- 1/2 cup chopped cucumber

- 1/2 cup chopped pineapple

- my crispy roasted channa (optional)
method:
- Whisk the curd to get a smoothie like consistency

- Mix in the salt, sugar, jeera and honey. Mix well to incorpoate

- Taste and adjust

- Add the chopped cucumber and pineapple

Other combinations

- Apple and roasted walnuts

- Shredded carrot and raisin

- Steam raw papaya

- Pomegranate and cashew

- Roasted almond pear

name: Kattu Ka Meetha
ingredients:
- 15g kattu atta

- 30ml milk

- 1 tsp sugar

- 1 tsp ghee

- 1 cashew
method:
- Heat ghee in a pan add kattu flour and saute till it turns brown.

- Now add milk and mix it well, then add sugar and allow it to cook .

- Cook it for 2 minutes and transfer it to a cup to mould in a shape .

- Top it with cashew and enjoy kattu ka meetha.

name: Raw Banana And Paneer Salad
ingredients:
- 2 large raw bananas

- 1 tsp whole cumin

- 1 – 2 green chilli, chopped fine (optional)

- powdered black salt to taste

- ½ cup coriander leaves, finely chopped

- 250 gms paneer, grated

- 1 tbsp of roasted and crushed peanuts, per person
method:
- Cut the raw banana in half and cover with water and boil till cooked.

- Remove the bananas and once cooled, remove and discard the skin.

- Grate the bananas with a big grater setting.

- Grate the paneer with the same thickness.

- Gently toss all the ingredients together, ensuring you don’t mash the paneer or banana.

- Top with the crushed and roasted peanuts and serve.

name: High Protein Raw Banana And Paneer Cutlets
categories: Evening Snack, Navratri Special, Sim's Family Recipes
ingredients:
- 2 large raw bananas

- 1 tsp whole cumin (jeera)

- 1 – 2 green chilli, chopped fine ( optional)

- powdered black Salt to taste

- 1 tbsp ginger, grated

- 2 tbsp potato Flour

- 2 tbsp amaranth Flour

- ½ cup coriander leaves, finely chopped

- 250 gms paneer, grated

- 1 tbsp oil for pan frying
method:
- Cut the raw banana in half and cover with water and boil till cooked.

- Remove the bananas and once cooled, remove and discard the skin.

- Grate the bananas with a big grater setting.

- Grate the paneer with the same thickness.

- Add all the ingredients (except the amaranth flour) and mix gently with your hands.

- Ensure you do not mash the paneer or the banana.

- Take golf ball sized amount and flatten to make a cutlet shape.

- Dust with the amaranth flour.

- Brush with oil and pan fry or air fry till crisp.

- Serve hot with a spicy green chutney.

name: Rajgira Walnut Laddu
ingredients:
- 1 tbsp rajgira flour

- 1 tsp jaggery

- 2 tsp roasted peanut and walnut powder

- 1 tsp ghee

- ½ tsp sesame seeds
method:
- Heat pan and dry roast rajgira flour.

- Add roasted peanut, walnut powder and saute until its brown and transfer to a plate.

- Heat pan and then add jaggery and melt it.

- Now add rajgira, walnut, peanut mix and mix all the ingredients well,cook for 1 minute.

- Turn off the flame and allow it to cool down until it's at a warm temperature.

- When it's warm apply some ghee on palm and make laddu and top it with sesame seeds and serve rajgira walnut laddu .

name: Navratri Hummus
ingredients:
- 1 cup chickpeas, soaked overnight and boiled

- 1/4 cup white sesame, roasted on a pan

- 1/2 lime

- 1 small green chilli optional

- 1/4 tsp cumin (jeera powder), dry roasted in a pan

- Salt to taste
method:
1. Add all ingredients to a mixer grinder and blend till you get a smooth paste
2. Taste to see if you would like to add more of any of the ingredients
3. Add 1/4 tsp of olive oil and garnish with sesame seeds on top before serving

TIPS
1. Measure 1 cup of chickpeas post boiling.
2. Keep the chickpea water and add to make the hummus thinner.
3. For a creamier hummus use a little cold water while blending or take off the skin for each chickpea for a very smooth consistency. I have not done that here.
4. Oil - optional.
5. Sesame seeds - if you do not have a high speed mixie make a tahini first. Dry roast 250 gms of white sesame seeds. cool sightly and blend with a little salt in a mixer grinder till you get a smooth paste. You can 1/4 cup of this paste instead of whole sesame seeds for a creamier option. use the remaining tahini for thickening other recipes like butter chicken etc. Or spice it up to make a dip.

name: Amaranth Khichdi
categories: Sim's Family Recipes, Navratri Special, Lunch, Dinner
ingredients:
- ½ cup cooked amaranth

- 1 tsp chopped corriander leaves

- ½ tsp chopped ginger

- ½ tsp jeera

- ¼ cup chopped roasted peanuts

- ½ tsp finely chopped green chilli

- 1 dried fig chopped small

- ½ tsp melted ghee

- salt to taste
method:
- Add the ghee to a kadhai and add the jeera, ginger and green chillies and cook till the ginger is slightly brown.

- Add the remaining ingredients and cook till all flavours are incorporated, about 2 mins.

Notes

- I pre cook the amaranth or rajgira, then wash of the sticky starch and drain it to get a dry crunchy texture grain.

name: Navratri Phirni
ingredients:
Ingredients

- ½ litre milk

- ¼ cup jaggery

- 2 tbsp sama rice (powdered)

- 2 tbsp sama rice pounded a little

- 1 tsp powdered green cardamom Method

- Boil the milk add the jaggery.

- When the jaggery melts.

- Add the powdered and pounded sama rice .

- Cook on low flame .

- Stir continuously .

- Cook on low flame till rice is cooked .

- Now add the cardamom powder .

- Stir for few minutes .

- Add the cut almonds ,leaving a little for garnishing .

- Stir for few seconds.

- Put in a dish.

- Garnish with the cut almonds .

- Let it cool down .

- Put in the fridge and let it set .

- This sets like curd /pudding .

- Done .
full_text:
Ingredients

- ½ litre milk

- ¼ cup jaggery

- 2 tbsp sama rice (powdered)

- 2 tbsp sama rice pounded a little

- 1 tsp powdered green cardamom Method

- Boil the milk add the jaggery.

- When the jaggery melts.

- Add the powdered and pounded sama rice .

- Cook on low flame .

- Stir continuously .

- Cook on low flame till rice is cooked .

- Now add the cardamom powder .

- Stir for few minutes .

- Stir for few seconds.

- Put in a dish.

- Garnish with the cut almonds .

- Let it cool down .

- Put in the fridge and let it set .

- This sets like curd /pudding .

name: Sukhi Arbi Ki Sabzi
categories: Lunch, Dinner, Navratri Special, Sim's Family Recipes
ingredients:
- ½ kg arbi (washed, peeled and cut in circles like lay chips )

- salt to taste

- ¼ tsp asafoetida

- 1 -1 ½ tsp aamchur

- ½ tsp whole cumin

- 1 tsp ajwain

- 1 tsp dhaniya powder

- 1/2 tsp turmeric powder

- 1 tsp red chilli powder

- 3 tbsp of oil/ghee

- few chopped green chillies

- 1 tbsp full chopped ginger .
method:
- Heat oil/ghee in a pan .

- When it is warm.

- Add the asafoetida, whole cummin and ajwain .

- Stir for few seconds till it starts spluttering.

- Then add the chopped green chillies and ginger .

- Stir for a minute or so .

- Then add the cut arbi .

- Mix everything in well .

- Now add the salt,turmeric, red chilli powder and dhaniya powder, mix everything well .

- Now cover and cook on low flame.

- Keep stirring in between .

- When arbi is more or less cooked .

- Add the aamchur powder and mix it well .

- Cover and cook for few minutes .

- When the arbi is totally done .

- Serve .

- Now add the chopped coriander leaves .

- Mix it in .

- Done .

- Serve with roti or paratha .

name: Navratri Idli  With Coconut Chutney
categories: Breakfast, Navratri Special, Sim's Family Recipes
ingredients:
- ½ cup sabudana

- ½ cup sama rice

- 2 tbsp of curd

- 2½ cup of water /whey from curd

- salt to taste

- 1 tsp eno salt
method:
- Soak sabudana in 1 cup water and keep aside for 1 1/2 - 2 hrs to soak.

- Then grind to a smooth paste.

- Wash and soak sama rice for 11/2-2 hours.

- Then grind to a smooth paste.

- Can use a little whey of curd to grind d ,or else 3-4 tbsp of water.

- Mix the sabudana and rice paste together, beat it for 5-7 minutes .

- Cover and keep aside for ½ hour .

- Then add 1 tsp eno, immediately add 3-4 tbsp of water and beat it for 5-7 minutes .

- Cover and keep aside for 10-15 minutes.

- The consistency should be a little thick.

- Now take a idli dish, rub a little oil/ghee in the depression, add 3-4 tsp of batter in each depression.

- Steam in a cooker ,with just placing the lid on it ,like a co er ,without whistle .

- Cook on medium flame.

- After 10-15 minutes check if idli is done, put a toothpick/knife in it .

- When you remove it no batter should be stuck to it.

- Let it cool down, remove and serve with coconut chutney.

name: Navratri Coconut Chutney
categories: Breakfast, Navratri Special, Sim's Family Recipes
ingredients:
- ½ coconut medium size

- few green chillies

- 1 piece ginger

- salt to taste

- 1-2 tsp oil/ghee

- 1 tsp black sesame seeds

- 2 tsp chopped coriander leaves
method:
- Grind the coconut ,green chillies ,ginger and salt together in a grinder.

- Make a smooth paste.

- Place in a dish.

- Sprinkle the chopped coriander leaves on the top.

- Take a small kadhai put oil/ ghee in it.

- When it is warm.

- Add the black sesame seeds to it.

- Stir for few seconds.

- Add 1- 2 chopped green chillies to it.

- Now put the tadka on top of the coconut chutney.

- Done.

name: Navratri Bottle Gourd Sabzi
categories: Lunch, Dinner, Navratri Special, Sim's Family Recipes
ingredients:
- 350 gms bottle gourd

- 1 tomato chopped

- few green chillies chopped

- 1 tsp ginger grated

- ½ tsp whole cumin

- salt to taste

- pinch of pepper powder

- 2 tbsp of chopped coriander leaves

- 2 tsp of ghee
method:
- Peel and cut the bottle gourd into cubes.

- Take a pan ,add the ghee.

- When the ghee gets warm. Add the whole cumin.

- When it starts spluttering, add the grated ginger. Stir for few minutes.

- Add the chopped green chillies. Stir for few minutes.

- Add the chopped tomato and salt. Saute till tomato becomes soft.

- Add cut bottle gourd and saute for few minutes.

- Cover and cook on low flame ,till the bottle gourd is cooked.

- Keep stirring in between, bottle gourd leaves its own water.

- When cooked add chopped coriander leaves. Stir for few minutes.

- Remove from flame.

- Done.

name: Lemon Parsely Chicken
ingredients:
- ½ kg chicken

- 1 lime cut in circles with the skin

- Juice of 1 lemon (1 ½ tbsp )

- Juice of ½ sweet lemon (mausambi)

- ¼ cup chopped Parsely

- few slitted green chillies

- salt to taste

- ½ tsp pepper

- 1 tsp chopped garlic

- 1 tsp lemon rind

- 1 ½-2 tsp honey

- 1 ½-2 tsp of corn flour

- 2 tbsp of oil

- 1 tbsp of melted butter

- 1 cup of broth/water

For the marination

- ½ kg chicken on which slits need to be made

- 1 tsp garlic paste

- 1 tsp ginger paste

- ¼ tsp pepper powder

- salt to taste

- marinate and keep aside for 15-20 minutes
method:
- Put oil in a pan. Heat the oil.

- Place all the chicken flat on the pan and let it cook.

- Flip the side after a few minutes.

- Let the chicken become a little beige brown in color.

- Add the chopped garlic in the center and let it cook for few minutes.

- Now cook all together for few minutes.

- Add the broth or water to the pan.

- Let it cook in it so that the gravy has a nice flavor.

- Add the butter and the lemon rind. Mix it in well.

- Add the chopped Parsely leaves. Mix it in.

- Add the salt and pepper. Cover an cook on low flame for few minutes.

- By now chicken should be cooked.

- Add the lime juice. Stir for few seconds.

- Mix the cornflour in the sweet lemon juice.

- Now add the cornflour lemon slurry to the pan.

- Cook on full flame.

- Let the gravy thicken a little.

- Add the honey and let it cook for a minute use or so.

- Add the lemon circles and slitted green chillies. Cook for few minutes.

- Done.

- Serve with boiled rice.

Note

- Parsely to be used is the one which looks quite a bit like coriander leaves.
Not to use the curly Parsely.

name: Grated Carrot/Beetroot Sabzi
ingredients:
- ½ kg carrot grated

- ½ tsp black mustard seeds

- 1 tsp raw urad dal

- 2 tbsp roasted chana dal

- 1 onion chopped into cubes

- few slitted green chillies

- 10-12 curry patta leaves

- salt to taste

- pinch of turmeric powder

- 1 tbsp chopped coriander leaves
method:
- Put oil in a Kadhai.

- When the oil is warm.

- Add the mustard seeds. When it starts spluttering. Add the urad dal. Stir for few seconds

- Add the roasted chana dal. Stir for few seconds.

- Add the chopped onions. Stir fry till translucent.

- Add the slitted green chillies and curry patta. Stir fry for few seconds.

- Now add the grated carrot. Stir it in well.

- Add the salt and turmeric. Stir fry for few minutes.

- Lower the flame and cover and cook till carrots are done. Stir in between.

- Now add the chopped coriander leaves.

- Mix it in and stir fry for few seconds.

- Done.

name: Lauki Ka Bharta (Bottlegourd/Dhudi)
ingredients:
- ½ medium size lauki

- 1 onion chopped

- 1 ½ medium size tomatoes chopped

- few green chillies chopped Pinch

- 3-4 cloves of garlic chopped

- 1 tsp grated ginger

- 2 tbsp chopped coriander leaves

- ½ tsp whole cumin

- ¼ tsp asafoetida

- salt to taste

- ¼ tsp turmeric powder

- ½ tsp kashmiri chilli powder (for colour)

- red chilli powder to taste

- ¼ tsp red chilli flakes

- 3 tbsp oil/ghee
method:
- Place a wire rack on the flame.

- Place the lauki on it and roast the skin ,like it's done for brinjal. Keep aside.

- When it cools down ,peel the skin off and put the lauki in a chopper. Should be coarsely ground. When done keep aside.

- Take a pan, put the oil. Let the oil warm a little.

- Add the asafoetida.

- Add the whole cumin. Stir for few seconds.

- When the cumin starts spluttering.

- Add the chopped onions and garlic.

- Stir fry on medium flame till the onions are translucent.

- Now add the grated ginger. Stir fry for a minute use or so.

- Now add the chopped tomatoes and green chillies. Saute till the tomatoes become soft.

- Add salt to taste, ¼ tsp turmeric powder, red chilli powder to taste and ½ tsp of kashmiri chilli powder (for colour). Saute till the masala becomes totally soft.

- Add the chopped ground lauki. Mix it in well. Saute for few minutes.

- Cover and cook on low flame ,stirring in between, till the lauki is cooked.

- Add the chopped coriander leaves. Saute for few minutes.

- Now can add a tadka on top, put 1 tsp ghee in a pan When warm add chilli flakes .

- Put on top of the bharta.

- Done.

name: Coconut French Beans
ingredients:
- ½ kg beans cut into small pieces (do remove the head and string from the sides of the beans)

- ½ cup grated coconut

- ½ tsp mustard seeds

- 1 tsp raw urad dal

- 1 tbsp chana dal roasted

- 1-2 whole red chillies

- 10-12 curry patta leaves

- salt to taste

- ¼ tsp turmeric powder

- few slitted green chillies

- 1 onion chopped into cubes

- 2 tbsp chopped coriander leaves

- 2-3 tbsp of refined oil
method:
- Put oil in a Kadhai, warm the oil a little.

- Add the mustard seeds, when it starts spluttering.

- Add the urad dal. Stir for few seconds.

- Add roasted chana dal. Stir for few seconds.

- Add the whole red chillies broken into small pieces.

- Add the curry patta. Stir for few seconds.

- Add the chopped onion. Stir fry till onion turns translucent.

- Add salt and stir for few seconds.

- Add turmeric powder. Stir for few seconds.

- Add the cut beans. Stir fry for few seconds cover and cook on low flame till the beans are cooked. Keep stirring in between.

- When beans are more or less done.

- Add grated coconut. Mix it in well. Stir fry for a minute or so.

- Now add the chopped coriander leaves.

- Mix it in and cook on low flame for a minute or so.

- Done.

name: Akki Roti
ingredients:
- 500 gms rice flour

- 1 tsp whole cumin

- ½ tsp asafoetida

- salt to taste

- 1 carrot grated

- ½ cucumber grated

- 1 onion chopped in cubes

- ¼ cup chopped coriander leaves

- ½ cup chopped dill leaves

- few chopped green chillies to taste
method:
- Mix all of the above ingredients together.

- Then slowly add water little by little and knead it to a smooth dough (water needs to be put little by little as the vegetables will also leave water ).

- When dough is done, cover and keep for 10-15 minutes.

- Take a tava put on the flame, keep it low.

- In the meantime take wax paper or foil cut into a big square. Rub a little oil on it .

- Now take the dough, size of a tennis ball. Make it round.

- Now place it on the wax paper /foil.

- Start pressing it to make a roti, size of a quarter plate.

- Keep pressing it gently, it might break.

- When it becomes a circle, pick it up from under the wax/foil paper.

- And turn it on the hot tava.

- Cook on medium heat for few minutes.

- Brush a wee bit of oil on the top .

- Cover and cook for few minutes ,check in between.

- Roti should start becoming beige brown underneath.

- Flip the side and cook the same way ,till it becomes little brown.

- Done.

- Serve with coconut chutney or any chutney of your choice .

name: Hariyali Mince
ingredients:
- 250 -300 gms mince (of your choice)

- 1 big onion chopped

- 1 bay leaf

- 1 tsp ginger paste

- 1 tsp garlic paste

- 4-8 green chillies

- 6-8 tbsp of chopped coriander leaves

- salt to taste

- ¼ tsp turmeric powder

- roasted and pounded coarsely

- 1 tsp whole cumin

- 1 tbsp of whole coriander seeds,

- 1 tsp peppercorns

- ¼ tsp garam masala

- 1 tsp dry kasturi methi leaves

- ½ cup peas

- sprinkling of jaifal

- 2 tbsp of oil
method:
- Wash the mince and put in a strainer, to drain the water.

- Then marinate mince with the ginger garlic paste

- Then keep the mince aside for 15-20 minutes.

- Put the oil in a pan, when the oil is a little warm add the bay leaf, can break it into 2.

- Then add the chopped onions. Stir fry the onions till translucent.

- Then add the marinated mince. Stir the mince for few minutes.

- Add salt to taste and turmeric powder.

- Saute for few minutes, cover and cook ,if need be can add 4-5 tbsp of water and let it cook on low flame .

- Now add the roasted pounded masala. Mix well.

- Pound the coriander leaves and green chillies in a mortar pestal.

- When coarsely pounded add to the mince. Stir it in nicely.

- Cover and cook on low flame for 5-7 minutes. Do stir in between.

- Now grate and sprinkle a pinch of jaifal.

- Add the garam masala. Mix it well and stir for few minutes.

- Now add the peas ,add 4-5 tbsp of water and cover and cook(If using fresh peas need to cook it 90% before adding to the mince).

- Lastly add the dry kasturi methi leaves.

- Stir fry for few minutes.

- Done.

name: Coriander Chilli Chicken
ingredients:
- 500 gms chicken

- ½ tbsp flour

- ½ tbsp cornflour

- 1 egg

- salt according to taste

- pinch of pepper

- 2 tbs chopped garlic

- 2 tbsp chopped coriander root

- ½ cup cut (1"pcs) coriander stem

- 6-8 whole pods of garlic

- 8-10 green n red chillies

- 8-10 tbsp of coarsely chopped coriander

- ½ a lemon juice

- 2 tsp light soya

- 1 tsp sugar

- salt according to taste.

- 4 tbsp of oil
method:
- Marinate the chicken in cornflour,flour ,egg,pepper and salt according to taste. Keep for 15 minutes .

- Then heat 2 tbsp oil in a pan add the chicken to it and stir fry in full flame ,for few minutes, then lower the flame and cook till done .

- Remove from flame and keep aside .

- Take the whole pods of garlic ,the chopped coriander and whole green chillies and pound it together in a mortar and pestal. Keep aside

- In the same pan add 2 tbsp of oil

- Add the chopped garlic and stir fry for a minute or so till raw smell goes .

- Add the chopped coriander root. Stir fry for few seconds.

- Now add the pounded mixture to the pan. Stir fry for a minute or so.

- Now add the sugar. Stir it in.

- Now add 1 tsp light soya and stir it for few seconds.

- Now add the cooked chicken and salt.

- Mix it well so that the chicken as a coating of the mixture.

- Now add the remaining soya sauce and the cut pieces stem of the coriander. Stir it in.

- Now add the juice of the half lemon and mix it well . Stir fry for few seconds.

- Remove from flame.

- Done.

- Serve with steamed rice.

name: Moong Dal Palak Soup
ingredients:
- 25g yellow moong dal (split)

- 100g spinach

- 2 garlic cloves, crushed

- 15g onion, chopped

- 15g tomato, chopped

- ½ tsp chilli powder

- ½ tsp salt
method:
- Combine the garlic and onions in a pressure cooker and dry roast on a medium flame for a few seconds.

- Add tomatoes, moong dal with required amount of water, mix well and pressure cook for 2 whistles.

- Allow the steam to escape before opening the lid. Keep aside.

- Once cooled, blend in a mixer to a smooth puree.

- Transfer the puree to a deep pan, add water,chilli powder, spinach and salt.

- Add more water if required, mix well and bring to a boil.

- Cook on medium flame for 1 - 2 minutes, while stirring occasionally.

- Garnish it with coriander leaves and serve hot.

name: Methi Lentil Soup
ingredients:
- 100g methi leaves

- 25g lentil

- 15g Onion

- 15g Tomato

- 2 garlic cloves

- ½ tsp oil

- ½ tsp salt

- Pinch of turmeric

- 4-5 Black pepper, crushed.
method:
- Rinse the red lentils and soak for 10 minutes. Meanwhile chop all the vegetables.

- Heat a pan. Add oil to it. Add chopped garlic and saute until the raw smell goes.

- Add chopped onion followed by chopped tomato. Stir fry the vegetables for a minute or so.

- Now add turmeric powder, saute for a few seconds.

- Add finely chopped fenugreek leaves and saute for a few seconds.

- Add 1 ½ cup water and cook the soup covered for 5-7 minutes or until the dal is cooked well and can be mashed between fingers.

- Finally add freshly crushed black pepper and serve the soup warm.

name: Roasted Cauliflower Soup
ingredients:
- 100g cauliflower, chopped

- 50ml curd

- 15g onion, chopped

- 3-4 garlic cloves, chopped

- 1 green chilli, chopped

- salt as per taste

- ½ tsp pepper powder

- ¼ tsp turmeric powder

- 2.5 ml oil
method:
- In a bowl take warm water, add salt and soak the cauliflower pieces into it for 20 minutes.

- Drain the water completely, make sure there is no excess water.

- Pre- heat the pan for 5-6 minutes.

- Carefully place the cauliflower pieces on it.

- Cover and roast on all sides. Turn off the flame and keep it aside.

- In the same pan, add oil.

- Add chopped garlic and chillies, saute for 30 seconds.

- Add onion and saute until they turn translucent.

- Now add the roasted cauliflower to it.

- Add turmeric powder and salt and mix well.

- Turn off the flame. Let it cool.

- Once it cools down, grind it into smooth puree, use curd to grind it into a smooth paste.

- Turn on the gas and pour this puree into the pan.

- Add the remaining curd and water (if required). Let it simmer for 10 minutes.

- Turn off the flame. Sprinkle some pepper powder and serve hot.

name: Cucumber Soup
ingredients:
- 85g cucumber

- 15g capsicum

- 3-4 garlic cloves

- 3-4 peppercorns, crushed

- 5-6 mint leaves

- ½ tsp lemon juice

- ½ tsp salt
method:
- Slice cucumbers, roughly chop capsicum. Place them in a mixer or blender, add garlic, mint leaves, salt, peppercorns and lemon juice and blend it till smooth.

- Pour it in a bowl, sprinkle some pepper powder on top and serve this refreshing soup.

name: Lentil Mint-Coriander Soup
ingredients:
- 25g lentil

- 40g mint leaves

- 40g coriander leaves

- 20g onion

- 3 garlic cloves, crushed

- ¼ tsp turmeric

- ½ tsp cumin powder

- 1 tsp pepper powder

- ½ tsp lemon juice

- ½ tsp oil

- 1 tsp salt
method:
- Pressure cook the lentils (3 whistles or until lentils are soft), and keep it aside.

- Heat oil in a pan.

- Chop onions and add them into oil.

- Saute until onions are golden brown for about 2- 3 minutes.

- Add pressure cooked lentils, garlic and mint-coriander leaves puree into it.

- Add water as required.

- Add turmeric powder, cumin powder, salt and pepper.

- Bring to boil then reduce heat and simmer uncovered on low-medium for about 10 minutes.

- Turn off the heat and add lemon juice on top. Serve hot.

name: Chicken Pepper Soup
ingredients:
- 100g chicken

- 25g cauliflower

- 25g cabbage

- 25g capsicum

- 25g beans

- 1 tsp ginger, finely chopped

- 1 tsp garlic, finely chopped

- 1 tsp lemon juice

- 3- 4 peppercorn

- 1 tsp pepper

- 1 small bay leaf

- 2 inch cinnamon stick

- ½ tsp salt

- ½ tsp oil
method:
- Add chicken and chopped vegetables and water (as required) to a pressure cooker.

- Tear the bay leaf to pieces and break the cinnamon. Add them along with pepper corn.

- Pressure cook for 3 whistles,or boil until the chicken is tender and falls off the bone.

- Set the chicken aside. Shred the meat and discard the bones.

- Heat a pan, add oil, saute ginger and garlic for a minute.

- Strain the chicken stock to the pan and boil for a while.

- Add salt and the shredded chicken and veggies. Turn off.

- Cool down the chicken soup a bit, then squeeze in the lemon juice and add more pepper powder.

- Serve warm chicken pepper soup.

name: Drumstick Soup
ingredients:
- 85gm drumstick

- 15gm onion

- 2-3 garlic cloves

- ½ tsp jeera powder

- 1 tsp pepper powder

- pinch of turmeric powder

- 1 tsp oil

- ½ tsp salt
method:
- Take a drumstick in a pan, covered with water. Cook till the drumstick is done.

- Cool it down, strain it.

- Remove the flesh from the drumsticks.

- Reserve the stock and flesh.

- Heat oil in a pan. Add onions and garlic and saute for a min.

- Add drumstick flesh and mix well.

- Take it in a blender and puree until smooth.

- Take stock and puree in a pan.

- Add cumin powder, salt and pepper.

- Bring it to a boil. Remove the scum off. Simmer for 5 minutes.

- Serve hot.

name: Tomato Ridge Gourd Ki Sabzi (Turai)
ingredients:
- ½ kg ridge gourd (peeled and cut in semi circles)

- 1 tomato grated

- ½ tsp garlic paste

- few slitted green chillies

- 1 tbsp gram flour (besan)

- 1 tsp whole cumin

- ½ tsp whole fennel

- 1 bay leaf

- ½ tsp coriander powder

- ¼ tsp turmeric powder

- red chilli powder to taste

- salt to taste

- 2 tbsp ghee/ oil
method:
- Put ghee in kadhai, let it warm a little.

- Add the whole cumin, bay leaf and fennel. Stir for few seconds.

- Add the gram flour and stir for few minutes till you get a fragrance from the gram flour .

- Now add the grated tomato and garlic paste.

- Saute on low flame till the raw smell of the garlic goes.

- Now add the turmeric, coriander red chilli powder and salt. Saute for few minutes.

- Add the ridge gourd, mix it in well.

- Cover and cook till it is cooked.

- Ridge gourd leaves its own water, so it cooks in it .

- Done.

name: Vegetable Chickpeas Cutlet
ingredients:
- 240 gms (raw) chickpeas

- 6 tbsp rice flour

- ⅔ cup beans chopped fine

- ⅔ cup red capsicum chopped fine

- ⅔ cup cabbage chopped fine

- ⅔ cups carrots chopped fine

- ⅔ cup cauliflower/broccoli chopped fine

- ½-1 onion chopped fine

- 1 piece ginger grated

- 8-9 garlic pounded

- 3 green chillies chopped fine 1 tbsp dill chopped fine

- ½ tsp chilli flakes
method:
- Wash and soak chickpeas overnight. Then pressure cooker the chickpeas, for 10-15 minutes. on low flame after the 1st whistle. Put a pinch of salt .

- When done ,let the cooker open naturally .

- Separate chickpeas from the water and grind the chickpeas to a paste. Keep aside.

- Chop all the vegetables small and fine .

- When done keep aside.

- Now mix the chickpeas paste, the cut vegetables, green chillies, chopped dill, grated ginger, pounded garlic, chilli flakes, salt according to taste and 3 tbsp of rice flour (3 tbsp to be put in the chickpeas mixture and rest to be kept for dusting the chickpeas patty).

- Mix all of the above well.

- Make into small balls ,then flatten it out ,like a small patty .

- Do the same with all the mixture and keep aside.

- Now take a pan drizzle a little oil.

- When oil is warm. Dust the patty on both side with rice flour.

- Place on the pan and cook on low to medium flame.

- Flip side to cook properly on both sides. Done.

- Can use as a patty for a burger /sandwich/evening snack .

- Accompanied with a Yogurt dip and salad .

Note

- If using airfreight, brush oil on both sides of each patty.

name: Chickpeas Masala Pulao With Spinach
ingredients:
- ⅔ cup basmati rice

- ⅔ cup chopped spinach

- 1 cup chickpeas (raw)

- 2 medium size onions grated

- 1 tsp ginger paste

- 1 tsp garlic paste

- 1 big tomato grated

- 1 tsp chana masala (optional)

- salt to taste

- 1 tsp whole cumin

- pinch of turmeric powder

- red chilli powder according to taste

- ½ tsp cumin powder

- 1 tsp coriander powder

- 2 tsp dry kasturi leaves

- 3 tbsp oil /ghee

- few chopped green chillies
method:
- Wash and soak the chickpeas at night.

- Put in pressure cooker with 3-4 cups of water.

- Put a pinch of salt.

- Cook it in a pressure cooker for 20-25 minutes on low flame after first whistle.

- Wash and soak the rice for ½ hour.

- Wash and chop spinach in strips and keep aside.

- In a pan put 2 ½ tbsp of oil/ghee.

- When the oil is warm add ½ tsp whole cumin.

- When it starts to splutter add the grated onions.

- Saute on low to medium flame till the onions turn beige in colour.

- Now add the ginger garlic paste. Saute till the masala become a nice beige brown.

- Add the salt (keeping in mind that salt has been put in the cooker ),turmeric ,red chilli powder, cumin and coriander powder. Saute for few minutes.

- Now add the grated tomato. Saute for few minutes.

- When the water of the tomato dries up.

- Add the kasturi methi leaves. Saute for few minutes.

- Add the boiled chickpeas. Mix it well with the masala.

- When it starts bubbling ,make the flame low and cook till oil comes on top.
Take a cooker, Put ½ tsp oil/ghee ,when it is warm add ½ tsp whole cumin, when it starts to splutter.

- Add few green chillies chopped.

- Add the chopped spinach. Stir for minute or so.

- Now add the soaked rice. Stir fry for a minute or so.

- Now add the chickpeas only from the gravy .

- Measure the gravy and put 1:2 in proportion with the rice .

- Need to add salt here for the rice ,keeping in mind that salt is already there. Close pressure cooker.

- Put on full flame and cook to 1 whistle. Switch of flame.

- Let the cooker open naturally .

- Even after cooker opens, leave the pulao for sometime, as it will absorb the gravy.

- Done. Serve with raita of your choice or coriander curd chutney .

name: Khus Khus Karela Ki Sabzi (Bitter Gourd)
ingredients:
- 4 big bitter gourd (cut into thin circles without removing skin )

- ½ tsp onion seeds(kala jeera/kalonji)

- few slit green chillies

- 1 tsp whole black mustard

- 1 ½ tsp poppy seeds (khuskhus)

- pinch of turmeric powder

- salt to taste

- ½ tsp sugar

- 2 tbsp refined oil/mustard oil
method:
- Make a smooth paste of the mustard seeds and poppy seeds .Keep the seeds soaked for sometime ,then grind with a green chilli and a pinch of salt. Keep aside.

- Put oil in a kadhai, when the oil is warm add the onion seeds.

- After few seconds add the cut bitter gourd. Stir fry till the bitter gourd is cooked and has turned a little brown.

- Add few slitted green chillies according to taste.

- Add the mustard and poppy seed paste. Mix it in well.

- Add ½ cup water and the sugar. Mix it in.

- Cook on low flame for 5-7 minutes.

- Done.

name: Methi Tofu Sabzi
ingredients:
- 25gm tofu

- 100gm methi leaves

- 1 tsp jeera

- ½ tsp haldi powder

- 1 tsp dhania powder

- 1 tbsp ginger-garlic, chopped

- ¼ tsp asafoetida

- 1 green chilli, chopped

- 2 dry red chilli

- salt as per taste

- 1 tsp oil
method:
- Wash the methi leaves thoroughly, and chop them finely. Sprinkle some salt over them and keep aside for half an hour. Then squeeze out the water and keep them aside.

- Heat oil in a pan or kadhai and add jeera.

- When the seeds crackle, add ginger, garlic, dry red chilli and saute for 1 minute.

- Add tofu and mix gently.

- Add the methi leaves, chopped green chilli, turmeric powder, dhania powder, asafoetida and salt and mix well. Sprinkle 2 tbsp of water over and cook for 10 minutes on a low flame.

- Serve hot.

name: Bell Pepper Tofu  Stir Fry
ingredients:
- 25gm red bell pepper

- 25gm yellow bell pepper

- 25gm capsicum

- 25gm onion

- 25gm tofu

- 1 tbsp curd

- 1 green chilli, chopped

- ½ tsp turmeric powder

- ½ tsp chilli powder

- ½ tsp dhania powder

- ½ tsp pepper powder

- salt as per taste

- ½ tsp oil
method:
- In a bowl, add all the chopped bell peppers, onion and diced tofu.

- Marinate it with curd, salt and all the spices, keep it aside for 10 minutes.

- After 10 mins, heat a pan, add oil.

- Add the marinated mixture and stir fry for 5 minutes.

- Cover the pan for 5- 7 minutes.

- Open the lid and stir for 3- 5 minutes more, check if the bell peppers are cooked.

- Turn off the flame.

- Serve hot.

name: Tinda Dal Sabzi
ingredients:
- 100gm tinda

- 25gm chana dal

- 20gm onion

- 15gm tomato

- 1 green chilli, chopped

- 1 tsp ginger-garlic paste

- ½ tsp whole cumin seeds

- ¼ tsp turmeric powder

- ½ tsp red chilli powder

- 1 tsp dhania powder

- salt, as per taste

- 1 tsp oil
method:
- Pressure to cook the chana dal (3-4 whistles).

- Heat oil in a pan, add the chopped tinda into it and fry till golden brown.

- Then add chopped onion and saute until golden brown.

- Add the chopped tomato, saute for a minute.

- Add ginger- garlic paste, all the spices and 2 tbsp water and cook on low flame for 5 mins.

- Add chana dal and ½ cup water and cook on medium flame for 5 more minutes. Mix well.

- Turn off the flame and serve hot.

name: Tinda Dal
ingredients:
- 80gm tinda

- 10g onion

- 10g tomato

- 25g moong dal

- 2 green chillies

- 1 dry red chilli

- ½ tsp whole cumin

- 4-5 curry leaves

- ½ tsp turmeric powder

- 1 tsp oil

- ½ tsp salt
method:
- Heat oil in a pan, add dry red chilli, whole cumin seeds when cumin seeds starts to splutter, add curry leaves, chopped onions, salt and saute it for 3 minutes.

- Then add turmeric powder, green chilli paste, tinda pieces and some water, semi- cook it then add soaked moong dal, let it cook on slow flame for 5 minutes with a closed lid.

- Add more water if required.

- Turn off the flame. Serve hot.

name: Palak Broken Wheat Khichdi
ingredients:
- 30g broken wheat (daliya)

- 15g green gram dal

- 80g palak

- 10g onion

- 10g tomato

- 1 tsp ginger-garlic paste

- 2 chopped green chillies

- 1 bay leaf

- ½ tsp jeera

- ½ tsp turmeric powder

- ½ tsp chilly powder

- ½ tsp jeera powder

- 1 tsp dhania powder

- 1 tbsp freshly chopped coriander leaves

- ½ tsp salt

- ½ tsp oil
method:
- Dry roast the green gram dal and keep it side.

- In a pressure cooker, add oil and let it heat a bit.

- Then add 1 bay leaf and ½ tsp jeera into the oil.

- Add ginger- garlic paste and stir for 1 minute. Then add all the palak and stir for 5 minutes.

- Add all the spices and mix well and cook for 2-3 minutes.

- Now add the broken wheat, roasted green gram dal, water and salt into the pressure cooker, mix thoroughly.

- Close the pressure cooker and turn off the flame after 3 whistles.

- Add freshly chopped coriander leaves and serve hot.

name: Tomato And Peas Upma
ingredients:
- 25g semolina

- 50g tomato

- 30g peas

- 20g onion

- ½ tsp mustard seeds

- ½ tsp jeera

- ½ tsp chana dal

- ½ tsp urad dal

- 1 green chilli, chopped

- 1 red chilli (dry)

- ½ tsp red chilli powder

- ¼ tsp turmeric powder

- salt as per taste

- 4-5 curry leaves

- 1 tsp oil
method:
- Heat a pan or kadai first. Add rava.

- On a low flame, begin to roast the rava. Stir often while roasting the rava.

- The rava or sooji grains should become fragrant and start to look dry, separate and crisp. Don’t brown the rava.

- Switch off the flame and then add the roasted rava on a plate and keep aside.

- In a pan, heat 1 tsp oil.

- Add ½ tsp mustard seeds. When the mustard seeds are crackling, then reduce the flame to a low and add ½ tsp cumin seeds along with ½ tsp chana dal and ½ tsp urad dal.

- Stir and saute them on a low flame.

- Saute till both the urad dal and chana dal become golden. Take care not to burn the dals.

- Now add 1 dry red chilli and curry leaves. Stir well.

- Add chopped onions. Stir and begin to saute the onions on a low to medium flame.

- Then add 1 green chilli (chopped).

- Add chopped tomatoes and peas.

- Add turmeric powder and red chilli powder. Mix very well and saute the tomatoes and peas on a low to medium flame till they are soft.

- Add water as required, then add salt to it, mix well. On a medium to high flame, heat the water and let it come to a rolling boil.

- When the water comes to a rolling boil, lower the flame to its lowest. Then add the rava little by little, immediately stir and mix very well.

- The rava grains absorb water and thus swell and get cooked. Quickly stir them, so that lumps are not formed. cover and allow the tomato- peas upma to steam for 2 to 3 minutes on low flame then switch off the flame.

- Here the rava is cooked and the tomato- peas upma is ready.

name: Roasted Bell Pepper Soup
ingredients:
- 25gm green bell pepper

- 25gm red bell pepper

- 25gm yellow bell pepper

- 15gm onion

- 10gm tomato

- 1 tsp ginger-garlic paste

- ¼ tsp turmeric powder

- ½ tsp chilli powder

- 1 tsp pepper powder

- 1 tsp oil
method:
- Pre-heat the pan for 3-5 minutes.

- Carefully place the bell pepper pieces on it.

- Cover and roast on all sides. Turn off the flame and keep it aside.

- Heat oil in the same pan. Add ginger-garlic, onion and tomato; season with salt, turmeric powder, chilli powder and black pepper and cook until vegetables are tender, about 5 minutes. Cool this mixture and blend it.

- Add the mixture into the pan, add water as required and let it come to boil.

- Once it starts boiling add roasted bell peppers into it. Mix and let it boil for 5-7 mins.

- Turn off the flame, add some pepper powder on top and serve hot.

name: Soya Bathua Sabzi
ingredients:
- 100g bathua leaves

- 25g soybean

- 15g onion

- 15g tomato

- 1 tsp ginger-garlic paste

- 1 tsp whole cumin seeds

- ½ tsp turmeric powder

- 1 tsp chilli powder

- ½ tsp coriander powder

- 1 tbsp curd

- 1 tsp oil

- salt as per taste
method:
- Heat oil in a pan. Add whole cumin seeds and onion, and saute.

- Now add tomatoes and cook further.

- Add salt, turmeric powder, red chilli powder, coriander powder and mix well.

- Once you get a thick curry base, add curd and cook until oil is released.

- Now add washed bathua leaves and soybean. Mix well and add water.

- Cover and cook until the curry comes together.

- Serve hot.

name: Smokey Aubergine Soup
ingredients:
- 100 gms aubergine

- 30 gms tomato

- 20 gms onion

- 1 garlic clove

- 1 tsp black pepper

- 1 tsp cumin powder

- ½ tsp oil

- salt

- water as required
method:
- Take Aubergine, make a slit with a knife, insert garlic clove in it.

- Put the aubergine directly on heat and roast it until completely roasted.

- Once roasted, cool it down and remove the skin and take all the seeds and retain only the pulp.

- Using a hand blender, blend the roasted aubergine.

- Once done, put it in a saucepan, mix it with water or vegetable broth.

- Season the soup with salt, pepper and cumin powder.

- Bring it to the boil or switch off the heat.

name: Tangy Tomato And Corn Soup
ingredients:
- 100 gms tomato

- 50 gm corn kernels

- 20 gms diced beet

- 30 gms onion

- ¼th tsp finely chopped ginger

- pinch of black pepper

- salt

- water as required
method:
- Boil the corn using a pressure cooker and keep it aside once it is cooked.

- In a pan, heat oil,once it is warm add chopped onions and saute it for a minute.

- Add salt then beetroot to give a nice colour to soup and ginger and mix it.

- Now add the chopped tomatoes, pinch of pepper, and fry for couple of minutes.

- Add water and close the lid and let it cook for 10 minutes.

- Let it cool and then blend the tomato mixture.

- Puree the soup as smooth or as chunky as you want it to be.

- Now add boiled corn. Mix it.

- Ready to serve

name: Guacamole
ingredients:
- 100 gms avocado

- 1 tsp lime juice

- 20 gms diced onion

- 1 tbsp fresh cilantro/coriander

- 30 gms diced tomatoes

- 1 minced garlic

- ½ tsp chilli flakes

- salt
method:
- In the bowl mashed together the avocados, lime juice and salt.

- Mix in onions, cilantro and tomatoes.

- Stir in chilli flakes.

- Refrigerate 1 hour for the best flavor or serve immediately.

name: Tomato Rajma Soup
ingredients:
- 25 gm rajma

- 50 gm capsicum

- 100 gm tomatoes

- 20 gm onion

- 10 gm coriander

- ¼ tsp chilli powder

- 5 ml lemon juice

- 1 garlic clove

- ½ tsp oil

- salt
method:
- Heat oil in the pressure, add the onions, garlic and saute on a medium flame for 1-2 minutes.

- Add the tomatoes, mix well and cook for 2-3 minutes.

- Add rajma, chilli powder, salt and water and pressure cook for 4 whistles.

- Allow the steam to escape before opening the lid.

- Blend in the pressure cooker using a hand blender. Since there is a lot of liquid, a hand blender works best.

- Add water and bring it to a boil.

- Add lemon juice and mix well.

- Now add all vegetables.

- Serve the rajma soup.

name: Spinach Mushroom Egg Salad
ingredients:
- 100 gms baby spinach leaves

- 50 gms mushroom

- 1 yolk

- 2 egg whites

- 30 gms tomatoes

- 20 gms onion

- 1 tsp soya sauce

- black pepper

- chilli flakes

- ½ tsp vinegar

- ½ tsp olive oil

- salt
method:
- Heat the pan,apply oil in it, add chopped mushrooms and soya sauce and let it saute for 4-5 minutes.

- Now take a bowl, add chopped spinach leaves, tomatoes, onion, and boiled eggs.

- Now add cooked mushroom in the bowl, add salt, pepper, vinegar and chilli flakes.

- Mix it and ready to serve.

name: Apple Lassi
ingredients:
- 50 gms apple

- 100 gm cup curd

- 1 tsp honey

- ½ cup ice cubes

- pinch of nutmeg/cardamom powder
method:
- Wash apples and chop them into cubes.

- Add apples into the blender and make Puree with the cardamom and yogurt. Add little water and 1 tsp honey to it.

- Pour the lassi into a glass and serve it with ice cubes.

name: Chicken Spinach Soup With Mushroom
ingredients:
- 50 gms chicken shredded

- 100 gms spinach leaves

- 50 gms mushroom

- 30 gms tomato

- 20 gms onion

- 2 garlic clove

- ½ tsp soya sauce

- black pepper

- chilli powder

- ½ tsp oil

- salt
method:
- Boil the water in a pot, add spinach leaves and boil it for 2-3 minutes.

- Keep it aside once done.

- Heat the oil in the pan, add tomatoes, garlic and onion and cook it until mushy.

- Now add boiled leaves and cooked tomatoes, onion in a blender jar and blend it.

- Now apply the oil in the pan, add chopped mushroom and soya sauce. Cook for 3 minutes.

- Once done, take it out and keep it aside.

- Add the prepared puree of vegetables on a pan, add salt, pepper, chilli powder and water as required and bring it to a boil.

- Now add mushroom and shredded chicken.

- Take it out in a bowl, sprinkle some more shredded chicken.

- Ready to serve.

name: Mushroom Spinach Soup
ingredients:
- 100 gms spinach

- 50 gms mushroom

- 2 tsp ginger garlic paste

- ½ tsp black pepper powder

- ½ tsp oil

- salt

- water as required
method:
- Heat oil in a pan, add ginger garlic paste.

- Add chopped mushrooms and cook for 4-5 minutes.

- Now add in boiled and blended spinach and mix well.

- Add in water and bring to the boil.

- Cook for about 10 minutes.

- Add salt and pepper mix well.

- Ready to serve.

name: Apple Shirkhand
ingredients:
- 90 ml hung curd

- 50g apple (grated)

- pinch cinnamon powder
method:
- Pour the curd in a thin muslin cloth and hang it overnight till all the water is drained.

- In a mixing bowl, add the curd and blend it using a blender till a smooth texture is obtained.

- Add the grated apple to this mixture and mix it gently with a spoon.

- Refrigerate it for at least 30 minutes and then serve it.

name: Sweet Potato Laddu
ingredients:
- 20g sweet potato (boiled)

- 10g makhana (roasted, powdered)

- 5g almond (roasted, powdered)

- 10ml milk (skimmed)

- 5g jaggery
method:
- Pressure cook the sweet potato.

- Dry roast makhana and almonds. Blend them into fine powder or flour consistency.

- Heat a non-stick pan on a low flame and add all these ingredients to the pan and mix it well till the sweet potatoes lose moisture(keep a little makhana powder aside).

- To this mixture add grated jaggery and milk and cook it well till the jaggery is completely melted and combined with the mixture.

- Cool this mixture completely and start making round balls and roll them in the remaining powder.

- Serve it.

name: Chicken Vegetable Roll
ingredients:
- 50g chicken

- 15g onion

- 15g tomato

- 20g capsicum

- 2 tbsp Curd

- 1 green chilli, chopped

- ½ tsp red chilli powder

- ½ tsp dhania powder

- 1 tbsp coriander leaves, chopped

- salt as per taste

- 1 tsp oil
method:
- In a bowl add chopped onion, tomato,capsicum, and green chillies. Add 2 tbsp curd, salt and all the spices, mix well and keep it aside.

- Take a pan, let it heat. Add oil to the heated pan. Add chicken pieces into it (remove the bones, if any. Can go for boneless chicken).

- Stir fry until the chicken turns white and is cooked.

- Turn off the flame. Add the curd marinated vegetables into it and mix well.

- Break the chicken into small pieces.

- Now take a phulka or a chapati and place the chicken vegetable mixture on it. Add chopped coriander leaves, and roll it into a roll.

- Chicken vegetable roll is ready.

name: Egg Tomato Rings
ingredients:
- 100 gm tomato

- 2 egg whites

- 1 tsp wheat flour

- black pepper

- red chili powder

- ½ tsp oil

- salt
method:
- Wash the tomatoes and cut it into ring shape and using a knife remove the middle part and keep it in the bowl.

- Once it is removed from all the tomatoes, chop it.

- Then add egg white, black pepper, salt, chilli powder and 1 tsp wheat flour and mix it.

- Apply oil on the pan, keep tomato rings on it and add egg mixture to it slowly.

- Let it cook on low flame. Then flip the tomatoes and cook it.

- Once cooked, remove it and serve it with coriander chutney.

name: Egg Rice Omelette
ingredients:
- 1 yolk

- 2 egg whites

- 25 gms rice

- 50 gms cabbage

- 50 gms capsicum

- 30 gms tomatoes

- 20 gms onion

- ½ tsp oil

- black pepper

- pinch of turmeric

- salt
method:
- Take a bowl, add cooked rice, vegetables and beaten egg and mix it properly.

- Now add salt, turmeric, black pepper and mix it.

- Apply oil on the pan, add the egg mixture on the pan.

- And let it cook on one side in medium heat.

- Now flip it on the other side and cook it.

- Once cooked, using a sharp knife or pizza cutter, cut it into desired pieces.

- Serve it with chutney.
