name: Gobi Peetha
ingredients:
- 100gm cauliflower, finely chopped

- 50gm rice flour

- salt as per taste

- 2 green chillies, chopped

- ½ tsp ginger paste

- ½ tsp turmeric powder

- ½ tsp chilli powder

- ½ tsp dhania powder

- ½ tsp jeera powder

- ½ tsp whole cumin seeds

- 1 tsp oil
method:
For dough

- Take rice flour in a bowl, add 2 pinches of salt, and mix well (dry) along with the flour.

- Add slight warm water little by little and knead the dough, and set aside.

For stuffing

- Heat a pan, add oil, add the whole cumin seeds, and let it splutter.

- Now add ginger paste and green chillies and saute for 2 minutes.

- Now add the finely chopped cauliflower. Add all the spices and salt to it and mix well.

- Add half cup water to it, mix, cover it and cook for 8- 10 minutes or until the water dries up and the cauliflower is cooked completely.

- Turn off the flame and let it cool down a bit.

- Now make small balls using the dough, and make space in between, add the stuffing and shape it into a peetha.

- Steam it for 15-20 minutes in a steamer or using a double boiler process.

name: Chicken Saag
ingredients:
- 100g chicken

- 100g palak

- 25g onion

- 20g tomato

- 1 tbsp ginger-garlic paste

- 1 tsp chilli powder

- ½ tsp turmeric powder

- 1 tsp dhania powder

- 2 chopped green chillies

- ½ tsp whole cumin seeds

- salt as per taste

- 1 cardamom

- 1 cinnamon stick

- 1 bay leaf

- 1 tsp oil
method:
- Add roughly chopped onion, tomato, and green chilli into the mixer and grind it into a smooth paste.

- In a pan/kadhai add oil, then add bay leaf, cardamom, cinnamon stick and whole cumin seeds, and ginger- garlic paste, after the seeds splutter, add the grinded mixture in to it.

- Then add chilli powder, turmeric powder, dhania powder and salt to the mixture and mix well and cook for 10 minutes.

- Then add the pieces of chicken to it, mix well and close it with a lid and let it cook for 10 minutes. Then add palak to it, mix well, cover and cook for another 7- 8 minutes.

- Take off the lid and cook for another 30 minutes.

- Turn off the flame. Serve hot.

name: Methi-Matar Roti
ingredients:
- 100 gm methi leaves

- 30 gm peas

- 20gm onion

- 50 gm wheat flour

- 1 green chilli, chopped

- salt as per taste

- 1 tsp jeera

- 1 tsp dhania powder

- ½ tsp chilli powder

- ½ tsp turmeric powder

- ½ tsp oil
method:
- Wash the methi leaves thoroughly, and keep them aside.

- Take wheat flour, knead dough and keep it aside.

- Take a pan, add oil and let it heat a bit, add jeera into it.

- Add chopped onion and green chilli, saute for a minute.

- Add peas and methi leaves into it, add salt and other spices, mix well.

- Add a little amount of water and cover the pan for 7- 8 minutes. Open the lid, check if the peas and methi leaves are soft, mix well.

- Turn off the flame and mash it. Let it cool down a bit.

- Take a small size dough and make hole in between, add the methi- matar mixture into it, close and roll into a roti.

- Heat a tawa, and place the rolled roti on it and cook properly from both the sides.

- Turn off the flame and serve hot.

name: Sukha Chatpatta Baigan (Brinjal)
ingredients:
- 300 gms of small brinjal (each brinjal cut into 4 pieces)

- 2 tbsp of chopped garlic

- 1 tsp aamchur (dry mango) powder

- ¼ tsp asafoetida ( hing)

- ½ tsp mustard seeds (big)

- ½ tsp whole cumin (jeera)

- ½ tsp of whole coriander (dhania)

- 1 tbsp peanuts

- 10-12 curry patta leaves

- salt to taste

- red chilli powder to taste

- ½ tsp chilli flakes (optional)

- ¼ tsp turmeric powder

- 2 tbsp of oil
method:
- Dry roast the cumin, coriander, mustard seeds and peanuts in a flat bottomed pan, till you get a nice fragrance and colour changes. Remove from heat and keep aside till it cools down and then grind to a powder.

- In a pan add oil and let it warm.

- Add in chopped garlic and stir fry for a few minutes.

- Add the cut brinjal and stir fry for few minutes, then lower flame and stir fry till the brinjal is half done.

- Add the turmeric powder, chilli powder, chilli flakes and salt and mix it in.

- Continue to cook the brinjal till is is about 90% done.

- Now add the ground powder and mix it in well.

- Add the curry patta leaves and stir fry for few minutes.

- Once the brinjal is cooked move the brinjal to the sides of the pan.

- In the center put 1 tsp oil, once it is warn add the asafoetida.

- When it starts cooking / spluttering, mix it in with the brinjal.

- Now add in the aamchur powder and cook for a few more minutes till done.

Note

- Since we are using very little oil the masala might stick to the pan. As and when the masala sticks to the pan add 2-3 tbsp of water and stir fry.

name: Garlic Chicken Steak
ingredients:
- 500gms of chicken breasts (boneless)

- salt to taste

- ½ tsp pepper

- 3-5 tbsp of cornflour

- 1-2 tbsp of butter

- 2 tbsp of chopped garlic

- 1-2 tsp of chilli flakes

- 2 tbsp of honey

- 1 tbsp of oyster sauce

- ½ tbsp of dark soya sauce

- 1 tbsp of vinegar

- 1 cup broth/stock

- 1-2 tbsp of chopped parsely/coriander/dill (put according to personal choice and taste )

- 3 tbsp of oil
method:
- Cut the breasts in long and broad pieces.

- Put on tissue paper or napkin and dry it completely. Pound it.

- Marinate it with salt and pepper and keep aside for 15-20 minutes.

- Then put the cornflour on a plate.

- Dust each chicken piece on both sides. Keep aside.

- In a pan put 1 ½ tbsp oil.

- Warm the oil a little then place the chicken flat on the pan.

- Cook on one side for few minutes then flip the side.

- Cook the chicken till a little brown. Keep aside.

- Repeat with the other pieces. Keep aside.

- In the same pan add the butter. When the butter gets warm, add the chopped garlic. Stir fry for few minutes till it changes colour

- Add the chilli flakes. Stir for few seconds.

- Add the honey ,stir for few seconds. As soon as the honey becomes liquidy, add the oyster sauce. Stir it in.

- Add the soya sauce. Stir it in and mix it well.

- Add the vinegar. Mix it in.

- Add the broth and let it come to a boil.

- Add the cooked chicken, place it in a manner that all of the pieces fit.

- Simmer on low flame, scoop up the liquid in a spoon and spread all over the chicken.

- Flip the side and cook for few minutes. Add the parsely/coriander on it.

- Cook for few minutes.

- Done.

- Serve with salad/sauted vegetables .

Note

- The sauce will thicken a little once the chicken is put.

name: Kali Mirchi Mutton Chops/Chicken
ingredients:
- 500gms of chops

- 3 medium size onions sliced

- 1 tsp garlic paste

- 1 tsp ginger paste

- salt to taste

- 2 tsp coarsely ground pepper

- pinch of turmeric

- 2-3 tbsp of curd

- 1 tbsp of oil

For the tarka

- 2-3 tbsp of ghee

- 4 green cardamom

- 1 big cinnamon

- 4 pieces of cloves

- 1 tsp of whole peppercorns

- 2 bay leaves

- 2 tsp chopped garlic

- 1 piece ginger julienne

- 2 tsp coarsely ground pepper

- few green chillies slitted

- 1-2 tbsp chopped coriander leaves
method:
- Marinate chops ,sliced onions, 2 tsp ground pepper, 1 tsp each of ginger garlic paste, pinch of turmeric and salt to taste. Keep aside for 15-20 minutes

- Put 1 tbsp of oil in a kadhai. Warm the oil and swirl it all around the inside of the kadhai.

- Add the marinated chops and stir fry on full flame for 5-10 minutes.

- Transfer the semi cooked chops to a pressure cooker,add 1 cup water and cook for 10 minutes on low flame after the first whistle. Should be a little undone as it has to be sauted.

- Let the cooker open naturally.

- Now transfer the chops back to the kadhai and saute till the water dries up 70-80%.

- Add the curd to the kadhai and saute till chops are cooked.

- Take a small pan/kadhai for the tarka.

- Put the ghee in the kadhai.

- When the ghee is warm add the bay leaf ,cinnamon, cardamom, cloves and whole peppercorns. Stir fry for a minute.

- Then add the chopped garlic and ginger julienne.

- Stir fry till the raw smell of thee ginger garlic goes.

- Ginger garlic should become a little beige brown.

- Add the slit green chillies. Stir fry for few seconds.

- Add the ground pepper. Stir fry for few seconds.

- Now add the tarka to the chops.

- Mix it in well ,cook for few minutes.

- Now add 1 tbsp of the chopped coriander leaves.

- Mix it in gently.

- Serve by garnishing with a little chopped coriander leaves. Done.

- Serve with roti.

name: Stir Fry Vegetables With Boiled Eggs
ingredients:
- 4 hard boiled eggs

- 1 red capsicum cut in thin strips

- ½ green capsicum cut in thin strips

- 1 ½ carrots cut into thin strips like matchstick

- 1 big onion sliced

- 2 tsp full chopped garlic

- few green chillies cut into 2

- 2-3 whole dry red chillies broken into pieces

- 1 tsp dark soya/½ tsp of oyster sauce

- 2 tsp light soya sauce

- 1 tsp cornflour

- ½ tsp sugar

- salt to taste

- ½ tsp pepper

- 2-3 tbsp of oil
method:
- In a bowl add the cornflour, dark soya/oyster sauce, light soya sauce, sugar, pepper and salt.

- Mix all of the above with 5-6 tbsp of water. Mix it well and keep aside

- Peel the eggs.

- Take a pan add 2 tsp of oil, when the oil is warm.

- Add the whole eggs and stir fry it so that the skin of the egg turns little brown. Remove from the pan.

- Cut each egg into 4 vertical pieces. Keep aside.

- In the same pan. Add the chopped garlic. Stir fry for a minute or so.

- Add the sliced onions. Stir fry for few seconds.

- Add the cut whole dry red chillies. Stir fry for few seconds.

- Add the cut carrots. Stir fry for a minute or so.

- Add the cut green chillies. Stir fry for few seconds.

- Add the cut bell peppers. Stir fry for few minutes.

- The vegetables should be crunchy.

- Now add the cornflour mixture to the vegetables. Stir it in well.

- The vegetables should have have a slight coating of the sauce. Check for salt.

- Add the eggs gently and cover with the vegetables. Done.

- Serve with plain rice/ fried rice.

Note

- If you like can add 1 tomato thinly sliced just before adding the cornflour mixture.

name: Methi Aloo
ingredients:
- 4-5 small bunches of methi leaves (washed and chopped )

- 3-4 small round potatoes (small like marbles)

- 5-6 whole garlic pods

- few dry whole red chillies

- salt to taste

- pinch of turmeric powder

- red chillies to taste

- 2-3 tbsp of mustard oil /refined oil (tastes nicer in mustard oil)
method:
- Wash the potatoes with the jacket and cut each into 2 pieces or 4 pieces.

- In a kadhai add the oil.

- When the oil is warm add the garlic pods and whole red chillies. Stir for a minute or so let the garlic become little beige.

- Add the potatoes. Stir for few minutes.

- Add the red chilli and turmeric powder. Mix it in well.

- Stir fry on low flame for few minutes.

- Then make the flame full and add the methi leaves. Stir fry for few minutes.

- The methi leaves will leave its own water.

- Lower the flame and cover and cook till the potatoes are soft and methi leaves are cooked .

- Serve with roti and curd .

name: Tur/Harar Dal
ingredients:
- 1 cup tur dal

- ¼ tsp asafoetida

- ½ tsp whole cumin

- 3-4 whole dry red chillies

- 2 tsp chopped garlic

- 2 tsp chopped ginger

- 1½ medium onion chopped

- 2 medium tomato chopped

- salt to taste

- ½ tsp turmeric powder

- red chilli powder to taste

- 2½ tbsp ghee/oil

For the tarka

- 5-6 whole pods of garlic

- 2 tbsp of chopped coriander leaves

- ½ tbsp of ghee
method:
- Wash the dal. Soak it for 20-30 minutes.

- Drain the water. Put the dal in a pressure cooker.

- Add 1:3 water. Add the turmeric powder and salt.

- Cook for 1-2 whistle on full flame , depending on your cooker.

- Remove from the flame and let the cooker open naturally.

- Grain of the dal should be visible. Keep the cooked dal aside.

- Take a pan add 2 ½ tbsp of ghee/oil. When it is warm.

- Add the asafoetida and whole cumin. Stir fry till the cumin starts spluttering.

- Add the whole dry red chillies. Stir for few seconds.

- Add the chopped garlic and ginger. Stir fry till the raw smell of the ginger garlic is gone.

- Add the chopped onions. Saute till the onions become translucent and they turn a little brown.

- Add the chopped tomatoes. Saute for few minutes, then cover and cook on low flame. Till the tomatoes become mushy. Stir in between.

- Add a pinch of turmeric powder and little red chilli powder. Saute for few minutes.

- When the masala becomes totally soft and little oil starts seeping from the sides.

- Add the cooked tur dal. Mix it in gently.

- Now take a tarka pan. Add ½ tbsp of ghee.

- Add the whole pods of garlic. When the colour of the garlic starts changing to a light brown.

- Add the chopped coriander leaves. Stir for few seconds.

- Add to the dal ,stir it in well. Done.

- Serve with rice .

name: Afghani Chicken
ingredients:
- 500 gms chicken (with bone)

For the marination

- grind to a paste

- 2 medium size onion

- 1 ½ piece ginger

- 1 whole pod of garlic

- few cut green chillies

- 2 tbsp of chopped coriander leaves

- grind the above in a grinder and add to the chicken

- add to the marination

- ½ tsp garam masala

- ½ tsp pepper

- salt to taste

- red chilli powder to taste

- 2-3 tbsp of curd

- 1 tbsp of kasturi methi

- Juice of ½ a lime

- 1 tbsp of mustard oil

- mix all of the above and keep aside for 30-40 minutes

- 2 tbsp of mustard oil /oil/ghee
method:
- Take a pan.

- Add 2 tbsp of oil.

- Heat the oil.

- Place the marinated chicken on the pan.

- Cook on medium burner on full flame.

- Let the chicken become a little brown in the bottom.

- Flip the side and let it become a little brown.

- Add the remaining marination on it. Mix it in well.

- Cover and cook on low flame, till the chicken is done. Do stir in between gently .

- If any liquid can dry it or leave a slight gravy .

- It's your choice.

- Serve with roti.

name: Stir Fry Garlic Long Beans
ingredients:
- 300 gms of long beans cut into 2" pieces

- 1 tomato sliced

- 2 tsp chopped garlic

- few whole red chillies cut into pieces

- salt to taste

- ½ -1 tsp chilli flakes

- 1½ tbsp of oil

- ½ tsp sugar

- ½ tsp light soya
method:
- Steam the long beans to 60-70 % done.

- Immediately put in cold water for few minutes.

- Drain and keep aside.

- Take a pan add the oil.

- Let the oil warm a little.

- Add the chopped garlic. Stir fry for few minutes so that the raw smell goes.

- Add the cut whole red chillies. Stir fry for a minute or so.

- Add the steamed long beans. Stir fry for a minute or so.

- Add the salt.

- Add the red chilli flakes. Stir fry for few minutes.

- Add the sugar. Stir fry for few seconds.

- Add the sliced tomato. Stir fry for few seconds.

- When the long beans are 90% done.

- Add the soya sauce. Stir fry for few minutes.

- Done .

- Serve with plain rice /fried rice .

Note

- the beans should be crunchy .

name: Celery Parsely Chicken Clear Soup
ingredients:
- 6 cups of chicken broth

- 1 chicken breast cut into strips

- 1 ½ medium size carrots cut into small triangle pieces (cut into 4 pieces length wise ,then cut each one horizontally)

- 1 cup chopped cabbage

- ½ cup french beans cut into small pieces

- 1 onion chopped

- 1 tsp chopped garlic

- 1 tsp chopped ginger

- 1 big celery stick chopped ,with the leaves

- 1 - 2 tbsp chopped parsely

- ½ a lime juice

- pepper to taste

- salt
method:
- Stir fry chicken strips with salt and pepper and keep aside.

- In a pan add 1 tbsp of oil.

- Add the chopped garlic and ginger. Stir fry till the raw smell goes.

- Add the chopped onion. Stir fry for few minutes.

- Add the chopped celery. Stir fry for a minute or so.

- Add the cut carrots and beans. Stir fry for few minutes.

- Boil the broth and add to the pan.

- Add salt and pepper to taste.

- When the carrots and beans are cooked 80%.

- Add the cut cabbage.

- Cook for few minutes.

- Add the juice of ½ a lime. Mix it in well.

- Add the stir fried chicken strips.

- Add the chopped parsley.Cook for few minutes.

- Done.

name: Chicken Vegetable And Corn Soup
ingredients:
- 1 chicken breast cut into strips

- 6 cups of broth

- 2 medium size tomato chopped

- ¼-½ cup frozen corn

- ½ cup chopped carrot

- ¼ cup french beans cut into small pieces

- 1 cup chopped cabbage

- 1 tsp chopped garlic

- 1 tsp chopped ginger

- few green chillies chopped (optional)

- 2 eggs

- salt to taste

- ½ tsp pepper

- ½ tsp sugar

- 1 tsp vinegar

- 2 tsp cornflour mixed with 3-4 tbsp of water

- 1 tbsp of oil
method:
- For the chicken, marinate it with salt and pepper, keep aside for 15 minutes.

- Put 2 tsp of oil in a pan, put the chicken strips. Stir fry the chicken till done. Keep aside.

- Take a pan add 1 tbsp of oil.

- Add the chopped garlic and ginger. Stir fry till the raw smell goes.

- Add the chopped tomatoes. Stir fry for a minute.

- Add the chopped green chillies. Stir fry for few seconds.

- Add the chopped carrot and beans. Stir fry for few minutes.

- Add the corn. Stir fry for a minute.

- Add the salt and pepper. Stir fry for few seconds.

- Add the chopped cabbage. Stir fry for a minute or so. Boil the broth and add to the pan.

- Add salt, sugar and vinegar mix it in.

- Add the stir fried chicken.

- Add the cornflour, keep stirring. Now beat the eggs.

- Add a pinch of salt to the eggs.

- Pour half the egg slowly, from the top. Then mix it in gently.

- Repeat for the remaining egg .

- Add 1 tsp of chopped coriander leaves (optional). Done.

Note

- Can add ¼ cup of tofu cut into tiny cubes.

name: Pepper Stir Fried Chicken
ingredients:
- 500 gms chicken (preferably boneless)

- 1 medium onion cut into thick slices

- ½ red bell pepper cut into thick pieces

- 1 full pod of garlic peeled (whole)

- 1 pc of ginger cut into half then into thin slices

- 5-6 whole red chillies cut into pieces

- 1 tsp whole peppercorns

- ½ tsp chilli flakes

- ½ tsp pounded peppercorns

- salt to taste

- mix together and keep aside

- 1 tsp dark soya

- ½ tsp oyster sauce (optional)

- 2 tsp light soya

- ½ tsp vinegar

- ½ tsp sugar

- 1 tsp cornflour

- 2 tbsp of oil

For the chicken

- Marinate chicken in salt and pepper to taste ,1 tsp cornflour,½ an egg and 1 tsp oil
Keep for 15-20 minutes.

- Then take a pan add 1 tbsp of oil. Heat the oil, when the oil is warm.

- Add the chicken and stir fry till it becomes a little brown, then let it cook on low flame till done.

- Remove from pan and keep aside.
method:
- Take a pan put 2 tbsp of oil.

- Add the whole peppercorns. Stir fry for few seconds.

- Add the ginger slices. Stir fry for 30-40 seconds.

- Add the pods of garlic. Stir fry fora minute or so.

- Add the cut whole red chillies. Stir fry for few minutes till the ginger ,garlic and chillies get roasted.

- Add the thickly sliced onion. Stir fry for few seconds.

- Add the cut bell peppers. Stir fry for few minutes.

- Add the salt and stir fry for a minute or so.

- Add the stir fried chicken. Mix it in well. Stir fry for few minutes.

- Add the mixed sauces (at this point I put of the flame as the sauces thicken immediately). Mix it in well.

- When the sauces are mixed in well.

- Restart the flame and stir fry for a minute or so.

- Add the chilli flakes and pounded peppercorns. Mix it in well.

- Stir fry for few minutes.

- Done.

name: Stir Fried Chicken With Cucumber
ingredients:
- 500 gms boneless chicken

Marination to be done

- 1 tsp cornflour

- 1 egg white

- salt to taste

- ½ tsp pepper

- 1 tsp oil

- marinate the chicken with all the above

- keep aside for 15-20 minutes

For cooking

- 2 cucumbers

- ½ cup of cut spring onions

- slit green chillies (optional)

- 8-10 pods of garlic

- 1 ½ pc ginger

- 4-5 whole red chillies

- 1 tsp vinegar

- 2 tsp light soya

- ½ tsp cornflour

- ½ tsp sugar

- ½ tsp white/black pepper

- salt to taste

- 3 tbsp of oil
method:
- Cut the cucumber with the skin in 4 vertical pieces, remove centre part with the seeds, then cut in a slant and keep aside.

- Cut the ginger in flat pieces and keep aside.

- Cut the garlic in round flat pieces. Cut spring onions in 1½ pieces and keep aside.

- Cut the whole red chillies into 3-4 pieces each, keep aside.

- Mix the cornflour in a bowl with 3-4 tbsp of water and keep aside.

- In a pan put 1½ tbsp of oil. Let the oil get warm.

- Place the marinated chicken on the pan.

- Cook on medium burner on full flame.

- Let the chicken cook on one side for few minutes. Then flip the side and cook. Stir in between. Cook till chicken is done. Remove from pan and keep aside.

- In the same pan put remaining oil. When it is warm.

- Add the ginger, garlic and cut red chillies. Stir for few minutes.

- Add the chopped green chillies. Stir fry for few seconds.

- Add the cut cucumber. Stir fry for few minutes.

- Lower the flame or remove the pan from the flame had the vinegar. Mix it in.

- Add the soya sauce mix it in. Place the pan back on the flame.

- Add the salt. Add the pepper. Stir fry for few seconds.

- Add the cornflour mixed with 3-4 tbsp of water. Mix it in well.

- Now add the cooked chicken. Stir fry everything well for few seconds.

- Add the cut spring onions. Mix it in.

- Add the sugar. Stir fry for few minutes.

- Done

name: Chilli Garlic Eggplant ( Brinjal )
ingredients:
- 1 big Brinjal

- 2 tbsp of oil (unflavoured oil)

- 1 tsp ginger,chopped small

- 1 tsp garlic, chopped small

- Few green chillies, chopped small

- 1 green pepper, cut in circles

- 1 red pepper, cut in circles (optional)

- Salt to taste

- 1/2 tsp red chilli flakes

Note : here the peppers are not capsicum but the chilli use to make mirchi or chilli pakoda.

FOR THE SAUCE

- 2 tsp light soya sauce

- 1 tsp dark soya sauce

- 1 tsp chopped garlic

- 1/2 tsp sugar

- 1 tsp cornflour

- 4-5 tbsp of water

- Mix all the above ingredients for the sauce and keep aside
method:
- Cut the brinjal into big 2inch broad strips

- Sprinkle salt on it, mix it well and keep aside for 20-30 minutes

- After the resting period, wash the brinjal and squeeze out all the water and keep aside

- Warm 1 tbsp oil in a pan then add the brinjal and stir fry on high heat till it is 70-80% cooked

- Stir continuously till the brinjal becomes a little brown then from pan and keep aside

- Now add 1 tbsp oil in the same pan

- Once the oil becomes warm add the chopped garlic and ginger

- Stir fry till the raw smell is gone and the garlic ginger become little brown

- Add the chopped green chillies as per taste and stir fry for few seconds

- Add the cut red and green peppers and stir fry for few minutes

- Add the salt as per taste and add the red chilli flakes and stir fry for few seconds

- At this point switch off the flame and add the sauce and mix it in well

- (If the flame is on the sauce will thicken immediately)

- Restart the flame and add 3-4 tbsp of water

- Mix everything well and add water to make sure it is a light consistency and not dry

- Add the cooked brinjal and mix it well to ensure the sauce covers the brinjal

- Stir fry for a few minutes and check that the brinjal is cooked.

- Serve with plain rice or my Lemon Basil Fried Rice and Schezwan Paneer or Capsicum Stir Fried Chicken

NOTES

- BRINJAL : Use the Big brinjal and cut in strips. Make sure you let it marinate in the salt and remove the excess water before cooking. You can also toss it in oil and air fry instead of cooking in the pan.

- PEPPERS : This is what we use for Mirchi Pakoda and is easily available in local stores. If you cannot get the red ones, use just the green ones

- OIL : When you are cooking Chinese style food opt for plain oils over strong flavoured oils like mustard or coconut as these will add their own flavour.

- SOYA SAUCE : Ideally buy and use a real soya sauce. Check the ingredients on the bottle and if its says caramel or colour then it's more of a flavouring. I use Kikkoman for the light soya sauce and Lee Kum Kee Dark Soya Sauce. These lasts really long.

- THIS IS NOT A MEAL ON IT'S OWN. I would add a side dish which has protein

name: Arbi Ka Bharta
ingredients:
- 350-400 gms of arbi

- 1½ onions chopped

- 2 medium size tomatoes chopped

- few chopped green chillies

- 1 tbsp of pounded garlic

- 1 tbsp of pounded ginger

- 1 tbsp chopped coriander leaves

- ¼ tsp asafoetida

- ½ tsp whole cumin

- ½ tsp whole ajwain

- ¼ tsp turmeric powder

- ½- ¾ tsp of aamchur (dry mango powder)

- ¼ tsp kashmiri red chilli (for colour)

- salt to taste

- red chillies to taste

- 3 tbsp of ghee/oil
method:
- Steam or boil the arbi. Peel and mash it and keep aside.

- In a pan ,add the ghee/ oil. When it gets warm.

- Add the asafoetida, whole cumin and ajwain. Stir it till the cumin starts spluttering.

- Add the pounde ginger garlic. Stir fry till the raw smell of the ginger garlic goes.

- Add the chopped onions. Stir fry for few minutes.

- Add the chopped green chillies. Stir fry for few seconds.

- Add the chopped tomatoes. Stir fry for few minutes.

- Add the salt,turmeric, red chilli, kashmiri chilli and aamchur powder. Mix it in well. Stir fry for few minutes. Lower the flame and cover the masala.

- Let the masala become soft ,keep stirring in between. Now add the mashed arbi to this masala, mix it in well. Stir for 5-7 minutes.

- Add 1 tsp of ghee and mix it in.

- Add the chopped coriander leaves and mix it in. Stir for few minutes.

- Done.

name: Mixed Dal Paratha
ingredients:
- 2 cups cooked dal

- atta according to requirement while kneading

- 2 onions chopped

- few chopped green chillies

- ½ tsp whole cumin

- ½ tsp ajwain

- ¼ tsp asafoetida

- salt to taste

- red chilli flakes to taste

- oil or ghee or mix of both for cooking the parathas
method:
- Boil the dal with one onion, 3-4 pods of garlic ,1 pc ginger grated ,salt ,turmeric, ¼ tsp of coriander and cumin powder and 1 tsp dry kasturi methi leaves.

- Any of the above ingredients you can increase or decrease as per taste. When the dal cools down.

- Knead the dough with the dal and all of the above ingredients.

- The dough will be soft, add dry atta while rolling out the dough.

- Heat a tava ,when warm Place the rolled out roti.

- When the bottom gets cooked little bit, flip the side.

- Brush ghee and flip it, cook till it becomes a little brown.

- Serve with curd or chutney.

name: Stir Fry Ladyfingers
ingredients:
- 300 gms ladyfinger(slit vertically in the centre, into two halves)

- 2 tbsp of mustard oil/refined oil

- ¼ tsp fenugreek seeds

- ¼ tsp turmeric powder

- ¼ tsp red chilli powder

- ¼ tsp kashmiri chilli powder

- ¼ tsp coriander powder

- ¼ tsp cumin powder

- 1 tsp chat masala
method:
- In a pan add the mustard oil.

- When it gets warm. Add the fenugreek seeds, when the seeds starts to splutter.

- Add the slit ladyfinger and stir fry for few minutes Then lower the flame and stir fry till the ladyfinger starts turning little brown.

- Add the turmeric powder. Stir fry for few minutes.

- When the ladyfinger is 90% done. Add the salt, mix it in well. Stir fry for a minute or so.

- Add the coriander, cumin, red chilli powder and chat masala. Stir fry for few minutes.

- When done, remove from flame.

- Serve with roti and raita or dal and rice.

name: Tawa Boti Chicken
ingredients:
- 350 gms of boneless chicken (cut into cubes)

- 1 ½ coarsely chopped onions

- 1 onion cut into rings

- 1 coarsely chopped tomato

- few chopped green chillies

- few slitted green chillies

- 1 tbsp chopped coriander leaves

- 1 tbsp chopped spring onions (optional)

- 1 ½ tsp chopped ginger

- 1 ½ tsp chopped garlic

- ¼ tsp turmeric powder

- red chilli powder to taste

- salt to taste

- ½ tsp garam masala

- 2 tbsp of oil
method:
- Put the oil on the tawa.

- When it gets warm.

- Add the chopped ginger and garlic. Stir fry till the raw smell goes.

- Add the coarsely chopped onions. Stir fry for few minutes.

- Add the chopped green chillies. Stir fry for few minutes.

- Add the chopped tomato. Stir fry for a minute or so.

- Add the cubed chicken. Stir fry till it changes color.

- Add the salt,turmeric, red chilli powder or flakes. Stir fry on low flame.

- Then cover the chicken and keep for few minutes for the chicken to cook.

- Open the cover.

- Add the garam masala. Stir fry now till the chicken becomes brown in colour.

- Add the chopped coriander and spring onions. Stir fry for few minutes.

- Add the onion rings. Mix it in well, then cover and cook on low flame for few minutes.

- Onion should become slightly soft.

- Add the slitted green chillies. Mix it in. Done.

- Serve with roti or paratha or can use as a stuffing for an egg paratha.

name: Basanti Pulao
ingredients:
- 1 cup rice (of your choice, preferably basmati or Gobindo Bhog)

- 2 tbsp of ghee

- 3 bay leaves

- 4 green cardamom

- 3-4 small piece of cinnamon stick

- 4-5 pcs of cloves

- 1 ½ tsp of grated ginger

- salt to taste

- ¼ tsp of turmeric powder

- 2 tbsp of sugar

- 8-10 pieces of cashews

- 8-10 pieces of raisins
method:
- Wash the rice and soak for 10 minutes. Drain the rice.

- Put turmeric powder ,little salt and ¼ tsp of ghee on the raw rice and mix it well. Keep for ½ an hour.

- In a pan put ¼ tsp of ghee, warm the ghee, add the rasins and cashews and stir fry for a minute or so. Remove and keep aside .

- In the same pan add the remaining ghee. Warm the ghee a little.

- Add the bay leaves,cardamom, cinnamon and cloves. Stir fry for 30-40 seconds.

- Add the grated ginger. Stir fry till the raw smell goes.

- Add the marinated rice. Stir fry for few minutes.

- Add water 1:2 (measure and boil the water and keep it ready so that the water is hot ). Mix it in well.

- When it starts bubbling. Cover and cook on low flame.

- When it is more or less done. Add the sugar and roasted dry fruit. Mix it in.

- Flatten it out.

- Cover and cook on low flame till rice is cooked.

- Done.

Note

- This is a traditional pulao of Bengal, it is slightly sweet and is had with mutton/chicken /fish /korma or a spicy mixed vegetable.

name: Jhatpat Gobi
ingredients:
- 1 full gobi (medium size cut into florets)

- 1 small potato (cut into cubes)

- 2-3 tbsp oil

- 1 ½ chopped onions

- 1 chopped tomato

- 1 tsp ginger garlic paste

- salt to taste

- ½ tsp whole cumin

- red chilli powder to taste

- ½ tsp coriander powder

- ¼ tsp cumin powder

- ¼ tsp turmeric powder

- 1 ½ tsp dry kasturi leaves

- 1 tbsp chopped coriander leaves

- few slit green chillies (optional)
method:
- Take a kadhai add 1 tbsp of oil.

- When the oil is warm add the cut cauliflower and potato. Stir fry on medium to full flame. Should become a little beige brown.

- Remove and keep aside.

- Now add the remaining oil in the same kadhai.

- When the oil is a little warm.

- Add the whole cumin, when it starts to splutter.

- Add the chopped onions. Stir fry till translucent.

- Add the ginger garlic paste. Stir fry till the raw smell goes.

- Add the tomato, saute for few minutes.

- Add the salt, turmeric, red chilli powder, coriander and cumin powder. Can add few tbsp of water so that the dry masala does not burn. Saute for few minutes.

- When the masala becomes soft.

- Add the stir fried cauliflower and potato. Mix it in well. Saute for few minutes.

- Cover and cook on low flame till the cauliflower and potato are cooked.

- Open the cover.

- Add the kasturi leaves. Stir fry for few minutes.

- Done.

name: Fish Korma
ingredients:
- 500 gms of fish

- 2½ onions

- few green chillies

- 1 tsp ginger garlic paste

- 2 bay leaves

- 4 green cardamom

- 2-3 small cinnamon sticks

- 2-3 cloves

- 5-8 pieces of whole peppercorns

- 1 tsp coriander powder

- ½ tsp cumin powder

- salt to taste

- red chilli powder to taste

- ¼ tsp turmeric powder

- 2 tbsp of curd

- 10-12 pieces of cashews

- few green chillies

- 3 tbsp mustard oil
method:
- Marinate fish with salt and turmeric ,keep aside for 15-20 minutes.

- Mix salt ,turmeric and red chilli powder in 3-4 tbsp of water, keep aside.

- Grind 1 ½ onions with few green chillies to a paste.

- Slice 1 onion and fry it brown ,when crisp crush and keep aside. If it does not become crisp, chop and keep aside.

- Grind cashews and curd together and keep aside.

Method

- Take a kadhai add the oil. Warm the oil. Fry the fish, should become a little brown. When done keep aside.

- In the same kadhai.

- Add the bay leaves, cardamom, cinnamon, cloves and peppercorns. Stir fry for few seconds.

- Add the onion green chilli paste. Saute till the water of the onion dries up.

- Add the ginger garlic paste. Saute till the becomes beige brown.

- Add the salt, turmeric, red chilli mixture. Saute till the rawness of the masala goes.

- Now add the curd cashews paste. Saute for few minutes.

- When the water dries up, add 1-2 cups of hot water.

- When it starts bubbling add the fish.

- Add a pinch of garam masala.

- Cover and cook on low flame for 10-15 minutes.

- Done.

- Serve with plain rice or pulao.

Notes

- when you put the water, put according to gravy you would like to keep, then add 1 cup on top of that .

- As after the dish cools down the gravy will thicken.

name: Kala Masoor Dal Vegetable Pulav
ingredients:
- 1/2 cup black masur dal (Washed and soaked overnight or for 6-8 hrs or soaked in hot water for 3 to 4 hours)

- 1 cup basmati rice (Washed and soaked for 30 minutes)

- 2 medium size onions sliced

- 1 medium size onion sliced fried brown and kept aside)

- 2 tsp of ginger garlic paste

- 1 1/2 carrot cut into cubes

- 10-15 french beans cut into 1" pieces

- 1 potato cut into 8 pieces (optional)

- 1 tomato cut into big pieces or slices ,stir fried in 1 tsp oil and kept aside.

- 4-6 whole green chillies

- 10-12 curry patta leaves

- 3-4 pieces of whole dry red chillies

- 3-4 bay leaves

- 3 tbsp chopped coriander leaves

- 4 green cardamom

- 2 pcs of 1" cinnamon stick

- 1 star anise

- 4-5 cloves

- 1 tsp of peppercorns

- 1 tsp of whole cummin

- Salt to taste

- Red chilli powder to taste

- 1/2 tsp turmeric powder

- 3 tbsp of ghee/oil
method:
- Warm the oil in a pan and add the bay leaves, whole red chillies, cardamom, cinnamon, cloves, star anise ,peppercorns and whole cumin and stir fry for a minute or so

- Add the curry patta leaves and stir fry for few seconds

- Add the green chillies and stir fry for few seconds

- Add the sliced onions and stir fry till translucent or transparent

- Add the ginger garlic paste And stir fry till the raw smell of the ginger garlic goes

- When the onions turn beige brown add the cut potato and stir fry for a minute or so

- Add the cut carrots and beans and stir fry for few minutes

- Add the turmeric, red chilli powder and salt to taste and stir fry for few minutes

- Here you can add 2-3 tbsp of water to prevent the masala from sticking to the bottom

- Add 3 tbsp of chopped coriander leaves and mix it in

- Add the soaked kala masur dal and stir fry for few minutes

- Lower the flame and cover and cook for 5-7 minutes

- Now add the rice and mix it in well

- Add the water 1:2 or 1:2 1/4

- Mix everything well

- When the water starts bubbling, cover the pan and lower the flame

- When the rice is 3/4 done add the stir fried tomato and mix it in

- Cover and cook till done .

- Add the remaining chopped coriander leaves

- Mix in the brown onions and cover and leave it for some time

- Can garnish with chopped coriander leaves and brown onions.

Note: Can add more vegetables according to personal preference.

Serve with raita of your choice from the recipe section

name: Meat/Chicken/Mince Masala
ingredients:
- 500 gms meat/chicken/mince

- 2 medium size onions sliced

- 1 tbsp of pounded ginger

- 1 tbsp of pounded garlic

- 1 tbsp of pounded green chillies

- 2 tomatoes sliced

- 2-3 bay leaves

- 4 pcs of green cardamom

- 2 pcs of 1 cinnamon stick

- 4-5 cloves

- ½ tsp turmeric powder

- 1 tsp kashmiri red chilli powder

- red chilli powder to taste

- salt to taste

- ½ tsp coriander powder

- ½ tsp cumin powder

- ½ tsp garam masala powder

- 1 tsp fennel pounded

- 3 tbsp mustard oil/ghee (50-50)

- 1 tsp sugar

- 2 tbsp curd
method:
- Marinate meat/chicken/mince with the curd and keep aside for 15-20 minutes.

- Mix the turmeric, red chilli powder, salt, kashmiri red chilli, coriander and cumin powder in a bowl with 7-8 tbsp of water and keep aside.

Method

- Put the oil in a pan, let the oil warm a little.

- Add the bay leaf, cinnamon stick, cardamom and cloves. Stir for few seconds.

- Add the pounded ginger, garlic and green chillies. Stir fry till the raw smell of the ginger garlic goes. And the masala becomes a little brown.

- Add the sliced onions. Stir fry till translucent and till the onions become a nice beige brown.

- Now add the masala mixture. Saute till the masala is cooked. When little oil starts seeping from the sides.

- Add the sliced tomatoes. Stir fry for few minutes.

- Now add the marinated meat/chicken/mince. Saute for few minutes.

- Cover and keep on low flame for 7-10 minutes. Keep stirring in between. Remove cover and saute till water dries up completely. Saute on low flame till oil seeps from the sides.

- The masala and meat/chicken/mince turns a nice reddish brown colour. Transfer to a pressure cooker.

- Add 1 cup water. Put the lid of the cooker and cook on low flame after the first whistle for 10 minutes.

- After 10 minutes remove from flame and let the cooker open naturally.

- When it opens ,put back on the flame and add the garam masala. Mix it in and cook on low flame for few minutes. Done.

- Gravy to be adjusted according to choice.

Note

- The ground garam masala used here is made of cinnamon, green cardamom and few cloves.

name: Boti(Boneless) Stir Fried Chicken
ingredients:
- 300 gms boneless chicken (cut in cubes)

- 2 onions cut in circles

- few green and red chillies

- ½ tsp panch phoren

- 1 tbsp of pounded ginger garlic

- salt to taste

- pinch of pepper

- 2 tbsp of oil (preferable mustard oil)
method:
- In a pan add the oil.

- Heat the oil. Add the panch phoren. Stir for 30-40 seconds.

- Add the chicken. Stir fry till the chicken changes colour.

- Add the pounded ginger garlic. Stir fry chicken till it turns a little brown. Can keep adding few tbsp of water if the pan is getting caught at the bottom.

- Add the green and red chillies. Stir fry for few minutes.

- When chicken is 90% done. Add the onions cut in circles. Mix it in well.

- Add the pepper. Stir fry till the chicken is done.

- The onion should not become totally limp. Done.

name: Cashew Stir Fry Chicken With Bell Peppers
ingredients:
- 300 gms of boneless chicken, cut into thin slices

- ½ red bell pepper

- ½ green bell pepper

- 1 onion cut into eight pieces

- ¼ cup cut into 1 piece spring onion

- ¼ cup cashews/almonds

- 2 pc ginger cut in thin circles

- 10-12 pods of garlic cut in thin round slices

- few whole red chillies cut into pieces

- salt to taste (keeping in mind that the sauce has salt )

- pinch of pepper

- ½ tsp sugar

- 2 tsp cornflour mixed in 4-5 tbsp of water

- 10 -12 tbsp of broth or water

- 3 tbsp of oil

For the sauce to be mixed together

- ½ tsp oyster sauce / dark soya sauce

- 2 tsp of light soya sauce

- 1 tsp brown sugar

- pinch of salt

- ½ tsp vinegar
method:
- Marinate chicken with 1 tsp vinegar, pinch of pepper and ½ tsp cornflour, keep aside.

Method

- In a pan add 1 tbsp of oil.

- Warm the oil a little. Add the cashews and roast it till it starts changing colour ,remove from pan and keep aside.

- In the same pan add ½ tbsp of oil.

- Warm the oil. Add the chicken pieces. Stir fry till it cooks. Dish out the chicken.

- In the same pan add remaining oil.

- Add the ginger garlic pieces. Stir fry till it is fragrant.

- Add the cut dry red chillies. Stir fry for 30-40 seconds.

- Add the bell peppers and onions. Stir fry for few minutes on full flame.

- Add salt, pepper and sugar. Stir fry for a minute or so.

- Add the cooked chicken and mix it in well.

- Now make the flame low and add the sauce mixture. Mix it in quickly.

- Add the broth/water and mix it in.

- Add the roasted cashews.

- Add the cornflour mixture. Stir fry on full flame so that the bell peppers ,cashews and chicken get a coating of the sauce mixture.

- Add the cut spring onions.

- Mix everything together. Done.

- Serve as a side dish with Fried Rice or Noodles.

name: Fish Masala
ingredients:
- 4 pieces of fish

- Marinate the fish with ½ tsp of kashmiri red chilli and juice of ½ a lime. Keep aside for 10-15 minutes.

Masala for the Fish

- 4 tbsp of hung youghart

- 1 tsp of ginger garlic paste

- ½ tsp garam masala

- 1 tsp kashmiri red chilli powder

- ½ tsp red chilli powder

- 1 ½ tsp dry kasturi methi leaves

- 1 tbsp of mustard oil

- salt to taste

- mix all of the above together in a bowl and keep aside
method:
- Now cover each piece of fish with the yogurt mixture. Then place in an oven or air fryer.

- Brush a little oil on top and cook.

- Do flip the sides and brush with oil again. Cook till the masala gets on top, changes colour, starts looking like tandoori dish.

- Serve as a appetizer with salad and lime.

- Sprinkle little chaat masala on it

- Done.

name: Vegetable Coriander/Mint Paneer Tikka
ingredients:
- Boil 1 kg milk. When it comes to a boil add juice of 2 limes. Stir it.

- Boil it on full flame, will gradually start separating. When the whey and paneer are visible.

- Add 1 small grated carrot and ¼ cup chopped spinach. Let it cook for a minute.

- Keep a muslin cloth ready on a bowl. Drain the paneer in it.

- Give it a square shape. Cover with the muslin.

- Place something heavy on it so that it takes the shape. Keep it for ½ an hour.

Coriander Mint Chutney
Recipe in the app

Marination for the Tikka

- 4 tbsp of hung yogurt

- 1 tsp of ginger garlic paste

- ½ tsp garam masala

- 1 tsp kashmiri red chilli powder

- ½ tsp red chilli powder

- 1 ½ tsp dry kasturi methi leaves

- 1 tbsp of mustard oil

- salt to taste

- mix all of the above together in a bowl and keep aside
method:
- Cut the paneer in cubes.

- Spread coriander /Mint chutney on the paneer cubes and place another piece on top ,like a sandwich.

- Now cover it with the yogurt mixture.

- Place in an oven or air fryer.

- Brush oil on the top, flip the side brush oil again. Till the masala gets cooked.

- Changes colour, starts looking like tandoori paneer. Serve as a appetizer with salad and lime. Sprinkle little chaat masala on it.

- Done.

name: Cabbage Mushrooms Stir Fry
ingredients:
- ½ medium size cabbage

- 6 mushrooms, each cut into 4 pieces

- 1 ½ tsp pounded garlic

- 1 ½ tsp pounded ginger

- few chopped green chillies to taste

- 2 whole dry red chillies cut into pieces

- 1 green peppers cut in thick rings

- ½ cup spring onions cut into 2 " pieces

- salt a pinch

- 2 tsp of light soya sauce

- 1 tsp of dark soya sauce

- ½ tsp oyster sauce (optional )

- 1 tsp vinegar

- 1 tsp sugar

- 2 tbsp oil
method:
- Cut the hard part of the cabbage and cut into thin slices.

- The leaves break into big pieces.

- In a kadhai add ½ tbsp of oil.

- Heat the oil.

- Add the hard part of the cabbage and stir fry in full flame for few minutes

- Add the cabbage leaves. Stir fry for a minute or so.

- Remove from kadhai and keep aside.

- In the same kadhai.

- Add ½ tbsp oil.

- Heat the oil. Add the mushroom and stir fry for few minutes.

- Add the pounded ginger garlic and the remaining oil. Stir fry for 1-2 minute.

- Add the green chillies. Stir fry for few seconds.

- Add the dry cut red chillies. Stir fry for few seconds. Now lower the flame.

- Add the dark soya sauce. Stir fry for few seconds.

- Add the pepper rings. Stir fry for few seconds.

- Now add the stir fried cabbage.

- Add the light soya sauce.

- Add the oyster sauce.

- Add vinegar. Stir fry for 20-30 seconds.

- Add sugar and salt to taste.

- Now make the flame full. Stir fry for few seconds.

- Add the spring onions. Stir fry for 20-30 seconds. Done.

- Remove and dish out.

- Garnish with roasted sesame seeds.

Note

- If you do not have oyster sauce can replace with ½-¾ tsp of dark soya .
Can serve with fried rice.

name: Fish With Cauliflower
ingredients:
- 4 pieces of fish marinated in a pinch of salt and turmeric

- 1 medium size cauliflower cut into big florets

- few whole green chillies

- 1½ piece ginger ground

- 2 tsp of whole cumin ground to a paste

- 1 tomato puree

- salt to taste

- ¼ tsp turmeric powder

- red chilli powder to taste

- salt to taste

- ¼ tsp whole cumin seeds

- 3 tbsp mustard oil / refined oil
method:
- Put ½ tbsp of oil in a kadhai.

- Warm the oil.

- Add the cauliflower florets.

- Add a pinch of salt. Stir fry and cook till half done.

- Remove and keep aside.

- In the same kadhai add the remaining oil.

- Warm the oil lightly fry the fish and keep aside.

- In the same kadhai add the whole cumin.

- When it starts splutter. Add the ground ginger and cumin paste. Saute till the raw smell goes Add the salt, turmeric and red chilli powder and tomato puree.

- Saute till the raw smell of the ginger goes.

- When the water from the tomato has dried and little oil starts seeping.

- Add the half cook florets. Saute for 5-7 minutes.

- Add 2 cups of water. Mix it in well.

- When the water starts to bubble.

- Cover and cook on low flame till florets are cooked. Keep stirring and checking in between. When florets are more or less done.

- Add the green chillies.

- Add the fried fish.

- Let it cook on low flame for 5-7 minutes. Done.

- Serve with plain rice.

name: Chicken Bharta
ingredients:
- chicken

- 300 gms boneless chicken (breast)

- boil chicken in pressure cooker for 5 minutes,after first whistle on low flame in 2 cups water, 2 cloves 1 pc cinnamon stick , 1 pc ginger, 3-4 cloves of garlic and a pinch of salt

- let the cooker open naturally

- remove chicken, shred it with a fork and keep aside

- keep the water for the cooking /gravy

Masala

- dry masala to soak in 5-6 tbsp of water and kept aside

- ½ tsp turmeric powder ,1 tsp red chilli powder, 1 tsp kashmiri chilli powder, ½ tsp cumin powder(raw) and ½ tsp coriander powder (raw)

- salt to taste

To be pounded and kept

- 4 pieces of green cardamom

- 6 cloves

- 1 black cardamom

- 1 big pc of cinnamon 2 stick

- 1 ¼ tbsp dry kasturi leaves

To be made into a paste

- 2 tbsp cashews

- 2 tbsp mixed melon seeds (char magaz)

- soak for ½ an hour and then grind to a paste

- 2-3 hard boiled egg ,1 egg coarsely mash the yolk and cut the white into pieces. Keep aside

- The other 2 cut vertically into 2 for garnishing

For garnish

- pinch of garam masala

- 1 tsp dry kasturi leaves

- 1-2 tsp of butter to drizzle before serving (optional ,added this as fresh cream is omitted from this recipe) and the boiled eggs

Remaining ingredients

- 1-2 bay leaf

- 1 ½ medium size onions chopped

- 2 medium size tomatoes, peeled and pureed

- 1 tsp ginger garlic paste

- 1 ½ tbsp oil

- 1 ½ tbsp ghee

- 1 tsp sugar

- ¼ cup curd

- few whole green chillies
method:
- Put oil and ghee in a pan, warm it a little.

- Add the pounded ,whole garam masala and kasturi leaves.

- Add the bay leaves. Stir fry for a minute or so.

- Add the chopped onions and stir fry till it becomes a little brown.

- Add the ginger garlic paste and saute till the raw smell goes.

- Add the tomato puree. Saute till the water from the tomato dries up and oil starts seeping.

- Add the soaked masala of salt, turmeric, red chilli, coriander and cumin powder. Saute till the rawness of the masala goes. Make the flame low.

- Add the curd and stir continuously, so that the curd does not leave water. Saute on low flame for 20-30 seconds.

- Add the shredded chicken. Mix the chicken well with the masala.

- Add the stock of the chicken. Mix it in well. Cook for few minutes.

- Add whole green chillies. Cook for a minute or so.

- Add the cashews melon seeds paste. Stir it in well. Cook for few minutes.

- Add the mashed yolk and cut egg white. Mix it in well.

- Lower the flame and cover and cook for 5-7 minutes. Do stir in between. Do not let the gravy dry up ,as it will become thick later.

- Add the sugar, garam masala, dry kasturi methi and blob of butter. Mix it in gently keep for few seconds. Done.

- Top with halved boiled eggs.

- Serve with roti.

name: Masala Aloo And Onion Paratha
ingredients:
- 1 boiled potato mashed (medium - big)

- 3 onions chopped

- 1 tsp grated ginger

- ½ tsp whole cumin

- 1 tbsp of chopped coriander leaves

- 2 tbsp oil

- wheat flour to be kneaded and kept aside

Masala to be ground coarsely together

- ½-¾ tbsp of coriander seeds

- ¼ tsp peppercorns

- ½ tsp carom seed(ajwain)

- ½ tsp fennel(sauf)

- ¼ tsp asafoetida

- 1-2 green chillies

- ½ tsp sugar

- 1 tsp kasturi methi

- ½ tsp dry mango powder

- ½ tsp kashmiri red chilli powder

- salt

- keep aside
method:
- Take a kadhai. Add the oil, warm the oil.

- Add the whole cumin seeds. When it starts to splutter.

- Add the chopped onions and grated ginger. Stir fry for few minutes, till it starts to become soft.

- Add the coarsely ground masala. Stir fry for few minutes.

- Add the mashed potato. Saute till all is amalgated together.

- Add the chopped coriander leaves. Mix well.

- Remove and keep aside. Make balls of the dough, roll it out a little. Place potato mixture on top.

- Gradually bring the sides up and close at the top.

- Sprinkle some loose flour. Roll it out gently.

- Heat a tava. Place the rolled out dough on it. Make the flame low.

- When little bubbles come on top. Make the flame full and flip the side.

- Brush with oil/ghee and roast on both sides till it gets a little brown.

- Repeat the same with the rest.

- Serve with raita.

name: Lamb Kebab
ingredients:
- 100g lamb mince

- 20g onion

- 1 tsp lemon juice

- 2 tbsp fresh coriander leaves

- 1 tsp garlic crushed

- ½ tsp ginger grated

- 2 green chillies chopped

- 2-3 pepper crushed

- ½ tsp cumin powder

- ½ tsp dhania powder

- ½ tsp turmeric powder

- ½ tsp garam masala

- ½ tsp salt

- 1 tsp oil
method:
- Mix ½ tsp tsp of lemon juice and lamb mince in a bowl.

- Blend the oil, garlic, ginger, chillies, crushed peppercorns, cumin, coriander powder, ½ tsp lemon juice, turmeric powder and salt in a mixer to a paste.

- Stir the paste and coriander into the mince.

- With wet hands skewer the meat into long sausage shapes. Rotate the meat around the skewer, pressing gently all round.

- Alternatively, shape the mixture into small patties.

- Brush each kebab with a little oil and grill under a medium heat or barbecue for 4- 5 minutes on each side, or until cooked through.

name: Mashed Chickpea Roll
ingredients:
- 50 gm wheat flour

- 25 gms cooked chickpeas

- 30 gms capsicum

- 20 gms carrot

- 30 gms cabbage

- 20 gms onion

- 1 green chilli

- 2 drops of Vinegar

- salt

- 1 tsp oil
method:
- Take wheat flour and make a dough.

- Cover it and keep it aside for 15 minutes.

- After 15 minutes, take a small dough, roll it out on a circle and cook it by applying oil.

For the filling

- Soak chickpeas for 8 hours.

- Boil it in a pressure cooker for 20-30 minutes.

- Mash it using a spoon or hand.

- Take a bowl, add all the grated vegetables and cooked mashed chickpeas in it.

- Add salt, drop of vinegar and mix it.

- Now place the roti on the board, add the filling and roll it.

name: Chole Veg Pulao
ingredients:
- 30 gm rice

- 30 gm chole

- 50 gm capsicum

- 30 gm cabbage

- 20 gm onions

- ¼ tsp grated Garlic

- ¼ tsp grated Ginger

- 1 tbsp coriander leaves

- 1 tbsp chole masala

- 3-4 curry leaves

- 1 tsp red chilli powder

- ½ tsp whole cumin seeds

- ½ tsp oil

- salt
method:
- Heat oil in a deep pan, add whole cumin seeds, when seeds start to change colour, add garlic and ginger and saute it.

- Add onions and curry leaves, saute till it becomes golden brown. Add chopped vegetables and saute it for 5 minutes.

- Now, add boiled chickpeas and cook it for a minute.

- Add rice, salt, chole masala, red chilli powder, mix well and cook for a minute. Add one tablespoon of coriander leaves and mix well.

- Serve hot

name: Brinjal Pulao
ingredients:
- 100 gms brinjal

- 30 gms rice

- 30 gms onion

- 50 gms Tomatoes

- 50 ml skimmed Milk

- 1 bayleaf

- 1 clove

- 1 inch cinnamon stick

- ½ tsp ginger garlic paste

- ½ tsp red chilli powder

- pinch of turmeric powder

- ½ tsp coriander powder

- 1 tbsp coriander leaves

- ½ tsp mint leaves

- ½ tsp oil

- salt
method:
- Heat oil in a pressure cooker with bayleaf, cinnamon, cloves and whole cumin seeds.

- Saute onion with ginger garlic paste till it turns golden brown.

- Add in tomatoes along with mint and coriander leaves. Cook till tomatoes get mushy.

- Add in turmeric, salt, red chilli and coriander powder.

- Once the masala gets cooked add chopped brinjals and saute for a few minutes.

- Now add milk and water. When it begins to boil, add soaked rice, put the lid on and pressure cook it.

- Switch off the flame once cooked and let it reset for 10-15 minutes.

- Serve it

name: Yogurt Coleslaw Sandwich
ingredients:
- 2 whole wheat bread

- 100 gms homemade hung curd

- 20 gm grated carrot

- 50 gms sliced green capsicum

- 50 gms sliced cabbage

- 30 gms onion

- 2 garlic clove

- black pepper

- salt
method:
- Take a bowl, add hung curd, chilli flakes, crushed garlic, pepper and salt.

- Mix together and add vegetables and mix it again.

- Now take bread, and apply coleslaw mixture gently over bread and cover it with another bread slice. Roast it

- Cut it in a desired piece and serve.

name: Rajma Masala
ingredients:
- 30 gms rajma

- 50 gms onion

- 50 gms tomatoes

- ½ tsp ginger garlic paste

- ½ tsp garam masala

- ½ tsp coriander powder

- ½ tsp red chilli powder

- 1 bayleaf

- ½ tsp whole cumin seeds

- coriander leaves

- ½ tsp oil

- salt
method:
- Soak rajma overnight and pressure cook it by adding salt and water.

- Heat oil in a pan, add whole cumin seeds and bayleaf.

- Now add onion paste and ginger garlic paste and saute till it turns golden brown.

- Add tomato puree and salt and cook it by covering the pan for 4-5 minutes.

- Now add coriander powder, garam masala, red chilli powder and turmeric powder and saute it for 2 minutes more.

- Add soft cooked rajma with stock i.e rajma cooked water.

- Mix it well, cover the pan and cook it.

- Add water according to the desired consistency and cook.

- Serve it

name: French Beans Pulao
ingredients:
- 100 gm french beans

- 30 gm rice

- 5-6 curry leaves

- 1 tsp mustard seeds

- pinch of asafoetida

- 1 dry red chilly (broken)

- 1 tsp red chilli powder

- ½ tsp turmeric powder

- 1 tsp salt

- 1 tsp oil
method:
- To begin with making french beans pulao, we need to cut the beans in 1 inch pieces and keep it aside.

- Heat oil in a pan. Add mustard seeds, curry leaves, turmeric powder, dry chilli, asafoetida and cook for a few seconds.

- Add in the cut beans and give a nice mix.

- Sprinkle some water and cover the pan. Cook on low flame for 5-7 minutes or till beans are cooked and tender. Do not over cook.

- Now add in the cooked rice and rest of the ingredients. Mix and cook on medium flame for the next 5 minutes, so that all the flavours can come together.

- Remove from the heat and serve.

name: Egg Curry
ingredients:
- 1 whole egg

- 150 gm tomato, cooked and pureed

- 25gm onion paste

- ½ tsp ginger paste

- ½ tsp garlic paste

- 1 green chilli, paste

- ½ tsp turmeric powder

- ½ tsp red chilli powder

- ½ tsp dhania powder

- ½ tsp garam masala powder

- 2 tbsp freshly coriander leaves chopped

- ¼ tsp sugar

- 1 tsp salt

- 1 tsp oil
method:
- Firstly, boil the egg. Add the egg in a saucepan with some water. Add sufficient water that the egg is covered with it. Let it come to boil for 15 minutes or until you see a crack on the outer shell.

- Once done, let it cool down. Remove the outer shell of the egg and keep it aside.

- Heat of oil in a wok; add in the onion garlic and ginger paste. Sauté for a few minutes until the raw smell goes away and the onion changes color.

- Once the onion is well roasted, add in the turmeric powder, sugar, garam masala powder, coriander powder and red chilli powder. Stir those powders into the onion masala until well combined. This will take about 3 to 4 minutes.

- After 3 to 4 minutes, add in the tomato puree, salt and the egg. Simmer the egg curry covered for 10 to 15 minutes until you see the eggs are coated well with the curry.

- Check the salt and spice levels and the consistency of the curry. Adjust them to taste and add water if you want the consistency of the curry to be thinner. Once done, stir in the chopped coriander leaves and serve.

name: Black Chana Rasam
ingredients:
- 1 cup black chana strained water

- 2 tbsp tamarind extract

- ½ tsp garlic grated

- 50 gms tomatoes

- 30 gms onion

- pinch of asafoetida

- 1 dry chilli

- ½ tsp whole cumin

- ½ tsp coriander seeds

- ½ tsp mustard seeds

- 3-4 curry leaves

- 1 tbsp chopped coriander leaves

- pinch of Turmeric

- salt

- ½ tsp oil
method:
- Soak the chana overnight and pressure cook it.

- Separate the chana with water after cooking.

- Use cooked chana water for cooking.

- Soak marble size tamarind in water and extract the thick water from it.

- Roast the peppercorn, cumin, coriander seeds together and coarsely grind them.

- Heat oil in a pan, add mustard, cumin seeds, curry leaves and red chilli.

- Now add crushed garlic and wait till they turn aromatic.

- Further add turmeric, onion and saute it till it turns golden brown.

- Now add tomatoes and salt, cook it for 5 minutes till the tomatoes become soft.

- Now add cooked chana water.

- Cook it on medium heat.

- Serve it with plain rice.

name: Palak Paneer
ingredients:
- 50 gms paneer

- 100 gms palak

- 50 gms tomatoes

- 30 gms onion

- 2 garlic cloves

- inch of ginger

- ½ tsp coriander powder

- ½ tsp garam masala

- ½ tsp chilli powder

- 1 green chilli

- ½ tsp lemon juice

- 1 tsp oil

- salt
method:
- Take a pot of boiling water, add spinach leaves and simmer it for 2-3 minutes until wilted

- Take them out and put them on a strainer.

- Heat the oil in a pan, add green chilli, chopped tomatoes, onions, garlic and ginger and saute it until it turns golden brown and keep it aside to cool down

- To a blender, add sauteed green chilli, tomatoes, onions, garlic and ginger and blanched spinach. Puree to a smooth paste and set aside

- Heat oil in a pan, add cumin seeds then add chopped onions

- Cook onion for 2-3 minutes until it becomes soft .

- Add the prepared spinach puree and mix. Also add ½ cup water.

- Cover the pan and let it cook for 10 minutes on medium heat.

- Once spinach is cooked add garam masala, red chilli powder and salt.

- Stir in the paneer and mix. Let the curry simmer for 3-4 minutes.

- Switch off the flame and add lemon juice.

- Ready to serve.

name: Raw Papaya Stuffed Paratha
ingredients:
- 100 gms raw papaya

- 10 gms onion

- 60 gms wheat flour

- pinch of ajwain

- 2 green chillies

- ¼ tsp garam masala

- 1 tsp coriander leaves

- ½ tsp grated ginger

- ½ tsp oil

- salt
method:
- Take a bowl and grate the washed and peeled papaya pieces.

- Meanwhile, take a bowl and add wheat flour, again to it. Add enough water and knead into a soft dough. Cover and keep it aside for 20 minutes.

- Take a pan, roast whole cumin seeds to it. Add the grated papaya along with salt, chopped coriander leaves, garam masala and black pepper to it.Add green chilli along with grated ginger to it and saute for a while and cook for about 5 minutes. Remove and cool it slightly.

- Take the dough and make a ball using a little dry flour, roll each ball in the shape of a poori.

- Add the fillings and place it in the middle.

- Now, roll the stuffed balls in the shape of a parathas.

- Take a pan, put rolled out paratha.

- Cook until it turns golden brown, drizzle some oil on top and cook on the other side as well.

name: Schezwan Fried Rice
ingredients:
- 240 gms raw rice

- 2 medium size tomatoes

- 2 red fresh red chilli or 2/3 cup, cut in circles

- 1/2 cup finely cut chives / spring onions

- 2 tbsp chopped garlic

- 3 tbsp tomato sauce

- 1 tsp dark soya sauce

- 2 tbsp red chilli/schezwan sauce ( added at the end)

- 1 tsp chilli flakes

- 1 tsp sugar

- Salt to taste

- 3 tbsp of unflavoured oil
method:
- Wash the rice and cook the rice till it is slightly underdone. Ensure you do not overcook it.

- Once cooked, spread it out on a plate or tray to cool.

- Make a slit at the top of the tomatoes and boil them till the skin starts separating. Remove from the boiling water and peel and remove the skin. Mash the tomatoes and keep aside.

- Take a kadhai or wok and add the oil.

- Once the oil is warm, add the chopped garlic and stir fry till the raw smell is gone.

- Add the tomato sauce, red chilli sauce, soya sauce, sugar and salt and stir fry for a minute or so .

- Now add the mashed tomatoes and stir it till the water of the tomatoes dries up.

- Now add the rice, chives (spring onions) and red pepper and mix it in well .

- Stir fry for few minutes, till the rice absorbs the gravy.

- Check the salt and adjust as needed.

- Serve hot, serve with a side of paneer vegetables manchurian.

Note

- The fresh red chilli looks like the green pakora chilli, you can replace this with strips of capsicum as well.

name: All C'S Fried Rice - Cabbage, Capsicum, Chives, Chillies.
ingredients:
- ½ cup (raw) rice

- ½ a capsicum cut into thin strips

- 1 ½ -2 cups finely shredded cabbage

- ¼ cup finely chopped chives

- 2 small sprigs of coriander (1/4 cup chopped)

- 4 green chillies

- 5-6 pods of garlic

- 1 tbsp chopped garlic

- 1 tsp light soya

- 1 tsp vinegar

- 1 ½ tsp sugar

- salt to taste

- 2 tbsp oil
method:
- Wash and boil the rice ,to 90% done. Keep aside, let it cool down.

- Pound the coriander,green chillies ,pods of garlic and vinegar together.

- Can be coarsely pounded in a mortar n pestal and keep it aside. Take a kadhai add the oil in it .

- When the oil is warm add the chopped garlic. Stir fir a minute or do till the raw smell goes.

- Now add the pounded coriander mixture to the garlic. Stir fry for few seconds on medium flame.

- Add the cabbage and stir fry for few seconds.

- Add the capsicum and stir fry for few seconds.

- Add the chopped garlic chives and sugar. Stir fry for few seconds.

- Add the soya sauce and stir fry for few seconds.

- Now add the rice and salt and mix everything together. Stir fry for a minute or so.

- Lastly add the a tbsp of chopped chives and stir fry for few seconds.

- Done.

name: Mushrooms And Vegetables In Manchurian Gravy
ingredients:
- 1 pkt fresh mushrooms cut into 4 pieces each

- 1 medium size carrot cut into thick strips

- 10-15 french beans cut into 1 pieces

- 1 bell pepper cut into thick strips

- 1 onion cut into thick strips

- ¼ spring onions cut into 2 pieces

- few slit green chillies

- 1 tbsp of chopped coriander leaves

- 1 tbsp of pounded ginger and garlic

- 1 tsp vinegar

- ½ tsp sugar

- ¼ tsp pepper

- 3 tbsp of oil

- salt to taste

- 2 tsp cornflour mixed with 6-8 tbsp of water

- 1 ½ cup of hot water/ broth (If using water for gravy add little chopped coriander leaves and 1 tbsp of chopped celery in the water then boil it )

For the sauce

- 2 tbsp of tomato ketchup

- 2 tbsp of chilli sauce

- 1 tsp dark soya
method:
- Take a pan. Add the oil.

- Add the pounded ginger garlic. Stir fry till fragrant.

- Add the carrots and beans. Stir fry for a minute or so.

- Add the bell peppers ,onion and mushrooms. Stir fry on full flame.

- Add the slit green chillies, sugar, salt and pepper. Stir fry for few minutes. Vegetable need to be crunchy and mushrooms should not become limp.

- Add the cut spring onions. Stir fry for few seconds.

- Now add the sauce mixture. Mix it in well.

- Add the water or broth. When it starts bubbling.

- Add the vinegar. Mix it in.

- Add the cornflour mixture.

- Add the chopped coriander leaves. Mix it in and let the sauce thicken to the desired consistency.

- Serve with fried rice or plain rice.

Note

- If gravy is not required then add ¼ -½ cup of water or broth only, will just have a coating on everything.

name: Stuffed Sweet Potato Paratha
ingredients:
- 2 big sweet potato peeled and steamed

- ½ onion finely chopped

- few green chillies to taste

- 1 tbsp of finely chopped coriander

- salt according to taste

- ½ -1 tsp chilli flakes

- 1 tsp aamchur

- dough for the parathas

- ghee/oil according to taste
method:
- Mash the sweet potato.

- Add the chopped onion, green chillies,chopped coriander leaves, salt and aamchur. Mix all of the above nicely.

- Can check the salt at this stage.

- Take a little dough, size of a golf ball.

- Roll out into a small circle.

- Place the stuffing in the centre.

- Bring all the edges together to the center. Press it in.

- Then gently roll out ,to the size of a quarter plate.

- Place a tava on the flame.

- Make it a little warm.

- Now ace the stuffed roti on it. Let it cook for a minute.

- Flip the side and cook for few seconds.

- Now spread some ghee/oil on top. And flip the side. Repeat on the other side.

- When both sides become a little brown. It's done .

- Serve with curd and chutney of your choice .

name: Capsicum Stir Fried Chicken
ingredients:
- 500 gms boneless chicken cut in strips

- 1 big green capsicum cut in thin slices

- 1 big onion sliced

- 1 cup chopped spring onions

- 2 tsp chopped garlic

- 1 ½ tsp chopped ginger

- few chopped green chillies

- salt to taste

- ¼ tsp pepper

- ½ tsp sugar

- ½ tbsp tomato sauce

- ½ tbsp of soya sauce

- ½ tbsp of vinegar

For the chicken marination

- Juice of ½ a lime

- 1 egg

- ½ tbsp of flour

- ½ tbsp of cornflour

- pinch of salt and pepper

- first marinate chicken in salt, pepper and lime juice and keep aside for 20-30 minutes

- then add egg, cornflour and flour and mix it well and keep it aside

- after sometime put 1 tbsp of oil in a pan

- place chicken on the pan and cook on low flame till done on both sides

- keep aside when done

For the green chilli sauce

- In a grinder put 10-12 green chillies and 2 tbsp of vinegar ,grind and keep aside
method:
- In a kadhai add 2-3 tbsp of oil.

- When the oil is warm add the chopped garlic and ginger. Stir fry for few seconds.

- Add the sliced onions and chopped green chillies. Stir fry for few seconds.

- Add the green chilli paste and stir fry for few seconds.

- Add the soya sauce and stir fry for few seconds.

- Add the sliced capsicum and stir fry for few seconds.

- Add the vinegar, pepper and salt to taste. Stir fry for few seconds.

- Add the sugar and tomato sauce. Stir fry for few seconds.

- Add the cooked chicken strips.

- Mix it in gently and well so that the chicken has a coating of all the ingredients.

- Lastly add the chopped spring onions and stir fry for few seconds .

- Done.

name: Tawa Kheema(Mince)
ingredients:
- 250 gms mince

- 1 big onion chopped

- 1 tomato chopped

- few whole green chillies

- few chopped green chillies

- 1 tbsp of ginger julienne

- 1 onion cut in rings

- 1-2 tbsp of chopped coriander leaves

- ½ tsp garlic paste

- ½ tsp ginger paste

- salt to taste

- red chilli powder to taste

- ¼ tsp of turmeric powder

- ¼ tsp of dhaniya powder

- ¼ tsp of cumin powder

- ¼ tsp of garam masala powder
method:
1. Place a tava or flat pan on the flame and immediately(if the tava gets hot the mince will stick to it).
3. Place and spread the mince on the tava.
4. Add the onions on top of it.
5. Add the ginger garlic paste.
6. Add the chopped tomato.
7. Add chopped green chillies.
8. Add the turmeric powder, red chilli powder, salt, garam masala, dhaniya powder and cumin powder and mix it in gently. Stir gently for a minute or so.
9. Mince will leave its own water ,make the flame low and cover and cook, stirring in between.
10. When there is no water left, saute on low flame till the mince become a nice brown colour.
11. Mince on being ¾ cooked add the whole green chillies and ginger julienne and mix it in and let it cook on low flame. Saute for few minutes, then add the chopped coriander leaves and mix it in.
13. Can add 2-3 tbsp of water to saute.
14. Add the onion rings on the top and cover and cook for few minutes.
15. Mix the onion rings into the mince gently.
16. When the onion is ¾ done remove from flame. Done.

name: Besan Chakli Curry
ingredients:
For the Chakli

- ⅔ cup besan

- 1 ½ cup water

- salt to taste

- chopped green chillies to taste

- ¼ tsp whole cumin

- 1 tsp grated ginger

- ¼ tsp asafoetida

- mix all together and stir it for 5-7 minutes

- keep aside for 10-15 minutes

- take a pan, add 1 tsp ghee

- when the ghee is warm add the besan mixture in it

- keep stirring and pressing it in so that no lumps form

- cook on low - medium flame

- when it becomes thick

- take a flat plate ,grease it with ghee

- put the cooked besan on it and spread it out flat. Keep for 10-15 minutes. Let it set

- then cut rectangles ,remove each piece and keep aside .

For the gravy
Ingredients

- 2 tbsp ghee

- ½ tsp whole cumin

- ¼ tsp asafoetida

- 1½ tsp of pounded garlic

- ½ tsp grated ginger

- 1 onion made into paste

- 1 tomato to be pureed with 2 green chillies

- ¼ tsp turmeric powder

- ½ tsp kashmiri chilli powder

- ½ tsp coriander powder

- red chilli powder to taste

- salt to taste

- ½-¾ tsp of sugar

- 2 tbsp of curd

- 1 tbsp chopped coriander leaves
method:
- In a kadhai add the ghee, when the ghee is warm.

- Add the whole cumin. When it starts splutter.

- Add the pounded garlic. Stir fry till it becomes fragrant

- Add the onion paste. Saute for few minutes.

- Add grated ginger. Saute till the water of the onion dries up.

- And the masala starts changing colour. Can add 2-3 tbsp of water to saute as and when required.

- Add the salt,turmeric, kashmiri chilli ,coriander and red chilli powder.

- Add 2-3 tbsp of water. Saute the masala till it changes to a nice reddish colour.

- Add the tomato puree chilli mixture. Saute till the water of the tomato dries up.

- And the masala has a nice red colour.

- Add the curd and saute till the water of the curd dries up.

- Add water 2 cups and bring it to a boil.

- Cook on low flame for 5-7 minutes so that the gravy gets the flavors.

- Add the chopped coriander leaves. Cook for few minutes.

- Gently add in the chakli and let the gravy come to a boil.

- Add the sugar. Stir it in gently.

- Make the flame low and cook for 5-7-10 minutes to let the gravy thicken a little .

- When oil starts coming on the top. Remove from flame.

- Dish out, serve with pulao, rice, roti or paratha .

name: Garlic Prawns
ingredients:
- 500gms cleaned prawns

- 2 pc ginger grated

- ¼ cup chopped spring onions

- ½ tsp cornflour

- marinate prawns in above ingredients and keep aside

Rest of the Ingredients

- 2 tbsp chopped garlic

- ½ cup chopped spring onions

- few slit/whole /cut green chillies

- 1 tsp soya sauce

- ½ tsp oyster sauce

- ½ of a sweet lemon, juice

- ½ tsp vinegar

- 3-4 tbsp of oil
method:
- Take a pan add half the oil

- Heat the oil.

- Add the marinated prawns. Stir fry on high flame till cooked. Remove and keep aside.

- In the same pan.

- Add the remaining oil.

- Add the chopped garlic. Stir fry till fragrant.

- Add cut green chillies. Stir fry for few seconds.

- Add spring onions. Stir fry for few seconds. Switch of the flame.

- Add immediately oyster sauce and soya sauce. Mix it in well.

- Put on the flame.

- Add the stir fried prawns. Stir fry for few seconds.

- Add the sweet lemon juice and vinegar. Stir fry for few seconds.

- Check for salt. Done.

- Top with chopped spring onions.

- Serve with fried rice.

name: Fried Rice
ingredients:
- 1 cup basmati rice ,boiled to 80% and kept aside

- 1 ½ medium size carrots cut into small cubes

- 15-20 french beans cut into small pieces

- 1 ½ cup cabbage chopped

- ¼ spring onions chopped small

- ¼ cup celery chopped (optional)

- ¼ cup chives chopped small (optional)

- 1 tbsp chopped/pounded ginger garlic

- 4 eggs beaten with little salt and made into a soft scramble

- ½ cup chicken strips marinated with salt,pepper and little cornflour .Stir fried and kept aside

- 3 tbsp oil

- 1 tsp sugar

- 2 tsp vinegar

- 1½ tsp dark soya

- salt to taste

- ½ tsp pepper
method:
- Put oil in a kadhai.

- Heat the oil.

- Add the ginger garlic. Stir fry till fragrant.

- Add chopped celery. Stir fry for few seconds.

- Add carrots and beans. Stir fry for a minute or so.

- Add the chopped cabbage. Stir fry for few seconds.

- Add half the spring onions and half the chives. Stir fry for few seconds.

- Add the rice. Stir fry for few seconds.

- Add the soya sauce, vinegar, sugar, salt and pepper. Stir fry for few minutes on high flame.

- Add the scrambled eggs and stir fried chicken. Mix it in well. Check for salt.

- Add the remaining spring onions and chives keeping a tablespoon for garnishing. Done.

- Serve with a main dish.

name: Chicken Bell Peppers
ingredients:
- 500 gms chicken cut in strips

- pinch of salt

- pinch of chilli flakes

- pinch of pepper

- ½ an egg

- ½ tsp cornflour

- marinate the chicken in the above ingredients

- put in a pan 1-2 tbsp of oil

- cook the chicken, when done keep aside

- 1 red bell pepper cut in cubes and kept aside

- 2 green peppers cut in cubes and kept aside

- 1 onion cut into four pieces and keep aside

- few green chillies slit and kept aside

Remaining ingredients

- ¼ cup tomato puree (tin)

- 2 tbsp tomato ketchup

- 1 tsp soya sauce

- 1 tsp sugar

- ½ sweet lemon juice (mosambi)

- 3-4 tbsp of oil

- 1 tbsp of chopped garlic

- ¼ cup chopped spring onions

- salt to taste
method:
- Take a kadhai.

- Add 1 tbsp of oil.

- Heat the oil.

- Add half the chopped garlic. Stir fry till fragrant.

- Add slitted green chillies. Stir fry for few seconds.

- Add red ,green peppers and onion. Stir fry for a minute or so.

- Remove from kadhai and keep aside.

- In the same kadhai.

- Add 1 tbsp of oil.

- Add the remaining chopped garlic. Stir fry till fragrant. Switch of flame.

- Add tomato puree,tomato sauce and soya sauce. Stir it in.

- Put on flame. Add ¼ cup hot broth/water.

- Add sugar. When it starts bubbling. Flame should be on high.

- Add the stir fried chicken and bell peppers. Mix it in well.

- Add the juice of sweet lemon. Stir fry for a minute or so. Done..

- Serve with fried rice/plain rice.

name: Methi Saag
ingredients:
- 100gm methi leaves

- 20gm onion

- 2 dry red chillies

- 3-4 garlic cloves

- 1 tsp oil

- ½tsp lemon juice

- salt as per taste
method:
- Wash the methi leaves thoroughly and keep it aside.

- Heat oil in a pan, break the red chillies into 2 pieces and add it into oil, then add garlic cloves and saute for 2-3 minutes.

- Now add the chopped onions and saute until it turns golden brown.

- Add the methi leaves, mix and add salt.

- Add little water and cover and cook until the methi leaves are soft and absorbs all the water. Give it a mix and turn off the flame.

- Sprinkle some lemon juice on top and serve hot with rice.

name: Dahi Baingan
ingredients:
- 100 gm brinjal

- 50ml curd

- 1 tsp chilli powder

- ½ tsp ginger paste

- 1 tsp oil

- salt as per taste
method:
- Heat a pan, add ½ tsp oil on it and spread it.

- Now place the brinjal (cut into round-shape and marinated with salt and red chilli powder for 5 minutes) on it and cook from both the sides. Keep it aside.

- In the same pan, add ½ tsp of oil again, add ginger paste, and add the curd, give it a mix, add salt and red chilli powder and mix well.

- Once the curd starts boiling, add the shallow fried brinjal into it, slowly mix and turn off the flame.

name: Sorse Ilish (Mustard Hilsa)
ingredients:
- 100 gm ilish fish

- 30 gm mustard paste

- 2 slit green chillies

- ½ tsp black jeera

- 1 tsp oil

- pinch of turmeric powder

- salt as per taste
method:
- Heat oil in a pan, and shallow fry the fish from both sides on medium flame and keep it aside.

- In the same pan, add oil, once the oil heats up a bit add black jeera and then slit green chillies and saute for 2-3 mins.

- Then add mustard seed paste to it and add a little water (semi-liquid consistency), add salt and a pinch of turmeric powder and mix well.

- Once it starts boiling, add the fried fish, give it a mix and let it cook for 5- 7 mins.

- Turn off the flame. Serve hot with rice and salad.

name: Prawns Cutlet
ingredients:
- 75 gm prawns

- 20 gm onion

- 1 green chilli

- 1 tsp ginger-garlic paste

- 1 tsp red chilli powder

- ½ tsp dhania powder

- ½ tsp turmeric powder

- 1 tsp lemon juice

- salt as per taste

- 1 tsp oil
method:
- Boil prawns, let it cool down a bit, then squeeze water from it, grind it into a paste (do not add water) and keep it aside.

- Add chopped onion, green chilli, ginger garlic paste, all the spices, salt in a mixer, and blend it into a paste.

- Heat a pan, add ½ tsp oil, let it heat a bit.

- Add the grinded mixture and saute for 5-7 mins.

- Now add the prawns paste into it, mix both together and turn off the flame. Let it cool down a bit. Then shape the mixture into cutlets.

- Heat a pan, spread some oil on it and place the cutlets on them.

- Cook from both the sides on low flame.

- Serve hot with pudina or coriander chutney.

name: Veg Lentils
ingredients:
- 25gm lentil

- 20gm beans

- 20gm tomato

- 20gm onion

- 20gm bottle gourd

- 20gm cabbage

- 2 garlic cloves, chopped

- ½ tsp turmeric powder

- 1 tsp red chilli powder

- 2 dry red chillies

- ½ tsp mustard seeds

- ½ tsp jeera

- 4-5 curry leaves

- salt as per taste

- ½ tsp oil
method:
- In a pressure cooker, add lentils, chopped bottle guard, beans, cabbage and tomato, add some salt, chilli powder and turmeric, add water as required, mix and let it cook on medium flame for 2- 3 whistles.

- Heat oil in a pan, add mustard seeds, jeera, dry red chillies, curry leaves, garlic and saute for 2-3 minutes.

- Now add chopped onion and saute until it turns golden brown in colour.

- Then add the pressure cooked ingredients into it, mix well and let it come to a boil.

- Turn off the flame, and serve hot.

name: Veg Sprouts Rice
ingredients:
- 30g rice

- 25g sprouted bengal gram

- 20gm onion

- 20g tomato

- 20g cabbage

- 20g capsicum

- 20g beans

- 3-4 slit green chillies

- 3- 4 curry leaves

- ½ tsp ginger-garlic paste

- ½ tsp whole cumin seeds(jeera)

- ½ tsp turmeric powder

- 1 tsp dhania powder

- salt as per taste

- 1 tsp Oil
method:
- Pressure cook the rice and sprouted bengal gram with a pinch of salt on high flame for 3 whistles (or until the rice is cooked).

- Heat oil in a pan, add jeera, curry leaves and slit green chillies and saute for 2 minutes, add ginger-garlic paste and saute for 30 secs.

- Add chopped cabbage, capsicum and beans and saute for 2-3 mins, then add the chopped onions and tomatoes and saute for 4-5 mins.

- Add turmeric powder, dhania powder and salt (if required, as salt is also added in the rice), mix well and cook for 5-7 mins more.

- Then add the pressure cooked rice and sprouts and slowly mix it well along with the vegetable mixture.

- Turn off the flame. Garnish it with coriander leaves (optional) and serve hot.

name: Thai Paneer Fried Rice
ingredients:
- 25 gms rice

- 50 gms paneer

- 50 gms green bell peppers

- 50 gms cabbage

- 50 gms onion

- 1 tsp homemade thai red curry paste

- 1 tsp soya sauce

- 1 red chili

- White pepper powder

- ½ tsp cooking oil

- salt
method:
- Apply oil in a pan and stir fry paneer for 2-3 minutes. Now turn off the flame.

- Finely chop bell peppers, cabbage and onion into thin slices.

- Heat oil in a frying pan.

- Add red curry paste and crushed red chillies. Stir fry for a minute
