- Now add sliced vegetables in it, stir fry over medium flame for 2-3 minutes.

- Add soy sauce, white pepper and salt and cook for a minute.

- Now add steamed rice and mix gently until all ingredients are well mixed.

- Turn off heat and serve it in a bowl.

name: Cabbage Egg Bites
ingredients:
- 150 gms cabbage

- 1 whole egg

- 1 egg white

- ¼ tsp red chilli powder

- pinch of black pepper

- ½ tsp oil

- salt
method:
- Chop cabbage finely into a bowl.

- Take another small bowl, break the egg, add salt, chilli powder and beat it.

- Now transfer the egg mixture to the cabbage bowl, mix it.

- Apply oil to the pan and add the egg mixture into it.

- Now let it cook for sometime in medium heat.

- Once cooked, flip the side and let it cook.

- Once done, take it out on a plate and cut into the desired shape.

- Serve it with chutney.

name: Chow Chow/Chayote  Dumplings
ingredients:
- 25 gms wheat flour

- 50 gms finely grated squash

- 20 gms onion

- 5 gms parsley

- ¼ tsp ginger

- pinch of black pepper

- ¼ tsp oil

- salt
method:
- Make a dough from wheat flour.

- For filling take finely grated chayote, onions and ginger in a bowl, add salt in it.

- Heat oil in a pan and add minced vegetables and saute it till slightly cooked.

- Roll the thin small round of dough.

- Wet the edge with water, place 1 tsp of fillings and give it half moon shape. Steam for 15 minutes.

- Ready to serve with tomato chutney

name: Mutton Dumplings
ingredients:
- 50 gms wheat flour

- 50 gms minced mutton

- 30 gms onion

- 10 gms parsley

- pinch of black pepper

- ½ tsp oil

- salt
method:
- Make a dough from wheat flour.

- For filling, take finely minced meat, onion and grated ginger in a bowl, add salt in it.

- Heat oil in a pan and add filling and saute it till cooked.

- Roll the thin small round of dough.

- Wet the edge with water, place 1 tsp of fillings and give it half moon shape. Steam for 15 minutes.

- Take roasted tomato in a grinder, add 1 garlic clove, red chillies and salt and grind it.

- Ready to serve with tomato chutney.

name: Egg Spaghetti With Vegetables
ingredients:
- 30 gms whole wheat spaghetti

- 1 whole egg

- 50 gms capsicum

- 50 gms cabbage

- 50 gms cauliflower

- 50 gms onion

- ¼ tsp soya sauce

- 2 green chillies

- 1 crushed garlic

- ¼ tsp vinegar

- pinch of black pepper

- ½ tsp crushed paprika

- ¾ tsp oil

- salt
method:
- Bring water to a rolling boil in a deep pan and add noodles and cook it.

- Once cooked, drain off and rinse thoroughly under running water to remove unwanted starch.

- Set the colander aside.

- Add 1 tsp of oil in a pan, add onions and garlic in it and saute it

- Now add slit chillies, capsicum, cabbage and cauliflower and saute it till it turns slightly soft yet crunchy.

- Now break the egg in a bowl.

- Set the vegetables aside in a pan and add egg to it on the other side and scramble them. Cook it until soft.

- Now add vinegar and black pepper to it and mix it.

- Now add noodles and add soya sauce to it.

- Sprinkle more pepper and salt.

- Toss well and let it fry for 2 minutes in a high flame.

- Serve it hot

name: String Beans Sabzi
ingredients:
- 100 gms string beans

- 50 gms tomato

- 50 gms onion

- 1 tablespoon ginger garlic paste

- ½ tsp coriander powder

- ½ tsp garam masala

- ¼ tsp red chilli powder

- ½ tsp whole cumin seeds

- ½ tsp coriander leaves

- salt

- ½ tsp oil
method:
- Wash the beans and chop them.

- Heat the oil in the kadhai and add whole cumin seeds, let it splutter.

- Now add onions and saute it for 2-3 minutes until it becomes golden in colour.

- Now add tomatoes in it, saute it for a minute and add garam masala, red chilli powder, coriander powder, ginger garlic paste and mix it.

- Saute it until tomatoes become mushy.

- Now add beans and salt, cook it for 3 minutes.

- Now cover the lid and let it cook.

- Check in between and add water to it and let it cook.

- Once cooked, add coriander leaves.

name: Tomato Shorba
ingredients:
- 150 gms tomatoes

- 100 ml milk

- ½ tsp besan

- 3 curry leaves

- 2 slit green chillies

- 1 tbsp finely chopped coriander

- ½ tsp grated jaggery

- salt
method:
- To make tomato shorba, combine the tomatoes and 1 cup of water in a deep non-stick pan and cook on a medium flame for 8-10 minutes or till it turns soft.

- Allow them to cool completely and blend in the mixer.

- Strain the mixture using a strainer and keep side.

- Heat the oil in the pan and add the whole cumin seeds.

- When the seeds crackle,add the green chillies and curry leaves, saute it for a few seconds.

- Add tomato puree and besan milk mixture, jaggery and salt, mix well and cook on a medium flame for 3-4 minutes while stirring continuously.

- Add coriander and mix well.

- Serve tomato shorba hot.

name: Kala Chana Spinach Curry
ingredients:
- 25 gms kala chana

- 100 gms spinach

- 50 gms tomato

- 50 gms onion

- 1 tsp grated ginger and garlic

- 1 tsp ginger garlic paste

- ¼ tsp jeera

- ¼ tsp mustard seeds

- ¼ tsp coriander powder

- ¼ tsp jeera powder

- ¼ tsp red chilli powder

- pinch of turmeric powder

- ¼ tsp amchoor powder

- ½ tsp oil

- salt
method:
- Wash and soak black chana in water overnight.

- Drain and pressure cook with water for 30 minutes.

- Once cooked, keep it aside.

- In a thick pan, heat the oil, split jeera and mustard seeds.

- Add grated ginger and garlic and saute it.

- Now add onions and ginger garlic paste until it becomes translucent.

- Add chopped tomatoes, turmeric powder, cumin powder, red chilli, amchoor powder and salt.

- Mix well for 2-3 minutes until the tomatoes are cooked.

- Now add cooked chana and spinach, mix it and cook it until it becomes dry.

- Now add water to it, depending on the consistency you want and cook for 2-3 minutes by closing the lid.

- Now turn off the flame and serve it hot.

name: Buckwheat Pancake
ingredients:
- 50gm buckwheat

- 100 ml milk

- ½ tsp sugar
method:
- In a bowl, add buckwheat flour, powder the sugar and add it, give it a mix.

- Add milk little by little and make it into a semi-liquid consistency batter.

- Heat a pan, use a ladle and pour the batter on the pan into a CD size pancake.

- Cook on medium flame. Once you see pores on the pancake (indicates it's cooked), turn off the flame and serve hot.

name: Sprouts Chat
categories: Evening Snack, Sim's Family Recipes, Ramzan Specials
ingredients:
- 1 cup sprouted black gram

- 1 cucumber cut into small strips

- 1 tomato cut into thin strips

- 1 onion cut into thin slices

- few chopped green chillies to taste

- 1 tbsp coriander chopped

- 1 boiled potato sliced (optional)

- salt to taste

- pinch of black salt

- 1½ tsp roasted cumin powder

- pinch of roasted dhaniya powder

- ¼ tsp red chilli flakes/powder

- ½ lemon juice

- ¼ cup thick tamarind paste (black tamarind preferably)
method:
- Mix all of the above.

- Adjust for tamarind, salt and chillies.

- Done.

name: Chana Dal Pulao
ingredients:
- 1 cup basmati rice wash and soak for ½-45 minutes

- ½-⅔ cup chana dal wash and soak for ½-45 minutes

- 2 medium size onions sliced and fried brown and kept aside

- 1 medium to big onion chopped

- ¾ tbsp of ginger paste

- ½ tbsp of garlic paste

- 3 tbsp of ghee/oil

- 2-3 bay leaves

- 3-4 whole red chillies

- 4-5 green cardamom

- 2 black cardamom

- 2 pieces of cinnamon of 2 each

- 4-6 cloves

- 1 star anise (optional)

- 1 piece mace (optional)

- 1 tsp whole cumin

- 3-4 whole red chillies

- salt to taste

- ½ tsp turmeric powder

- 1 tsp red chilli powder

- 1 tsp kashmiri red chilli
method:
- Take a kadhai.

- Add the ghee to the kadhai.

- When the ghee gets warm.

- Add the bay leaves, whole red chillies, whole cumin, black and green cardamom, cloves ,cinnamon and mace.

- When the spice gets fragrant.

- Add the chopped onions. Stir fry till onions become beige brown.

- Add the ginger garlic paste. Saute till the raw smell goes of the ginger garlic.

- Add the salt, red chilli powder, turmeric powder.

- Add few tbsp of water. Stir till the masala has a nice reddish colour and oil starts seeping out.

- Drain the water from the chana dal and add to the masala. Saute for 5-10 minutes.

- Drain the water from the rice and add to the kadhai. Saute for few minutes.

- Add the 2 cups of hot water.

- Check the salt to adjust to taste.

- When the water starts bubbling. Cover and cook on low flame till done. Stir and check in between, can add more water if required. Top with the brown onions.

- Serve with raita of your choice .

name: Spiny Gourd Sabzi
ingredients:
- 5 pieces if spiny gourd ,grate and keep aside (with skin)

- 1 onion chopped

- 1 tomato chopped

- 1 tsp ginger garlic paste

- ¼ cup grated coconut

- few chopped green chillies

- 2 tbsp of chopped coriander leaves

- salt to taste

- red chilli powder to taste

- ¼ tsp turmeric powder

- ¼ tsp coriander powder

- ½ tsp whole cumin

- 2 baby leaves

- 2 tbsp of oil
method:
- Put oil in a kadhai.

- When the oil gets warm Add the bay leaves and the whole cumin.

- When the cumin starts to splutter.

- Add the chopped onion. Saute till the onion becomes beige brown.

- Add the ginger garlic paste. Saute till the raw smell of the ginger garlic goes.

- Add the chopped green chillies. Stir for a minute or so.

- Add the chopped tomato. Stir for few minutes.

- Add the salt,turmeric, red chilli powder and coriander powder. Saute till tomato becomes soft.

- Add the grated spiny gourd. Saute for 5-7 minutes.

- Cover and cook on low flame till done.

- Add the grated coconut, mix it in well. Saute for few minutes.

- Add the chopped coriander leaves. Done.

name: Vegetable Soup
ingredients:
- 30 gms cabbage

- 30 gms capsicum

- 30 gms beans

- 30 gms carrot

- 30 gms onion

- 1 tsp soya sauce

- ½ tsp oil

- black pepper

- salt
method:
- Take a pan, heat oil, add onions and saute it.

- Now add chopped vegetables and saute it for 2 minutes.

- Now add water and let it come to a boil.

- Add soya sauce and salt and boil it for 10 minutes.

- Soup is ready to serve.

name: Chicken Vegetable Soup
ingredients:
- 50 gms cabbage

- 50 gms capsicum

- 30 gms onion

- 20 gms carrots

- 30 gms french beans

- 2 diced garlic cloves

- ½ tsp oil

- salt

- water as required
method:
- In a pan, heat the oil, add finely chopped garlic and ginger.

- Saute until the raw smell of garlic and ginger goes away.

- Add chopped onions. Saute until translucent.

- Now add all the chopped vegetables.

- Saute 1-2 minutes on medium heat.

- Then add water or vegetable broth.

- Season with black pepper and salt.

- Cover the pan and simmer the clear soup.

- Do not cook the vegetables completely or make them mushy.

- Once done, ready to serve.

name: Tangy Chicken And Amaranth Soup
ingredients:
- 50 gm chicken shredded

- 100 gm green amaranth leaves

- 50 gm tomatoes

- 20 gm onion

- 2 garlic cloves

- black pepper

- chilli powder

- ½ tsp oil

- salt
method:
- Boil the water in a pot, add amaranth leaves and boil it for 2-3 minutes. Keep it aside once done.

- Heat the oil in the pan, add tomatoes, garlic and onion and cook it until mushy.

- Now add boiled leaves and cooked tomatoes, onion in a blender jar and blend it. Cook for 3 minutes.

- Once done, take it out and keep it aside.

- Add the prepared puree of vegetables on a pan, add salt, pepper, chilli powder and water as required and bring it to a boil.

- Now Add shredded chicken.

- Take it out in a bowl, sprinkle some more shredded chicken.

- Ready to serve.

name: Chicken Mushroom Soup
ingredients:
- 50 gms chicken shredded

- 50 gms mushroom

- 50 gms capsicum

- 50 gms cabbage

- 30 gms onion

- 20 gms carrot

- 2 garlic cloves crushed

- black pepper

- 10 ml soya sauce

- ½ tsp vinegar

- ½ tsp olive oil

- salt
method:
- Apply the oil in the pan, add onion, crushed garlic and saute it.

- Now add chopped cabbage, capsicum and carrots and mix it.

- Cook it for 3 minutes and add chopped mushroom and saute it.

- Mix soya sauce with it and cook for 1-2 minutes more.

- Now add water or vegetable broth in it.

- Add salt, pepper, vinegar and keep it for a boil.

- Once it comes to boil, add shredded chicken, turn off the flame and ready to serve.

name: Bengali Mustard Rohu Curry
ingredients:
- 100g rohu

- 25g onion

- 25g tomato

- 15g mustard paste

- 2 green chillies, slit

- ½ tsp turmeric powder

- ½ tsp chilli powder

- ½ tsp jeera powder

- 1 tsp ginger-garlic paste

- salt as per taste

- 1 tsp oil
method:
- Heat a pan, add oil, and stir fry the fish on it from both sides. Cover and cook for 7-8 minutes. Keep it aside.

- Add chopped onion and saute for 2-3 minutes, then add ginger-garlic paste and add slit green chillies, followed by tomatoes and saute until tomatoes are a little soft.

- Then add salt and all the spices, and mix well.

- Add mustard paste, mix well and add little amount of water.

- Add the fish and give it a mix and let it cook for 8-10 more minutes.

- Add more water if required. Turn off the flame.

- Serve hot with rice.

name: Brinjal Kheema
ingredients:
- 100 gms brinjal

- 50 gms chicken keema

- 50 gms Tomatoes

- 50 gms onion

- 1 green chilly

- ½ tsp coriander powder

- ½ tsp lemon juice

- 1 tsp coriander leaves

- 3 garlic cloves

- Mustard seeds

- whole cumin seeds

- inch of Ginger

- garam masala

- red chilli powder

- salt

- ½ tsp oil
method:
- Pierce garlic cloves on brinjal and roast directly on flame till the skin becomes charred and starts peeling off. Set aside to cool.

- Heat oil in a pan, add mustard seeds and whole cumin seeds, saute till fragrant.

- Chop ginger and garlic cloves, add to the pan and saute till garlic turns slightly brown in colour.

- Add tomatoes, onion and green chillies and saute for 2-3 minutes and add kheema to it and cook.

- Peel and mash the brinjal and keep it aside. Add coriander powder, red chilli powder, garam masala and salt to the pan and saute for a pan.

- Add the cooked kheema to the brinjal and mix well. Add lemon juice, coriander and mix well.

- Transfer into a serving bowl and serve hot.

name: Pineapple Skewers
ingredients:
- 100g pineapple

- 20g onion

- 20g capsicum

- 1tsp red chilli powder

- ½ tsp jeera powder

- ½ tsp garam masala

- 1 tsp lemon juice

- ½ tsp salt

- ½ tsp oil
method:
- In a bowl take oil, salt, chilli powder, lemon juice, cumin powder, and garam masala powder. Mix everything.

- To the marination, add diced pineapple, onion and capsicum. Mix. Allow it to sit for 20- 30 minutes.

- Meanwhile prepare the barbecue charcoal grill.

- Take the metal skewers provided with the grill and skew marinated pineapple and vegetables alternatively one by one. If you are using wooden skewers, soak it in water for 30 minutes and then use, otherwise they will get burnt while grilling.

- Place the skewers with tikka on the grilling metal tray. Keep turning the skewers so that they get cooked on all sides.

- Enjoy the grilled pineapple skewers with mint chutney and some sliced onion.

name: Mushroom Biryani
ingredients:
- 100 gms mushroom

- 30 gms rice

- 50 gms onion

- 2 tbsp milk

- ½ tsp mint

- 1 bayleaf

- small stick of cinnamon

- 2 peppercorn

- ½ tsp jeera

- ½ tsp garlic ginger paste

- ½ tsp red chilli powder

- ½ tsp garam masala

- ½ tsp oil

- salt
method:
- Soak the rice for 20-30 minutes.

- Heat the oil in a cooker then add bayleaf, peppercorn, cinnamon, cloves and jeera and saute it.

- Now add onions and ginger garlic paste, saute it till it turns golden brown.

- Add in the thick sliced mushrooms and cook for 1-2 minutes, then add milk and stir it.

- Now add chopped mint, salt and drained rice and toss to combine with the rest of the ingredients.

- Add water and close the lid and cook on high pressure for 5 minutes.

- Let the pressure release naturally.

- Serve it.

name: Mixed Veg Dumplings
ingredients:
- 50 gms wheat flour

- 30 gms cabbage

- 20 gms onion

- 30 gms mushroom

- 10 gms parsley

- 30 gms capsicum

- 50 gms wheat flour

- ½ tsp oil

- salt
method:
- Make a dough from wheat flour.

- For filling take finely minced cabbage, onion, mushrooms, capsicum and grated ginger in a bowl, add salt in it.

- Heat oil in a pan and add minced vegetables and saute it till slightly cooked.

- Roll the thin small round of dough.

- Wet the edge with water, place 1 tsp of fillings and give it half moon shape. Steam for 15 minutes.

- Take roasted tomato in a grinder, add 1 garlic clove, red chillies and salt and grind it.

- Ready to serve with tomato chutney.

name: Horse Gram Curry With Egg
ingredients:
- 25 gms horsegram

- 1 whole egg

- 50 gms onion

- 50 gms tomato

- 10 gms coriander

- 1 tbsp ginger garlic paste

- ½ tsp jeera

- ½ tsp mustard seeds

- inch of cinnamon stick

- ½ tsp red chilli powder

- pinch of turmeric powder

- ¼ tsp asafoetida

- black pepper

- ½ tsp oil

- salt
method:
- Soak horse gram overnight in water.

- Next morning, in a pressure cooker, add the soaked horse gram dal, turmeric powder, salt and water and pressure cook for 6-7 whistles.

- In a saucepan, add water and egg and let it boil.

- Once it is boiled, peel away the shells, give a cut to the egg and keep it aside.

- Next, heat the oil in a pan, add mustard seeds, whole cumin seed and let them crackle.

- Add asafoetida and let it cook for a few seconds.

- Now add ginger garlic paste and let it cook on medium flame until the raw aroma of ginger garlic paste goes away.

- Add chopped onions and saute it until translucent. Add tomatoes, red chilli powder, salt and coriander powder.

- Cover the pan and let it cook for 2-3 minutes.

- After 2-3 minutes, add the mashed horse gram into the pan.

- In another pan, apply the oil and add the egg and saute it for a minute until it becomes golden brown.

- Now add the egg to the horse gram pan, cover and let it simmer.

- Turn off the flame and garnish with coriander leaves.

name: Mince Ball In Horsegram Curry
ingredients:
- 25 gms horsegram

- 50 gms minced chicken

- 50 gms onion

- 50 gms tomato

- 10 gms coriander

- 1 tbsp ginger garlic paste

- ½ tsp jeera

- ½ tsp mustard seeds

- inch of cinnamon stick

- ½ tsp red chilli powder

- pinch of turmeric powder

- ¼ tsp asafoetida

- black pepper

- ¾ tsp oil

- salt
method:
- Soak horse gram overnight in water.

- Next morning, in a pressure cooker, add the soaked horse gram dal, turmeric powder, salt and water and pressure cook for 6-7 whistles.

- Now add minced meat, bread crumbs and salt. Mix thoroughly and make a small ball out of it

- Next, heat the oil in a pan, add mustard seeds, whole cumin seed and let them crackle.

- Add asafoetida and let it cook for a few seconds.

- Now add ginger garlic paste and let it cook on medium flame until the raw aroma of ginger garlic paste goes away.

- Add chopped onions and saute it until translucent. Add tomatoes, red chilli powder, salt and coriander powder.

- Cover the pan and let it cook for 2-3 minutes. After 2-3 minutes, add the mashed horse gram into the pan.

- In another pan, apply the oil and keep the meat balls and saute it for a minute until it becomes golden brown.

- Now add the meat balls to the horse gram pan, cover and let it simmer.

- Turn off the flame and garnish with coriander leaves.

name: Garlic Broken Wheat Khichdi
ingredients:
- 30 gms wheat daliya

- 30 gms moong dal

- 50 gms capsicum

- 50 gms spinach

- 3 crushed garlic clove

- 20 gms tomato

- 10 onion

- ½ tsp Jeera

- 1 green chilli

- ½ tsp red chilli powder

- 10 gms coriander

- ½ tsp Oil
method:
- Heat a pan, roast the daliya for 5 minutes till the daliya turns aromatic.

- In a cooker, heat oil, add jeera and pinch of hing.

- Saute till the jeera splutters.

- Add ½ tsp garlic paste, chopped green chilli, crushed ginger tomato and saute it till it turns soft and mushy.

- Now add all the chopped vegetables, turmeric and salt to taste.

- Saute for a minute and add soaked moong dal and dalia. Add enough water to it.

- Cover and pressure cook for 3-4 whistles or till dalia gets completely cooked.

- Ready to serve.

name: Dal Pitha
ingredients:
- 30gm chana dal

- 50gm rice flour

- salt as per taste

- 2 green chillies, chopped

- 2-3 garlic cloves, chopped

- 1 tsp ginger, chopped

- 3-4 pepper

- ½ tsp whole cumin seeds

- 1 tsp ajwain

- 1 tsp oil
method:
For dough

- Take rice flour in a bowl, add 2 pinches of salt, and mix well (dry) along with the flour.

- Add slight warm water little by little and knead the dough, and set aside.

For stuffing

- Pressure cook the dal on medium flame for 2-3 whistles. Let it cool down.

- Add it into a mixer along with chopped ginger, garlic and green chillies, whole cumin seeds, pepper corns and carom seeds and grind it.

- Now make small balls using the dough, and make space in between, add the stuffing and shape it into a peetha.

- Steam it for 15- 20 minutes in a steamer or using a double boiler process.

name: Gongura Roti
ingredients:
- 50 gm wheat flour

- 100 gm gongura leaves

- 1 tsp ginger-garlic paste

- ½ tsp mustard seeds

- ½ tsp jeera

- ½ tsp chilli powder

- ½ tsp dhania powder

- 1 green chilli, chopped

- salt as per taste
method:
- Saute the gongura leaves on a pan without oil for a few seconds (until it changes its colour). Let it cool down a bit.

- In the same pan roast mustard seeds and jeera, and green chilli.

- Add the gongura leaves into the mixer along with ginger-garlic paste, roasted mustard- jeera, green chilli, salt and other spices, and grind it into a smooth paste, add 2 tbsp of water to grind it.

- Take wheat flour, and knead it into a dough using the gongura leaves grinded mixture.

- Roll it into two cd sized rotis.

- Heat a tawa, place the rolled rotis on it and cook from both sides.

- Serve hot.

name: Kale Garlic Dal
ingredients:
- 100 gm kale

- 30 gm toor dal

- 3-4 garlic, finely chopped

- 15 gm onion

- 15 gm tomato

- ½ tsp jeera

- ½ tsp turmeric powder

- 2 green chillies, slit

- salt as per taste

- 1 tsp oil
method:
- Pressure cook the dal with salt and turmeric powder on high flame for 3 whistles.

- Heat oil in a pan, add jeera and saute for 3-5 secs, then add chopped ginger and slit green chillies and saute until the garlic turns light brown.

- Then add chopped onion and tomato and saute until the onion turns light golden in colour.

- Now add the pressure cooked dal into the pan, mix well and add kale into it.

- Add water if required (as per your desired consistency), and let it come to a boil.

- Turn off the flame and serve hot.

name: Pepper Shrimp Fry
ingredients:
- 100gm shrimp

- 1 tsp pepper powder

- 5-6 curry leaves

- ½ tsp turmeric powder

- salt as per taste

- 1 tsp oil
method:
- Take 100gm of shrimp in a bowl, marinate it with turmeric powder and salt and keep aside for 10 minutes.

- Heat oil in a pan, add curry leaves and saute for 5 seconds.

- Then add the shrimps and saute for 5- 7 minutes.

- Add pepper powder on it and saute for 5-7 minutes more.

- Turn off the flame and serve hot.

name: Tomato Spring Onion Sabzi
ingredients:
- 100 gm spring onion

- 50 gm tomato

- 1 tsp ginger-garlic paste

- ½ tsp turmeric powder

- ½ tsp chilli powder

- ½ tsp jeera powder

- 2-3 green chilli, slit

- salt as per taste

- 1 tsp oil
method:
- Heat oil in a pan, add ginger-garlic paste and slit green chillies and saute, until the raw smell ends.

- Then add spring onion and saute for 5 mins.

- Add in the tomatoes, mix well.

- Then add jeera powder, turmeric powder and chilli powder, salt, and combine all the ingredients together.

- Add ½ cup water, cover the pan and let it cook for 5-7 mins.

- Open the lid and mix again, and let it boil for 2-3 more mins.

- Turn off the flame, serve hot.

name: Yogurt Barks
ingredients:
- 100 gm strawberry

- 200 ml yogurt

- 1 tsp honey
method:
- Chop the strawberries and keep it aside.

- Now take a bowl, add yogurt into it (make sure the yogurt is thick and not watery), add 1 tsp honey and mix well for about 5 mins.

- Take a tray, put foil or butter paper on it and pour the yogurt-honey mix on it and spread it slightly.

- Place the chopped strawberries on it and freeze it for about 4 hours.

- Take it out and cut it into your desired shapes and serve.

name: Strawberry Chocolate Dip
ingredients:
- 80 gm Strawberry

- 15 gm Dark chocolate
method:
- Wash and dry the strawberries and keep them aside.

- Take a pan or a vessel, fill it with water and bring it to boil.

- Now carefully place a bowl smaller than the pan or vessel on it.

- Add the chocolate into it and stir constantly, until melted and smooth.

- Remove the bowl from the heat.

- Dip the strawberries in melted chocolate.

- Coat the strawberries well with the melted chocolate.

- Now take a tray, place foil on it and place the chocolate coated strawberries on it.

- Refrigerate it for 30 - 40 mins. And serve. You can also store them for a day (do not freeze it).

name: Millet Vermicelli With Vegetables
ingredients:
- 30gm millet vermicelli

- 20gm onion

- 20gm capsicum

- 20gm red bell pepper

- 20gm yellow bell pepper

- salt as per taste

- ½ tsp mustard seeds

- 4-5 curry leaves

- 2 green chillies, chopped/slit

- 5 gm chana dal

- 1 tsp oil
method:
- In a vessel add 1 cup water, add the millet vermicelli with a pinch of salt and let it boil for 3-5 mins or until it turns a little soft (do not boil for long, as it might turn mushy). Turn off the flame and keep it aside. Remove the excess water, if any.

- Heat oil in a pan. Add mustard seed and let it splutter.

- Then add chana dal, green chillies and curry leaves and saute, until chana dal turns slightly brown in colour.

- Then add the chopped onions and saute until it turns translucent, then add all capsicum and bell peppers and saute for 5-7 mins, then add tomato into the add.

- Add salt and mix all together. Once the vegetables are cooked, add the boiled vermicelli, slowly mix everything together.

- Turn off the flame and serve hot.

name: Veg Topped Adai
ingredients:
- 15gm green moong (whole)

- 15gm lentil

- 15gm urad dal

- 20gm onion

- 20gm capsicum

- 20gm red bell pepper

- 20gm yellow bell pepper

- 20gm tomato

- 2-3 garlic cloves

- salt as per taste

- ½ tsp oil
method:
- Wash all the dals and soak for 4-6 hours.

- Blend it along with salt and garlic gloves into dosa consistency batter.

- Heat a tawa, spread some oil on it and pour the batter on it and spread it outwards in circular motion.

- Add finely chopped vegetables on it and slightly press it with the same ladle or a spoon.

- Cover it and cook for 2-3 mins.

- Open the lid and flip it and cook for another 2-3 mins.

- Turn off the flame and serve hot with mint or coriander chutney or can have it as it is.

name: Vegetable Wheat Pasta
ingredients:
- 30 gm wheat pasta

- 20gm onion

- 20gm tomato

- 20gm capsicum

- 20gm red bell pepper

- 20gm yellow bell pepper

- 2 green chillies

- 1 tsp pepper powder

- ½ tsp chilli flakes

- ½ tsp cinnamon powder

- salt as per taste

- 1 tsp oil
method:
- In a vessel add a pinch of salt and add the pasta and boil for about 10-15 mins or until it's cooked.

- Strain excess water, if any and keep it aside.

- Heat oil in a pan, add all the vegetables and saute for 5-7 mins.

- Add all the spices and salt, mix well and cook for 5-7 more minutes.

- Then add the pasta and slowly mix. Turn off the flame.

- Serve hot.

name: Tofu Bhurji
ingredients:
- 30gm tofu

- 10gm onion

- 10gm tomato

- 20gm capsicum

- 20gm red bell pepper

- 20gm yellow bell pepper

- 20gm cabbage

- 2 green chillies

- 1 tsp ginger-garlic paste

- ½ tsp red chilli powder

- ½ tsp dhania powder

- ½ tsp turmeric powder

- salt as per taste

- 1 tsp oil
method:
- Finely chop all the veggies and keep it aside (you can also grate the vegetables).

- Grate the tofu using a grater.

- Heat Oil in a pan, add the ginger-garlic paste.

- Saute until it turns light brown in colour.

- Then add the chopped green chillies and saute for 2 mins.

- Then add onion and saute, until it turns slightly brown in colour.

- Add in all the other vegetables. Add all the spices and salt and mix well.

- Cook for 10 mins. Once the vegetables turn a little soft, add the grated tofu and mix well.

- Cook for 5-7 more minutes.

- Turn off the flame, garnish it with coriander leaves and serve hot.

name: Roasted Veg Buckwheat With Prawns
ingredients:
- 100gm prawns

- 20gm capsicum

- 20gm red bell pepper

- 20gm yellow bell pepper

- 25 gm buckwheat

- 20gm beans

- 10gm onion

- 10gm tomato

- 2 green chillies

- 1 tsp ginger-garlic paste

- ½ tsp jeera powder

- ½ tsp dhania powder

- ½ tsp turmeric powder

- ½ tsp pepper powder

- salt as per taste
method:
- Take prawns and all the chopped vegetables in a bowl, marinate it with ginger- garlic paste, turmeric powder, jeera powder, salt and pepper powder, and mix thoroughly and keep it aside for 7-8 mins.

- Meanwhile, dry roast the buckwheat in a pan and keep it aside.

- Pre- heat the pan for 5 mins and place the marinated prawns and vegetables on it.

- Roast both the sides well, for about 10 mins.

- After the prawns and vegetables are roasted well, and have turned slightly brown, add the roasted buckwheat, mix all together properly.

- Turn off the flame and serve hot.

name: Sprouts Masala Curry
ingredients:
- 15gm sprouted bengal gram

- 15gm sprouted moong

- 20gm onion

- 20gm capsicum

- 20gm tomato

- 2 green chillies

- 1 tsp ginger-garlic paste

- 1 tsp dhania powder

- ½ tsp turmeric powder

- ½ tsp red chilli powder

- ½ tsp jeera

- salt as per taste

- 1 tsp oil
method:
- In a pressure cooker, add sprouted moong and bengal gram, add 2 pinches of salt and pressure cook for 3 whistles on high flame.

- Heat oil in a pan, add jeera and saute for 5 secs, then add ginger- garlic paste and saute until the raw smell ends.

- Then add the chopped green chillies, and capsicum and saute for a minute.

- Add chopped onion and saute until it turns translucent. Add the tomatoes and mix.

- Add turmeric powder, chilli powder, dhania powder and salt and combine all together with the sprouts and vegetables.

- Cook for 7-8 mins. Then add the pressure cooked sprouts, mix well and cook for 3-5 mins.

- Turn off the flame and serve hot.

name: Roasted Makhana
ingredients:
- 1 cup makhana (lotus seeds)

- pinch of salt

- ¼ tsp black pepper powder
method:
- Heat a non stick pan.

- Add makhana and Roast them until it turns golden brown and turns aromatic.

- Remove from the flame add salt and black pepper and mix well.

name: Lobia Vada
ingredients:
- 25 gm lobia (soaked for 8-10 hours)

- 15gm onion

- ½ tsp red chilli powder

- ½ tsp dhania powder

- ½ tsp grated ginger

- 2 green chillies

- ½ tsp ajwain

- salt as taste

- ½ tsp oil
method:
- Soak lobia for 8-10 hours.

- Coarsely grind it in the mixer with salt (can add little water, if required), do not make fine paste.

- Take it out in a bowl, add grated ginger, finely chopped onion and green chillies. Then add ajwain and all the spices. Mix well. And shape it into vada.

- Heat a pan, spread some oil on it and place the vadas on it.

- Cook well from both the sides for 5-7 mins.

- Serve hot with green chutney.

name: Roasted Veg Buckwheat With Prawns
ingredients:
- 100gm prawns

- 20gm capsicum

- 20gm red bell pepper

- 20gm yellow bell pepper

- 25gm buckwheat

- 20gm beans

- 10gm onion

- 10gm tomato

- 2 green chillies

- 1 tsp ginger-garlic paste

- ½ tsp jeera powder

- ½ tsp dhania powder

- ½ tsp turmeric powder

- ½ tsp pepper powder

- salt as per taste
method:
- Take prawns and all the chopped vegetables in a bowl, marinate it with ginger- garlic paste, turmeric powder, jeera powder, salt and pepper powder, and mix thoroughly and keep it aside for 7-8 mins.

- Meanwhile, dry roast the buckwheat in a pan and keep it aside.

- Pre-heat the pan for 5 mins and place the marinated prawns and vegetables on it.

- Roast both the sides well, for about 10 mins.

- After the prawns and vegetables are roasted well, and have turned slightly brown, add the roasted buckwheat, mix all together properly.

- Turn off the flame and serve hot.

name: Crispy Makhana
ingredients:
- 1 cup makhana (lotus seeds)

- pinch of salt

- ¼ tsp black pepper powder

- ¼ tsp red chilli powder

- ¼ tsp chat masala

- 1 pinch powdered sugar
method:
- Heat a non stick pan.

- Add makhana and Roast them until it turns golden brown and turns aromatic.

- Remove from the flame add salt, black pepper, chilli powder, chat masala, sugar and mix well.

name: Healthy Pakora
ingredients:
- 35gm capsicum

- 35gm cabbage

- 30gm onion

- 8-10 mint leaves

- 15gm besan

- 2 green chillies

- 1 tsp ginger-garlic paste

- ½ tsp ajwain

- salt as per taste

- ½ tsp oil
method:
- Grate all the vegetables in a fine grater.

- Transfer it into a bowl. Add pudina leaves (chopped), salt, ajwain, green chillies, ginger garlic paste.

- Slowly add besan and keep mixing, add water if required.

- Make it into dough consistency.

- Pre-heat the oven for 5 minutes.

- Take a tray, place baking paper on it and grease it with oil.

- Place the pakoras on it and bake for 10 minutes at 480° F 250° C.

- Serve hot with green chutney.

name: Broken Egg Curry
ingredients:
- 1 whole egg

- 25g onion

- 150g tomato

- 2 green chillies

- 1 tsp ginger-garlic paste

- ½ tsp turmeric powder

- ½ tsp chilli powder

- ½ tsp dhania powder

- ½ tsp jeera

- 1 tsp oil
method:
- In the same pan add oil, add ginger-garlic paste and saute for 2 mins, add chopped onion and saute until it turns slightly brown in colour, then add the tomatoes and saute.

- Then add all the spices and salt, mix well and cook for 5 more mins.

- Add water and mix well. Now break an egg into it close a lid and let it set for 5-7 mins.

- Open the lid and check if egg is cooked and open the lid and cook for 2-3 mins more.

- Turn off the flame and serve hot.

name: Capsicum Rings
ingredients:
- 100 gm Capsicum rings (cut the capsicum into rings and remove the middle portion)

To be mixed into a smooth thick batter -

- 3 tsp corn flour

- ½ tsp baking powder

- ½ tsp black pepper

- salt to taste

- 2 egg whites/can use water (if vegetarian)

- ½ tsp oil
method:
- Preheat the oven to 220 degree celsius. Grease a baking sheet with non-stick spray or line with parchment paper.

- In a bowl, corn flour, pepper, salt and egg whites and mix thoroughly into a smooth semi-liquid batter.

- Drench the capsicum rings into the mixture, make sure to coat all sides.

- Arrange the capsicum rings on the baking sheet.

- Bake for 10- 15 minutes, flipping halfway through, until golden brown on both sides.

- Serve hot.

name: Makhana Chat
ingredients:
- 20g makhana

- 10g onion

- 10g tomato

- 20g cucumber

- 5ml curd

- ½ tsp lemon juice

- ½ tsp green chutney

- ¼ tsp tamarind chutney

- ¼ tsp red chilli

- black salt to taste

- salt to taste
method:
- Roast makhana on a tawa till it turns golden brown and keep aside.

- Chop onion, tomato, cucumber into small cubes and add them into the puffed rice bowl.

- To the vegetables and boiled horse gram and curd, green chutney, tamarind chutney, lemon juice, salt, red chilli powder, black salt and mix well.

- Bhel puri is ready to serve. Garnish with chopped coriander leaves or mint leaves.

name: Cabbage Soup With Egg
ingredients:
- 10g cabbage

- 5g carrot

- 5g onion

- 50g egg

- garlic

- salt

- black pepper powder
method:
- Heat oil in a pan, add onion and garlic saute well.

- Then add carrot, cabbage mix and saute well, then add water and boil.

- After boiling add salt, pepper mix it and add beaten eggs stir well and cook for a minute.
Soup is ready.

name: Makhana Kheer
ingredients:
- 5g Makhana (lotus seed)

- 1204ml milk

- 1 tsp jaggery

- 5g almond

- 1 pinch cardamom powder

- 2-3 saffron strands
method:
- Take a non stick pan and roast them until it turns light golden brown.

- In a blender add lotus seeds and grind them coarse powder.

- In a pan boil milk, add jaggery and cook well.

- To the milk add cardamom powder, saffron and lotus seeds powder and cook well.

- Once cooked add chopped almonds and serve.

name: Roasted Strawberries Frozen Yogurt
ingredients:
- 100gm strawberries

- 120 gm low fat yogurt

- 1 tsp powdered fennel

- 1 tsp balsamic vinegar

- 1 tsp honey

- salt
method:
- In a baking pan, add strawberries, vinegar, powdered fennel powder and salt.

- Let it bake at 350 for 40 minutes.

- Allow it to cool completely and blend it into a puree.

- In a bowl, add strained yogurt and roasted strawberries puree along with honey and whisk.

- At this stage, you can pour it in a container and let it rest in the refrigerator to set for a few hours or churn it in your ice cream container.

name: Frozen Blueberries Yogurt Bites
ingredients:
- 120 gm low fat yogurt

- 50 gms blueberries
method:
- Blend blueberries and yogurt together in a blender.

- Using a piping bag or spoon, scoop yogurt into a mold or ice cube tray.

- Freeze until ready to eat.

name: Shukto(Traditional Bengali Cuisine)
ingredients:
Vegetables

- 4 medium size bitter gourd

- 5 small brinjal

- 2 big drumsticks

- 2-3 sweet potato

- 5-7 long beans

- 2 medium size white radish

- 6-8 moong dal dried balls (optional)

- all the above vegetables to be cut lengthwise

Other ingredients

- 1 tsp black mustard

- 1 tsp yellow mustard

- ¼ tsp radhuni (if available)

- 1 tsp panch phoren

- 1 tsp sugar

- 2-3 bay leaves

- 2-3 whole red chillies

- 1 tbsp of grated ginger

- 2 tbsp mustard oil

- 1 tbsp of ghee

- little more than ¼ cup milk
method:
- In a kadhai put the mustard oil. Heat the oi, when it is warm, add the bay leaves and panch phoren.

- When it gets fragrant.

- Add thr ginger paste. Stir fry till the raw smell of the ginger goes.

- Add the bitter gourd. Stir fry till the bitter gourd gets a little brown.

- Add the other vegetables except the brinjal and stir fry till it becomes little beige, add the brinjal. Stir fry for 5-10 minutes.

- Now add the mustard radhuni paste. Stir fry for few minutes.

- Add a 6-7 tbsp of water and stir for few minutes.

- Add the milk. Stir it in well.

- Add the salt ,sugar and ghee. Stir it in.

- When it starts bubbling. Cover and cook on low flame till all the vegetables are cooked.

- The gravy has to be there but little and it gets thick.

- In 1 tsp oil/ghee in a pan Stir fry the dal balls and add it with the milk.bDone.

- Serve with plain rice.

name: Hakka Noodles
ingredients:
- 4 pkts of noodles boiled andkept aside (individual portion pkts)

- 1 cup cabbage shredded

- 1 cup carrots cut into julienne

- 1 cup capsicum cut into strips

- 1 cup spring onions cut into 1"pieces

- 2 medium onions cut into slices

- ½ cup chives chopped

- salt to taste

- ½ tsp pepper

- 1 tsp sugar

- 2 tsp vinegar

- 2 tsp green chilli sauce (or whatever is available)

- 2 tsp tomato sauce

- 1-2 tsp soya sauce

- 3 tbsp of oil
method:
- Put oil in a kadhai.

- When the oil is hot.

- Add the sliced onions and carrots. Stir fry for few seconds.

- Add the cabbage and capcicum. Stir fry for few seconds.

- Add the spring onions. Stir fry for few seconds.

- Add the noodles.

- Add all the sauces and salt,pepper and sugar, mix it in well all together. Stir fry on full flame for 10 minutes.

- Add the chives. Stir fry for few seconds.

- Done.

name: Cucumber Salad
ingredients:
- 1 medium size Cucumber

- ½ tsp chopped and pounded garlic

- ¼ tsp soya sauce

- ¼ tsp apple cider vinegar

- ½ tsp sesame oil

- 1 tsp roasted sesame seeds

- 1 fresh red chilli chopped fine

- 1 tsp sugar /honey

- ¼ tsp chilli flakes

- salt to taste (just a pinch is required)

- 1 tsp finely chopped chives/spring onions
method:
- Cut cucumber in thin slices and sprinkle a pinch of salt on it.

- Need to keep it marinated in salt for 10 minutes.

- After 10 minutes gently squeeze the water out from the cucumber, and place in a bowl.

- Now add all the ingredients to the cucumber and mix it in well.

- Garnish with chives.

- Ready to serve.

name: Chilli Garlic Noodles
ingredients:
- 4 small pkts of noodles (1 pkt individual portion)

- 1 tbsp chopped garlic

- 1 tbsp chopped spring onions (white part ,the head )

- 1-2 tsp spicy chilli sauce

- 3-4 tbsp of tomato sauce

- 1 tsp dark soya sauce

- 1 tsp sugar

- salt to taste

- 2 tsp red chilli sauce

- ¼ cup chopped chives/green spring onions

- 3 tbsp of oil
method:
- Boil the noodles and keep aside.

- Heat oil in a kadhai/wok, when the oil becomes hot, add the chopped garlic. Stir fry till the raw smell of the garlic goes.

- Then add the chopped spring onions, the white part. Stir fry for few seconds .

- Now add the spicy red chilli sauce, tomato sauce, soya sauce ,sugar, red chilli sauce and salt. Mix it in well and stir fry for few seconds .

- Now add the boiled noodles and toss it so that the noodles are coated with the sauce .

- Lastly add the chopped chives and toss it well, taking care not to break the noodles .

- Check for salt and adjust seasoning according to taste.

- Done.

name: Stir Fry Pepper Chicken
ingredients:
- 500 gms boneless chicken

- 1 big onion sliced little thick

- 5-6 whole garlic pods

- 5-6 garlic pods cut into slices

- 2-3 green peppers cut in diagonal pieces

- 1-2 fresh red chilli cut in diagonal pieces

- ½ cup chopped spring onions

- 1 tsp black pepper powder

- ½ tsp chilli flakes

- salt to taste

- 2 tsp light soya sauce

- 3 tbsp of oil
method:
- Cut chicken into rectangle thin pieces, marinate with pinch of salt pepper ,1 tsp vinegar,1 tsp chopped/pounded, 2 tsp of chopped/pounded garlic, ½ an egg and 1 tsp cornflour.
Keep for 10 minutes.

- Then take a pan brush 1 tbsp oil on it .

- Let the oil become hot ,place the chicken pieces on it and cook till the side facing the pan, becomes brown. Flip and cook the other side.

- When all the chicken is done, dish out.

- In the same pan ,put the remaining oil, heat the oil.

- When the oil is hot add the pods of garlic and the sliced garlic. Stir fry till fragrant, then add the sliced onion.

- Stir fry for a minute or so.

- Then add the green peppers and fresh cut red chillies. Stir fry for few seconds.

- Now add the salt and black pepper powder ,and stir fry for few seconds.

- Now add the chilli flakes, the chopped chives and stir fry for few seconds.

- Add the chicken pieces and mix it on well. Lastly add the light soya sauce and toss. everything together well.

- Done.

- Serve with Fried Rice or Noodles.

name: Chilli Sweet Crispy Chicken
ingredients:
- 500 gms boneless chicken cut into flat slices

- marinate with salt, pepper, 1 tsp garlic pounded, ½ tsp ginger pounded and 2-3 tbsp of milk

For the chicken batter

- 4 tbsp of rice flour

- 2 tbsp of cornflour

- pinch of salt

- mix with water to make a thick batter

- mix the marinated chicken in the batter and keep aside.

For the sauce

- 2 tbsp sugar

- 1 tbsp red chilli powder

- 1 .5 tbsp of soya sauce

- ½ tbsp of oyster sauce

- ½ tbsp of tomato sauce

- 3 tbsp sesame oil

- 1 tsp chilli flakes

- 1 ½ tsp pounded garlic

- 1 tsp cornflour slurry

- mix all of the above and keep aside.

Rest of the Ingredients

- 3-4 cut green chillies

- ¼ cup pounded peanuts

- 2-3 tbsp of oil
method:
- In a pan add the oil, heat the oil .

- When the oil is heated, add the chicken pieces dipped in batter and cook till it gets cooked in the bottom.

- Flip the side and cook till both sides are brown.

- When done keep aside.

- In the same pan, remove the oil.

- Add the sauce mixture, stir for 30-40 seconds.

- Add the cooked chicken, toss it nicely so that all the chicken is coated nicely with the sauce.

- Add the cut green chillies and pounded peanuts. Mix well.

- Done.

name: Grated Spiny Gourd Sabzi
ingredients:
- 5 pieces if spiny gourd ,grate and keep aside (with skin)

- 1 onion chopped

- 1 tomato chopped

- 1 tsp ginger garlic paste

- ¼ cup grated coconut

- few chopped green chillies

- 2 tbsp of chopped coriander leaves

- salt to taste

- red chilli powder to taste

- ¼ tsp turmeric powder

- ¼ tsp coriander powder

- ½ tsp whole cumin

- 2 baby leaves

- 2 tbsp of oil
method:
- Put oil in a kadhai.

- When the oil gets warm Add the bay leaves and the whole cumin.

- When the cumin starts to splutter.

- Add the chopped onion. Saute till the onion becomes beige brown.

- Add the ginger garlic paste. Saute till the raw smell of the ginger garlic goes.

- Add the chopped green chillies. Stir for a minute or so.

- Add the chopped tomato. Stir for few minutes.

- Add the salt, turmeric, red chilli powder and coriander powder. Saute till tomato becomes soft.

- Add the grated spiny gourd. Saute for 5-7 minutes.

- Cover and cook on low flame till done.

- Add the grated coconut, mix it in well. Saute for few minutes.

- Add the chopped coriander leaves.

- Done.

name: Chilli Lime Yogurt
ingredients:
- 120ml yogurt

- 1 lime, juiced

- ¼ tsp ground paprika

- ½ small fresh red chilli, deseeded and finely chopped

- ¼ tsp caster sugar
method:
- Combine all the ingredients together and season with salt and pepper.

- Serve immediately.

name: Yogurt Dip
ingredients:
- 120ml yogurt

- ¼ tsp black pepper

- salt as per taste

- ¼ tsp caster sugar
method:
- Combine all the ingredients together and season with salt and pepper.

- Serve immediately.

name: Grilled Gobi
ingredients:
For blanching

- 100gm cauliflower

- ½ tsp salt

- hot water as required

For marination

- 2 tbsp thick curd

- 1 tsp red chilli powder

- ¼ tsp turmeric powder

- ½ tsp coriander powder

- ½ tsp cumin powder

- ½ tsp garam masala

- pinch of salt

- 1 tsp lemon juice

- 1 tsp ginger-garlic paste

- 1 tsp roasted besan

- 1 tsp oil
method:
- Firstly, in a large bowl take cauliflower florets and ½ tsp salt.

- Pour hot water (as required) and rest for 5 mins to blanch.

- Now drain off the water and keep aside. Do not overcook the gobi.

- In a bowl take curd, and salt all the spices and a pinch of salt, lemon juice and besan and combine all together thoroughly.

- Further add blanched gobi and 1 tsp oil. Mix well and apply the coating uniformly.

- Refrigerate for 30 minutes or until the flavours are absorbed.

- Grill it on the griller till it turns golden brown on all sides.

- Now take the skewer and slide in the grilled gobi.

- Or you can slide in the gobi to the skewer first and then grill it.

- Serve hot with green chutney.

name: Buckwheat Roti
ingredients:
- 50gm buckwheat flour

- ½ tsp salt

- water as required
method:
- In a bowl take buckwheat flour, add ½ tsp salt to it, mix well.

- Add water little by little and knead it into a soft dough.

- Make 2 small balls. Take 1 ball and pat it on the hand a bit.

- Heat the tawa/pan, place the slightly patted dough on the tawa, and pat on it till it achieves cd size. Repeat the same for the other one.

- Flip and cook from both the sides.

- Serve hot.

name: Mutton Kheema With Vegetables
ingredients:
Ingredients

- 100g mutton kheema

- 3 garlic cloves

- 1 green chilli

- 1 tsp coriander leaves

- ¼ tsp garam masala

- ¼ tsp coriander powder

- pinch of turmeric powder

- pinch of red chilli powder

- 50g finely chopped onion

- 50g finely chopped capsicum

- salt to taste

- 1 tsp ghee

- 1 cup water

- 1 tsp steamed sweet corn (optional)

Ingredients

- Take a blending jar, add minced mutton, garlic cloves, green chilli, coriander and blend all the ingredients well.

- Heat ghee in a pan transfer the blended mutton kheema and saute well, then add garam masala, coriander powder, red chilli powder, turmeric powder, salt and saute well.

- Now add 1 cup water and cook mutton kheema for 5-6 minutes at low flame.

- Once the water in absorbed add finely chopped onion, capsicum and then add some more water and cook until it's dry and serve with a little sweet corn topping.
full_text:
Ingredients

- 100g mutton kheema

- 3 garlic cloves

- 1 green chilli

- 1 tsp coriander leaves

- ¼ tsp garam masala

- ¼ tsp coriander powder

- pinch of turmeric powder

- pinch of red chilli powder

- 50g finely chopped onion

- 50g finely chopped capsicum

- salt to taste

- 1 tsp ghee

- 1 cup water

- 1 tsp steamed sweet corn (optional)

Ingredients

- Take a blending jar, add minced mutton, garlic cloves, green chilli, coriander and blend all the ingredients well.

- Heat ghee in a pan transfer the blended mutton kheema and saute well, then add garam masala, coriander powder, red chilli powder, turmeric powder, salt and saute well.

- Now add 1 cup water and cook mutton kheema for 5-6 minutes at low flame.

- Once the water in absorbed add finely chopped onion, capsicum and then add some more water and cook until it's dry and serve with a little sweet corn topping.

name: Lamb Chargrilled Pepper Soup
ingredients:
- 50 gms lamb bones preferably shank and shoulders

- 100 gms char Grilled bell peppers

- 50 gms onion

- 20 gms carrot

- 30 gms coriander

- 2 crushed garlic cloves

- 1 tsp ginger crushed

- ¼ tsp black pepper

- ¼ tsp cinnamon

- 1 cardamom

- 1 bayleaf

- 1 clove

- ½ tsp oil

- salt
method:
- Add the oil in a stock pot and saute the onion, ginger and garlic over medium heat for a few minutes.

- Add the whole spices, coriander and carrots, chargrilled green bell pepper along with lamb ones.

- Increase the heat and stir for a while till the bones are browned.Add the salt, stir thoroughly and pour the warm water gradually.

- Simmer the contents for an hour over low heat. Strain through muslin cloth, check the seasoning and serve in a bowl.

name: Mutton Kheema Paratha
ingredients:
- 100 gms minced mutton

- 50 gms wheat flour

- 50 gms onion

- 1 green chilli

- 1 tbsp chopped coriander

- 1 crushed garlic

- ¼ tsp grated ginger

- ¼ tsp cumin powder

- ¼ tsp coriander powder

- ¼ tsp garam masala

- ¼ tsp red chilli powder

- ¼ tsp turmeric powder

- ½ tsp oil

- salt
method:
- Take a pan and start cooking minced meat with water, chopped ginger and garlic till they are tender. Add green chillies, coriander, cumin, turmeric and garam masala powder.

- On the other hand, knead wheat flour along with added salt and water to make a smooth dough.

- Take out the small balls from dough as required.

- Press each portion from the centre of the dough and stuff it with mutton keema. Seal the dough properly.

- Roll out the dough like chapathi and roast on the pan. Add oil from both sides till they turn golden brown.

name: Green Gram Sprouts Pasta
ingredients:
- 30g pasta

- 15g green gram sprouts

- ½ tsp red chilli powder

- ½ tsp pepper powder

- ½ tsp chaat masala

- 10g capsicum

- 5g tomato

- 5g onion

- 4 curry leaves

- ½ tsp coriander

- salt as per taste

- 1 tsp oil
method:
- Wash and boil pasta, add salt as per taste and drizzle oil.

- Drain the water.

- Boil sprouts with 1 whistle.

- Add oil into the vessel, add chopped onions, garlic, curry leaves, red chilly powder, coriander leaves, capsicum and tomato stir well.

- Add the boil sprouts, pepper powder and chat masala.

- Salt as per taste.

- Add boiled pasta, mix well and cook for 2 minutes.

- Serve hot.

name: Palak Lassi
ingredients:
- 50ml curd

- 10g palak

- 1 tsp sugar
method:
- Combine all the ingredients in a deep bowl and whisk well till smooth.

- Refrigerate for at least 1 hour.

- Pour into individual glass and serve chilled garnished with curry leaves.

name: Masala Mint Chaas
ingredients:
- 50ml curd

- 10g mint leaves

- ½ tsp coriander leaves

- ½ green chilli

- ¼ cumin seeds powder

- pinch of black salt

- salt as per taste
method:
- Combine the mint leaves, coriander, green chilli, cumin seeds powder, black salt and curd in a mixer and blend till smooth.

- Combine the prepared mint coriander mixture, remaining curd, salt and chilled water in a deep bowl and mix well using a whisk.

- Pour the prepared chaas in 4 individual glass and serve chilled.

name: Tomato Cucumber Salad
ingredients:
- 100g cucumber

- 100g tomato

- 1 green chilli (to garnish)
method:
- Wash and peel the cucumber and slice it into an oval shape.

- Wash and slice the tomato into a round shape.

- place it on the plate and garnish it with green chilli.

name: Grilled Tofu
ingredients:
- 100gm tofu

- 1 tsp vinegar

- 1 tsp soya sauce

- 1 tsp olive oil

- ¼ tsp ground black pepper

- salt as per taste
method:
- Cut the tofu and microwave for 2 minutes. This releases most of the liquid.

- Wrap the tofu with a clean dish towel and weight it with something heavy for at least 15 minutes, so that the water drains out completely.

- Meanwhile, mix together remaining ingredients in a bowl.

- Cut each piece of tofu into 6 thick slices and put it all in baking dish. Paint marinade over tofu, turning to coat and chill, covered, tuning occasionally for at least 30 minutes.

- Preheat a grill to medium high heat. That’s about 375 to 450 degrees then reduce heat to medium.

- Transfer the tofu from marinade to grill with a spatula. Cover grill and cook tofu tuning once until well browned for 10 minutes.

- Transfer the tofu to a platter and cover with foil to keep warm.

- Paint with additional marinade and serve.

name: Cabbage Paneer Paratha
ingredients:
For dough

- 60 gm whole wheat flour

- ¼ tsp ghee

- salt to taste

For stuffing

- ½ cup grated cabbage

- 50gm paneer (cottage cheese)

- 1 tbsp finely chopped coriander

- 5 gm finely chopped onion

- ¼ tsp cumin powder (roasted and ground )

- ½ tsp finely chopped green chilli

- whole wheat flour for rolling

- ¾ tsp oil for cooking
method:
- Combine whole wheat flour with ghee and salt in a deep bowl, mix well and knead into a soft dough using enough water. Cover and keep aside for at least 10 to 15 minutes.

- Divide the dough into 2 equal portions.

- To make cabbage paneer parathas, in a large bowl add paneer use your fingers or a fork and begin to crumble the paneer, next add cabbage, onion, coriander leaves, chopped green chillies, cumin powder and salt as per taste, combine all the ingredients well.

- Roll out a portion of dough into roti with the help of a little whole wheat flour, spread a portion of stuffing evenly over it. Cover it with another roti and press the sides well.

- Heat a non stick tawa and cook the paratha, using a little oil till golden brown spots appear on both the sides.

- Serve the cabbage paneer paratha hot with curd.

name: Cabbage Paneer Soup
ingredients:
- 50gm paneer

- 100 gm cabbage

- ½ tsp oil

- ¼ tsp mustard seeds

- ½ tsp crushed ginger

- 2 curry leaves

- salt to taste

- 1.5 cups water
method:
- Take a deep saucepan, heat oil and add mustard seeds.

- When the seeds crackle, add the curry leaves and crushed ginger and garlic and saute for a few seconds.

- Now add the paneer and toss well.

- Add 2 cups of water, pepper and salt, mix well and add the chopped cabbage.

- Cover with a lid and simmer for 10 minutes.

- Serve hot

name: Tomato Soup
ingredients:
- 100g tomato

- 10g onion

- ½ tsp black pepper

- ½ tsp low fat butter

- salt as per taste
method:
- Combine the water, tomatoes in a deep kadhai, mix well and cook on a medium flame for 8 to 10 minutes or till the tomatoes are soft, while stirring occasionally.

- Remove from the flame and keep aside to cool .

- Once cooled, blend in a mixer to a smooth puree. Do not strain and keep aside.

- Heat the butter in a deep non-stick kadhai ,add the onions, mix well and saute on a medium flame for 1 to 2 minutes or till the onions turn light brown in colour.

- Add the tomato, salt and pepper and mix well.

- Bring to boil, while stirring occasionally and simmer for 5 minutes.

- Serve hot.

name: Chicken Tomato Soup
ingredients:
- 100g tomato

- 50g chicken

- 10g onion

- ½ tsp black pepper

- ½ tsp low fat butter

- salt as per taste
method:
- Boil the water in a kadhai and add chicken to it, let it boil for 5 minutes .

- Combine the water, tomatoes in a deep kadhai, mix well and cook on a medium flame for 8 to 10 minutes or till the tomatoes are soft ,while stirring occasionally.

- Remove from the flame and keep aside to cool .

- Once cooled, blend in a mixer to a smooth puree.do not strain and keep aside.

- Heat the butter in a deep non-stick kadhai, add the onions, mix well and saute on a medium flame for 1 to 2 minutes or till the onions turn light brown in colour.

- Add the tomato puree, chicken, salt and pepper and mix well.

- Bring to boil, while stirring occasionally and simmer for 5 minutes.

- Serve hot .

name: Apple Kheer
ingredients:
- 100g apple

- 100ml milk

- 1 tsp sugar
method:
- Combine the apples, sugar and add ¾ cup water in a broad non-stick pan and cook on a medium flame for 4-5 minutes, or until the apples are soft, while stirring occasionally .

- Remove from the flame and let it cool completely and keep aside.

- Bring the milk to boil in a broad kadhai.

- Once cooled, add the prepared mixture and mix well .

- Serve chilled garnish with chopped apples.

name: Malai Ridge Gourd
ingredients:
- 500 gms of ridge gourd ,peeled and cut lengthwise ,each 2" pieces

- few slitted green chillies

- ¾ cup milk

- 1 tsp whole cumin

- 2 bay leaf

- ¼ tsp cumin powder

- ½ tsp coriander powder

- ½ tsp sugar

- salt to taste

- 3 tbsp of ghee/oil

- ¼ tsp of asafoetida

- 1 tsp of flour
method:
- In a pan put the ghee, when the ghee is warm.

- Add the bay leaves and asafoetida and stir fry for 30-40 seconds.

- Then add the whole cumin, stir it and when the cumin starts crackling, add the cut ridge gourd. Stir for few minutes.

- Then we add the salt, cumin powder and coriander powder. Stir fry all together for few minutes.

- Now add the sugar and mix it in well, keep stirring the sabzi.

- Add the slitted whole green chillies and mix it in well.

- Now cover and cook the ridge gourd on low flame till it is done, keep stirring in between.

- When the ridge gourd is cooked, add the milk and mix it in well.

- When the milk starts bubbling add the flour mixed in little water.

- The gravy will start thickening.

- Switch of the flame.

- Keep the gravy little more than you require as on cooling down, the gravy will thicken a little.

- Done, serve with pulao or paratha.

name: Rara Chicken
ingredients:
- 500 gms chicken mince

- 250 gms of chicken (pieces)

- 3-4 bay leaves

- 2 black cardamom

- 1 tsp whole cumin

- 3 medium size onions chopped

- 1 tbsp of ginger garlic chopped/pounded

- 2-3 medium size tomatoes chopped

- few green chillies chopped

- salt to taste

- red chilli powder to taste

- 1 tsp kashmiri red chilli powder

- ½ tsp turmeric powder

- ½ tsp cumin powder

- 1¼ tsp coriander powder

- ¼ tsp garam masala powder

- ¼ tsp black pepper powder

- 3 tbsp of curd

Marination and cooking of chicken pieces

- Marinate 250gms chicken in 1 tbsp of hung yogurt, ½ tsp ginger-garlic paste, 1 tsp of kashmiri red chilli powder, 1 tsp lemon juice and pinch of salt.

- Marinate for 15-20 minutes, then put 2 tsp of ghee in a pan and place the chicken on the pan and cook on low flame till it changes colour, flip the side and do the same.

- When the chicken pieces are ¾ done, remove from pan and keep aside,including the masala in the pan.
method:
- In a kadhai/pan add the oil When the oil gets warm, add the bay leaves and cardamom. Stir for few seconds then add the whole cumin to the pan.

- When the cumin starts spluttering add the chopped onions. Saute the onions till they become a beige brown colour.

- Add the pounded ginger garlic mixture. Saute till the raw smell of the ginger garlic goes. Saute the masala till it becomes a nice brown colour.

- Then add the chopped tomatoes and saute till the tomatoes become mushy. Now add the salt, red chilli powder, kashmiri red chilli, turmeric powder, cumin powder, coriander powder,¼ tsp pepper powder and garam masala.

- Add 3-4 tbsp of water and saute till the masala is cooked and oil starts seeping from the sides.

- Add the chopped green chillies and saute for few minutes.

- Then add the curd and saute the masala till it becomes a nice reddish brown colour.

- Add the mince and saute for few minutes ,then cover and cook on low flame. Keep stirring in between. No need to add any water as the mince will leave its own water.

- When the mince is more or less done, add the semi cooked chicken pieces in it and saute till the mince and chicken is cooked.

- Done.

name: Panch Mishali Sabzi
ingredients:
- 4 small brinjal cut into 4 pieces lengthwise

- 1 big sweet potato cut lengthwise

- ½ kg orange pumpkin cut in big cubes

- 2-3 white radish cut into 2 pieces

- ½ kg( pui sag ) malabar spinach, cut the stems in thin pieces and cut the leaves in strips

- few slitted whole green chillies

- few whole red chillies

- 1 ½ tsp panch phoren seeds

- 1 ½ tsp sugar

- ½ tsp turmeric powder

- ½ tsp red chilli powder

- 2 tbsp mustard oil
method:
- Put the oil in a kadhai and heat it.

- When the oil is warm add the panch phoren and whole red chillies. Stir for few seconds.

- Now add the sweet potato and the stems of the malabar spinach. Stir fry for few minutes, then add the pumpkin and brinjal.

- Stir fry for few minutes, then add the salt, sugar, turmeric powder and red chilli powder and stir it in.

- Now cover and cook till the vegetables are 60-70% done, keep stirring in between.

- Now add the spinach and green chillies and mix it all in well.

- Cover and cook till the malabar spinach is done.

- If there is water there ,dry the water ,just leaving a little as it will be absorbed by the vegetables.

- Done.

name: Open Toast
ingredients:
- 2 whole wheat bread slices

- ¼ tsp mustard seeds

- 1 green chilli

- ¼ tsp garlic

- ¼ tsp turmeric

- ¼ tsp red chilli powder

- ¼ tsp garam masala

- 10g cabbage

- 10g carrot

- 10g capsicum

- 5g tomato

- ½ tsp butter

- 1 tsp oil
method:
- Take a pan and add oil, mustard seeds, chopped green chillies, garlic.

- When it starts to splutter, add chopped onions, tomato. Saute well till soft and mushy.

- Add chopped cabbage,carrot , capsicum and saute well

- Add turmeric ,chilli powder,garam masala, salt as per taste.

- Saute for 2 minutes.

- Take 2 slices of bread , cut of the edges evenly.

- Apply butter and toast bread till brown

- Serve .

name: Cluster Beans Sabzi
ingredients:
- 100g cluster beans

- 5g urad dal

- 5g chana dal

- 1 green chilli

- ½ tsp coriander leaves

- salt as per taste

- ¼ tsp mustard seeds

- 10g tomato

- 10g onion

- 1 tsp oil
method:
- Heat the oil and add the mustard seeds.

- When the seeds crackle, add the urad dal and chana dal, curry leaves and green chillies and saute on a medium flame for a few seconds.

- Add the cluster beans, salt and water, tomato, onion, mix well and cover and cook on a slow flame for 10 minutes, while stirring occasionally.

- Add the coriander,mix well and cook on a medium flame for 2 minutes, while stirring occasionally.

- Serve hot

name: Cabbage Sandwich
ingredients:
- 2 whole wheat Bread slices

- 100g cabbage

- 1 green chillies

- ½ tsp coriander leaves

- salt to taste
method:
- To make a cabbage sandwich, combine the cabbage, coriander, green chillies and salt in a deep bowl and mix well.

- Spread 2 bread slices on a clean ,dry surface.

- Place a portion of the prepared filling on each bread slice.

- Serve hot.

name: Coleslaw Sandwich
ingredients:
- 2 whole wheat Bread slices.

- 10g cabbage

- 10g carrot

- 10g onion

- 1 tsp mayonnaise

- salt as per taste

- ¼ tsp pepper powder
method:
- Take a bowl add mayonnaise, salt,pepper, shredded carrots, cabbage, onions, mix well.

- Take 2 slices of bread, roast on both sides .

- Spread coleslaw filling to one side and flip over.

name: Gobi Fish Curry
ingredients:
- 100g fish

- 50g chopped cauliflower

- 10g onion chopped

- 15g tomatoes chopped

- 1 tsp oil

- ½ tsp cumin and coriander powder

- ⅛ tsp turmeric powder

- ¼ tsp chilli powder

- 1 green chilli slit

- ¼ tsp whole cumin seeds

- ½ tsp ginger and garlic paste
method:
- Mix the fish with turmeric powder, salt and little chilli powder. Keep aside.

- Heat oil in a pan and shallow fry the fish until golden brown.

- To the same oil add whole cumin seeds, green chilli, ginger garlic paste and onions. Saute until translucent.

- Now add chopped tomatoes and salt and stir well then cover the lid for 30 seconds. Now add coriander-cumin powder, turmeric powder, and chilli powder. Stir and continue to cook for 2 more minutes.

- Now add cauliflower florets, cook until the softened a little, approximately 3 to 4 minutes. stirring occasionally, can add little water so that it doesn’t stick on the bottom.

- Add enough water to immerse everything, adjust salt and cover and cook over medium heat for 5 to 6 more minutes or until oil separates.

- When the veggies have cooked all the way, add the fried fish. Stir and sprinkle fresh coriander leaves and turn off the heat.

- Can be served with steamed white rice.

name: Chilli Garlic Fish
ingredients:
- 100g fish

- ½ tsp red chilli paste

- 1 tsp tomato sauce

- 1 tsp red chilli sauce

- 1 tsp vinegar

- 1 tsp garlic paste

- ¼ tsp red chilli powder

- 15g onion

- salt as per taste
method:
- First marinate the fish with red chilli powder, salt and keep it aside for 5 minutes.

- Then take a kadai add oil, when oil is hot fry the fish.

- In the same oil add chopped garlic fry for 1 minute.

- Then add onion and fry another 2 minutes.

- Next add dry chilli paste, tomatoes sauce, chilli sauce and mix well.

- Now add salt and cook for another 1 minute.

- Then add fried fish and mix well and cook another 2 minutes.

- Finally switch it off and add vinegar and stir it.

- Serve it hot.

name: Broccoli Chickpea Pulao
ingredients:
- 15g chickpea (soaked)

- 10g broccoli

- 5g onion

- 5g tomato

- ¼th tsp turmeric powder

- ¼th tsp red chilli powder

- 1 tsp coriander-cumin seeds powder

- 1 tsp ginger garlic

- 1 tsp oil

- salt to taste
method:
- Heat the oil in a broad non-stick, add the onions and saute on a medium flame for 1 to 2 minutes or till they turn light brown in colour.

- Add the ginger garlic paste and saute on a medium flame for a seconds.

- Add the broccoli, chickpea and tomatoes and saute on a medium flame for 1 to 2 minutes.

- Add the spinach, turmeric powder, chilli powder, coriander-cumin seeds powder and 2 tbsp water, mix well and cook on a medium flame for 1 to 2 minutes.

- Add the rice, mix well and cook on a medium flame for 1 to 2 minutes.

- Serve hot.

name: Veg Pulao
ingredients:
- 30g rice

- 10g capsicum

- 10g carrot

- 10g beans

- 5g onion

- 5g tomato

- ¼th tsp turmeric powder

- ¼th tsp red chilli powder

- ½ tsp coriander-cumin seeds powder

- 1 tsp ginger garlic

- 1 tsp oil

- salt to taste
method:
- Soak the rice in enough water for 30 minutes, drain well and keep aside.

- Heat the oil in a pressure cooker, add the onions, cinnamon, clove and saute on a medium flame for 1 minute.

- Add the soaked rice and mixed vegetables, mix well and cook on a medium flame for 1 minute, while stirring continuously.

- Add the green chillies, ginger, garam masala, salt and add 2 cups of water, mix well and pressure cook for 2 whistles.

- Allow the steam to escape before opening the lid.

- Serve hot garnished with coriander.

name: Mutton Biryani
ingredients:
- 100g mutton

- ½ tsp ginger garlic

- ½ tsp red chilli powder

- ¼ tsp turmeric powder

- ¼ tsp garam masala

- 15 ml yogurt

- 10g onions

- ½ tsp coriander leaves

- ¼ mint leaves

- 10g tomato

- 2 tsp ghee

- ½ cinnamon sticks

- 1 green cardamom

- 1 black cardamom

- ¼ tsp whole cumin seeds

- 1 bay leaves

- 1 green chilly

- salt as required

- 30g rice
method:
- Soak basmati rice for 20 mins in lukewarm water.

- In a pan with boiling water, add salt, ghee, ginger garlic and green chilli paste along with bay leaves, whole cumin seeds, cloves, cinnamon stick, green cardamom, allow the water to boil for 2 to 3 mins.

- Add the soaked rice to the boiling water.

- Cook the rice on high flame for a minimum of 12 mins.

- Once done, drain the rice.

For marination

- In a bowl, take mutton pieces and add yogurt, fried onions, mint leaves, coriander leaves, ginger garlic and green chilly paste, ghee and slit green chilly.

- Add bay leaves, whole cumin seeds, red chilli powder, turmeric powder, garam masala powder, cloves, green and black cardamom.

- Keep the marinated mutton aside for 30 mins or else pressure cook them.

- Add sliced tomato and salt to taste.

- Lastly add oil and mix everything well.

- After 4 whistles, allow the pressure to subside completely.

- Time to layer the rice and mutton gravy.

- In a pan, layer the gravy and then place the rice.

- Top it with ghee, fried onions and coriander leaves.

- Cook it on a layer flame for 7 mins and then low flame for 7 mins.

- Plate the rice and garnish it with fried onions and coriander leaves.

name: Oats Upma
ingredients:
- 30g oats

- 200 ml water

- 10g carrot

- 10g capsicum

- 10g onion

- 1 green chilli

- 10g urad dal

- 5 curry leaves

- ½ tsp coriander leaves

- 1 tsp oil

- salt as per taste
method:
- Roast the oats until the colour changes and transfer to a plate and let it cool down to room temperature.

- Cook carrot and capsicum in boiling water and keep aside.

- Heat a pan and heat oil in it.

- Add mustard seeds, urad dal, curry leaves, green chilli, onion and saute until onion softens.

- Add the oats, water with cooked vegetables and keep stirring.

- Once thick enough add salt, coriander leaves.

- Serve.

name: Stir Fry Chilli Garlic Vegetables
ingredients:
- 1 cup mushrooms (each cut into 4 pieces)

- 1 cup carrots cut like matchsticks

- 1 cup bell pepper cut in strips

- 1 cup chinese cabbage

- 1 cup bean sprouts (optional)

- 1 big onion cut into slices

- ½ cup chopped spring onions

- 2 tsp chopped garlic

- 1 tbsp ginger julienne

- 2 tbsp of oil

For the sauce

- 1 tsp chopped garlic

- 1 tsp sugar

- salt to taste

- 1 ½ tsp spicy chilli paste

- 1 tsp vinegar

- 1 tsp dark soya sauce
1 tbsp of oil
method:
For the vegetables

- Take a wok /kadhai add the oil.

- When the oil gets warm Add the chopped garlic and stir fry till the raw smell goes.

- Then add the ginger julienne and stir fry for a minute or so.

- Now add the carrots, stir fry for a minute or so.

- Then add the onion and stir fry for few seconds.

- Add the mushrooms (can stir fry mushrooms separately and then add or can add it straight away to the vegetables).

- Add the bell peppers and chinese cabbage. Stir fry for 30-40 seconds.

For the sauce

- In a separate pan add 1 tbsp of oil ,let it warm a little.

- When the oil is warm add the chopped garlic and stir fry till fragrant. Then add the chilli paste and stir fry for few seconds.

- Now add the soya sauce, vinegar, salt and sugar (when adding the sauces lower the flame). Stir fry for few seconds ,then add it to the stir fried vegetables .

- Mix everything well.

- Lastly add the spring onions and mix it in. Done.

- Serve with Fried Rice.

name: Orange Chicken
ingredients:
- 300-400 gms of boneless chicken (cut into strips)

- ½ tsp pepper

- salt to taste

- 1 tbsp pounded garlic

- ½ lime juice

- marinate all of the above and keep aside

Remaining ingredients

- 1 cup orange juice

- 1 big onion sliced little thick

- 1 tsp chopped garlic

- few slitted green chillies

- 1 tbsp chopped celery

- salt to taste

- ¼ tsp pepper

- 1 tsp sugar

- 3 tbsp of oil
method:
- In a pan put 1 tbsp of oil, warm the oil a little.

- When the oil is warm add the thickly sliced onion. Stir fry for 30-40 seconds. Then remove from pan and. keep aside.

- Now 1 ½ tbsp of oil in the same pan and place the marinated chicken ,leave the remaining batter to be added later.

- Cook on one side on full flame flip the chicken after a minute or so.

- Both sides should become a little brown. Then remove the chicken from the pan and keep aside.

- In the same pan add the remaining oil.

- When the oil gets warm Add the chopped garlic and stir fry till fragrant.

- Then add the orange juice and stir for few minutes.

- When the juice starts bubbling add the sugar ,salt and pepper and stir fry few seconds.

- Now add the stir fried cooked chicken and mix it in well.

- Next add the stir fried onions and mix it in well.

- Add the remaining batter of the chicken to the pan, can add 1-2 tbsp of water to the remaining batter .

- Now add the slit green chillies and the chopped celery. Mix all in.

- Then simmer for a minute or so. It's Done.

- Serve with plain rice/fried rice.

name: Tangri Masala
ingredients:
Marinate

- 500-600 gms of chicken tangri /lollipops (make slits in them)

- 2 tsp ginger-garlic paste

- 1 tsp coriander powder

- ¼ tsp turmeric powder

- ½ tsp garam masala

- ½ tsp chilli powder

- ½ tsp kashmiri chilli powder

- salt to taste

- ½ lime juice

- 3 tbsp of hung yogurt
method:
- Mix all of the above with the chicken and keep aside for 15-20 minutes.

- Then take a pan add 1 tbsp of oil, make the oil warm.

- When the oil is warm add the chicken pieces, keep the remaining marination to be added later, and cook on low flame changing the sides in between.

- When the chicken is half to three quarter done ,switch off the flame.

Other Ingredients

- 2 green cardamom

- 2 cinnamon sticks of 1-2 each

- 1 tsp black peppercorns

- 3-4 cloves

- 2 medium size onions ground to a paste

- salt to taste

- ½ tsp turmeric powder

- red chilli powder to taste

- ½ tsp kashmiri chilli powder

- 1½ tsp of dry kasturi methi leaves

- 1 cup hot water

- 2 tbsp of oil/ghee or 50-50

Method

- Put oil in a pan.

- Heat the oil, then add the cloves, cardamom, cinnamon and peppercorns. Stir for a minute or so, then add the ground onion paste.

- Saute till the onion turns into a nice beige brown colour.

- Now add the remaining marination masala and saute for few minutes.

- Now add the semi cooked chicken, mix it in well with the masala. Saute for few minutes.

- Then add hot water and cover the pan and cook on low flame till chicken is done. Do stir in between.

- Lastly add the kasturi methi leaves and cover and keep for few minutes.

- Open the lid, if there is any water left can dry it up or keep according to taste. Done.

- Serve with tandoori roti.

name: Truly Chilli Chicken
ingredients:
- 350 gms of chicken, boneless, cut into thin pieces

- ½ tsp oyster sauce

- 1½ tsp light soya sauce

- ½ tsp dark soya sauce

- ½ tsp sesame oil

- ½ tsp cornflour

- pinch of salt

- marinate all of the above and keep aside for 20-30 minutes

Remaining ingredients

- 1 tsp chopped garlic

- 6-8 whole pods of garlic sliced

- ¼ cup scallions cut in 1"pieces

- 12-15 green chillies cut in diagonal, in 1 pieces

- ¼ tsp oyster sauce

- 1 tsp light soya

- 3 tbsp oil
method:
- Take a wok or pan and add 2 tbsp of oil.

- Heat the oil, when the oil is hot add the marinated chicken and stir fry continuously on high flame.

- When the chicken is more or less done.

- Add all the green chillies and stir fry for a minute or two. Remove from wok and keep aside.

- In the same wok add the remaining oil, when the oil is warm add the chopped garlic, stir then immediately add the sliced garlic. Stir fry for 30-40 seconds.

- Now add the scallions and stir fry for few seconds. Switch of the flame and add the light soya and the oyster sauce. Mix it in well.

- Put on the flame stir for few seconds. Then add the chicken, sugar and pinch of salt. Stir fry on high flame for few seconds. Done.

- Serve with rice or fried rice

name: Pan Grilled Chops
ingredients:
- 400 gms of chops

- salt to taste

- 1 tsp black pepper powder

- ½ lime juice

- 1 tsp garlic ginger paste

- 1 tsp oil
method:
- Marinate all of the above and keep aside for 20-30 minutes.

- After 20-30 minutes Put the chops in a pressure cooker with very little water and cook for 5 minutes after first whistle.

- If there is water, dry it in the cooker or keep aside to be added later. Remove and keep aside.

Remaining Ingredients

- 1 tbsp butter

- 1 onion thickly sliced

- 1 boiled potato sliced

- 1 tsp soya sauce

- ½ tsp chilli flakes

- ½ tsp vinegar

Method

- In a tawa put the butter then add the chops, stir it gently. Fry for few minutes on low flame.

- Then add the soya sauce and vinegar and mix it in.

- After few minutes Add any remaining liquid and let the chops cook on low flame.

- When the chops are more or less done add the sliced onions and chilli flakes. Cook for few minutes.

- Lastly add the boiled potatoes and mix it in gently. If chops are cooked.

- It's done.

- Serve with tandoori roti or bread.

name: Stir Fry Cauliflower
ingredients:
- ½ medium size cauliflower cut into florets

- 1 carrot sliced diagonal

- 1 onion thickly sliced

- 6-8 whole pods of garlic

- 1 piece ginger cut into slices

- 6-8 green chillies chopped

- 3-4 red fresh chillies chopped (can use whole red chillies chopped also )

- ¼ cup chicken strips (optional)

- 1 ½ tsp light soya sauce

- ½ tsp dark soya

- ½ tsp oyster sauce

- ¼ tsp vinegar

- salt to taste

- ¼ tsp sugar

- 3 tbsp of oil
method:
- Blanch the florets and keep aside ,so that they are 50% done. Now take a kadhai or pan.

- Add the oil and warm the oil a little. Then add the ginger garlic and stir fry for few seconds.

- If you are using chicken ,then need to add the chicken at this stage and stir fry for 7-8 minutes, if not then go directly to next step.

- Then add green chillies. Stir fry for few seconds.

- Add the carrots and stir fry for few minutes. Make the flame low.

- Now add all the sauces ,salt to taste and sugar. Stir fry for few seconds on full flame.

- Then add the cauliflower florets and stir fry for few mi uses so that it all mixes well. Lastly add the sliced onion and mix it in. Stir fry for few minutes.

- Done.

name: Boti Chicken
ingredients:
- 350 gms of boneless chicken

- 2-3 tbsp of chopped coriander leaves

- salt to taste

- ½ tsp red chilli flakes

- ½ tsp black pepper

- ¼ tsp turmeric powder

- ½ tsp garam masala

- ¼ tsp cumin powder

- ½ tsp coriander powder

- 3 tbsp of yogurt

- mix all of the above with the chicken and let it Marinate for 20-30 minutes

Remaining ingredients

- 1 tbsp chopped garlic

- few chopped green chillies

- 1 onion chopped

- 3 tbsp oil

- salt to taste
method:
- In a pan add the oil ,when the oil is warm add the chopped garlic. Stir fry till it becomes a beige brown.

- Then add the chopped green chillies. Stir for few minutes

- Then add the chopped onion. Saute for few minutes till the onion starts changing colour.

- Then add the marinated chicken and mix it in well.

- Add the salt, keeping in mind that salt has been put in the marination. Saute for few minutes.

- Then cover and cook on low flame till the chicken is done. Keep stirring in between.

- Can add 3-4 tbsp of water while sauteing .

- Done.

name: Kesar Badam Oats
ingredients:
- 2 tbsp oats

- 100 ml skimmed milk

- 5 almonds

- 50grm apple

- 1 tsp powdered sugar

- pinch of saffron

- pinch of cardamom powder
method:
- Heat the skimmed milk gently in a saucepan on a low flame. Combine the saffron and warm milk.

- Let it sit for 10 minutes to infuse. Add the infused saffron milk,powdered sugar, and cardamom powder to a bowl. Now add the mashed apples and nuts to this. Mash the apple gently with a fork.

- Stir well to combine. Transfer to a clean glass jar. Let it sit in the fridge overnight.

- Add nuts as a topping before serving.

- Enjoy it as a chilled breakfast.

name: Vegetable Egg Mushroom Soup
ingredients:
- 1 whole egg

- 50 gms mushroom

- 50 gms capsicum

- 50 gms cabbage

- 30 gms onion

- 20 gms carrot

- 2 garlic cloves crushed

- black pepper

- 10 ml soya sauce

- ½ tsp vinegar

- ½ tsp olive oil

- salt
method:
- Apply the oil in the pan, add onion, crushed garlic and saute it.
