- Now add chopped cabbage, capsicum and carrots and mix it.

- Cook it for 3 minutes and add chopped mushroom and saute it.

- Mix soya sauce with it and cook for 1-2 minutes more.

- Now add water or vegetable broth in it.

- Once it comes to boil, add 1 beaten whole egg slowly to the soup and stir it continuously.

- Keep on stirring till the soup comes to boil.

- Now add salt, pepper and vinegar.

- Mix it and serve it hot.

name: Vegetable  Mushroom Soup
ingredients:
- 50 gm mushroom

- 50 gms cabbage

- 50 gms capsicum

- 20 gms carrots

- 30 gms onion

- 2 garlic cloves crushed

- black pepper

- 10 ml soya sauce

- ½ tsp vinegar

- ½ tsp olive oil

- salt
method:
- Apply the oil in the pan, add onion, crushed garlic and saute it.

- Now add chopped cabbage, capsicum and carrots and mix it.

- Cook it for 3 minutes and add chopped mushroom and saute it.

- Mix soya sauce with it and cook for 1-2 minutes more.

- Now add water or vegetable broth in it.

- Add salt, pepper, vinegar and keep it for a boil.

- Once it comes to boil, turn off the flame and ready to serve.

name: Omelette Sandwich
ingredients:
- 2 egg whites

- 1 yolk

- 50 gms paneer slice

- 50 gms capsicum

- 50 gms cabbage

- 50 gms tomato

- ¼ tsp oil

- black pepper

- salt
method:
- Take 2 small bowls. In one bowl add 2 egg whites, add salt and beat it.

- In another bowl, take yolk, add a pinch of salt and beat it.

- Take a pan, brush the oil and keep a bowl in the middle covering ¾ part of the pan.

- Now add the egg white on the side of the bowl, giving it a round shape.

- Cook it for a minute on medium flame. Remove the bowl.

- Now keep a smaller bowl in between and fill the gap with yolk.

- Cook it for a minute and remove the bowl.

- Now in the leftover space, add egg white.

- Cook it and flip the omelette.

- Sprinkle blackpepper.

- Add chopped cabbage, capsicum, tomato and paneer in the omelette and fold it.

- Ready to serve.

name: Vegetable Corn And Chicken Soup
ingredients:
- 50 gms corn kernels

- 60 gms shredded chicken

- 1 egg white

- 1 ½ cup chicken broth

- 50 gms capsicum

- 50 gms cabbage

- 20 gms onion

- 2-3 garlic clove

- ¼ tsp blackpepper

- ½ tsp oil

- salt
method:
- Prepare the chicken broth by boiling water, salt, chopped garlic and chicken breast.

- Place the lid and allow the water to come to a boil. Simmer for 15 minutes and turn off the flame.

- Take out the chicken, let it cool and use a fork to separate the shred.

- Boil the corn, take 30 gms of corn from it and blend it in a jar. Keep it aside.

- Heat oil in a heavy bottomed vessel.

- Add onion and garlic and saute it.

- Add other chopped vegetables and cook it for 3-4 minutes.

- Now add corn paste that we have prepared and stir it thoroughly.

- Add black pepper, salt and remaining boiled corn in it.

- Add chicken broth and let it come to a boil.

- Now add shredded chicken.

- Take 1 egg white and add slowly to a soup while stirring.

- Close the lid and boil it for 10 minutes.

- Soup is ready to serve.

name: Crispy-Chicken And Egg Sandwich
ingredients:
- 2 slice whole wheat bread

- 50 gms chicken thighs

- 1 whole egg

- 2 tbsp curd

- 50 gms tomato

- 50 gms capsicum

- 50 gms onion

- 1 small garlic clove

- lemon zest

- pinch of Black pepper

- chilli flakes

- ½ tsp oil

- salt
method:
- In a small bowl, combine curd, garlic and lemon zest. Season it with pepper and salt.

- In a non-stick skillet, heat the oil over medium heat. Season chicken and cook, skin side down until the chicken is golden brown for about 6 minutes and then flip the chicken and cook until it is cooked through.

- Transfer chicken to a plate and drizzle lemon juice.

- Brush the oil in a pan, break egg on it, Sprinkle pepper and salt on it.

- Let it cook for 2 minutes.

- Assemble sandwich with bread, chicken, egg and vegetables.

name: Citrus Burst Infused Water
categories: Morning Snack, Evening Snack, Sim's Family Recipes
ingredients:
- 4-5 slices of oranges

- 5-6 slices of lime

- 7-8 mint leaves

- 1 tsp chia seeds

- 500ml water
method:
- Take a jug or a bottle, add orange slices, lime slices, mint leaves and chia seeds into it.

- Add water and stir and keep it aside for 15-20 minutes.

- It's ready to drink.

name: Broad Beans (With Mustard And Poppy Seeds Paste)
ingredients:
- 350-400 gms of broad beans(heads to be removed and cut into 2-3 pieces each depending on the size)

- few slit green chillies

- ¼ tsp turmeric powder

- 2 tbsp of mustard oil / refined oil

- ½ tsp onion seeds (kala jeera/kalonji

- ½ tsp sugar

To be ground to a paste and kept aside

- 1 tbsp of mustard seeds (black and yellow)

- 1 tsp poppy seeds

- 2 green chillies (grinding green chillies with mustard is a must )
method:
- Put the oil in a kadhai and heat the oil.

- When the oil becomes hot add the onion seeds. Stir fry few seconds then add the cut broad beans, stir fry for 7-8 minutes.

- Now add the slit whole green chillies. Stir fry for 1 minute or so Then add the salt and turmeric powder.

- Stir fry for few minutes Now add the mustard ,poppy seeds and green chillies paste. Mix it in and stir fry for a minute or so.

- Now add ½ cup of water, when it comes to boil.

- Lower the flame and cover and cook till done. Do stir in between.

- Now add ½ tsp sugar.

- Mix it in and cook for few seconds .

- Done.

name: Stir Fried Eggplant
ingredients:
- 1 medium size eggplant cut into cubes (dust the eggplant cubes in 1 tsp cornflour and 1 tsp flour and keep aside)

- 3 tbsp of oil

- 1 tbsp of chopped garlic

- 1 big onion cut into thick slices

- few green chillies chopped

- salt to taste

- ½-¾ tsp chilli flakes

- ½-¾ tsp sugar

- 1 tsp soya sauce
method:
- Take a wok or kadhai add the oil.

- Heat the oil, when the oil is hot add the chopped garlic. Stir fry for a minute.

- Then add the sliced onions. Stir fry for few minutes.

- Now add the chopped green chillies. Stir fry for few seconds.

- Add the red chilli flakes and stir fry for few seconds. Then add the cut eggplant and stir fry.

- Add the salt and sugar and stir fry till it is cooked. Then add the soya sauce and stir fry for few minutes .

- Done.

Note

- If the eggplant is taking time to cook, then make the flame low and stir fry. Do not cover, it will become soggy.

name: Tangy Chicken Masala
ingredients:
- 500-600 gms of chicken

- 1 big onion grated

- 1 tsp garlic paste

- 1 tsp ginger paste

- salt to taste

- red chilli powder to taste

- ¼ tsp turmeric powder

- ½ tsp cumin powder

- ½ tsp coriander powder

- ¼ tsp garam masala

- 1 tsp kashmiri chilli powder

- 2-3 bay leaves

- 2 green cardamom

- 4 cloves

- 2 pieces of cinnamon stick of 1 each

- 3 tbsp of mustard oil/refined oil

- 2 tsp vinegar

- ¼ tsp sugar

- 2 tsp mustard paste (ground with 1 green chilli)
method:
- Marinate the chicken with 1 tsp vinegar, mustard paste, cumin powder, coriander powder, turmeric powder, red chilli powder, kashmiri red chilli, ¼ tsp of red chilli flakes and salt.

- Marinate the chicken with all of the above ingredients and keep aside.

Method

- In a kadhai add the oil, when the oil is warm.

- Add the bay leaves, cloves, cardamom and cinnamon sticks. Stir for 30-40 seconds.

- Now add the ground onions and saute till the onions turn into a nice brown colour.

- Then add the marinated chicken and saute till chicken is ¾ done.

- Now add ¾ cup water and cook the chicken.

- Cover and cook on low flame one the water starts bubbling. Keep stirring in between.

- In between can add the sugar and let it cook.

- When the chicken becomes tender add the 1 tsp of vinegar and saute for few minutes .

- Check for salt.

- Done.

- Serve with roti or paratha.

name: Mustard Fish Gravy
ingredients:
- 500-600 gms of fish

- 1 big onion grated

- 1 big tomato grated/pureed

- 1 tsp ginger-garlic paste

- 2 tsp of ground mustard paste (to be ground with 1 green chilli)

- few slit green chillies

- salt to taste

- ½ tsp turmeric powder

- ½ tsp kashmiri chilli powder

- red chilli powder to taste

- 3 tbsp of mustard oil/refined oil

- 2 tbsp of chopped coriander leaves
method:
- Marinate the fish with little salt and turmeric powder. Then in a pan put 1 tbsp of oil, warm the oil.

- When the oil is warm place the fish let it cook.

- When one side is done flip the side and do the same on the other side.

- When both sides are cooked, remove and keep aside.

- Mix the salt, red chilli powder, kashmiri red chilli powder and turmeric powder in a bowl with 4-5 tbsp of water, so that the masala infuses.

Method

- In a kadhai put the remaining oil.

- Heat the oil, when warm add the ground onions. Saute till the onion becomes a beige brown colour.

- Then add the ginger-garlic paste and saute till the raw smell goes.

- Then add the tomato puree and saute till the water of the tomato dries up.

- Now add the infused masala to it and saute till oil starts seeping from the sides.

- Now add the ground mustard paste. saute for few minutes.

- Now add 2 cups of water and let the gravy come to a boil.

- Add the cooked fish in gently and cook on low flame for 7-10 minutes will start seeing oil on the top.

- Add the chopped coriander leaves and let it simmer for few seconds.

- Done.

- Serve with plain rice.

name: Salad With A Twist
ingredients:
- 1 cup blanched (cooked) peas

- 1 sweet potato/boiled potato cut into cubes

- 1 big onion sliced

- 1 big cucumber cut in big cubes

- few slit green chillies

- 1 tbsp of chopped coriander leaves

- 1 ginger julienne

- 1 ½ tbsp white sesame seeds roasted

- 1 tsp whole cumin roasted

- few whole red chillies roasted

- salt to taste

- ½ -1 lime juice

- 1-2 tbsp of mustard oil

- 5-6 pieces of fenugreek seeds
method:
- Grind the roasted sesame seeds, whole cumin and whole red chillies in a grinder to a powder and keep aside .

Method

- Add the oil to a pan and let it get hot .

- When the oil is hot add the fenugreek seeds and stir fry for 30-40 seconds.

- When it is fragrant remove and discard the seeds.

- Now to that oil add the ginger julienne and slit green chillies and stir fry for 30-40 seconds.

- Switch of the flame and add the onion, cucumber, potato and peas. Stir it in and mix it nicely with the ginger and chillies.

- Now add the ground powder and mix it in well.

- Add the salt and lime juice and stir it in (can add ½ -1 lime juice on personal preference).

- Lastly add the chopped coriander leaves. Mix it in.

- Done. Can have it by itself or as a salad with your meal.

name: Dhoi Fish
ingredients:
For the fish

- 5 pcs of medium size

- ¼ tsp salt

- ¼ tsp turmeric powder

- mix all the above together and keep for 10-15 minutes

- then in a kadhai or pan Add 1 1/2 tbsp of mustard oil

- heat the oil ,when the oil is hot add the marinated fish pieces

- when the side placed down changes colour flip the side and cook on the other side
remove and keep aside

Remaining ingredients
For the tarka

- ½ tsp whole cumin

- 4 cloves

- 2 green cardamom

- 2 sticks cinnamon of 1 each

Remaining ingredients

- 1 big onion grated/ground

- 1 tsp ginger-garlic paste

- 1 tsp poppy seeds

- ½ tsp whole coriander

- ½ tsp whole cumin (poppy seeds, whole cumin and coriander seeds can be ground together to a paste)

- ½ tsp sugar

- 2 tbsp curd/yogurt

- few slit green chillies

- 2 tbsp mustard oil/refined oil (preferably much oil)

- In a bowl put 3-4 tbsp of water and add ¼ tsp turmeric powder, ½ tsp kashmiri chilli powder, ½ tsp red chilli powder and salt to taste. Keep aside ,the masala infuses better in water
method:
- Put the oil in a kadhai, heat the oil.

- When the oil is hot add the cloves, cardamom and cinnamon stick and whole cumin.

- When it becomes fragrant, add the onion paste and saute till the water of the onion dries up.

- Now add the ginger garlic paste and saute till the raw smell goes and the masala turns into a nice light brown.

- Add the infused masala and saute till little oil seeps out.

- Now add the curd and sugar and mix it well. Saute for few minutes.

- Add 2 cups of hot water.

- When the gravy starts bubbling add the green chillies.

- After few minutes add the fish.

- When the gravy comes to a boil, lower the flame and cover and cook for 10-15 minutes.

- Done. Serve with plain rice.

name: Nepali Matar With Black Sesame Seeds
ingredients:
Preparation

- 1 ½ cup cooked matar
(dried peas ,need to soak it overnight. Then wash and add to pressure cooker ,add 2 cups of water. Cook for 5 minutes on low flame after first whistle. Let cooker open naturally) keep aside

- next take a ping pong ball size tamarind and soak it in 1 cup water

- mix it in well

- then remove the pulp and keep the rest aside

To be pounded

- 1 piece ginger and few green chillies

To be roasted

- ¼ cup black sesame seeds

- take a pan put the sesame seeds and roast on medium flame, stirring continuously.

- when you start getting a popping sound or a fragrance starts coming from the sesame seeds its done.

- let it cool down.

- then grind it in a grinder to a powder texture. Keep aside.

To be cut and kept

- 1 cucumber cut into cubes

- 1 big onion sliced

- ½ cup chopped coriander leaves

Remaing Ingredients for the cooking

- 1 onion sliced

- few slit green chillies

- 1 pc ginger to be cut coarsely and smashed

- 2 tbsp of mustard oil

- ½ tsp black salt

- salt to taste

- pinch of turmeric powder

Method

- Take a pan add the mustard oil. When the oil is hot.

- Add the coarsely cut and smashed ginger. Stir for few seconds.

- Add the sliced onion. Stir for a minute or so.

- Add the turmeric powder and the pounded ginger and green chillies. Stir for 30-40 seconds.

- Then add the boiled mattar. Stir for a minute or so.

- Now add 2-3 tsp of the black sesame powder (remaining keep away). Mix it in well. Switch off the flame.

- Now add the cucumber, sliced onion, salt, black salt and tamarind pulp. Mix it all in well.

- Lastly add the chopped coriander leaves and mix it in .

- Check for salt, chillies and tamarind. Can adjust to your choice.

- Ready to eat.

- Done.

(dried peas ,need to soak it overnight. Then wash and add to pressure cooker ,add 2 cups of water. Cook for 5 minutes on low flame after first whistle. Let cooker open naturally) keep aside

- let it cool down.

- 1 pc ginger to be cut coarsely and smashed

- 2 tbsp of mustard oil

- ½ tsp black salt

- salt to taste

- pinch of turmeric powder

- Take a pan add the mustard oil. When the oil is hot.

- Add the coarsely cut and smashed ginger. Stir for few seconds.

- Add the sliced onion. Stir for a minute or so.

- Add the turmeric powder and the pounded ginger and green chillies. Stir for 30-40 seconds.

- Then add the boiled mattar. Stir for a minute or so.

- Now add 2-3 tsp of the black sesame powder (remaining keep away). Mix it in well. Switch off the flame.

- Now add the cucumber, sliced onion, salt, black salt and tamarind pulp. Mix it all in well.

- Lastly add the chopped coriander leaves and mix it in .

- Check for salt, chillies and tamarind. Can adjust to your choice.

- Ready to eat.

- Done.

name: Pineapple Fried Rice
ingredients:
- 1 cup raw rice (cook and keep aside )

- 1 medium carrot cut into small cubes

- 1 ½ cup fresh pineapple cut into cubes

- ¼ cup peas frozen

- ¼ cup corn frozen

- ¼ cup cashews

- 1 medium size onion chopped

- ½ cup chopped celery

- ¼ cup chopped spring onions

- 3-4 eggs

- 1 tsp chopped garlic

- 2 tsp light soya sauce

- 1 tsp oyster sauce

- 1 tsp sugar

- salt to taste

- 3 tbsp of oil

- ⅔ cup of boneless chicken (optional)
method:
- Stir fry the peas and corn for 30-40 seconds in a pan with 1 tsp oil and keep aside. Cut chicken in small strips

- Marinate the chicken in ¼ tsp dark soya sauce, ¼ tsp rice wine, salt, pepper, ½ tsp ginger garlic paste, ¼ tsp sugar tsp and ½ tsp cornflour.

- Mix all of the above with the chicken and keep aside for 10-15 minutes.

- Next In a kadhai add 1 tbsp of oil, swirl the oil around the kadhai and heat the oil.

- Now put the chicken, spread it out .

- Let one side cook then flip the side and cook the other side .

- When done remove and keep aside .

- In the same pan add the remaining oil.

- Let the oil become hot then add the chopped garlic. Stir fry for few seconds.

- When the garlic is fragrant Add the onion and stir fry a minute or so.

- Now add the chopped celery and stir fry for few seconds.

- Now add the carrot and cashews and stir fry for 30-40 seconds.

- Now bring everything to one side. Beat the eggs together with a pinch of salt and add to the kadhai. Stir it gently till more or less done.

- Then add the pineapple cubes and the boiled rice and mix everything in together gently.

- Now add the corn and peas and mix it in gently.

- Add the sauces, salt ,sugar and mix it in well.

- If adding chicken ,add chicken and stir it in carefully.

- Lastly add the spring onions and mix it in.

- Done.

- Can garnish with spring onions.

name: Pineapple Chicken
ingredients:
- 350-400 gms boneless chicken

- ½ red capcicum cut in big cubes

- ½ green capsicum cut in big cubes

- 1 big onion cut in cubes

- 2 red peppers cut in thick diagonal piece

- 1 small cucumber cut in diagonal pieces

- 1 ½ cup Pineapple cut in big cubes

- 1 cup pineapple puree coarsely done in a grinder

- 1 ½ tsp chopped garlic

- 1 tsp chilli flakes

- 1 tsp dark soya

- ½ tsp oyster sauce

- 1 tsp sugar

- salt to taste

- 2 tsp cornflour mixed with 6-8 tbsp of water

- 3 -4 tbsp of oil
method:
- Marinate chicken in a pinch of salt, pepper, 1 tsp ginger-garlic paste, ½ tsp soya sauce ,pinch of sugar, ½ tsp rice wine,1 tsp oil and ½ tsp cornflour. Marinate and keep for 10-15 minutes.

Method

- Take a wok or kadhai add 2 tbsp of oil.

- Heat the oil, swirl the oil around in the kadhai.

- When the oil is hot add the marinated chicken, spread it out in the wok/kadhai. Leave for few minutes

- .Then flip the side and cook that side. Stir it around so that the chicken cooks evenly.

- When the chicken is done. Remove and keep aside.

- In the same pan add 1 tbsp of oil. Warm the oil. Now add the cut capsicum, onion, red peppers, cucumber and pineapple. Stir fry on full flame for a minute or so only.

- Remove and keep aside. Now in the same pan add 1 tbsp of oil.

- Add the chopped garlic and stir fry till fragrant. Then add the pineapple puree mixed with 6-8 tbsp of water. Stir it for few seconds.

- Put in the chilli flakes. Add the sugar ,salt and the sauces one by one. Mix it in well.

- Now add the cornflour mixture and keep stirring till the gravy starts to thicken.

- Immediately add the cooked chicken and stir fry vegetables. Mix it in well.

- Add the chopped spring onions. Mix it in. Done.

- Check for salt,sugar and sourness of the pineapple, can adjust according to taste.

- Serve with plain rice or fried rice.

name: Hariyali Dal
ingredients:
- wash and soak the dal for 30 minutes

- 1 cup dal (5 mixed dal ,get it premixed ) then put it in a pressure cooker with 2 ½ cups of water

- 1 sliced onion

- 1 tomato cut coarsely

- 5-6 pods of whole garlic

- 1 pc ginger cut coarsely or grated

- ½ tsp coriander powder

- ½ tsp cumin powder

- salt to taste

- ½ tsp turmeric powder

- ½ tsp red chilli powder
½ tsp dry kasturi methi leaves

- cook all of the above in the cook for 10 minutes on low flame after the first whistle

- when done let the cooker open naturally

To be coarsely grounded/pounded and kept aside

- 2-3 green cardamom

- 1 tsp whole coriander

- ½ tsp whole cumin

- 10-12 whole black pepper

- tiny piece of jaifhal (nutmeg)

Ground to a paste together

- ½ cup chopped coriander leaves

- 6-8 cloves of garlic

- 1 pc ginger

- 4-5 green chillies (or according to taste)

- grind to a paste and keep aside

Remaining ingredients

- 1 big onion chopped

- 1 tbsp of kasturi methi leaves

- 3 tbsp of oil

For the takda

- 1 tsp ghee

- 1 tomato cut into big cubes

- 5-6 pods of garlic

- ½ tsp kashmiri red chilli

- ½ tsp whole cumin
method:
- In a kadhai add the oil.

- Warm the oil, when it is warm.

- Add the coarsely ground/pounded masala. Stir for 30-40 seconds.

- Then add the dry kasturi methi leaves. Stir for few seconds.

- Add the chopped onion. Stir till onion becomes translucent.

- Then add the ground paste of coriander, green chillies, garlic and ginger. Saute till the raw smell of the masala goes.

- When the water from the masala dries up. And oil starts seeping from the sides.

- Add the cooked dal. Mix it in well.

- Let the dal come to a boil and then simmer on low flame for 10-15 minutes. Keep stirring in between.

- Lastly add the tarka.

- Take a pan add the ghee.

- When the ghee is warm add the whole cumin, when it starts splutter.

- Add the kashmiri red chilli, tomato and garlic. Stir for a minute or so.

- Then add to the dal.

- Check for salt.

- Done.

- Serve with tandoori roti.

name: Cauliflower Korma
ingredients:
- 1 medium to big Cauliflower (cut into big florets)

- 1 onion sliced browned and kept aside

- 2 bay leaves

- 2-3 green cardamom

- 1 tsp whole cumin

- 2 pcs of cinnamon stick of 1 each

- 2-3 tbsp of cashew ground to a paste

- 3 tbsp of yogurt

- 3 tbsp of mustard oil

- 1 tsp ghee

- 1 tsp sugar

- salt to taste

To be ground to a paste

- 1 onion

- 5-6 green chillies

- 10 -12 pods of garlic

- 1 ½-2 pc ginger
method:
- Take a kadhai. Put 1 tbsp of oil, heat the oil, swirl the oil around the kadhai.

- Add the florets. Stir fry for 10-15 minutes. Then remove and keep aside.

- In the same kadhai can add 2 tsp of oil, heat the oil and add the sliced onion and brown it. Keep aside.

- In the same kadai add the remaining oil. Heat the oil, when it is warm

- Add the bay leaves, cloves, cardamom and cinnamon sticks. Stir for few seconds.

- Now add the paste of onion, coriander, chillies, ginger and garlic. Saute till the water of the masala dries up. Add the stir fry florets and saute for 5-10 minutes on medium flame.

- Then cover and cook on low flame ,stirring in between. Now add the cashew paste, saute for few seconds.

- Add the yogurt. Mix it in well.

- Add ½-1 cup water. Add salt to taste and sugar.

- Mix everything in well. Cover and cook on low flame till the cauliflower is done (should be a little crunchy). Lastly add the brown onion and 1 tsp ghee. Mix it in.

- Serve with plain rice or pulao. Done.

name: Pineapple Raita
ingredients:
- 1 cup yogurt

- ¾ cup cut pineapple

- 1 tsp sugar

- ½ tsp roasted cumin

- ½ tsp chat masala

- ¼ tsp black salt/according to taste

- pinch of red chilli powder
method:
- Whip the curd and keep aside.

- Cut the pineapple into small cubes.

- Add sugar /roasted cumin, chat masala/red chilli powder and black salt to the curd and mix it in well.

- Add the cut pineapple an mix it in.

- Adjust salt and sugar according to taste.

- Serve cold with Indian food.

name: Radish Leaves Bharta
ingredients:
- 1 bunch of baby radish leaves

- 2 whole red chillies

- ½-1 tsp onion seeds (roasted and kept aside)

- green chillies according to taste

- 3 tbsp of mustard oil

- 8-10 garlic pods

- salt to taste

- pinch of turmeric powder

- 1 tsp sugar
method:
- Take the leaves of the radish and wash it ,then cut it and blanch it .

- To blanch it put it in a kadhai (without oil)and let it cook in it, keep stirring, cover and keep for few minutes.

- The leaves will leave its own water, let it cook in it. When done, let it cool.

- Then put the cooked radish leaves in a grinder add ,the onion seeds, garlic pods and green chillies. Grind it coarsely keep aside.

- In the same kadhai add the oil. Warm the oil.

- Then add the turmeric powder. Stir for 2-3 seconds.

- Add the ground radish leaves. Saute for few minutes on medium flame

- Add the salt and sugar and saute for 10-15 minutes on low flame. Done.

- Serve with dal and rice.

name: Hara Bhara Saag
ingredients:
- 1 bundle spinach (approximately 500-600 gms)

- few whole green chillies

- 1 carrot cut into semi circles

- ½ green capsicum cut into cubes

- ½ red capsicum cut into cubes

- 1 onion cut into 4(optional)

- 5-8 mushrooms cut into 4 pieces each

- ½ cup cooked peas

- 8-10 cashews

- 2 tsp melon seeds

- 1 tsp whole cumin

- 2 tsp whole coriander seeds pounded coarsely

- few whole red chillies

- 1 onion chopped

- 1 tsp ginger garlic paste

- 2 tomatoes chopped

- red chilli powder to taste

- salt to taste

- ½ tsp garam masala

- ¼ tsp turmeric powder

- ½ tsp coriander powder

- ½ tsp cumin powder

- 1 tbsp of dry kasturi methi leaves

- 2½ tbsp of ghee/oil

For the tadka (optional)

- ½ tbsp of ghee

- 5-6 whole pods of garlic

- ½ tsp kashmiri red chilli

- 1 tomato cut into big pieces
method:
- Blanch the spinach.

- Clean and cut the spinach coarsely. Place it in a pan on low flame.

- Cover and keep for few minutes. Flip the spinach and cook for few minutes. Remove from flame and let it cool down.

- Then grind the spinach with few green chillies and keep aside.

- Grind the cashews and melon seeds together in a grinder to make a paste. Keep aside.

- Take a pan add 1 tsp of ghee/oil. Warm the oil and swirl it around. Add the cut vegetables with a pinch of salt and stir fry on full flame till the vegetables are more than half done.

- Remove and keep aside.

Method

- Take a kadhai. Add the ghee.

- When the ghee in warm add the whole red chillies, whole cumin seeds and the ground coriander, stir till the cumin starts spluttering.

- Add the chopped onion. Stir fry till the onions become beige.

- Then add the ginger-garlic paste. Saute till thee raw smell of the ginger garlic goes.

- Now add the chopped tomatoes. Saute till the tomatoes become mushy, can add 2-3 tbsp of water to saute.

- Now add the salt, turmeric, red chilli powder, cumin powder, coriander powder. Saute for few minutes. Can add few tbsp of water and saute.

- When the masala becomes a nice reddish colour. Add ½ tsp garam masala. Saute for few minutes.

- Now add the dry kasturi methi leaves. Saute for few minutes.

- Add the ground spinach. Mix it in well in the masala.

- When the spinach starts bubbling. Lower the flame and cook till the water of the spinach dries up. Keep stirring.

- When the spinach becomes thick. Add the cashews melon paste mixed with a little water. Mix it in well. Cook for few minutes.

- Now add the vegetables and cook on low flame for few minutes.

Now the tadka

- Take a small kadhai.

- Add the ghee.

- When the ghee is warm add the whole cumin and garlic. Stir for few minutes.

- Add red chilli powder and cut tomato. Stir fry for few seconds.

- Now add to the spinach. Done.

- Serve with rotis.

name: Lasuni Bhindi (Garlic Okra)
ingredients:
- 300 gms bhindi cut into ½ pieces (wash and dry with a napkin, cut and discard the head and tail)

- 1 big onion chopped

- 1 big tomato chopped

- 2 tsp chopped garlic

- 4-5 pods of whole garlic

- pinch of turmeric

- ½-1 tsp chilli flakes

- salt to taste

- 3 tbsp mustard oil
method:
- Take a pan.

- Heat the oil, when the oil is warm.

- Add the chopped garlic and stir fry till it becomes beige brown.

- Add the chopped onion. Saute till it it is translucent.

- Then add the chopped tomato. Saute till the water from the tomato dries up.

- Now add the salt, turmeric and chili flakes. Saute for few minutes .

- Then cover and cook on low flame, stirring in between. Till the tomato becomes soft.

- Now add the whole garlic and the cut bhindi and mix it in well. Stir fry for few minutes

- Then cook on medium to low flame and let the bhindi cook without cover. Cook till done

- Serve with roti and raita or dal.

name: No Fuss Chilli Chicken
ingredients:
- 300-400 gms of boneless chicken (cut chicken in cubes)

Marination for chicken

- 1 tbsp garlic grated

- ½ tsp pepper powder

- salt to taste

- 1 tbsp finely chopped coriander leaves

- ½ an egg (only white)

- 1 tsp cornflour

- mix all of the above ingredients together and keep aside for 15-20 minutes

Remaining ingredients

- 3-4 tbsp of oil

- 1 tsp chopped garlic

- 1 tsp chopped ginger

- 1 bell pepper cubed

- 1 onion cut into 4

- few chopped green chillies

- 2 tbsp of chopped spring onions

- 1 tsp dark soya sauce

- 1 tsp vinegar

- pinch of pepper

- ½-1 tsp of sugar

- salt to taste (keeping in mind that soya sauce has salt and in the marination Salt has been put )

- pinch of cornflour mixed in 4-5 tbsp of water
method:
- In a pan put 2 tbsp of oil.

- Heat the oil, when the oil is hot place the chicken pieces one by one in the pan.

- When one side becomes little brown.

- Flip the side and cook till it is brown(can cook in air fryer also). When done keep aside.

- In the same pan add the remaining oil. Heat the oil, when the oil is warm.

- Add the chopped garlic and ginger. Stir fry till the change colour to a beige brown.

- Add the cubed bell pepper. Stir fry for few seconds.

- Add the cut green chillies. Stir fry for a minute or so.

- Add the cubed onions. Now add the sugar ,pepper and salt. Stir fry for few seconds.

- Then add the soya sauce and vinegar. Stir it in well.

- Now add the stir fried chicken. Mix everything together. Now put the cornflour water and mix it in well while scraping the sauce from the pan.

- Add the chopped spring onions. Mix it in.

- Done.

- Serve with Fried Rice or paratha.

name: Roasted Karela Ki Sabzi (Bitter Gourd)
ingredients:
- 300-400 gms of kerela

- ½ tsp whole coriander seeds

- ¼ tsp asafoetida

- 1 onion grated/chopped /sliced

- 1 tomato grated

- 1 tsp chopped garlic

- 1 tsp grated ginger

- salt to taste

- pinch of turmeric powder

- red chilli powder to taste

- ½ tsp coriander powder

- ½ tsp aamchur powder(dry mango)

- 1 tsp dry kasturi methi leaves (optional)

- 3 tbsp of mustard oil/refined oil
method:
- Take a wire mesh place on the flame, place the karela on it and roast. Keep turning it so that all sides get roasted nicely.

- When done wash the karela well, pat dry and then cut in round thin slices. Keep aside.

- Take a pan, add the oil. Warm the oil a little.

- Add the whole coriander and asafoetida. Stir for a minute or so.

- Add the chopped garlic and grated ginger. Stir fry till the raw smell of the ginger garlic goes.

- Add the onion and stir fry till translucent.

- Then add the turmeric and chilli powder. Saute for few minutes.

- Now add the grated tomato. Saute till the water from the tomato dries up.

- Add the coriander and amchur powder. Saute for few minutes.

- Add the salt and saute for few minutes. Can add 2-3 tbsp of water to saute.

- Now add the cut karela and saute for few minutes.

- Add 2-3 tbsp of water. Cover and cook on low flame till the karela is cooked. Keep stirring in between.

- When the karela is done add the dry kasturi methi leaves. Mix it in well.

- Cover and keep for a minute or so. Done.

- Serve with roti.

name: Khara Masala Mince
ingredients:
- 500 gms mince (of your choice)

- 2 chopped onions

- 1 tbsp of grated ginger and garlic

- 3 tbsp of yogurt

- pinch of turmeric powder

- red chilli powder to taste

- ¼ tsp kashmiri chilli powder

- ¼ tsp garam masala powder

- 4 green cardamom

- 4 cloves

- 2 pcs of cinnamon of 1 pc each

- few whole round red chillies

- few chopped green chillies

- 2pc ginger julienne

- 2 tbsp finely chopped coriander leaves

- ½ lime juice

- 3 tbsp of oil/50-50 oil and ghee

To be pounded coarsely together

- 1 tsp whole cumin

- 1 tsp whole coriander

- 1 ½ tsp whole black peppercorns

- pound the above together and keep aside
method:
- Take a kadhai.

- Add the oil/ghee. When it is warm.

- Add the chopped onions. Stir fry till translucent.

- Then add the mince and saute for few minutes.

- Add the turmeric powder and stir fry for few minutes.

- Now add the grated ginger-garlic and saute for few minutes ,till the raw smell of the ginger garlic goes.

- Cover and cook the mince on low flame for 7-10 minutes, stirring in between.

- Add the cloves, cardamom and cinnamon sticks. Saute for few minutes on medium flame.

- By now the water from the mince would have dried up. Saute mince on low flame.

- Add the coarsely pounded coriander, cumin and peppercorns. Mix it in well and saute for 5-7 minutes.

- Add the whole round red chillies. Now add the salt and mix it on well.

- Add the yogurt and saute for few minutes. Then add the red chilli powder, kashmiri red chilli powder and garam masala.

- Mix it in well and saute for 5-7 minute.

- Can keep adding 2-3 tbsp of water when required to saute, so that the masala does not catch.

- Now add 1 cup of water and let it come to a boil.

- Then lower the flame and cover and cook the mince till done.

- When the mince is cooked add the chopped green chillies, chopped coriander leaves, ginger julienne and lime juice. Mix it in well.

- Cook for few minutes to infuse what we put last.

- Cover and keep on low flame for few minutes.

- Done.

- Serve with roti/tandoori roti.

name: Spinach Chakli
ingredients:
For the chakli

- ⅔ cup besan

- 1 cup spinach finely chopped

- ½ tsp whole cumin

- ½ tsp chilli flakes

- pinch of turmeric

- salt to taste

- ⅔ cup water
method:
- Mix all of the above together ,beat it for few minutes gently and keep aside for 15-20 minutes.

- Then take a flat plate ,grease the plate and pour the besan mixture into it.

- Spread it evenly, place it on a pan of boiling water cover the plate and steam it till done.

- Cut in cubes and keep aside.

Remaining Ingredients

- 1 tbsp of ghee

- ¼ tsp cumin seeds

- pinch of asafoetida

- 1 medium size onion chopped

- 1 tsp ginger garlic paste

- 1 tomato grated

- few chopped green chillies (optional)

- salt to taste

- ½ tsp coriander powder

- ½ tsp kashmiri red chilli powder

- ¼ tsp turmeric powder

- 1 cup of chopped spinach

Method

- In a pan add the ghee.

- When the ghee becomes warm.

- Add the whole cumin When it starts spluttering.

- Add the asafoetida. Stir for few seconds.

- Add the chopped onion. Stir fry for few minutes.

- Add the ginger garlic paste. Saute for few minutes till the raw smell of the ginger garlic goes.

- Now put the chopped green chillies and saute for a minute or so.

- Then add the grated tomato. Saute for few minutes.

- Add salt, turmeric, red chilli and coriander powder. Saute till the water of the tomato dries up.

- When the masala becomes nice and soft.

- Add 5-6 tbsp of water and let it cook.

- Now add the chopped spinach. Stir it all in mix nicely. Saute for few minutes.

- Add 1 cup of water, when it comes to a boil.

- Add the steamed besan chaklis.

- Mix it in gently.

- When the gravy starts bubbling Cover and cook on low flame for 10-12 minutes.

- Keep stirring in between gently so that the chakli gets infused with the masala of the gravy. Done.

Note

- Gravy can be adjusted according to taste.

name: Spinach Stems, Carrots And White Radish Subzi
ingredients:
- 1 bunch of stems (cut roots an cut into 2 pieces, wash and keep aside)

- 1 bid carrot cut into vertical pieces of 2 each

- 1 radish cut into vertical pieces of 2 " each

- 1 sweet potato cut into vertical pieces (optional)

- few whole green chillies according to taste

- 1 tsp panch phoren

- few cut whole red chillies

- 1 bay leaf

- salt to taste

- pinch of turmeric powder

- pinch of red chilli powder

- ½ tsp sugar

- 3 tbsp of mustard oil/refined oil
method:
- In a kadhai put the oil ,heat the oil. When the oil is hot ,add the panch phoren.

- When it starts spluttering add the cut whole red chillies and bay leaf.

- Add all the vegetables one by one stirring in between.

- Add the salt,turmeric, sugar and red chilli powder. Stir for few minutes.

- Cover and cook on low flame till the vegetables are done. Done.

- Serve with dal and rice.

Note

- Can add 2-3 small brinjals cut in cubes ,with the other vegetables and cook together.

name: Khatta Meetha Cabbage Ki Sabzi
ingredients:
- ½ a medium size cabbage shredded

- 1 carrot cut into matchstick pieces

- 1 capsicum sliced thin

- 2 red peppers cut vertically

- 1 onion sliced

- few slitted green chillies

- 10-12 pieces of curry patta

- ½ tsp whole big mustard seeds

- ½ lime juice

- salt to taste

- pinch of turmeric

- 1 ½ tsp of sugar

- 2 tbsp of oil
method:
- Take a pan and add the oil to the pan.

- Let the oil become warm. When it becomes warm add the mustard seeds.

- When the mustard seeds start spluttering. Then add the curry patta and stir fry for 30-40 seconds.

- Then add the sliced onions. Stir fry the onions for a minute or so.

- Now add the green chillies to the onions and mix it in. Then add the carrots and stir it in.

- Now add the capsicum to the pan and mix it in well.

- Add the cabbage to the pan and gently mix all the vegetables together.

- Immediately add the salt, turmeric and sugar to the vegetables in the pan. Mix everything in together well.

- Keep the flame full, the cabbage should not leave water.

- Keep stirring the vegetables the water that is released will simultaneously dry up.

- The vegetables need to be little crunchy.

- Finally add the lime juice, mix it in throughly with the vegetables.

- Done.

name: Chicken With French Beans
ingredients:
Marinate

- 300-400 gms boneless chicken cut in cubes

- ½ tsp sesame oil

- pinch of salt

- ¼ tsp blackpepper powder

- ¼ tsp ginger powder

- ½ an egg

- 1 tsp cornflour

- marinate the above and keep aside

Remaining ingredients

- 200-300 gms of french beans, cut vertically then cut into 2

- 2-3 red peppers sliced vertically

- 1 big onion sliced thick

- ½ cup scallions cut into 2 pieces

- 5-6 pounded whole garlic

- 2 tsp chopped garlic

- 1 tsp chilli flakes or according to taste

- 3-4 tbsp of oil

For the sauce mix together and keep aside

- 3 tsp light soya sauce

- 1 tsp oyster sauce

- ½ tsp dark soya sauce

- ½ tsp cornflour

- ½ tsp sugar

- 5-6 tbsp of water
method:
- In a pan add 2 tbsp oil and let it become hot.

- Then place the chicken pieces on it one by one. Let it cook and get brown on the bottom, then flip the side and repeat the same.

- When both sides are gets and becomes a little brown. Remove and keep aside.

- In the same pan add the remaining oil and let it get warm.

- When the oil is warm add the pounded pods of garlic. Stir fry for a minute or so Then add the french beans and stir fry for few minutes.

- When you have stirred fried the beans for few minutes.

- Add the chopped garlic and stir fry for few minutes. Now add the thickly sliced onion and stir fry for a minute or so.

- Then add the salt and red chilli flakes and stir fry for 20-30 seconds.

- After that add the red peppers and stir fry for few minutes Add 1-2 tsp of vinegar and mix it in well.

- Now add the cooked chicken Mix it in with the vegetables. Then add the sauce on it and mix it in.

- Lastly add the cut scallions. Stir for a minute or so.

- Done, ready to serve.

name: Lobia And Chana Chat
categories: Evening Snack, Sim's Family Recipes, Ramzan Specials
ingredients:
- ⅔ cup boiled lobia

- ⅔ cup boiled chickpeas

- 1 big tomato chopped small minus the pulp

- 1 onion chopped

- few green chillies chopped according to taste

- 2 tbsp chopped coriander leaves

- 1 potato boiled and cut in cubes

- ½ lime juice

- salt to taste

- 1 tsp red chilli flakes or according to taste

- 4 tbsp of tamarind pulp

- ½ tsp black salt

- ½-1 tsp chat masala

- ¼ tsp of roasted cumin powder (optional)
method:
- Mix all of the above ingredients together, adjust salt, chilly and sour according to personal taste.

- Note can keep tamarind pulp ready.

- Soak lemon size ball in 1 -2 cups of water soak for sometime.

- Remove the seeds then cook thee pulp for 5-7 minutes on low fame after it starts bubbling.

- Can store for 2-3 weeks.

name: Peanut With Chilli Flakes Fried Rice
ingredients:
- 1 cup rice

- 1 carrot cut into small cubes

- 1 big scallion cut in to small pieces (head the white part to be cut and kept separate)

- 2 tsp chopped garlic

- 1 tsp chilli flakes (can put more or less according to taste)

- ¼ cup plain peanuts

- salt to taste

- ½ tsp sugar

- 2-3 tbsp of oil

For the sauce

- 2 teaspoon light soya

- ½ tsp dark soya

- 1 tsp oyster sauce

- ¼ tsp vinegar

- ½ tsp sesame oil

- ½ tsp sugar

- mix the above and keep aside
method:
Rice

- Wash and boil the rice to 90% as on cooking it will become softer.

- Boil and keep aside, preferably use rice made 1 day before.

- Take a kadhai /wok.

- Put the oil in the wok and heat it.

- When the oil is warm on full flame, add the chopped garlic and stir fry for 30-40 seconds.

- Add the white part of the scallion and stir fry for 20-30 seconds.

- Now add the cut carrot and stir fry for a minute or so.

- Then add the boiled rice and mix it in.

- Immediately add the scallion green part. Mix it in.

- Now add the sauce and mix it in stirring gently

- Can bring the flame to medium and stir fry the rice.

- Add the peanuts, chilli flakes, sugar and salt to taste.

- Mix everything in together gently and stir fry for few minutes. Done.

- Serve with any stir fry vegetable.

name: Cauliflower, Cauliflower Stem, Long Beans And Long Radish Sabzi
ingredients:
- ½ cauliflower cut into florets

- stem of cauliflower cut into 1"pieces

- 3-4 long beans cut into 1 pieces

- 1 radish cut into 1"pieces

- few slitted whole green chillies

- salt to taste

- ½ tsp sugar

- ¼ tsp turmeric

- ½ tsp red chilli powder

- 1 tsp grated ginger

- ½ tsp panch phoren

- 2-3 whole red chillies

- 2-3 bay leaves

- 2 tbsp mustard oil (can use refined oil as well)

To be ground to a paste

- 1 tbsp of yellow mustard seeds

- 2 green chillies and keep aside
method:
- Take a kadhai and add the oil to it.

- When the oil becomes hot add the panch phoren and whole red chillies.

- When it starts to splutter and you get a nice fragrance.

- Add all the cut vegetables and the whole green chillies. Stir fry for 4-5 minutes.

- Then add the salt, red chilli powder and turmeric mix it in well.

- Cover and cook till the vegetables are more than half done.

- Now add the mustard and green chillies paste and 3-4 tbsp of water. Mix it in throughly

- Then add the sugar. Mix it in and stir fry for few minutes.

- Cover and cook till done.

name: Brinjal And Peas Sabzi
ingredients:
brinjal

- 1 big brinjal to be cut vertically into 2 pieces

- then take a pan add 2 tsp of mustard oil/refined oil, heat the oil

- when the oil gets warm add the cut brinjal and stir fry

- cook till it the brinjal is ¾ done

- remove the brinjal from the pan and keep aside

Chana Dal

- 2 tbsp of chana dal

- take a pan and roast the chana dal and keep

Ground to a paste

- 1 medium size onion+ 2-3 green chillies + 5-6 pods of garlic, 1 pc ginger and keep aside

- then separately grind

- ½ cup chopped coriander and

- the roasted channa dal, grind to a smooth paste and keep aside .

Pound

- 1 tsp whole cumin

- 1 tsp whole coriander seeds

- coarsely pound the cumin and coriander and keep aside

Remaining ingredients

- ½ cups peas (If fresh blanch and keep aside ,can use frozen also )

- 1 medium size tomato grated

- 2 tbsp of mustard oil/refined oil

- ¼ tsp asafoetida

- ¼ tsp turmeric powder

- ¼ tsp chat masala

- ½ tsp sugar

- 1 ½ tsp kasturi methi leaves
method:
- Take a kadhai or pan add the oil.

- When the oil gets warm.

- Add the asafoetida and the pounded cumin and coriander powder. Stir for 30-40 seconds.

- Now add the onion, ginger, garlic and green chillies paste. Saute till the raw smell goes.

- Keep adding 2-3 tbsp of water as and when required whenever the masala starts catching.

- By now the masala would have changed to a nice beige brown colour.

- Now add the coriander and chana dal paste. Saute for a minute or so then add the salt ,turmeric, chat masala.

- Add few tbsp of water so that the masala does not burn. Saute for a minute or so.

- Add the grated tomato and saute till the water of the tomato dries up. Then add ½ cup water let it come to a boil.

- Add the peas. Stir for a minute then add the brinjal and mix it in.

- Cover and cook for few minutes on low flame till brinjal is done.

- Then add the sugar and stir it in. Lastly add the kasturi methi leaves and mix it in.

- Cover and cook for few minutes. Done.

- Serve with roti /paratha.

name: Jhatpat Chicken
ingredients:
Marinate

- 300-400 chicken in ½ lime and ½ tsp red chilli powder for 15-20 minutes

- then add to the chicken 3 tbsp of curd

- 1 tsp ginger-garlic paste

- ¼ tsp garam masala

- ¼ tsp black salt

- ¼ tsp cumin powder

- ¼ tsp coriander powder

- ½ tsp chilli powder

- 1 tbsp of mustard oil

- marinate the chicken with the above and keep aside for 20-30 minutes

Remaining Ingredients

- 2 tbsp oil/ghee

- 1-2 cinnamon stick of 1 pc

- 2 green cardamom

- 3-4 cloves

- 1 big onion sliced
method:
- Take a kadhai add the ghee/oil.

- When the ghee/oil becomes warm.

- Add the cinnamon, cloves and cardamom. After few seconds, when a nice fragrance starts emitting.

- Add the sliced onion. Stirring fry onion till it becomes beige brown.

- Then add the marinated chicken. Saute for few minutes.

- Cover and cook on low flame till the chicken is cooked.

- Can make it dry or keep a little gravy. This is on personal preference. Done

- Serve with tandoori roti.

name: Marinated Stir Fry Chicken Tikka
ingredients:
- 500gms boneless chicken

- marinate and keep aside for 20-30 minutes (Cut chicken in small cubes and marinate chicken with 3 tbsp of curd ,1 tsp of ginger-garlic paste, salt to taste, red chilli powder to taste, ½-1 tsp Kashmiri chilli powder and juice of half a lime)

Remaing Ingredients

- 3 medium size onions sliced

- 1 tsp garlic paste

- 1 tsp ginger paste

- 2 medium size tomatoes sliced

- 2 capsicum sliced

- 3-4 slit green chillies

- salt to taste, keeping in mind that salt has also been added to the marination

- red chilli powder to taste

- ¼ tsp of turmeric powder

- 3-4 tbsp of oil
method:
- Take a kadhai add 2 tbsp of oil.

- Warm the oil ,when the oil is warm add the marinated chicken and stir fry for few minutes.

- Then cover and cook ,stirring in between, till the chicken is totally cooked.

- Remove the chicken from the kadhai and keep aside.

- Now in the same kadhai add the remaining oil.

- When the oil becomes a little warm.

- Add te sliced onions and stir fry till translucent

- Then add the ginger-garlic paste and saute till the raw smell of the ginger garlic goes.

- Now add the sliced tomatoes, salt ,turmeric and red chilli powder. Saute till the tomatoes become soft.

- Then add the sliced capsicum and stir fry for few minutes.

- Add the slit green chillies and stir fry for few minutes till the capsicum is half done.

- Finally add the cooked chicken and mix everything in together gently.

- Keep on low flame for few minutes. Stir in between. Done.

name: Stir Fried Vegetables In Gravy
ingredients:
- ½ medium size cauliflower cut into florets

- ½ medium size cabbage cut into big pieces

- 1 big carrot cut in diagonal circles

- 7-8 flat beans

- 2 scallions (head and stem cut into 1/2" pcs and kept seperately)

- 1 ½ tbsp ginger julienne

- 5-6 pounnded garlic pods

- 2 medium onions sliced thickly

- salt to taste

- 1 tsp sugar

- 1 tbsp of black pepper powder

- 2 cup vegetable stock

- 1 tsp cornflour (mix in 5-6 tbsp of water and keep aside)

- 3-4 tbsp of oyster sauce

- 2 tbsp oil
method:
- Add the oil to a wok/kadhai.

- When it becomes hot. Add the sliced onions. Stir fry for few seconds.

- Then put the ginger julienne and mix it in. To this add the white part of the scallion and stir fry for few seconds.

- Add the pounded garlic and stir fry for 30-40 seconds.

- Now add the vegetables one by one carrot, cauliflower, flat beans, cabbage. Stirring for few seconds in between.

- Add salt to taste (keeping in mind that the sauce and the stock have salt).

- Add sugar then add to the vegetables blackpepper powder and mix it in well. Stir fry for 30-40 seconds.

- Then add the oyster sauce and mix it in well. Now boil the vegetable stock and add it in
Vegetables should b a little crunchy.

- When the stock starts bubbling. Add the cornflour slurry and keep stirring.

- The gravy will gradually start to thicken. Add the cut green scallions and mix it in. Done. Can have with plain rice or toast.

Note

- Can add chicken those who would like to, 300 gms of boneless chicken.

- Chicken has to be cut in thick strips and marinated with salt, pepper and 1 tsp garlic paste.

- Marinate and keep aside for 20-30 minutes.

- Then take a wok add 2 tbsp of oil.

- Heat the oil, when the oil is hot add the chicken.

- Cook on full flame.

- Do not stir the chicken, let one side cook then flip the side.

- When both sides have changed colour then can stir fry and cook the chicken to 3/4 done.

- After all the vegetables have been put add the chicken and mix it in.

- Instead of vegetable stock can use chicken stock.

- Let the chicken cook with the vegetables.

- Rest procedure same.

name: Lobia Curry
ingredients:
- 1 cup beans (raw)

- 2-3 tbsp of oil/ghee

- 2 medium size onions chopped

- 1 big tomato chopped

- 1 tsp heaped ginger-garlic paste

- salt to taste

- ½ tsp whole cumin

- ½ tsp turmeric powder

- ½ tsp red chilli powder

- ½ tsp kashmiri red chilli powder

- 2 tsp dry kasturi methi leaves

- ½ lime juice

- 1 tbsp of chopped coriander leaves
method:
- Take a pan /kadhai.

- Add the oil/ghee to the pan.

- When the oil/ghee is warm add the whole cumin seeds, when it starts splutter add the chopped onions. Saute till the onions become beige brown.

- Then add the ginger garlic paste and saute till the raw smell of the ginger garlic goes.

- Keep adding 2-3 tbsp of water to the pan if it is getting caught at the bottom.

- Then add the chopped tomato and saute till the tomato becomes soft.

- Add the salt, turmeric and red chilli powders and saute for few minutes.

- Then add 2-3 tbsp of water, cover the pan and cook for few minutes.

- Tomato should become totally mushy.

- Now add the kasturi methi leaves and saute for few minutes.

- Then add the cooked beans and the water with it. Mix it in well with the masala.

- Once the gravy starts bubbling Cover and cook on low flame for 5-7 minutes so that the gravy infuses with the masala.

- At this point with a flat spoon can mash little bit of the beans ,which gives a thickness to the gravy.

- Next, when the gravy becomes a little thick.

- Add the lime juice and mix it in well.

- Cook for few minutes.

- Add the chopped coriander leaves. Mix it in.

- Done. Serve with rice & raita.

Note
Short cut Method

- Saute the masala totally, when the masala is ready then add the soaked beans to the masala. Saute for few minutes.

- Add 3 cups of water (more or less depending on the gravy you would like)and cook for 15-20 minutes after the first whistle on low flame. Let the cooker open naturally.

- Done .

name: Ridge Gourd With Poppy Seeds (Khuskhus)
ingredients:
- 1 kg ridge gourd (peel and cut in the centre vertical then cut in 1 pieces like a d)

- 2 whole slitted green chillies

- 1 tsp onion seeds

- 3 tbsp mustard oil/refined oil

- ¼ tsp turmeric powder

- salt to taste

- red chilli powder to taste

- 1 tsp sugar

Grind to a smooth paste

- 2 tbsp of poppy seeds

- 2 whole green chillies and keep aside
method:
- Take a kadhai/pan add the oil to it.

- Heat the oil, when it becomes hot.

- Then we add the onion seeds and the whole slitted green chillies. Stir for few seconds ,when it starts emitting a fragrance.

- Immediately add the cut ridge gourd. Mix it in nicely and stir fry for a minute or so.

- Now add the turmeric powder, red chilli powder and salt to taste. Stir fry for few minutes.

- Cover and cook on low flame but keep stirring in between.

- No need to add water as the ridge gourd will start releasing its own water.

- When the ridge gourd is cooked 70-80%.

- Add the poppy seed and green chilli paste. Stir fir few minutes, then add 1 tsp sugar.

- Mix it in well and cover and cook on low flame till the ridge gourd is cooked.

- If any water is left make the flame and dry it ,leaving just a hint of gravy.

- Not to make it completely dry.

- Done.

name: Dadima'S Special Simple Shalgam (Turnip)
ingredients:
- 500gms turnip (peeled and cut in circles)

- salt to taste

- ¼ tsp turmeric powder

- ½ tsp chilli flakes

- 1 tbsp makkai ka atta

- 1-2 tsp ghee/white butter

- ¼ cup of water
method:
- Take a cooker, put the cut turnip in it.

- Add salt, turmeric and ¼ cup water.

- Close the lid of the cooker and cook it till one whistle.

- Switch off flame after one whistle.

- Let the cooker open naturally. When the cooker opens check if the turnip has become soft. If not cook according to requirement.

- On opening the cooker mash the turnip with a whipper or fork.

- Add the red chilli flakes and ghee/white butter.

- Check the salt.

- Done.

Notes

- Can have with paratha or on a toast with a fried egg on top.

- We use to have it for breakfast.

name: Perfect Jodi Sabzi - White And Orange Pumpkin
ingredients:
- 250 gms orange pumpkin (cut in cubes)

- 250 gms white pumpkin (cut in cubes)

- ¼ tsp asafoetida

- 1 tsp whole cumin

- ½ tsp fenugreek seeds

- 2-3 whole red chillies

- 3 tbsp chopped coriander leaves

- 1½ tsp kasturi methi leaves

- ½ tsp coriander powder

- ½ tsp cumin powder

- ½ tsp dry mango powder

- 1 tsp red chilli flakes

- ½ tsp turmeric powder

- pinch of black salt

- ½-1 tsp sugar

- salt to taste

- 3 tbsp mustard oil/refined oil
method:
- Take a pan/kadhai add the oil.

- Warm the oil.

- When the oil becomes warm Add the whole cumin, fenugreek seeds, asafoetida and whole red chillies. Stir fry for 30-40 seconds.

- Add 2 tbsp of chopped coriander leaves. Stir fry for few seconds.

- Then add the cut pumpkin mix it in well. Stir fry for few minutes.

- Then cover and cook on low flame stirring in between.

- When it is half done. Add the cumin, coriander, dry mango powder, red chilli flakes, dry kasturi methi leaves and salt to taste. Mix everything in well together.

- Cover and cook till the pumpkin is totally cooked.

- Add the sugar and cook for few minutes. End by putting 1 tbsp of chopped coriander leaves.

- Done

name: Makhana(Fox Nuts), Mattar (Green Peas) And Mushroom Yummy Mix
ingredients:
Makhana

- 1 cup makhana

- take a kadhai add 1-2 tsp of ghee, when the ghee gets warm. Add the makhana and roast it till it turns beige and becomes crisp. Remove and keep aside

Mushrooms

- 8-10 mushrooms cut into 4 pieces each of them

- in the same kadhai add 1-2 tsp of oil, when the oil becomes warm

- add the cut mushrooms and stir fry in full flame ,so that it does not leave water

- when the mushrooms becomes a little soft, remove from the kadhai and keep aside

Peas

- ½ cup peas

- If using fresh peas then need to cook it 75% and keep aside

- If using frozen peas. Stir fry in the kadhai with 1 tsp of oil for a minute or so and keep aside.

For the masala

- 1 ½ onions sliced

- 6-8 pods of garlic

- 1 pc ginger cut into pieces

- 2 tbsp of cashew

- 1 tbsp of melon seeds

- 1 piece of cinnamon stick

- 2 pieces of green cardamom

- In the same kadhai add 1 ½ tbsp of oil

- Add the cardamom and cinnamon. Stir for few seconds then.

- Add the sliced onions and stir fry till it becomes beige.

- Then add the garlic pods and the cut ginger and stir fry till the raw smell of the ginger garlic goes.

- Now add the cashew and melon seeds to the kadhai and stir fry till they are roasted in the masala. Remove and keep aside.

- When this mixture cools down.

- Put in a grinder and make it into a smooth paste. Keep the paste aside.

- In a bowl put 2 tbsp of curd, salt to taste ,pinch of turmeric, 2 tsp of kashmiri chilli powder, 2 tbsp of dry kasturi leaves and 1 tsp coriander powder, mix it all in together well. Keep this mixture aside.

Remaining ingredients

- 1 tsp whole cumin

- few slitted green chillies

- 1 tsp dry kasturi methi leaves

- ½ tsp sugar

- 2 tbsp of ghee
method:
- Take a pan add the ghee, when the ghee becomes warm.

- Add the whole cumin, slitted green chillies and the kasturi methi leaves. Stir fry till the cumin starts spluttering.

- Then add the cashew onion paste and saute fir 5-7 minutes on low to medium flame.

- Now add the curd and masala mixture and saute for 5-10 minutes on low flame.

- In the masala add the stir fried mushrooms and peas. Stir in in well with the masala.

- Then had the roasted makhana and mix it in well together. Cook on low flame for few minutes.

- Now add 1-1½ cups of warm water. Mix it in well so that the masala infuses with the water.

- Let the makhana cook in it. Now add the sugar, mix it in.

- Cook on low flame till the gravy thickens. Done.

name: Chicken And Cauliflower Masala
ingredients:
- 500gms chicken

- 1 big cauliflower cut into florets

- 1 medium size onion sliced

- 1 medium size onion grated

- 1 ½ medium size tomatoes chopped

- 1 tbs of ginger garlic paste

- salt to taste

- ¼ tsp turmeric powder

- 2 tsp kashmiri red chilli powder

- ½ tsp cumin powder

- ½ tsp coriander powder

- 1 piece cinnamon stick

- 2 green cardamom

- 2-3 cloves
method:
- Take a kadhai add 2 tsp of oil. Swirl the kadhai around with the oil.

- Warm the oil then add the cut florets. Stir fry till slightly beige.

- Then remove and keep aside. In the same kadhai add the remaining oil.

- Heat the oil.

- Add the cinnamon stick, cardamom and cloves. Stir for few seconds then add the sliced onions. Stir fry till the onion becomes beige brown.

- Then add the ginger-garlic paste. Saute till the raw smell of the ginger garlic goes.

- Add the grated onion and saute till the masala becomes a nice beige brown colour.

- To this masala add the salt, red chilli powder, coriander powder and cumin powder
Saute with few tbsp of water. After sautéing for 5-7 minutes on low flame

- Add the chopped tomatoes and saute till tomato becomes totally soft.

- Then add the chicken and saute for 10-15 minutes on low flame. Can cover and cook for few minutes.

- Now add the stir fried florets and saute for 5-7 minutes. Then cover and cook till the cauliflower and chicken are cooked. Keep stirring in between.

- Add 1-2 tbsp of chopped coriander leaves. Mix it all in gently.

- Done.

- Serve with paratha/roti.

name: Red Beans And Mushroom Rice
ingredients:
- 1 cup red beans (rajma raw)

- 1 -1½ cup boiled rice(ideally one day old)

- 1 onion chopped

- 2 tsp chopped garlic

- 1 green pepper chopped

- 4-5 flat beans finely sliced

- 8-10 mushrooms cut into 4

- salt to taste

- ½ tsp cumin powder

- ½ tsp black pepper powder

- 1 tsp chilli flakes

- 3 tbsp oil
method:
- Wash and soak the red beans overnight or can soak for 7-8 hours.

- Take a pressure cooker add 3-4 cups of water.

- Put the soaked red beans in a bowl and sprinkle it with salt and place in the cooker.

- Steam the red beans for 35-40 mins on low flame after the first whistle.

- When done remove the cooker from the flame and let it open naturally.

- Remove the red beans and keep aside.

Method

- Take a pan add the the oil, when the oil gets warm.

- Add the chopped garlic and stir fry for few minutes till it starts changing colour

- Then add the chopped onions to the pan and stir fry with the garlic till the onion becomes translucent.

- Add to this the finely cut flat beans and stir fry for few minutes.

- Now add the mushrooms and stir fry for few minutes stirring constantly so that the mushrooms don't start leaving water.

- Add the cut green pepper and mix it in well and stir fry for 30-40 seconds.

- Now add the red beans to the pan and mix everything in together.

- To this add the salt, cumin powder, black pepper powder and red chilli flakes. Stir it all in well together. Cook for few minutes.

- Finally add the cooked rice stir it in gently and mix everything well in together.

- Done.

name: Mixed Vegetables In Mustard Paste
ingredients:
- 1 medium size brinjal cut into 1 pieces vertical

- 1 big sweet potato cut into cubes

- ½ a cauliflower, cut into florets

- stem and leaves of the cauliflower cut vertically

- 150-200gms of flat beans

- few green chillies

- 1½ tbsp (flat) yellow mustard seeds ground to a fine paste (when grinding the mustard seeds need to add ¼ tsp salt or 1-2 green chillies or both)

- 1 tsp panch phoren

- 2 bay leaves

- 2 whole red chillies

- 1 tbsp of ginger paste

- ½ -1 tsp of sugar

- salt to taste

- ¼ tsp turmeric powder

- ½ tsp red chilli powder

- 2 tbsp of mustard oil/refined oil
method:
- Put the oil in a kadhai, heat the oil.

- When the oil becomes hot add the bay leaves, whole red chillies and the panch phoren.

- When a nice fragrance starts emitting.

- Add the ginger paste and saute for few minutes.

- Now add the cut sweet potato. Stir fry for a minute or so.

- Then add the cut cauliflower the stem and leaves.

- Mix it in well then cover and cook for 5 -7 minutes.

- Then add the salt, turmeric and red chilli powder. Mix the masalas in by stirring the vegetables.

- Now add the flat beans and brinjal.

- Cook all the vegetables together. Stir fry for few minutes, then cover and cook on low flame till vegetables are 80% done, keep stirring in between.

- Now add the mustard paste, mix it in gently if need we can add few tbsp of water to mix everything in together.

- Cover and cook till vegetables are one.

- Lastly add the sugar and whole green chillies, mix it in gently.

- Cook on low flame for few minutes.

- Done. Serve with rice and dal.

name: Radish And Carrot Ki Sabzi
ingredients:
- 1 bid white radish (cut I the centre ,then cut in semi circles) cut the stems of the radish into thin strips and chop the leaves in to strips also

- 1 big carrot (cut in center then cut in semi circles)

- 2 tbsp of ghee /oil

- ¼ tsp asafoetida

- ¼ tsp ajwain (carom/caraway seeds)

- ¼ tsp turmeric powder

- ½ tsp chilli flakes

- ¼ tsp coriander powder

- ¼ tsp cumin powder

- ¼ tsp dry mango powder

- ¼ tsp black salt

- salt to taste
method:
- Take a pan, add the ghee. Let the ghee warm a little.

- Then add the asafoetida and the ajwain seed. Stir fry for few seconds.

- Then add to the pan turmeric powder and red chilli flakes. Stir the masala for few seconds.

- To the masala add the cut vegetables and stir fry for few minutes.

- Then add the black salt and mix it in.

- Cover and cook on low flame till the vegetables are half done.

- When the vegetables are half done add the coriander powder, cumin powder, dry mango powder and salt to taste. Stir fry for few minutes.

- Then cover and cook till the vegetables are totally done, stirring in between.
Ready to eat.

name: Pearl Onions And Chicken
ingredients:
- 500 gms chicken

Marinate chicken in

- 1 tsp ginger-garlic paste

- ¼ tsp cumin powder

- ¼ tsp coriander powder

- pinch of turmeric powder

- 1 tsp kashmiri red chilli

- ½ tsp garam masala

- 1 ½ tsp kasturi methi leaves

- 3 tbsp yogurt

- mix all of the above with the chicken and keep aside for 20-30 minutes

Remaining ingredients

- 2 bay leaves

- 1 black cardamom

- 2 green cardamom

- 1 pc cinnamon stick

- 1 tsp black peppercorns

- 2 medium size onions sliced

- 1 tomato chopped

- 2 tbsp chopped coriander leaves

- 1 tsp ginger garlic paste

- red chilli powder to taste

- salt to taste

- 2 tbsp of oil

For the tarka

- 1 tbsp of ghee /oil

- 1 tsp whole cumin and 1 tsp whole coriander coarsely pounded together

- 6-8 pearl onions

- few slitted green chillies

- 1 tbsp of ginger julienne
method:
- Take a pan /kadhai add the oil.

- Heat the oil. When the oil becomes hot add the bay leaves, black and green cardamom, cloves and cinnamon stick, stir fry for few seconds then add the sliced onions. Stir fry till onions become beige brown.

- To this masala now add the ginger-garlic paste. Saute till the raw smell of the ginger garlic goes.

- Then add the chopped tomatoes. Saute till tomatoes become soft.

- If required do add few tbsp of water to saute.

- When the masala becomes a nice reddish brown.

- Add the marinated chicken and mix it in well with the masala.

- Add salt and red chilli powder to taste and mix it all in. Saute for few minutes.

- Cover the chicken and cook on low flame, stirring in between.

- The chicken will leave its own water, in which the chicken will cook.

- When the chicken is ¾ done remove the cover and saute till done.

- Then finally add the tarka then it's done.

For the tarka

- Take a pan add 1 tbsp of oil/ghee.

- Warm the oil/ghee, when it is warm.

- Add the coarsely pounded coriander and whole cumin seeds. To this add the pearl onions. Stir fry for few minutes.

- Then add the ginger julienne. Stir fry for few minutes.

- Lastly add the whole slitted green chillies. Stir fry everything together for few minutes.

- Now add this to the chicken and mix it in well, Saute for few minutes on low flame so that the onions become little translucent.

- Lastly add chopped coriander leaves. Mix it in.

- Ready.

name: Cottage Cheese With Mixed Vegetables
ingredients:
- 200-250 gms of cottage cheese, cut into thick strips

- 150 gms of french beans cut into thin strips of 2

- 1 big carrot cut into strips of 2

- 1 red pepper cut in strips

- 1 green pepper cut in strips

- 1 onion cut into 4 pieces

- 1 tomato cut into 8 pieces

- few slitted green chillies

- 1 onion chopped

- 2 tsp of ginger chopped

- 2 tsp of garlic chopped

- 1 ½ tomato grated

- salt to taste

- red chilli powder to taste

- ½ tsp tomato sauce

- 1 tbsp yogurt

- 1 ½ tbsp of dry kasturi methi leaves

- ½ tsp sugar

- ½ tsp coriander powder

- ½ tsp onion seeds

- ½ tsp whole cumin

- 2 whole red chillies

- 3 tbsp of oil
method:
- Take a pan add ½ tbsp of oil.

- Heat the oil.

- When the oil gets warm add ¼ tsp of onion seeds and ¼ tsp of whole cumin.

- When it starts spluttering, place the cottage cheese strips and let it turn to a beige colour.

- Flip the side and do the same.

- When done remove the cottage cheese from the pan and keep aside.

- In the same pan add ½ tbsp of oil.

- Heat the oil, when the oil becomes warm

- Add the cut carrots, beans and stir fry for few minutes.

- Then add the cut red and green peppers and stir fry for few minutes.

- When the vegetables are 75% done. Remove and keep aside.

- In the same pan add the remaining oil.

- Heat the oil, when the oil becomes warm.

- Add the remaining onion seeds and whole cumin seeds, when the seeds start spluttering, add the chopped onions and stir fry for few minutes.

- Now add the chopped garlic and ginger and stir fry till the onions become beige brown in colour and the ginger-garlic become soft.

- Now add the grated tomato. And saute till the water from the tomato dries up.

- Add the whole red chillies and stir fry for few minutes.

- Now add the red chilli powder and the coriander powder. Saute for few minutes
Can add 3-4 tbsp of water to saute.

- Now add the tomato sauce, mix it in well. Cover and cook on low flame for few minutes do stir in between.

- Now add the cut onion, tomato and slitted green chillies. Mix it in well in the masala and saute for few minutes.

- Add the yogurt mixed in 5-6 tbsp of water. Mix it in well and saute fir few minutes.

- Add the dried kasturi methi leaves and stir for few minutes.

- Finally add the cottage cheese strips and the vegetables. Mix it in all together and stir fry for few minutes.

- Then cover and cook on low flame for 5-7 minutes so that the vegetables and cottage cheese infuses with the masala.

- Done.

name: Dahiwala Keema
ingredients:
- 500 gms of mince

- 1 onion grated

- 1 tbsp of ginger-garlic paste

- 1 tsp whole cumin pounded

- 1 tsp whole coriander pounded

- few green chillies pounded

- salt to taste

- ¼ tsp black salt

- red chilli powder to taste

- ½ tsp red chilli flakes

- ½ tsp garam masala

- ½ tsp chat masala

- ½ tsp blackpepper powder

- ½ cup yogurt

- mix all of the above in the mince and keep aside for 20-30 minutes

Remaining ingredients

- 3 tbsp of mustard oil/refined oil

- 1 onion sliced

- 2 bay leaves

- 2 cinnamon stick of 1 each

- 2 green cardamom

- 4 cloves
method:
- Take a kadhai add the oil.

- Heat the oil, when the oil becomes hot add the bay leaves, cardamom, cloves and cinnamon stick. Stir for 30-40 seconds.

- Then add the sliced onions and stir fry till they become beige brown.

- Now add the marinated mince to the kadhai and saute for 5-7 minutes

- Cover and cook the mince on low flame till done, keep stirring in between

- No need to add water as the mince and yogurt will leave water.

- When the water dries saute on low flame till the mince turns light brown.

- Done.

name: Coriander Stir Fry Chicken
ingredients:
- 300-400 gms boneless chicken

Marinate chicken in

- ½ tsp sesame oil

- ½ tsp sugar

- ½ tsp chilli flakes

- ½ tsp light soya

- pinch of salt

- marinate the chicken in the above ingredients together and keep aside

Remaining ingredients

- 1 piece ginger, cut into thin round slices

- 8-10 garlic pods chopped into little big pieces

- 2-4 fresh red chillies cut diagonally into little big pieces

- 10-12 whole peppercorns

- ¼-½ tsp coarsely pounded blackpepper

- 1 tsp light soya sauce

- 1 tbsp oyster sauce

- 1 cup coriander stems cut into 1-2 pieces

- ¼ cup coarsely cut leaves

- 1 tbsp coriander roots pounded

- salt to taste

- ½ tsp sugar

- 2-3 tbsp of oil
method:
- Take a pan and add the oil to the pan.

- Warm the oil a little and when the oil gets warm.

- Add the whole peppercorns and the coarsely pounded blackpepper.

- Then add to the blackpepper the chopped garlic and stir fry for few seconds.

- To this add the cut red chillies and ginger slices, stir fry for few minutes.

- When you see the garlic changing color.

- Add the marinated chicken and mix it well. Stir fry for few minutes ,then add the pounded coriander roots and mix it in.

- Now add the oyster sauce and mix it throughly with the chicken and all the other ingredients in the pan.

- Add the light soya sauce and mix it in well nicely.

- Now cover and cook the chicken for few minutes on low flame. Keep stirring in between.

- Then add salt to taste and the sugar.

- Mix it in all nicely stir fry for few seconds.

- Then cover and cook till chicken is 90%. Done.

- Open the cover and add the coriander stems and leaves to the chicken

- Mix the coriander stem and leaves with the chicken and cook till chicken is done.
Serve with plain rice /fried rice/noodles .

name: Pepper Chicken With Vegetables
ingredients:
- 300-400 gms boneless chicken

Marinate chicken in

- ½ an egg

- pinch of salt

- ½ tsp sugar

- ½ tsp chilli flakes

- ½-1 tsp cornflour

- marinate chicken in all of the above ingredients together and keep aside for 15-20 minutes, after 15-20 minutes take a pan add 2 tbsp of oil

- heat the oil, when the oil is hot place the chicken pieces one by one and let it cook, when it becomes a beige colour, flip the side and repeat on the other side

- when the chicken is done, keep aside

Remaining ingredients

- 1 ½ tbsp oyster sauce

- 1 tsp light soya

- 1 tsp dark soya

- ½-1 tsp black pepper pounded

- 1 tbsp chopped garlic

- ½ tbsp chopped ginger

- few green chillies chopped

- few fresh red chillies chopped

- 2-3 whole red dry chillies broken into 2 pieces

- 1 bell pepper cut in cubes (any colour)

- 1-2 onions cut in 4 or small onions cut in half

- 1 carrot cut in circles

- 2 tbsp of oil

- 1 cup hot water

- 1 tsp cornflour mixed in 4-5 tbsp of water
method:
- Take a pan add the oil.

- When the oil becomes warm Add the chopped garlic and stir fry for a minute or so. Then add the chopped ginger and stir fry for 30-40 seconds.

- Next you add to the pan the cut green chillies, cut red chillies and dry red chillies. Stir fry for few seconds.

- Then add the pepper powder and stir fry for 5-7 seconds. Now add the carrot and the onions and stir fry for 30-40 seconds.

- Now add the hot water and mix everything together. Let it cook for a minute or so.

- Then add the salt and sugar ,mix it in. Now add the oyster sauce, dark soya sauce and light soya sauce. Mix everything in together.

- Then add the cut bell pepper and mix it in. When the gravy now starts bubbling add the cornflour mixture and stir well.

- The gravy will start thickening immediately ,lower the flame or else will keep becoming thicker. Add the cooked chicken and mix in gently.

- Check for salt and sugar and adjust according to taste. Done.

name: Veg Hakka Noodles With Special Sauce
ingredients:
- 4 pkts of noodles (pkts which contain individual portions, can use atta /millet noodles also) Boil the noodles and keep aside

Vegetables for the noodles

- 1 big carrot cut into matchstick pieces

- 1 bell pepper cut into thin strips

- 1 ½ cup spring onions cut into 1"pieces

- ¼ cup chopped spring onions

- 2 tsp garlic chopped

- 1 tsp ginger chopped

Note can also add finely chopped cabbage ,few minutes before removing from the flame

For the sauce to be mixed together

- 1 tsp rice wine

- 1 tsp sesame oil

- 1 tbsp oyster sauce

- 1 tsp light soya

- 1 tsp dark soya

- 1 tsp chilli flakes

- 1 tsp sugar

- salt to taste

Remaining ingredients

- 3-4 tbsp of oil

- salt to taste

- ½ tsp sugar
method:
- In a kadhai add 2 tbsp of oil, heat the oil and swirl it around.

- Then add the boiled noodles and stir fry on full flame for few minutes. Then remove and keep aside.

- In the same pan add the remaining oil.

- Heat the oil, then add the chopped garlic and ginger and stir fry for few seconds then add the it the chopped spring onions and stir fry for a minute or so.

- Then add the carrot and stir fry for few seconds.

- Then add the bell pepper and spring onions. Stir fry for few minutes.

- Now add salt to taste, sugar and pepper. Mix it in well, then add the sauce and mix it in well. Stir fry for few minutes or till all the sauce is mixed well with the noodles.

- When the sauce has been mixed nicely and the noodles are coated ,it's done.

- Serve with a gravy side dish.

Note

- Can add egg if you like.

- Take 3-4 eggs, beat it I a bowl with a pinch of salt.

- In the kadhai before starting on the noodles, add 1 tbsp oil, heat the oil and add add the eggs and make like a thick scramble.

- Mix with the noodles.

- If want to add chicken take a piece of chicken boil it in a pan with little salt and pepper.

- When the chicken is cooked place the chicken piece in a pan in 2 tsp oil, when it gets little brown Flip the side, repeat the same on the other side.

- Then add to the noodles.

name: Pyazi Bhindi
ingredients:
- 500 gms bhindi

- Cut in 1 pieces ,cut off and discard the tip and head

- Next take a kadhai add 1 tbsp of mustard oil/refined oil .Warm the oil, when the oil gets warm add the cut bhindi and cook stirring in between. Cover and cook the bhindi for some time, till the bhindi is cooked. Then remove from flame and keep aside

- 1 big onion

- 6-8 pods of garlic

- 1 tsp chopped ginger

- Cut the onion into 4 pieces and then open it up. Take a pan add 1 tsp oil, when the oil becomes warm add the onion, garlic and ginger. Stir fry till onions are ¾ done. Remove from flame and keep aside

- 3-4 tbsp of peanuts

- Take a pan add the peanuts to it, dry roast it, when done keep aside.

Ingredients for cooking

- 2 tbsp of mustard oil/refined oil

- ¼ tsp whole cumin

- ½ tsp ajwain (carom seeds)

- 3-4 whole red chillies

- 1 ½ onion chopped

- 1 tsp grated ginger-garlic

- 2 grated tomatoes

- salt to taste

- ¼ tsp turmeric powder

- ½ tsp chilli powder

- ½ tsp cumin powder

- ¼ tsp garam masala

- ½ tsp dry kasturi methi leaves

- 3 tbsp of curd
method:
- Take a kadhai and add the oil.

- Warm the oil, when the oil is warm.

- Add the whole cumin and the ajwain. Stir for few seconds

- Then add the whole red chillies and stir fry, when the colour of the chillies start changing.

- Then add the chopped onions. Stir fry the onions till it becomes a beige brown colour.

- Then to the onions add the grated ginger-garlic and saute till the raw smell of the ginger garlic goes.

- Now add the grated tomatoes to the kadhai. Saute till the water of the tomatoes dry up.

- Then add the salt, turmeric, chilli powder and 3-4 tbsp of water and saute for few minutes.

- Next add the cumin powder and saute for few minutes.

- After few minutes Add the curd and garam masala. Saute for few minutes.

- Then add 5-6 tbsp of water to loosen the masala.

- Now add the cooked bhindi and onion to the masala and mix it in gently. Cook for few minutes on low flame, can check the salt at this stage.

- Now add the roasted peanuts and the kasturi methi leaves and mix it in well.

- Cover and cook for few minutes so that the masala infuses in the bhindi. Done.

- Remove and serve.

name: Mushrooms Peas Stir Fry
ingredients:
- 1 pkt fresh mushrooms(approximately 12-15 pieces, cut each into 4 pieces )

- 300 gms fresh peas (blanch it so that they are ¾ cooked)

- 1 tbsp chopped garlic

- 1 medium to big onion chopped

- 1 tsp ginger garlic paste/grated

- few slitted green chillies according to taste

- 15-20 pcs of curry patta

- ½ tsp pepper powder

- salt to taste

- ¼ tsp cumin powder

- 1 tsp soya sauce

- 1 tsp chopped mint/coriander leaves

- ½ tsp dry kasturi methi leaves

- 3 tbsp of oil
method:
- Take a pan / kadhai add the oil to it.

- When the oil gets warm, add the chopped garlic and stir fry for few minutes.

- Then add the curry patta leaves and stir fry for few seconds, till its fragrant.

- Now add the chopped onions and stir fry the onions till it becomes translucent.

- Then add the ginger-garlic paste and stir fry for few minutes till the raw smell goes.

- To this add the mushrooms and stir fry for few minutes.

- Then add the peas and saute for few minutes.

- Add the salt and pepper and stir fry for 30-40 seconds.

- Then add the cumin powder, chopped mint/coriander leaves and dry kasturi methi leaves .Stir fry for few seconds ,cover and keep for a minute or so.

- Remove from flame.

- Done.

name: Split Black Dal
ingredients:
- 1 cup raw dal

- 2 onions chopped

- 1 big tomato chopped

- 1 tsp ginger garlic paste

- 1 tbsp of chopped coriander leaves

- salt to taste

- ½ tsp turmeric powder

- ½ tsp chilli powder

- ¼ tsp coriander powder

- ¼ tsp cumin powder

- few whole red chillies

- ½ tsp of whole cumin

- 3 tbsp of oil
method:
- Pressure cook the dal for 10 minutes on low flame after the first whistle (1:3 ratio for water or you personal choice )and keep aside.

- In a kadhai add the oil, when the oil becomes warm.

- Add the whole cumin and whole red chillies.

- When the cumin starts spluttering, add the chopped onions and saute till the onions are translucent.

- Now add the ginger-garlic paste and saute till the raw smell goes.

- Then add the chopped tomato and the coriander, cumin powder, turmeric, red chilli powder and salt, now saute till the water of the tomato dries up and the tomato is totally mushy.

- While sautéing can add 2-3 tbsp of water to the masala.

- Add this masala to the cooked dal and cook for 10-15 minutes on low flame, so that the masala infuses in the dal.

- Add the chopped coriander leaves.

- Mix it in well.

- Done.

name: Lobia French Beans And Spinach Sabzi
ingredients:
- ½ cup lobia steamed or boiled ,keep aside

- 1-2 cups chopped spinach

- 1 ½ cups of cut French beans

- ¼ cup grated coconut

- 1 big onion chopped

- few green chillies pounded

- ½ tsp mustard seeds

- few whole red chillies

- ¼ tsp turmeric powder

- salt to taste

- 3 tbsp of oil
method:
- Take a kadhai add the oil.

- When the oil becomes warm Add the mustard seeds and whole red chillies.

- When the mustard seeds start spluttering.

- Then add the chopped onion and pounded green chillies. Saute for few minutes.
