- When the onion becomes translucent. Add the cut french beans and saute for few minutes.

- Cover and cook on low flame ,stirring in between Till the beans are ¾ done.

- Now add the cut spinach and cooked lobia and stir fry for few minutes, then cover and cook till more or less done.

- Then add the grated coconut and stir fry for few minutes. Remove from flame.

- Done.

name: Long Green Beans
ingredients:
- 350 gms long beans (cut into ½ pieces )

- 1½ big onion chopped

- 2 medium tomatoes chopped

- 1 tsp ginger chopped

- 1 tsp garlic chopped

- few chopped green chillies

- 2 tsp dry kasturi methi leaves

- salt to taste

- ½ tsp turmeric powder

- ½ tsp chilli powder

- ¼ tsp garam masala

- 3 tbsp of oil
method:
- In a kadhai add the oil ,when the oil becomes warm.

- Add the chopped garlic ginger. Stir fry for few seconds.

- Then add the chopped green chillies. Stir fry till the rawness of the ginger garlic goes.

- Now add the chopped onions. Stir fry till the onions become translucent.

- Then add the chopped tomato and saute till the tomato becomes soft.

- Add the salt, turmeric and chilli powder. Saute for few minutes (if needed can add 3-4 tbsp of water).

- Now add the cut green beans and mix it in well.

- Cover and cook on low flame, stirring in between till they are done.

- Add the garam masala and dry kasturi methi leaves.

- Mix it in well. Done.

name: Kheema Masala
ingredients:
- Marinate and keep for 15-20 minutes

- 500 gms mince

- 1 tbsp of tomato ketchup ½ cup tomato puree (or can blanch 2-3 tomatoes, then peel and grate it)

- pinch of salt

Remaining ingredients

- 3 medium size onions chopped

- 1 tsp garlic paste

- 1 tsp ginger paste

- few whole red chillies

- few whole peppercorns

- 6-8 cloves

- 1 big cinnamon stick

- 4 green cardamom

- 1 black cardamom

- 1 little piece of Java tried

- grate ¼ tsp of jaiphal

- salt to taste

- ¼ tsp turmeric powder

- ½ tsp kashmiri red chilli powder

- ½ tsp cumin powder

- ½ tsp coriander powder

- ½ tsp garam masala

- 1 tsp dry kasturi methi leaves

- 2 tbsp of chopped mint leaves

- 3-4 tbsp of oil
method:
- Take a kadhai, add the oil.

- Warm the oil, when the oil is warm.

- Add the whole red chillies, cloves, cinnamon stick, whole peppercorns, javatri, jaifal and black and green cardamom. Stir fry for 30-40 seconds.

- Then add the chopped onions. Stir fry till the onions becomes beige brown in colour.

- Now add the ginger-garlic paste and saute till the raw smell of the ginger garlic goes.

- Then add the marinated mince and saute on low till the mince.

- The mince will leave its own water.

- Add the salt, turmeric, red chilli powder, coriander and cumin powder and garam masala powder. Saute till the mince becomes a beige brown colour.

- Then add the chopped mint and dry kasturi leaves. Mix it all in well add 1 cup water cover and cook till the oil, starts seeping up.

- Keep gravy accordinary to personal preference.

- Done.

name: Moong Dal With Squash
ingredients:
- 1 cup moong dal (raw)

- 1 small-medium squash cut in cubes

- few slitted green chillies

- 8-10 whole garlic pods

- 2 medium onions chopped

- 2 medium tomatoes chopped

- 2 bay leaf

- salt to taste

- ½ tsp turmeric powder

- ¼ tsp red chilli powder

- 2 tbsp chopped coriander leaves

- 3 tbsp oil
method:
- Wash the dal and put it in a pressure cooker, with the cut squash, salt, turmeric powder ,whole pods of garlic, green chillies and water (1:3 ratio of water to dal ).

- Pressure cook to one whistle then remove from the flame.

- Let the pressure cooker open naturally. In a pan add the oil, warm the oil a little.

- Add the bay leaves and after few seconds Add the chopped onions and stir fry till the onions become translucent.

- Now add the chopped tomatoes and saute. Add the red chilli powder, saute till the tomatoes become soft.

- Add the tomato onion masala to the dal. Mix it in well.

- Add the chopped coriander leaves.

- Done.

name: Ridge Gourd And Mangalore Cucumber Sabzi
ingredients:
- 3-4 ridge gourd (peel and cut length wise down and then cut into 1 pieces)

- 1 medium Mangalore cucumber(cut into cubes)

- 1 big onion chopped

- 1 big tomato chopped

- 2 tsp chopped garlic

- 2 tsp chopped ginger

- 10-15 curry patta leaves

- ½ tsp whole cumin

- ½ tsp ajwain (caraway seeds)

- salt to taste

- ¼ tsp turmeric powder

- ½ tsp coriander powder

- red chilli powder to taste

- 3 tbsp of oil

To be roasted and ground to a powder

- 2 tsp urad dal

- 2 tsp channa dal

- 2 whole red chillies. Then keep aside.
method:
- Take a kadhai, add the oil warm the oil a little.

- Then add the whole cummin and caraway seeds and the curry patta.

- When the cummin starts spluttering. Put in the chopped ginger garlic and stir fry for few minutes.

- Then add the chopped onions. Stir fry till the onions become translucent and change to a beige brown colour.

- Now add the chopped tomatoes to the onions and saute for few minutes. To this add the salt, turmeric, red chilli powder and coriander powder.

- Add 3-4 tbsp of water to the masala. Then saute till the tomatoes becomes mushy.

- Now add the cut ridge gourd and the Mangalore cucumber. Mix it in well then cover and cook on low flame, stirring in between, till the vegetables are totally cooked can add little water if required, though both the vegetables leaves its own water.

- When the vegetables are cooked add the powdered, urad dal, channa dal and whole red chillies powder. Mix it in well.

- Cover and cook for few minutes. Remove from flame.

- Done.

name: Sauted Chicken Tikka
ingredients:
- 500 gms chicken

- 3 medium size onions sliced

- 2 medium size tomatoes sliced

- 2 green bell peppers sliced

- 2 tsp garlic paste

- 1 tsp ginger paste

- 3-4 slitted green chillies

- salt to taste

- red chilli according to taste

- ¼ tsp Kashmiri red chilli powder

- ¼ tsp turmeric powder

- 3-4 tbsp oil
method:
Marinate

- 500gms chicken

- 2 tbsp curd

- 1 tsp garlic

- 1 tsp ginger. Keep aside for an hour

Method

- Take a Kadhai add 2 tbsp of oil. Warm the oil a little, when the oil is warm add the marinated chicken and stir fry for 5-7 minutes.

- Then cover the chicken and cook , stirring in between till the chicken is tender/cooked.

- When the chicken is done remove and keep aside. Take a kadhai add the remaining oil.

- Warm the oil a little then add the sliced onions. Stir fry the onions till it becomes translucent and beigevin colour.

- Add to it the ginger garlic paste and sauté till the raw smell of the ginger garlic goes.

- Now add the sliced tomatoes to the onions and stir fry for free minutes.

- Then add the salt, red chilli and turmeric powder. Sauté for sometimes till the tomatoes become soft.

- Add the sliced bell peppers and the slitted green chillies. Sauté for few minutes.

- Then add the cooked chicken and stir fry for 8-10 minutes on low flame, so that the masala infuses and coats the chicken.

- Done.

name: Meifoon (Rice Noodles)
ingredients:
- 1 pkt meifoon( 400-500gms)

- 2 onions sliced

- 1 carrot cut into thin sticks

- 1 bell pepper sliced

- 1 cup cabbage thinly sliced

- ½-⅔ cup stir fried mushrooms

- 2 cups of spring onions cut into 2 pieces

- few slitted green chillies

- 1 tbsp of chopped garlic

- 2 tsp of chopped ginger (optional)

- ½ tsp pepper powder

- salt to taste

- 1 tsp sugar

- 1 tbsp of soya sauce

- 3-4 tbsp of oil

Non-veg

- Cut 1 breast of chicken into strips, stir fry with salt pepper and keep aside.

- ½ cup raw prawns ,stir fry with salt and pepper and keep aside.

- 4 eggs mix together and make into a scramble with salt and keep aside.
method:
- Cook the noodles according to instructions on the packet and keep aside.

- Take a kadhai add the oil to the kadhai.

- When the oil becomes warm. Add the vegetables one by one. Starting with the carrots, then onions, then capcicum, then cabbage and then spring onions. Stir fry on full flame
Vegetables should be crunchy.

- Now add the noodles, salt, soya sauce and sugar and mix it in well and gently. Stir fry for 5-7 minutes.

- Add the cooked mushrooms.

- If adding non veg, chicken/prawns/egg can add now.

- Mix everything in gently. Check for salt.

- Done.

name: Neem Leaves And Brinjal Sabzi
ingredients:
- 1 big brinjal cut in cubes

- 1 potato cut in cubes (optional)

- 1-2 sprigs of neem leaves, remove leaves from stem and chop into small pieces , keep aside

- salt to taste

- red chilli powder according to taste

- ¼ tsp turmeric powder

- 2 tbsp of mustard oil
method:
- Soak the salt, red chilli powder and turmeric powder in 5-6 tbsp of water and keep aside.

Method

- Take a kadhai, add the oil..

- Warm the oil, when the oil is warm.

- Add the cut potato first, stir fry for few minutes.

- Then add the chopped neem leaves. Stir fry for few minutes.

- Now add the cut brinjal. Mix everything well.

- Then add the infused masala. Stir fry and cook till the potatoes and brinjal are cooked.

- Serve with rice and dal.

- Done.

name: Prawns With Mustard And Poppy Seeds With Coconut Milk
ingredients:
- 500gms prawns

- ¾ tbsp small black mustard seeds

- ½ tbsp poppy seeds

- salt to taste

- red chilli powder according to taste

- ½ tsp turmeric powder

- ½ tsp onion seeds (kala jeera)

- 2 tbsp chopped coriander leaves

- few slitted green chillies

- 1 cup thick coconut milk

- 3 tbsp of 2 oil
method:
- Marinate the prawn in a pinch of salt and turmeric.

- After few minutes, add 1 tbsp oil in a kadhai, when the oil is hot, stir fry the prawns and keep aside when done.

- Soak the mustard seeds and poppy seeds in little warm water for 10 minutes Then grind it with a pinch of salt and 2 green chillies.

- When done keep the paste aside. Keep the coconut milk ready in a cup and keep aside.

- Soak the salt, red chilli powder and turmeric powder in 5-6 tbsp of water, so that the masala infuses, keep aside.

Method

- Take a kadhai, add the remaining oil.

- Heat the oil, when the oil becomes warm.

- Add the onion seeds and the slitted green chillies and stir fry for 30-40 seconds.

- Now add the mustard poppy seed paste and the infused masala. Stir fry for 7-10 minutes on low flame.

- Then add the chopped coriander leaves and saute for few seconds.

- Now add the coconut milk and mix it well.

- When the gravy starts bubbling add the prawns and cook on low flame for 7-10 minutes, to the viscosity of the gravy you like. Serve with plain rice.

- Done.

name: Bengali Pumpkin Ki Sabzi
ingredients:
- 500 gms of pumpkin cut into cubes

- 2 bay leaves

- 3-4 whole red chillies

- ½ tsp panch phoren

- 2 tbsp mustard oil

- salt to taste

- red chilli powder to taste

- ¼ tsp turmeric powder
method:
- Add the oil to the kadhai, and warm the oil. When the oil is warm.

- Add the panch phoren, whole red chillies and bay leaves. Stir for 20-30 seconds.

- Then add the cut pumpkin. Mix it all in throughly. Stir for a minute or so.

- Now add the salt, turmeric and red chilli powder. Stir fry for few minutes.

- Then cover and cook on low flame, while stirring in between, till the pumpkin is cooked.
Done.

- Serve with rice and dal.

name: Fish In Brinjal Curry
ingredients:
- 5 big pieces of fish

- 6-8 small brinjals cut into 2 pieces vertically

- 2-3 tbsp of chopped coriander leaves

- 1 tsp onion seeds

- 3-4 slitted green chillies

- salt to taste

- red chilli powder to taste

- ½ tsp turmeric powder

- 3-4 tbsp of mustard oil
method:
- Soak the salt, turmeric and red chilli powder in 3-4 tbsp of water and keep aside.

- Put a pinch of salt and turmeric powder on the fish and mix it well and keep aside.

Method

- Put 3 tbsp oil in a kadhai, let the oil become warm.

- When the oil becomes warm. Add 1 piece fish at a time and shallow fry the fish and keep aside.

- In the kadhai add the remaining oil, when the oil gets warm.

- Add the onion seeds and the slitted green chillies. Stir fry for few seconds.

- Add the infused masala and stir for a minute or so,

- When the oil appears on top ,add the chopped coriander leaves and stir for few seconds.

- Then add the cut brinjal and stir fry for a minute or so.

- Add 2 cups of water and let it come to a boil. Cover and cook on low heat, stirring in between till the brinjal is cooked.

- Then add the fish to the gravy, mix it in gently.

- Let the fish cook for few minutes on low flame.nSprinkle 1 tbsp of chopped coriander leaves on top.

- Done. Serve with plain rice.

Note : can keep the gravy thick or thin on personal choice.

name: Sweet Potato Sabzi
ingredients:
- 500 gms sweet potato

- 2 pc ginger cut into julienne

- 15-20 curry patta leaves

- 5-7 whole green chillies (add more or less depending on personal preference)

- few whole red chillies broken in half1 tsp panch phoren

- salt to taste

- red chilli powder to taste

- ½ tsp turmeric powder

- 2-3 tbsp of tamarind pulp (or on personal choice )

- 1 tbsp bengal gram

- 3 tbsp mustard oil/refined oil
method:
- Steam/boil the sweet potatoes. When it is done peel and cut into pieces and keep aside.

- Take a kadhai add the oil .Warm the oil for few minutes.

- Then add the bengal gram and stir fry till it becomes beige in colour. Immediately add the panch phoren and whole red chillies. Stir fry till fragrant then add the curry patta, fry for few seconds.

- Now add the cooked sweet potatoes and gently stir it in.

- Then add the salt, turmeric, red chilli powder and whole green chillies and stir fry for few minutes.

- Make the flame low and cook for few minutes so that all the ingredients infuse into the sweet potato ,stirring in between.

- Finally add the tamarind pulp and mix it in gently.

- Cook for 30-40 seconds and remove from flame.

- Ready.

Note

- Can add instead of potatoes in a masala dosa.

name: Salad With Sprouted Brown Chana
ingredients:
- 1 cup sprouted black chana

- 1 big cucumber chopped into small cubes

- 1 big tomato cut into small cubes

- 1 big onion chopped small

- 1-2 green chillies chopped

- 2 tbsp of chopped coriander leaves

- 1 tbsp grated coconut

- ½ lime juice

- salt to taste. Mix all of the above together and keep in a bowl

For the takda

- 1 tsp oil

- ¼ tsp mustard seeds

- 1-2 whole red chillies cut into two pieces each

- 1 tsp urad dal

- 6-8 curry patta leaves

- pinch of asafoetida
method:
- Put the oil in a small pan ,when the oil becomes warm.

- Add the urad dal and mustard seeds. Stir for few seconds then add the red chillies, curry patta and the asafoetida. Stir for few seconds then add it to the salad in the bowl.

- Mix all together.

- Ready to serve .

name: Methi And Arbi Sabzi
ingredients:
- 2 medium size bunch of methi leaves (wash and chop into small pieces)

- 300-400 gms of arbi (peel and cut in circles )

- 2 medium onions chopped

- 2 tsp chopped garlic

- 2-3 whole red chillies

- 1 big tomato chopped

- ½ tsp whole cumin

- 3-4 tbsp of mustard oil (or any oil of your choice)

- salt to taste

- red chilli powder to taste

- ½ tsp turmeric powder

- ¼ tsp garam masala

- 2 tbsp of tamarind pulp
method:
- Take a kadhai, add the oil, then heat the oil.

- When the oil is hot add the whole cumin and whole red chillies. Stir for few seconds then add the chopped onions, stir fry till onions become translucent, then add the chopped garlic and stir fry for few minutes.

- Now add the cut arbi and salt and cook for few minutes. Cover and cook on low flame stirring in between for few minutes and cook till the arbi is ¾ done.

- Add in the chopped methi leaves and mix it in well.

- Now add the chopped tomato and mix it in well. Stir fry for few minutes ,then add the turmeric and red chilli powder and stir fry on low flame.

- The methi leaves will leave its own water. After few minutes add the garam masala and cook till the methi leaves are cooked.

- Lastly add the tamarind pulp and stir fry on low flame for 5-10 minutes. Then done, serve with dal and rice or have with roti.

name: Masala Kerela (Bitter Gourd)
ingredients:
- 500gms of kerela (cut into 1 pieces, with skin, remove the insides of the kerela and discard)

- 3 tbsp oil

Mix together

- 2 ½ tbsp of besan (gram flour)

- 2 tsp cornflour

- 2 tsp maida (refined flour)

- 1 tsp turmeric powder

- 1 tsp dry mango powder

- 1 tsp garam masala

- 1 tsp cumin powder

- 1 ½ tbsp dry fenugreek leaves (dry kasturi methi )

- 1 tsp red chilli powder

- ½ tsp pepper powder

- ¾ tsp coriander powder

- salt to taste

- 1 tbsp curd

- 1 lemon (juice squeezed)

- 1 tbsp chopped garlic

- 1 tsp chopped ginger

- add 3-4 tbsp of water and mix all of the above into a smooth paste and keep aside and keep aside
method:
- Take a pan add 1 cup water and heat it till the water is lukewarm, then add the cut kerela to the pan and add a pinch of salt. Cover and cook the kerela till it is ¾ done.

- When the kerela is ¾ done remove e from the pan and keep aside.

- Now add the kerela to the paste and mix it well ,so that the kerela is coated with the masala inside out.

- Take a pan add the oil and warm the oil for few minutes.

- Then add the masala coated kerela to the pan. Stir fry for few minutes.

- Cook on low flame till the kerela is completely cooked.

- Done.

name: Lace Ragi Dosa
ingredients:
- ½ cup raagi flour

- 1 cup water

- salt to taste

- oil as per requirement

Options that can be added to the batter

- 1 medium size onion finely chopped

- 1 medium size tomato finely chopped

- 1 tbsp finely chopped coriander

- 1 tbsp finely chopped dill leaves

- chopped green chillies to taste

- can add little of all of the above or any combination of your choice
method:
- Mix the raagi flour and water into a smooth paste and add salt to taste.

- Heat a tava /flat pan and add 1/4 -1/2 tsp of oil .Spread the oil nicely all over.

- When the the tava is hot pour the batter with a ladle on the tava/pan. 2 -2 ½ ladles of batter can be put.

- Cover and cook for 30-40 seconds.

- Remove the cover. When the batter starts leaving the sides, flip it over and cook for a minute or so.

- Fold into half then again fold into half. Will be like a triangle.

- Serve with chutney.

Note

- Can add finely chopped onion/finely chopped coriander leaves/finely chopped dill leaves/finely chopped tomato/finely chopped green chillies to the batter.

- Can add little of each or any combination you prefer.

name: Green Moong Dal Dosa
ingredients:
- 2 cups Green moong/ mung dal ( you can also used sprouts here)

- 1 green chilli

- ½ teaspoon jeera (optional)

- ½ inch ginger

- 1 pinch asafoetida (hing), optional

- ¼ cup chopped coriander leaves (optional)

- salt to taste

- coconut oil/olive oil for cooking

Toppings

- onions, finely chopped

- green chilli, finely chopped
method:
Making the batter

- Rinse the moong dal and soak overnight in enough water.

- Drain and add the moong dal, ginger, green chilli, asafoetida, coriander leaves, and salt to grinder jar.

- Add a little water and grind to a smooth batter.

- The consistency should be similar to a dosa batter or thick milkshake.

Making the dosa

- On a griddle or flat pan put a few drops of oil and spread it with a cut onion, coating the pan evenly. Use a non stick pan when cooking with less oil.

- Sprinkle a little water. If it sizzles your pan is hot enough. With a ladle, pour one ladle of batter onto the pan and use the back of the ladle to move in a circular pattern spreading the batter as you go outwards.

- Sprinkle the finely chopped onion, green chillies onto the dosa.

- Press the toppings into the batter to ensure it gets stuck to the batter as it cooks.

- Flip and cook until both sides are crisp and browned.

- Serve hot with mint chutney or tomato chutney.

Notes

- This dosa can be made with yellow moong dal, split green gram or sprouted moong dal.

- If using yellow moon dal, soaking for 3-4 hours will suffice.

- Toppings are optional as the dosa can be had plain too. You can store the left over batter in the refrigerator for upto 3 days.

name: Mango Rice
ingredients:
- 3 tbsp oil

- 1 cup raw rice

- 1 cup grated raw mango

- 15-20 curry patta leaves

- few slitted green chillies to taste

- 1/2 tsp whole cumin

- 1/2 tsp whole mustard seeds

- 10-12 pieces of fenugreek seeds

- 1 tbsp of raw urad dal

- 1 tsp of raw chana dal (gram)

- 2 tbsp of raw peanuts

- 2 medium size onions sliced

- 1 tsp ginger paste

- 1 tsp garlic paste

- salt to taste

- 1/4 tsp turmeric powder

- 2 tbsp chopped coriander leaves

- 1-2 tbsp of grated coconut
method:
- Boil the rice to 90% and keep aside.

- Take a kadhai, add the oil to it.

- Warm the oil for a minute or so ,then add the whole cumin, whole mustard seeds, fenugreek seeds, when they start spluttering.

- Add the urad dal ,chana dal and peanuts and stir for few seconds

- Then add the sliced onions,slitted green chillies and curry patta. Stir fry till the onions become soft, then add the grated raw mango and the ginger-garlic paste, stir fry for few minutes.

- When the raw smell of the ginger garlic goes, add the grated coconut and the chopped coriander leaves. Stir fry for few minutes Then add the turmeric and salt. Stir fry for few seconds then add the cooked rice.

- Mix it in well and thoroughly gently stirring it. Cook on low flame for few minutes.

- Done.

Note

- Can add more grated mango according to taste, if the mango is sweet can add more.

name: Arbi (Taro Root) Stir Fry
ingredients:
- 500gms arbi

- 3 tbsp of oil

- 2 medium to big size onions chopped

- 2 tsp finely chopped garlic

- 2 tsp finely chopped ginger

- salt to taste

- 1/2 tsp chilli flakes

- 1/2 tsp turmeric powder

- juice of half a lime (optional)
method:
- Boil or pressure cooker the arbi till cooked. Then peel the arbi and cut it into circles and keep aside.

- Take a kadhai add the oil, warm the oil for a minute or so.

- Add the chopped garlic and ginger and stir fry till they slightly change colour.

- Then add the chopped onions and stir fry till the onions become soft and translucent.

- Add the turmeric powder and salt to taste to the onions and stir fry for 30-40 seconds.

- Now add the arbi to the kadhai and stir fry with the onions for few minutes then add the chilli flakes.

- Mix everything well stirring continuously. Stir fry and cook on look fame for 10 minutes till the arbi becomes little beige brown in colour.

- Mix lime juice and mix for few seconds (this is optional).

- Done.

name: Moong Dal Pulao
ingredients:
- 3 tbsp ghee

- 1/2 cup raw rice

- 1/3 cup green(slit) moong dal (little less than 1/3)

- 1/4 cup moong dal (yellow)

- 1 tbsp channa dal

- 1/2 tsp whole cumin

- salt to taste

- pinch of asafoetida

- 1/4 tsp turmeric powder

- 1 medium size onion chopped

- 1 tsp finely chopped garlic

- 1 tsp finely chopped ginger

- 1 tsp finely chopped green chillies

- 3-4 curry leaves chopped fine

- 1-2 tbsp of green peas

- 1 1/2 cups water
method:
- Wash all the dals and rice well together and soak it for 30 minutes.

- Take a pressure cooker, place on the flame then add the ghee to the cooker.

- When the ghee becomes warm add the whole cummin and the asafoetida.

- As the cumin starts spluttering add the chopped garlic and ginger and stir fry for a minute or so.

- Now add the chopped onion and stir fry till translucent.

- Then add the chopped green chillies and chopped curry patta leaves. Stir fry for 30-40 seconds, then add the salt to taste and the turmeric powder. Stir fry for 30-40 seconds
Drain the water from the soaked dal and rice.

- Then add the rice and dals to the cooker and stir fry for 1 minute or so.

- Add the peas and stir fry for few seconds. Lastly add the water mix well, can check for salt at this stage.

- Close the lid of the cooker and cook for 1 whistle, switch of the flame. Let the pressure cooker open naturally.

- Remove the lid and puff up the rice with a spoon. Done.

- Can serve with any vegetable or kadhai or raita.

Note

- on opening cooker if you feel rice should be softer ,then sprinkle a little water on the rice ,put back the lid of the pressure cooker and cook till it catches, immediately switch of flame and let the cooker open naturally.

name: Creamy Cutlets
ingredients:
- 1 small to medium size onion chopped fine

- 2-3 cloves of garlic chopped fine

- 1 cup cauliflower cut into small pieces

- 1/3 cup green peas

- 1 cup chopped carrots, finely cut into cubes

- 10-12 french beans cut into small pieces

- 5-7 mushrooms cut into small pieces

- 1/4 cup celery (just the stems cut into tiny pieces)

- salt to taste

- red chilli flakes to taste

- pinch of black pepper powder

- 2 tbsp breadcrumb for the mixture

- breadcrumbs as per requirement, for the cutlets

- 3 tbsp of oil/butter

Ingredients for the sauce

- 1/2 ltr milk

- 3 tbsp of refined flour (maida)

- 1 bay leaf

- salt to taste

- pinch of black pepper powder
method:
- Take a kadhai, add the oil/ butter to the kadhai.

- Warm the oil/butter then add the onion and stir fry for few seconds.

- Then add the garlic and stir fry for 1 minute or so.

- Now add the celery and fry for few seconds.

- Then add the vegetables one by one starting with the ones which take longer to cook.

- Add the peas stir fry for few minutes.

- Next add the french beans and stir fry for few minutes.

- Now add the carrots, cauliflower and a pinch of salt and mix it in well.

- Then add the mushrooms and stir fry till the vegetables are 90% done.

- Add the chilli flakes and the black pepper powder. Mix it in well. Stir fry the vegetables for few minutes and mash them a little bit.

- The vegetables are ready.

Method for the sauce

- Take a pan add the milk (should be boiled before and kept aside).

- In a small bowl put the flour and add 1/4 cup milk in it and mix it with the flour to make a smooth paste ,then add this paste to the milk and start cooking on low flame stirring continuously, or else lumps will form.

- Keep stirring till you get a real thick consistency like a thick custard (keeping in mind that on cooling the sauce will become thicker).

- Add salt to taste, should be a little less than what is required, as the vegetables also have salt.

- When the sauce becomes thick, discard the bay leaf. Let the sauce cool down.

- When the sauce cools down add it to the vegetables and mix everything really well.

- Can check for salt now, adjust according to requirement.

- When the mixture cools down add the bread crumbs to it and mix it well. Brush some oil on your palm place a heaped tbsp of the mixture and make it into a flat cutlet
In a plate put the breadcrumb.

- Place the cutlet on the breadcrumb plate ,cover the cutlet with the breadcrumb on both sides.

- Place it on your palm and press the breadcrumb on it.

- Brush a little oil on a pan, when it becomes hot place the cutlet on it.

- After few minutes flip the side gently, then cover and cook till both sides are browned.

- Done.

name: Sitaphal (Custard Apple) Ka Kheer/Rubri
ingredients:
- 1 ltr skimmed milk

- 2 big sitaphal deseeded
method:
- Put the milk in a kadhai on low flame after boiling it.

- Cook it on low flame and keep stirring in between.

- Scrape the sides and bottom of the kadhai as you stir it.

- When the milk becomes less than half and starts having a thick consistency. Remove from flame.

- On cooling the consistency will become thicker.

- When the rubri has completely cooled down add the deseeded sitaphal and mix it in gently.

- Personally I do not use sugar in this, it has a mild sweetness of the sitaphal.

- If one needs to make it slightly sweeter can add 1 tbsp of sugar when cooking the milk
Or can put 1/4 jaggery instead of sugar.

- Can serve cold or room temperature.

- Done.

name: Dry Suji, Til, Besan, Dry Fruits Halwa
ingredients:
- 1/2 suji

- 3 tbsp of roasted white til (sesame seeds)

- 1/2 cup palm jaggery

- 1/2 cup roasted besan

- 1/2 cup of dry fruits (almonds, walnuts, rasins, coconut)

- 3/4 tsp crushed green cardamom powder

- 2 -3 tbsp of ghee
method:
- Add 2 tsp ghee to the pan, warm the ghee.

- When the ghee is warm add the dry fruits and roast it for few seconds and keep aside .

- In the same pan add the remaining ghee.

- When the ghee gets warm. Add the suji and roast it till it changes colour to a light beige and there is a nice fragrance.

- Add the roasted sesame seeds and stir fry for few minutes.

- Now add the roasted besan and mix it in well.

- Add the cardamom powder and mix it in.

- Then add the jaggery to the pan, if it is solid then add 2-3 tbsp water on the jaggery so that it melts fast.

- Then mix it in nicely.

- Add the dry fruits. Done.

- This is a dry kind of halwa ,if you want to make this like a normal halwa texture ,add 2 cups of hot water and mix it in well.

- When the halwa leaves the sides its done.

name: Tomato Garlic Chilli Sauce
ingredients:
- 1 cup finely chopped tomato (remove the pulp and chop)

- 1/4 cup finely chopped garlic

- 1/2 cup finely chopped green chillies (can put 1/4 cup depending on personal choice)

- 4-6 tbsp tomato sauce

- 2 tbsp vinegar

- 1 tbsp sugar

- salt to taste
method:
- Mix all of the above ingredients together and check for salt and other flavors.

- Adjust according to taste.

- This sauce can be served as a sauce for add on .

- It can also be used in cooking when making chilli chicken, schezwan noodles/rice, stir fry chicken/vegetables.

- Can be added for marination, also in grills.

- It gives a pep to whatever we add it too.

name: Coriander Chilli Sauce
categories: Sim's Family Recipes, Evening Snack, Lunch, Dinner
ingredients:
- 1 cup chopped coriander (press it in )

- 12 pods of garlic

- 8-10 green chillies (or according to taste)

- 1 tsp sugar

- 2 tsp vinegar
method:
- Grind all of the above to a paste.

- Check for salt and adjust according to taste. Done.

- Can be served as a sauce with anything you want.

- Can be used for cooking Chinese and for marination also .

name: Stir Fried Eggplant (Brinjal)
ingredients:
- 1 big Brinjal

- 2 tbsp of oil

- 1 tsp ginger chopped

- 1 tsp garlic chopped

- few green chillies chopped

- 1 green pepper

- 1 red pepper

- salt to taste

- 1/2 tsp red chilli flakes

For the sauce

- 2 tsp light soya sauce

- 1 tsp dark soya sauce

- 1 tsp chopped garlic

- 1/2 tsp sugar

- 1 tsp cornflour

- 4-5 tbsp of water, mix all the above ingredients for the sauce and keep aside
method:
- Cut the brinjal into big 2 broad strips.

- Sprinkle salt on it, mix it well. Keep aside for 20-30 minutes.

- Then wash the brinjal and squeeze out all the water and keep aside.

- Take a pan put 1 tbsp of oil.

- When the oil becomes warm.

- Add the brinjal. Stir fry on high flame till the brinjal is 70-80% cooked.

- Keep stirring till the brinjal becomes a little brown.

- Remove from pan and keep aside.

- Now add 1 tbsp oil in the same pan.

- When the oil becomes warm.

- Add the chopped garlic and ginger. Stir fry till the raw smell goes and the garlic ginger become little brown.

- Add the chopped green chillies as per taste. Stir fry for few seconds.

- Add the cut red and green peppers. Stir fry for few minutes.

- Add the salt as per taste.

- Add the red chilli flakes. Stir fry for few seconds.

- At this point switch off the flame and add the sauce and mix it in well (If the flame is on the sauce will thicken immediately).

- Restart the flame and add 3-4 tbsp of water. Mix everything well ,should have a little consistency.

- Now add the cooked brinjal. Mix it on well, stir fry for few minutes. Done.

- Serve with plain rice or fried rice.

name: Lemon Honey Chicken
ingredients:
Chicken

- 750 gms of boneless chicken (breasts) cut into flat pieces and beaten lightly Marinated in 2-3 tsp of cornflour

- 1 tsp of garlic paste

- 1/2 tsp of pepper powder

- 1 egg

- salt to taste (Keep aside for 5-7 minutes)

For the rind mixture

- 1 -1 1/2 lemon rind thinly cut

- 2 tsp vinegar

- 1/2 tsp salt

- 1 tsp of sugar

- 3 tsp of honey

- 1 1/2-2 tbsp of lemon juice

- Mix all the above and keep aside. Cut 1/2 a yellow bell pepper/capsicum into thin strips and keep aside
method:
- Dust the chicken pieces on both sides with cornflour and keep aside.

- Take a pan put 2-3 tbsp of oil, when the the oil becomes warm .

- Place the chicken pieces in it.

- Cook on medium to low flame.

- When the side facing down becomes light brown. Flip it and cook the other side.

- Remove when done ,repeat the same with the rest of the pieces.

- In the same pan put the capsicum pieces. Stir fry for few seconds

- Then add the soaked rind mixture to the pan. Stir fry for few seconds.

- Then add 1 cup of hot water/broth. Add 1-2 tsp cornflour made into a slurry.

- Add 2 tsp of honey. Mix it in well.

- Add the cooked chicken pieces.

- Add 1/2 tsp of white pepper powder.

- Now can check for the salt and adjust according to taste.

- Done. Serve with white rice.

name: Spring Rolls
ingredients:
- 1 big capsicum (green) sliced very thin

- 1 big onion sliced very thin

- 1/2 cup chives sliced fine into 2" pcs

- 1/2 cup finely sliced celery stick

- 1 cup finely sliced cabbage

- 1/2 cup finely sliced carrots

- 1 tbsp of chopped garlic

- 1/2 tsp pepper

- 1/2 tsp sugar

- salt according to taste

- 1/2 tsp red chilli flakes(optional)

- few green chillies chopped fine and small (optional)

- 1 tsp soya sauce

- 1 tbsp chopped coriander leaves (optional)

- 1 tbsp of refined oil
method:
- In a kadhai add the oil.

- Warm the oil a little, when the oil is warm.

- Add the garlic and stir fry for few minutes till the raw smell goes.

- Add the sliced onion and capsicum. Stir fry for few seconds.

- Add chives and celery stick and carrots. Stir fry for a minute.

- Add the cabbage and stir fry for a minute or so.

- While stir frying need to keep in mind that the vegetables should be a little bit crunchy . Add the pepper, sugar and salt.

- Add the chopped green chillies and chilli flakes (can skip this step if you do not want to put ).

- Lastly add the soya sauce Stir fry till vegetables are left little crunchy.

- Add the chopped coriander leaves if you desire. Mix well.

- All the above to be done in high to medium flame,

- When vegetables are done remove from fire and keep aside.

Note:

- If you want to add chicken, need to finely cut small chicken pieces in strips of 1/2, need 1/2 cup of chicken strips.

- Put a pinch of salt and pepper on the chicken and mix well.

- In a pan add 1 tbsp of oil Warm the the oil, add the chicken strips cook on high flame till done.

- Remove from flame and keep side.

- Then add the vegetables to the chicken and mix it well. Keep aside .

Spring Rolls Batter for the wrapper
Ingredients

- 1/2 cup cornflour

- 1/2 cup Flour (maida)

- 1/2 egg

- 3/4 cup water

- pinch of salt

Method

- Mix the flour, cornflour, egg,salt and water and make a smooth batter.

- Take a pan, heat the pan rub oil on the pan.

- When the oil is hot Add a ladle of this batter on the center and rotate it to make a big circle like a dosa .

- When bubbles come its done.

- Remove and place on a plate, on which before you need to dust some flour on it, so that it does not stick .

- Now add the vegetable mixture to it in the centre in a line and fold the sides in first, then one horizontal side, when placing the other side on it, rub a little water on the edge and press it in.

- Fold and keep aside.

- When all are done, brush a little oil on both sides, place in an air fryer.

- Cook till it becomes crisp.

- Serve with sauce of your choice.

name: Curd Dosa
ingredients:
- 2 cups of raw rice (can use any normal rice )

- 2 cups of curd

- 1 onion chopped

- 1 tbsp of chopped coriander

- few chopped green chillies

- 1 tsp of ajwain

- salt to taste

- pinch of cooking soda
method:
- Wash the rice nicely then spread it on a paper or cloth to dry.

- When completely dry, grind it in a grinder to look like very fine rawa(suji).

- Now mix the ground rice with the curd ,chopped onions ,chopped coriander,ajwain and salt.

- Keep aside for 20-30 minutes.

- Just before cooking add the cooking soda. Mix well.

- Take a small kadhai or an appam kadhai.

- Heat the kadhai and add 1 1/2 tsp of oil.

- Warm the oil a little, then add 1/2 cup of the mixture in the centre of the kadhai, with a ladle.

- Add the chopped green chillies on top. Cover and cook on medium flame.

- When the dosa starts leaving the kadhai on the sides.

- Gently flip it and cook the other side.

- When slightly brown, it's done.

- Done.

name: Tangy Saucey Chicken Potato Fritters
ingredients:
For sauce

- 1 medium size tomato

- 1 small size onion

- 1 dried red chili

- 1 green chili

- 3 garlic cloves

- ¼ tsp sugar

- Salt to taste

- ¼ tsp vinegar

For chicken potato fritters

- 50g boneless chicken

- ½ cup grated potato

- ¼ tsp black pepper powder

- ¼ tsp red chili flakes

- ¼ tsp garam masala powder

- pinch of Italian herbs

- 1 tsp oil for frying

- salt to taste
method:
For sauce

- Wash tomato, peel of onion and garlic cloves.

- Place tomato, onion, garlic cloves, green chili, red chilli and steam for 10 minutes.

- After steaming it allow it to cool down and then transfer all the steamed ingredients to a blending jar and then add sugar, salt, vinegar and blend it well to make a smooth paste and keep it aside.

For chicken potato fritters

- Chop chicken to fine and small pieces and squeeze it well to drain the excess water.

- Peel of the potato and grade it finely and mix it with chicken chunks.

- Now add black pepper, chili flakes, garam masala, Italian herbs, salt and mix it well.

- After mixing everything well, can have small patties.

- Heat a pan add oil and place the patties and shallow fry on both the sides until its golden brown in color.

- Take a serving plate transfer the pre-cooked tomato sauce and place the patties and enjoy whole meal.

name: Palak Mutton Chaap
ingredients:
- 50g boneless mutton

- 1/4 tbsp finely chopped spinach

- ¼ tsp whole cumin seeds

- ¼ tsp coriander seeds

- ½ tsp garam masala

- ½ tsp red chilli flakes

- 1 finely chopped green chili

- 2 garlic cloves

- 1 tsp finely chopped coriander leaves

- 2-3 drops vinegar

- salt to taste

- 1 tsp oil
method:
- Take a blending jar add finely chopped boneless mutton pieces, coriander seeds, whole cumin seeds, red chilli flakes, finely chopped green chilli, garlic cloves, vinegar and blend all the ingredients well and transfer to a mixing plate.

- Add finely chopped spinach, coriander, salt and mix all the ingredients well and make it small cylindrical chaps and can use a popsicle stick if needed.

- Heat oil on a pan and place the mutton, spinach chap and shallow fry on both the sides.

- Can enjoy with green chutney.

name: Baked Chilli Chicken Samosa
ingredients:
For samosa outer shell

- 2tbsp wheat flour

- ¼ tsp ajwain (whole carom seeds)

- salt to taste

- warm water for kneading

- pinch of yeast

- pinch of baking soda

- 1 tsp milk

For filling

- 50g chicken

- 2 tbsp curd

- ½ tsp red chili powder

- ½ cup ginger-garlic paste

- ¼ tsp coriander powder

- ½ tsp red chilli flakes

- ½ tsp mixed herbs

- ½ tsp soya sauce

- ½ tsp tomato sauce

- salt for taste

- 1 tsp oil for cooking
method:
For samosa shell

- Take a bowl add wheat flour, carom seeds, salt, yeast, milk, baking powder and mix the ingredients, then add warm water gradually to knead the dough and make a nice soft dough and keep it aside for 2 hours for fermentation.

For chilli chicken stuffing

- Take chicken and chop it finely and add curd, ginger-garlic paste, red chilli powder, coriander powder, salt and mix it well and allow it to marinate for 1 hour.

- Heat oil in a pan, add marinated chicken and allow it to cook for 10-12 minutes and once the water is oozing out allow it to cook until the water is absorbed.

- Now add soya sauce, tomato sauce, red chili flakes and mixed herbs and saute once and turn off the flame and allow it to cool down.

- Take the pre prepared dough make a small ball, roll it out into a roti, cut it in between to make two equal halves.

- Fold each one into a samosa shell and fill it with the chicken stuffing and close it well.

- Transfer the chicken stuffed samosa to a baking tray and brush oil.

- Preheat oven for 10 minutes at 180 degree celsius.

- Finally bake the samosa for 12 minutes at 200 degree celsius.

- Serve baked chili chicken samosa and enjoy the snack.

name: Buckwheat Barley Porridge
ingredients:
- 25 g buckwheat

- 15 g barley

- 1 small onion

- 50g chicken

- 100 ml chicken broth

- 1 small green chili

- ½ tsp ginger-garlic paste

- ½ tsp turmeric

- ½ tsp jeera powder

- salt to taste
method:
- In a saucepan, add 120 ml water, chopped onion, chicken, green chilli, ginger garlic paste, jeera powder, turmeric and salt.

- Place a lid over it and let it boil till the chicken cooks well.

- Once done, take the chicken out of the broth. Cool it down and shred it into small pieces.

- To the broth add buckwheat and barley and cook well.

- Add the shredded chicken to this mix. Let the ingredients come together in a porridge consistency.

- Serve hot.

name: Chia Seeds Watermelon Fusion Drink
ingredients:
- 1 tbsp soaked chia seed

- ½ cup diced watermelon

- few fresh mint leaves

- t½ tsp lemon juice

- ½ tsp salt
method:
- In a glass Soak chia seeds for 15 mins.

- In a separate glass add soaked chia seeds, Diced watermelon, fresh mint leaves, lemon juice and salt and mix well.

- Refrigerate and drink chilled.

name: Fruit Custard
ingredients:
- ½ cup milk

- 1 tsp sugar

- 2 tsp custard powder

- ½ cup chopped seasonal fruits
method:
- Add ½ cup milk to pan on medium high heat.

- Once it has heated up a little, take out 3 tablespoons milk from the pan into a small bowl. Add custard powder to that milk and mix well. There should be no lumps. Set it aside.

- Stir the milk in the pan let it heat up and come to a gentle boil. Then lower the heat, add sugar and mix until combined.

- Start adding the custard mix. Add little at a time and mix after each addition. Whisk continuously.

- Cook for 2-3 minutes until the custard thickens. Remove pan from heat and let it cool down a bit.

- At the same time, chop all fruits that you are using for the custard and refrigerate.

- Once the custard and the fruits are chilled, transfer custard to serving bowl and mix in the fruits (banana, apple, grapes)

- Cover and refrigerate the custard for 1 to 2 hours after mixing in the fruits for the flavors to develop and then can have it chilled.

name: Watermelon Sharbat
ingredients:
- ½ cup milk

- ¼ cup chopped watermelon

- ½ tsp sweet basil seeds

- 2-3 drops of rose extract

- ½ tsp goondh
method:
- Soak sweet basil seeds and goondh in water for 1 hour.

- Boil milk and let it cool.

- In a glass add ½ tsp of sweet basil seeds, ½ tsp of goondh, milk, 2 drops of rose extract and mix well.

- Add chopped watermelon to it.

- Refrigerate and drink it chilled.

name: Mashed Sweet Potatoes With Mixed Herbs Paneer And Salad
ingredients:
- 30g Sweet potatoes

- 100 ml Whole milk/Cow Milk

- ½ tsp lemon juice

- ½ tsp Red chilli flakes

- ½ tsp Roasted Jeera Powder

- 1 tsp Chopped coriander leaves

- ½ cut Ripe tomatoes

- 1 tbsp shredded Cabbage

- ¼ capsicum

- 1 tbsp Carrots

- ½ cucumber

- ½ tsp olive oil

- Salt as per taste

- A pinch of Pepper
method:
Mashed sweet potatoes

- Wash your sweet potatoes thoroughly.

- Put the sweet potatoes in a big pot without cutting them

- Add water to almost the same level as sweet potatoes. You don't have to cover the sweet potatoes with water, add salt and cover the pot with parchment paper or banana leaves. Place a lid to cover and bring to boil

- Boil at a moderate high heat for about 20 mins

- Check the cooking by inserting a sharp thin knife in one sweet potato. If the knife goes inside without any resistance, then cut off the heat. If not boil the sweet potatoes again for about 5 mins

- Once you cut off the heat, let the sweet potatoes cool down before manipulating them

Herbed Paneer

- Take a heavy pan or the vessel. To this add milk and let it come to a boil on medium flame. Keep stirring in between so that it doesn't get stuck at the bottom.

- Meanwhile, assemble the following. Take a pan. Place the strainer on top. Line the strainer with a muslin cloth. Also, keep a heavy object ready.

- Once the milk starts heating up (it should not be boiling). Ensure that the milk is hot but not boiling.

- At this stage add salt, roasted cumin powder, chopped coriander leaves, red chili flakes and mix it well.

- Now once the milk gets boiled. Switch off the gas and let it cool down for 2-3 minutes. Always remember, do not curdle the milk when it's too hot.

- Now add citric acid and water mixture slowly and let it curdle.

- Once it's curdled, immediately pour this mixture in the sieve that we have assembled before. The Paneer will come on the muslin cloth and all the whey will be gathered at the vessel below.

- Wash the Paneer under tap water so that the sour flavor of citric acid is gone completely.

- Secure the edges of the muslin cloth tightly and place it back on the strainer keeping it in on a plate or a vessel.

- Put a heavy mortar or a heavy rock/object on top of the Paneer which is covered with a muslin cloth. This will ensure no water is left and we will get a round shape because of the heavy object.

- Leave the Paneer under the heavy object for an hour.

- After an hour or so, the Herbed Paneer will be ready. Keep the paneer in the refrigerator in an airtight box. This Paneer can be used for the next 2-3 days

- This paneer can be baked or pan fried later and served hot.

Vegetable salad

- Chop all the vegetables into the same length and keep a side .

- Mix the salt, pepper and olive oil and blend well together in a bowl.

- Now keep both the vegetables and the dressing separately until ready to serve.

- When ready to serve, mix the vegetables and the dressing together.

- This has to be done at the last minute, as the vegetables combined with the salt tend to shed their juices and thus become limp and soggy if kept too long.

name: Thin Lentil Vegetable Porridge
ingredients:
- 30g moong dal soaked

- ¼ cup cauliflower

- ½ tsp pepper

- ¼ cup beans

- ¼ cup chopped carrot

- ½ tsp salt

- 2 tbsp of chopped onion

- 3 tbsp of chopped tomato

- 1 green chilli

- 3-4 cloves garlic finely chopped

- few chopped coriander

- ½ tsp lemon juice
method:
- Heat a non-stick pan on medium flame and add oil to it. Add onions followed by garlic and green chilli. Saute for a minute.

- Pre-cook the moong dal separately.

- After that add the remaining vegetables to the pan and cook for 2 minutes. Stir in cooked moong dal and saute for a minute. To this prepared mixture add water followed by salt and pepper. Mix well and cook the mixture for 2 minutes.

- Finally, add chopped coriander and lemon juice to the mixture. Mix well using a spoon. Serve fresh and hot.

name: Baked Paneer Chickpea Nuggets
ingredients:
- 30g chickpeas drained and rinsed

- 3tbsp goat flour

- 3 tbsp chickpea stew

- 1/2 tsp garlic powder

- 1/2 tsp onion powder

- sprinkle some paprika

- 1 tsp Olive oil

- salt as per taste

- 1 tsp whole wheat bread crumbs

- 30g Paneer sliced in cubes
method:
- Drain chickpeas with a bowl under it to save the chickpea liquid or "aquafaba". Add chickpeas into the food processor with spices.

- Pulse the chickpeas, and spices together then add in the oat flour and 2 tbsp of chickpea liquid. Pulse until combined. Do not over blender - it should have texture.

- Make a prep station with a bowl of the breadcrumbs, a bowl with the remaining chickpea liquid and then a plate.

- Form the mixture into the hand and make a concave shape and keep a paneer in the middle that covers it with the mixture then give a nugget shape, dipping each one in the chickpea liquid first then the breadcrumbs. Place them all on the plate.

- Air-fryer method: bake for 15-20 minutes at 400 degrees flipping halfway through or until completely golden brown (this is what I did).

- Oven method: Bake on a baking sheet with parchment paper for about 30 minutes at 450 flipping halfway through or until golden brown.

- Serve fresh with green chutney and enjoy!

name: Dates Walnut Kheer
ingredients:
- 180ml milk

- 2 dates

- 1 tbsp Jaggery

- 2 walnut

- 2 tbsp oats

- 2-3 chopped almonds for toppings
method:
- In a nonstick pan add dates and water and cook on a low flame till the dates turn soft.

- Allow the dates to cool. Then using a blender and make a fine paste adding 80 ml milk to the mixture.

- Heat the remaining milk in a pan and cook it on low flame, add jaggery and date paste and mix well.

- Add oats and crushed walnuts and bring to a boil.

- Cool the mixture and refrigerate it.

- While serving garnish with nuts.

name: Soya Keema Veg Spring Rolls (Baked/Airfried)
ingredients:
- 1tsp oil

- ½ tsp cumin seeds

- 2 tbsp chopped Onions

- ¼ cup soya chunks

- ½ tsp ginger garlic green chilli paste

- 2 tbsp chopped Tomatoes

- salt to taste

- 1tsp red chilli powder

- 1tsp coriander powder

- ¼ tsp turmeric powder

- ¼ tsp garam masala

- few coriander leaves

- 1 tsp green peas

- ¼ cup water

- 2 tbsp wheat flour
method:
Preparation of soya keema

- Add oil in a pan heat it and add cumin seeds till it splutters.

- Then add onion and saute till it turns golden brown, then add ginger garlic green chilli paste saute for a few minutes.

- After that add finely chopped tomatoes, salt, red chilli powder, coriander powder, turmeric powder, garam masala, coriander leaves and saute well

- Then add green peas, water and soya keema and cook for 5-10min.

Preparation of roll

- In a bowl add wheat flour and pour water till the consistency and make a dough

- Take a small ball and roll it to a circular shape and half cook the roti.

- Later add coriander chutney and little onions on top of roti and fill the soya kheema and roll it.

- In a pan add little oil and cook the roll on both side and serve.

name: Squash (Chow Chow) Chutney
ingredients:
- 1 1/2-2 cups of cut squash

- 1/2-1 cup of squash skin (optional)

- 5-6 tsp of oil

- 1 cup sliced fresh coconut

- 1/4 cup thick tamarind pulp

- 2 1/2 tbsp of urad dal

- 5-6 whole red chillies

- 10-15 curry patta leaves

- Pinch of asafoetida

- 1/4-1/2 tsp whole mustard seeds

- salt to taste
method:
- Soak tamarind in 1/4-1/2 cup of water to make a thick pulp.

- Cut the squash in cubes with the skin, can scrape a little if you like, keep aside. Take a kadhai add 2 tsp oil it it.

- Warm the oil a little then add the urad dal and whole red chillies, stir fry till the dal becomes beige brown.

- Remove the urad dal and red chillies from the kadhai and keep aside.

- In the same kadhai add 1 tsp oil.

- Add the cut squash and stir fry for few minutes.

- Now add little salt and 1 cup water to the squash.

- When the water begins to bubble, lower the flame and cover and cook till the squash is cooked.

- Remove the squash and keep aside.

- Take a grinder, add the browned urad dal, red chillies, tamarind pulp and the fresh coconut.

- Grind to a paste ,then add salt to taste ,keeping in mind that salt has been put in the squash. Grind again.

- Now add the cooked squash to the grinder and grind everything together to a paste. Then keep aside..

- Now take a kadhai add 2 tsp oil, heat the oil a little.

- Add the asafoetida and the mustard seeds.

- When the mustard seeds start spluttering add the curry patta leaves. Stir fry for few seconds.

- Now pour the tarka on the ground paste. Slightly give it a mix. Ready to serve.

- Done.

Note

- Can adjust red chillies and tamarind according to personal choice. Here I have incorporated the discarded skin of squash which I used to make the vegetable.

name: Squash Ki Subzi (Chow Chow)
ingredients:
- 500 gms squash, peeled, deseeded and cut into big slices

- 3 tbsp oil

- 2 tsp chopped garlic

- 1 tsp chopped ginger

- 1/2 tsp mustard seeds

- 12-15 curry patta leaves

- pinch of fennel powder (optional)

- salt to taste

- red chilli powder to taste

- 1/2 tsp turmeric powder

- 2 tbsp bengal gram roasted ,then powdered
method:
- Put the oil in a kadhai, heat the oil a little.

- Add the mustard seeds, when it starts spluttering.

- Add the chopped garlic and ginger. Stir fry for few minutes.

- Now add the salt, turmeric and red chilli powder to the oil. Stir for few seconds then add the cut squash. Mix it in well.

- Add the curry patta leaves and mix it in well.

- Add 1 cup water, when it comes to boil.

- Cover and cook for few minutes, then add the fennel powder.

- Cover and cook till the squash is cooked.

- Now add the roasted powdered gram flour, mix it in well. Stir fry for few minutes.

- Done.

- Serve with dal and rice.

name: Tinda (Round Gourd) Ki Sabzi
ingredients:
- 500 gms tinda, wash, peel and cut each tinda in 4 pieces. Keep aside

- 3 tbsp oil/ghee

- 1 cup sliced onions

- 1/2 cup chopped coriander leaves

- 2-3 green chillies chopped

- 1/2 tsp ginger paste

- salt to taste

- red chilli powder to taste

- 1/4-1/2 tsp turmeric powder

- 1/2 tsp coriander powder

- 1/4 tsp asafoetida

- 1/2 tsp whole cumin
method:
- Take a pan, add the oil/ghee to it.

- Heat/warm the oil/ghee .

- Then add the asafoetida and whole cumin. Stir fry for few seconds.

- Now add the sliced onion and stir fry till it becomes translucent.

- Add the ginger paste and stir fry till the raw smell goes.

- Can add 2-3 tbsp of water to the pan if the masala is catching at the bottom.

- Next add the chopped green chillies and saute for few seconds.

- Add the salt, turmeric and red chilli powder. Saute for few minutes.

- Now add the coriander powder and saute for few seconds.

- Then add the cut round gourd and mix it in well. Saute for few minutes.

- Add 1/2- 1 cup of water to the pan.

- When the water starts bubbling lower the flame and cover the pan and cook till the vegetable is done.

- Finally add the chopped coriander leaves, mix it in well, cover and cook for few minutes. Then done.

- Serve with roti and raita .

Note

- Can keep a little gravy or make it dry on personal choice.

name: Masala Sattu Paratha
ingredients:
- whole wheat flour (enough for 6-8 parathas)

- 200-250 gms sattu (roasted horesgram)

- 1 tbsp caraway seeds (ajwain)

- 2 tsp onion seeds (kala jeera )

- 1 whole garlic chopped

- 3-4 tbsp of chopped coriander

- green chillies chopped to taste

- salt to taste

- chilli flakes to taste (optional)

- pinch of asafoetida (optional)

- ghee
method:
- Mix the caraway seeds, onion seeds, chopped garlic, green chillies, coriander leaves, salt ,red chilli flakes and asafoetida all together with the sattu (powdered horsegram).

- Dry mix all of the above and keep aside.

- Do not mix any water .

- Make a ball from the kneaded flour ,enough to make a cd size paratha.

- Flatten it out a little put 11/2-2 tbsp of the sattu mixture on it.

- Now bring the sides into the centre and close the ball. Flatten it out a little with your palm.

- Now roll it out gently.

- Heat a tawa or flat skillet. Warm it a little, then add the rolled out sattu dough.

- When it gets a little cooked. Flip the side and roast it till it gets a beige colour.

- Now brush a little ghee on both sides and cook each side for 30-40 seconds.

- Done. Serve hot with mint chutney or curd.

name: Betroot Raita
ingredients:
To prepare the Beetroot for the Raita :

- 2 pcs of Beetroot (wash, peel and cut into small cubes and keep aside)

- 1 tbsp oil

- 1/4 tsp mustard seeds

- 1/4 tsp red chilli powder

- 1 onion chopped

- 1 tbsp roasted peanuts powder

- 1 tbsp grated/desiccated coconut

- few chopped green chillies

- few curry patta leaves chopped

For the raita

- 2 tsp chopped coriander leaves

- 1 tsp chopped green chillies

- 1-2 tbsp of chopped onion

- salt to taste (keep in mind the cooked beetroot has salt and the chat masala has salt )

- 1/2 tsp roasted cumin powder

- 1/4 tsp chat masala

- 2 cups of thick yogurt/curd
method:
- To cook the Beetroot .

- Take a kadhai add the oil ,when it becomes a little warm .

- Add the mustard seeds, chopped green chillies and chopped curry patta. Stir for few seconds .

- Now add the chopped onion. Stir fry till onion becomes translucent .

- Then add the cut beetroot. Stir fry for a minute or so

- Add salt to taste and the red chilli powder. Stir fry for few minutes, then cover and cook on low flame till 70% done. Keep stirring in between.

- Then add the grated/desiccated coconut and stir fry for few minutes.

- Then add the roasted peanut powder. Mix it in well .

- Cook till the beetroot is totally cooked.

- Can be a little crunchy, if preferred.

- Remove and keep aside and let it cool down.

For the Raita

- Beat the curd well ,to give a smooth texture .

- Add salt to taste, roasted cumin powder, chat masala, chopped onion, chopped green chillies and chopped coriander leaves.

- Mix everything well together.

- Lastly add the cooked beetroot .

- Garnish with a little chopped onion, green chillies and coriander leaves.

Note :

- Can add finely chopped ginger to the raita, on personal preference.

- Can make this beetroot vegetable like a main dish and keep some aside for the raita or else just steam the beetroot put tarka of your choice and add to the curd.

name: Eggs With Capsicum/Bell Peppers
ingredients:
- 5-6 full boiled eggs (cut into half)

- 4 medium size onions chopped

- 2 medium -big tomatoes chopped

- 1 big capsicum/bell pepper cut into cubes

- 2-6 green chillies chopped

- 1"pc ginger chopped fine

- 1/4 tsp turmeric powder

- salt to taste

- red chilli powder to taste

- 2-3 tbsp of oil
method:
- Take a pan add the oil .

- Warm the oil a little, then add the chopped ginger, green chillies and onions. Stir fry till till the onions become soft and translucent.

- Then add the chopped tomatoes. Cook till the tomatoes become soft.

- Now add the salt, turmeric and red chilli powder. Saute till the onions and tomatoes become totally soft little pish pash.

- To this add the cut capsicum/bell pepper.

- Cook till the capsicum cooks a little, should remain crunchy. Finally add the hard boiled eggs cut in halves. Mix it in gently, so that they do not break.

- Cover the eggs with the onion tomato masala. Keep for few minutes. Done.

Note :

- Before putting the eggs do check for the salt.

name: Tamarind Rice
ingredients:
- 1 cup raw rice

- 1 golf ball size of tamarind

- 10 whole red chillies

- 1/2 cup raw peanuts

- 1 tbsp sesame seeds

- 10-12 curry patta leaves

- few slitted green chillies

- 6-8 whole garlic chopped

- 1 1/2 tsp whole cumin

- 1 tsp of urad dal

- 1 1/2 tsp whole mustard seeds

- 3/4 tsp fenugreek seeds

- salt to taste

- 1/2 tsp turmeric powder

- 1 tsp cumin powder

- 1-2 tbsp grated coconut (optional)

- 3-4 tbsp of chopped coriander leaves

- 3-4 tbsp oil
method:
Assembling

- Boil the rice with a little salt and keep aside .

- Take a pan and add the whole red chillies, tamarind and 1 cup of water and cook till it all becomes nice and soft. Cool it down and then grind to a paste and keep aside .

- Take a pan and dry roast 1 tsp of whole cumin seeds, 1 tsp of mustard seeds and 3/4 tsp fenugreek seeds, when the seeds start changing colour, remove from flame and let it cool down.

- Dry roast the sesame seeds till it changes colour to a light beige and keep aside.

- Then dry grind all of the above together and keep aside (roasted cumin, fenugreek and sesame seeds).

For the cooking

- Take a kadhai add the oil and warm the oil a little, then add 1/2 tsp of mustard seeds, 1/2 tsp of the whole cumin and the urad dal. Stir fry for 30-40 seconds.

- Then add the peanuts and stir fry for 30-40 seconds.

- Now add the slitted green chillies and chopped garlic and stir fry for 30-40 seconds.

- Next add the curry patta leaves and stir fry till the urad dal changes to a beige brown colour and the peanuts get little crisp.

- To this add the red chilli tamarind paste and stir fry for a minute or so.

- Then add salt to taste ,turmeric powder and half of the roasted (fenugreek, cumin, mustard, sesame) ground powder. Mix it in well and stir fry for few minutes.

- Add the chopped coriander to the kadhai and stir fry for few minutes.

- The masala is done ,remove from the flame. Finally now add the cooked rice to this masala and mix it in really well, so that the rice is throughly infused with the masala .

- Garnish with grated coconut and serve.

name: Bindi Raita
ingredients:
- 200 gms of bindi (ladyfinger)

- 500 gms of curd

- 1 tsp oil

- red chilli powder according to taste

- black salt according to taste

- 1/2 tsp chat masala

- 1 tsp roasted jeera powder

- 1/2 tsp sugar

- 1/2 medium size onion chopped

- 1 tbsp finely chopped coriander leaves

- 1-2 free chilly finely chopped
method:
- Wash and dry the bindi nicely.

- Cut the head and wee bit of tail.

- Cut bindi in small pieces.

- Rub 1 tsp oil in a non stick pan, heat the pan a little and add the cut bindi. Keep stirring on low flame till the bindi cooks and becomes crisp.

- When done leave it for few minutes in the pan.

- Prepare the curd. Add the red chilli powder, black salt, chat masala and roasted jeera powder and the sugar. Mix once then add the chopped onions, coriander and green chillies.

- Mix all nicely and keep aside.

- Just before serving add the crisp bindi. Garnish with roasted jeera powder.

Note

- Do mix bindi in the curd just before serving, or else will become soft.

name: Paneer (Cottage Cheese) & Vegetable Cutlets
categories: Lunch, Dinner, Sim's Family Recipes, Ramzan Specials
ingredients:
- 2 cups crushed paneer

- 2-3 medium size potatoes, boiled

- 15-20 french beans cut small

- 3-4 medium size carrots grated

- 2 cups finely shredded cabbage

- 1/2 cup chopped coriander leaves

- few green chillies chopped to taste

- 1 onion finely chopped

- salt to taste

- 1 tsp dry mango powder

- 1/2 tsp garam masala

- 3 tsp corn flour

- 3-4 tbsp bread crumbs

- 3-4 tbsp of oil
method:
- In a kadhai add 1 tbsp of oil Add the chopped onion and green chillies stir fry for few minutes.

- Add the beans and stir fry for a minute or so.

- Then add the grated carrots and stir fry for few minutes.

- Now add the shredded cabbage and cook for few minutes till the vegetables are 3/4 cooked.

- Remove from the flame then add the boiled potato ,the crushed paneer, the chopped coriander leaves, salt, dry mango powder, garam masala, cornflour and breadcrumbs. Mix it in well

- Check for salt now.

- Now make a ball and and press it in on your palm to make it a little flat.

- Do the same with the rest and keep aside.

- Take a pan and brush oil on it ,when the pan gets a little warm.

- Place the cutlets on it and cook on low flame.

- When one side gets brown Flip the side and repeat the same on the other side.

- Done.

name: Fresh Methi Masala Rice
ingredients:
- 1 1/2 cup raw rice ,to be boiled and kept aside .

- 3-4 tbsp oil

- 1 pc cinnamon stick of 2

- 2 green cardamom

- 1 star anise

- 1-2 bay leaves

- 7-8 garlic pods chopped coarsely

- 2 medium size onions, ground to a paste

- 1 medium size tomato chopped

- salt to taste

- 1/2 tsp turmeric powder

- 1/2 tbsp cumin powder

- 3/4 tbsp of coriander

- 3 cups of chopped methi leaves

- 1 lemon juice
method:
- Put oil in a kadhai, let the oil warm a little.

- Then add the cinnamon stick, cardamom, star anise and bay leaf. Stir for 30-40 seconds.

- Then add the chopped garlic and stir fry till the garlic changes colour.

- Then add the chopped tomato and stir fry for few minutes.

- Now add the ground onion paste. Saute till the water from the onion dries up and it starts changing colour.

- Then add the salt, turmeric, red chilli powder, cumin powder and coriander powder. Mix it in well and saute for 5-7 minutes.

- Now add the chopped methi leaves and saute for 5-10 minutes ,so that the leaves are cooked.

- Next add the lemon juice and mix it in well. Stir for a minute or so.

- Lastly now add the cooked rice and mix it in gently, so that the rice does not break.

- Check for salt.

- Done. Serve with curd and salad.

name: Tamarind Jaggery Brinjal
ingredients:
- 600gms of brinjal (small round brinjal ,remove stem and cut into 4 or 6 pieces )

- 3 tbsp oil

- 1 medium size onion chopped

- 1/4 tsp mustard seeds

- 6-8 curry patta leaves

- 1/4 cup tamarind pulp (not thick )

- salt to taste

- 1/2 tsp turmeric powder

- 1 tsp kashmiri red chilli

- 1/4 tsp cumin powder

- 1/2 tsp coriander powder

- 1 tbsp jaggery powder

- all the roasted powder (given below )

Ingredients to be roasted and coarsely ground and kept aside

- 1/4 tsp whole cumin seeds

- 1/4 tsp mustard seeds

- 1/4 tsp fenugreek seeds

- 1/2 tbsp channa dal

- 1/2 tbsp urad dal

- 2-3 whole red chillies

- 5-6 curry patta leaves
method:
- Take a kadhai add the oil and warm the oil .

- When the oil is warm add the mustard seeds. When it starts spluttering add the chopped onion and the curry patta leaves. Stir fry for few minutes, when it becomes soft.

- Add the cut brinjal and stir fry for few minutes.

- Then add the salt and turmeric powder and mix it in well.

- Add few more curry patta leaves ans stir fry for few minutes. Then cover and cook for 5-7 minutes, stirring in between.

- Now add the tamarind pulp and mix it in well. Stir fry for few minutes

- Then add the red chilli powder, cumin powder, coriander powder and mix it in well. Cover and cook till 90% done.

- Then add the roasted powder and the jaggery powder. Mix it in thoroughly and keep for few minutes. Done.

name: Lemon Rice
ingredients:
- 2 cups of raw rice

- 4 tbsp of oil

- 1/2 tsp mustard seeds

- 1 tbsp of urad dal

- 1/4 cup raw peanuts

- few green chillies chopped

- 1 1/2 onion chopped

- 10-12 curry patta leaves

- 1 tbsp of grated coconut

- salt to taste

- 2 tbsp of chopped coriander leaves

- 2-3 lemon juice
method:
- Boil the rice and keep aside.

- Take a kadhai, add the oil and warm it a little.

- Add the mustard seeds and urad dal.

- When the mustard seeds start spluttering. Add the peanuts and roast for few minutes should become a little crisp.

- Then add the chopped green chillies and stir fry for few minutes.

- Now add the chopped onions and the curry patta leaves. Stir fry for few minutes.

- Add the salt and turmeric powder and stir fry for few minutes.

- Then add the grated coconut and mix it in.

- Now add the juice of the lemons and mix it in.

- Add the chopped coriander leaves, mix it in.

- Remove from the flame and add the rice to it and mix it in thoroughly.

- Done.

Note

- Adjust the lemon flavour to personal taste.

name: Khatta Meetha Karela (Bitter Gourd)
ingredients:
- 500 gms karela (cut into small cubes )

- 1 golf ball size tamarind soaked and pulp taken out, pulp should not be very thick

- 2 tbsp of jaggery

- 1/4 tsp whole cumin

- 1/4 tsp mustard

- salt to taste

- 1/4 tsp turmeric powder powder

- 1/2 tsp kashmiri red chilli

- 1/4 tsp cumin powder

- 3 tbsp oil
method:
- Put oil in a kadhai, warm the oil a little.

- Add the whole cumin.

- Add the mustard, when it starts spluttering add the cut karela and stir fry for few minutes.

- Then add tamarind pulp mix it in well. Cover and cook for few minutes, do stir in between.

- Now add the turmeric powder and stir for few minutes. Cover and cook for few minutes ,do stir in between.

- Next add the red chilli powder, cumin powder and salt to taste. Stir for few seconds then add the jaggery.

- Mix it in well and then cover and cook till the karela is cooked.

- Done.

Note

- The sourness, sweetness and chilli can be adjusted according to taste.

name: Baigan (Brinjal/Eggplant) Bharta
ingredients:
- 2 big brinjal

- 4 medium- big size onion chopped

- 3 -4 medium tomatoes chopped

- 2"pc ginger finely chopped

- 4-5 tbsp of chopped coriander leaves

- few chopped green chillies

- salt to taste

- 1/2 tsp turmeric powder

- 1/2 tsp red chilli powder

- 3 tbsp oil
method:
- Take a metal rack and place on the stove.

- Run a little oil on the brinjal and place on the rack.

- Put on the flame, keep on one side then flip to another side. Keep repeating on all sides ,till the brinjal is totally roasted. Remove from flame and keep aside.

- When it cools down, remove the skin and mash the brinjal with a fork and keep aside.
Can remove few seeds if you like.

Method

- Take a kadhai, add the oil, when the oil becomes warm. Add the chopped onions and ginger and stir fry fir few minutes.

- Now add the chopped green chillies and stir fry till the onions become translucent.

- Then add the chopped tomatoes and saute for few minutes.

- Now add the salt ,turmeric and red chilli powder and saute till the masala becomes soft.

- Next add the the chopped coriander leaves and saute for few minutes.

- Now add the mashed brinjal to the masala and mix it in really well. Cook for few minutes stirring constantly. Done .

- Serve with roti or dal and rice.

name: Padavalakai Sabzi (Snake Gourd)
ingredients:
- 1 big padavalakai

- 1/2 cup chana dal

- 1 medium onion chopped

- 1 medium tomato chopped

- few green chillies slitted into 2

- 10-15 curry patta leaves

- 1/2 tsp mustard seeds

- 1/2 tsp whole cumin

- 1 tsp urad dal

- salt to taste

- red chilli powder to taste

- 1/2 tsp turmeric powder

- 1 tsp cumin powder

- 4 tbsp of roasted peanuts

- 5-6 whole roasted red chillies

- 1 tbsp roasted sesame seeds

- 2-3 tbsp of oil
method:
For the vegetable

- Scrape the vegetable and cut it from the centre, scrape and discard the insides, then cut vertically and then into small cubes, cut and keep aside.

To be ground

- Grind the roasted peanuts, whole red chillies and sesame seeds together and keep aside (peanuts and whole chilli to be roasted together and sesame seeds to be roasted separately).

For the chana dal

- Wash and soak the dal for 1/2 hr, then put in the pressure cooker, add 1 cup of water and cook for 5-7 minutes on low flame after the first whistle. Remove from flame and keep aside. Let the cooker open naturally, the dal should be whole, not too soft, should stand out individually .

Method

- Take a kadhai add the oil, warm the oil.

- Add the mustard seeds, urad dal and whole cumin. Stir for few seconds.

- Then add the green chillies and stir for few seconds.

- To this add the chopped onions and stir fry for few minutes.

- Next add the chopped tomato. Stir fry for few minutes.

- Now add the curry patta and saute for 5-10 minutes.

- Then add the chopped padavalakai and cook for few minutes.

- Add the channa dal and let it cook on low flame.

- Now add the turmeri, red chilli powder and cumin powder and mix it in well.

- Cover and cook for few minutes.

- Lastly add the ground peanut, chilli and sesame seeds powder.

- Mix it in well. Done.

name: Moong Dal Soup
ingredients:
- 1/2 cup raw moong dal

- 1:4 water

- salt to taste

- pinch of white pepper

- 1/4 cup milk

- 1/4 tsp chopped dill (optional)

- crotons
method:
- Wash the dal well and put in a pressure cooker.

- Add water and salt to the dal in the cooker. Close the lid of the pressure cooker and cook on full flame till the start of a whistle.

- Remove the cooker from the flame and let it open naturally.

- Take a pan and place a strainer on it.

- When the cooker opens pour the cooked dal on the strainer. Strain the cooked dal by mashing it in on the strainer.

- Mash all the dal till it becomes a smooth liquid.

- In the end a little dal is left ,like a residue. Discard it.

- Put the pan on the stove and cook on low flame, stirring continuously for few minutes.

- Now slowly add the milk into the soup ,stirring all the time.

- Then add the white pepper (optional).

- Mix it in well, cook for few minutes.

- Done.

- Garnish with crotons and chopped dill.

Method for crotons

- Cut 1 slice of brown bread into small cubes and keep aside.

- Take a pan, add a few drops of oil.

- Warm the oil a little Add the cubes bread pieces.

- Cook on low flame stirring in between, till it becomes a nice brown and crisp. Crotons done.

- Ready to garnish.

name: Chicken Frankie
ingredients:
- ready parathas/tortillas/quesadilla as per requirement

- 300 gms of boneless chicken cut in cubes

- 1 medium to big onion cut in cubes

- 1 medium size tomato cut in cubes

- 6-7 pods of garlic chopped

- 1-1 1/2" pc ginger cut into julienne

- 1 tsp black pepper powder, ground coarsely

- salt to taste

- 1 tsp brown sugar (can use normal sugar also )

- 2 tsp dark soya sauce

- 3 tbsp of oil

Ingredients for hung yogurt

- 500gms of yogurt( put yogurt on a muslin cloth, close it and keep aside for 1/2 hr-1hr )

- 1/2 tsp garlic paste

- salt to taste

- pinch of pepper

- 2 tsp dill chopped (optional)

- 1 tbsp celery stem chopped (optional)

- 1/2 medium size grated (optional)

- 1/4 tsp red chilli flakes

- 1/2 a lime juice

- 1-2 green chillies finely chopped (optional)

- mix all of the above together and keep aside

Ingredients for topping

- sliced carrots

- sliced tomato

- sliced cucumber

- sliced onion

- sliced lettuce

- sliced iceberg

- little mustard sauce (optional)

NB: if you like mustard, then can mix mustard sauce on the cut vegetables and keep aside or just put a little mustard sauce on top of the Frankie if you want or can separately serve some salad on the side tossed lightly with a little mustard sauce .
method:
- Take a kadai add 2 tbsp of oil.

- Warm the oil a little, when the oil is warm add the cut chicken. Stir fry till half done
Then add the chopped garlic and ginger julienne and saute for few minutes and cook till done.

- Now remove the chicken from the kadai and keep aside.

- In the same kadhai add 1 tbsp of oil.

- Warm the oil a little.

- Then add the cut onion, cook till it becomes translucent and change colour.

- Now add the chopped tomato. Saute till the tomato becomes soft.

- To this now add 1 tsp brown sugar and the soya sauce. Cook for few minutes on low flame.

- Now add the cooked chicken and little salt to taste, keeping in mind that the sauce has salt

- Then add the coarsely ground pepper.

- Mix it in well and cook for few minutes till chicken is done.

- Remove the chicken and cut into strips.

- Now take a paratha place the chicken strips on it. Top with hung yogurt.

- Then top with all the sliced veggies. Add a bit of mustard sauce /sriracha sauce or any other sauce you like (optional).

- Close with a toothpick. Enjoy.

name: Tangy Sweet Pearl Onions
ingredients:
- 500 gms of pearl onions (tiny whole onions to be peeled and kept aside)

Ingredients to be roasted and ground to a paste :

- 3 tsp whole coriander seeds

- 1 tsp whole cumin seeds

- 1/2 tsp fenugreek seeds

- 1/2 tsp sesame seeds

- 1/4 tsp black mustard seeds

- 10 whole red chillies

- 3 pieces of coconut of 2 each, to be roasted separately for 4-5 seconds only

- all of the above to be ground to a paste, can add a little water to make a smooth paste.
When done keep the paste aside

Remaining Ingredients

- 3 tbsp oil

- 4 -5 tbsp of tamarind pulp to be kept ready (soak a golf ball tamarind in warm water and keep aside)

- 1/2 tsp black mustard seeds

- 10-12 curry patta leaves

- 1/2 tsp whole cumin

- 1 whole red chilli broken in to half

- 1/4 tsp asafoetida

- salt to taste

- pinch of cumin powder

- pinch of turmeric powder

- pinch of coriander powder

- 1 tsp sambar powder

- 3 tbsp of jaggery powder
method:
- Take a kadhai add the oil and warm the oil a little.

- When the oil is a little warm add the mustard seeds, then add the whole cumin seeds.

- Next add the whole red chilli broken in half. Stir for 30-40 seconds.

- Then add the the curry patta leaves.

- Now add the asafoetida. Stir for few seconds.

- Next add the onions and stir fry till the onions start getting a little translucent.

- Now add the tamarind pulp. Mix it in.

- Now add the salt and turmeric powder and add the ground paste to the onions. Mix it in well.

- Then add the coriander, sambar and cumin powder. Mix everything in well

- Add 1 cup of water in the grinder so that the water gets the flavor of the ground masala. When the water starts bubbling.

- Lower the flame and cover and cook on low flame for few minutes.

- Check for salt, chilli, sourness and sweetness at this stage.

- Adjust according to taste.

- Done.

Note :

- If you do not want to put sambar masala, can be omitted.

name: Chocolate Popcorn
ingredients:
- 1/2 cup raw corn kernels

- 1 tsp oil

- 1× 3 chocolate piece (cooking chocolate)
method:
- Take a pressure cooker, place it on the flame.

- Add the oil and spread it evenly at the base and little on the sides.

- Add the corn kernels and stir it for few seconds so that they get a coating of the oil.

- Lower the flame and cover with a lid or place the cooker cover on top.

- After few seconds the kernels will start popping.

- When done, remove from flame and keep aside.

- Now take a kadhai and place on the flame and warm it a little.

- Remove from the flame When it gets warm.

- Now take the chocolate piece and spread it on the base, till the chocolate melts.

- Now add the popcorn and mix it in well, till all the popcorn is coated with chocolate.

- Done.

name: Manpasand Keema/Mince Curry
ingredients:
- 250 gms mince (meat of your choice)

- 1 tbsp oil

- 1/2 tsp whole cumin

- 2 green cardamom

- 4-5 cloves

- 1 cinnamon stick of 1"pc

- salt to taste

- 1/2 tsp kashmiri red chilli powder

- 1/2 tsp coriander powder

- 1/2 tsp cumin powder

- 1/2 tsp turmeric powder

- 1 medium size onion chopped

- 1 tsp ginger garlic paste

- 1 big or 2 medium size tomatoes chopped

- 10-12 curry patta leaves

- 1 tbsp chopped green chillies (or according to taste)

For the tarka

- 1/2 tsp ghee

- 2-3 whole slitted green chillies

- 7-8 curry patta leaves

- 1/2 tsp kashmiri red chilli powder

- 1 tbsp chopped coriander leaves for garnishing (optional)
method:
- Take a kadhai add oil, warm the oil a little.

- When the oil becomes warm Add the whole cumin, green cardamom, cloves and cinnamon stick. Stir fry for few seconds, when you get a nice fragrance.

- Add the chopped green chillies and stir fry for few seconds.

- Next add the curry patta leaves and stir fry for few seconds.

- Now add the chopped onions and stir fry till the onion starts changing colour.

- When the onion becomes beige brown.

- Add the chopped tomatoes and stir fry for few minutes.

- Then add the salt, chilli, cumin, coriander and turmeric powder. Mix it in well and stir fry till the masala changes colour and the tomatoes become soft.

- When the masala becomes ready add the mince and mix it in well so the the masala mixes well with the mince. Saute for few minutes the mince will leave its own liquid, then add the ginger-garlic paste.

- Now saute the mince on low flame till the raw smell of the ginger garlic goes.

- While sautéing can add few tbsp of water, so that the masala does not catch.

- Now add 3/4 cup warm water.

- Mix it in well, when it starts bubbling, lower the flame and cover and cook till done.

- When the mince is cooked, add the tarka to it.

For the tarka

- Take a small pan, add 1 tsp ghee.

- Let the ghee warm a little. Then add few slitted green chillies.

- Next add the curry patta leaves. Stir fry for few seconds.

- Then add the kashmiri red chilli powder. Stir fry for few seconds, then immediately add to the mince.

- Done. Can garnish with chopped coriander leaves (optional).

Note:

- If using Lamb/Beef/Pork after sautéing can pressure cooker it for 10 minutes on low flame after first whistle. Let the pressure cooker open naturally.

- Then add tarka.

- Done.

name: Lasuni Ridge Gourd
ingredients:
- 750 gms - 1 kg ridge gourd

- peeled and cut into 1-2 piece

- 3-4 whole red chillies
