- 3-4 whole slitted green chillies

- 12-15 pods of garlic chopped coarsely

- 2 medium size onions finely sliced

- 1/2 tsp turmeric powder

- salt to taste

- 3-4 tbsp of chopped coriander leaves

- 2 tbsp of oil
method:
- Take a kadhai add the oil, warm the oil a little.

- When the oil is warm add the whole red chillies and the slitted green chillies. Stir fry for few seconds.

- Then add the coarsely chopped garlic. Stir fry till the garlic changes colour.

- Then add the sliced onions and stir fry. Stir fry till the onions become soft and changes to a beige brown colour.

- Now add the cut ridge gourd and mix it in well.

- Then add the turmeric powder and mix it in.

- After few minutes add the salt and mix it in.

- Cover and cook for few minutes. Do stir in between, the ridge gourd will leave water, it will cook in it.

- When the ridge gourd is done add the chopped coriander leaves. Mix it in nicely.

- It's done.

Note:

- Can leave a little gravy or make it dry on personal preference.

name: Stir Fry Masala Bhindi (Ladyfinger)
ingredients:
- 500gms ladyfinger
(to be washed ,dried completely. Remove the head, slit it from the middle then cut into half. Cut and keep aside. )

- 2-3 tbsp of oil

- 1/2 tsp whole cumin

- salt to taste

- 1/2 tsp turmeric powder

- 1/2 tsp red chilli powder

- 1/2 tsp coriander powder

- 1/2 tsp cumin powder

- 1/2 tsp dry mango powder

- 1/4 tsp chat masala
method:
- Take a kadhai add the oil and warm the oil a little.

- Then add the whole cumin.

- When the cumin starts spluttering.

- Add the cut ladyfinger and mix it in well. Stir fry for few minutes.

- Then add the turmeric powder and stir fry for few more minutes. Cover and cook on low flame, stirring in between.

- Cover and cook till half done. Remove the lid.

- Then add salt and stir fry for few minutes.

- Next add the red chilli powder, coriander powder, cumin powder, dry mango powder and chat masala. Stir fry and mix the dry masala well.

- Now cook on low flame till done, keep stirring the ladyfinger, so that it does not get caught.

- Done.

name: Stir Fry Roast Chicken
ingredients:
- 500 gms of chicken

- cut into small pieces

- 3 tbsp of oil

- 12-15 pods of garlic

- 1 tsp grated ginger

- 2 medium size onions cut into 4 pieces

- few green chillies cut into big pieces

- 3-4 whole red chillies broken into half

- salt to taste

- 1 tsp black pepper powder

- 1/2 tsp dark soya

- 1 tsp worcester sauce (optional)

- 1/2 tsp oyster sauce

- 1/2 tsp vinegar

- 1 tsp rice wine

- 1/2 cup of chopped coriander leaves with stem and roots
method:
- Take a kadhai add the oil, heat the oil a little. Then add the garlic pods and stir fry till it slightly changes colour.

- Remove the garlic pods from the kadhai and keep aside.

- In the same kadhai add the chicken. Stir fry the chicken in full flame.

- Cook till 3/4 done, remove and keep aside.

- In the same kadhai add the grated ginger saute the ginger till it starts changing colour.

- Then add the onion and cut green chillies and stir fry for few minutes.

- Now add the broken whole red chillies. Stir fry for few minutes.

- Next add the cooked chickento the kadhai. Mix it in.

- Add salt and pepper powder and mix it in. Stir fry for few minutes.

- To this add the soya sauce, worcester sauce, oyster sauce one by one and mix it in well. Then add the rice wine and vinegar. Cover and cook so that the sauces get infused in the chicken.

- Finally add the chopped coriander leaves, stem and roots and mix it in.

- Done.

name: Hara Bhara Lauki (Bottle Gourd) Ki Sabzi
ingredients:
- 500gms of bottle gourd

- peeled and cut into small cubes

- cut and keep aside

- 2 tbsp oil/ghee

- 1/2 tsp whole cumin

- 1/4 tsp asafoetida

- 1 medium size onion chopped

- 1 1/2 tsp of grated ginger

- few green chillies chopped 3-4 tbsp of chopped coriander leaves

- 1/4 tsp turmeric powder

- salt to taste
method:
- Take a kadhai add the ghee/oil.

- Let it warm a little, then add the whole cumin.

- When the cumin starts spluttering add the asafoetida. Keep fir 15-20 seconds.

- Next add the chopped onion and stir fry till they become little translucent. Then add the grated ginger. Saute for few minutes then add the cut green chillies.

- Saute for few minutes till the onion starts becoming soft and changing color.

- Now add the chopped coriander leaves. Mix it in well and saute for a minute or so.

- Now add the cut bottle gourd and mix it in with the onion masala. To this now add the turmeric powder.

- Next add salt to taste. Saute for few minutes.

- Lower the flame and cover and cook till the bottle gourd is cooked, do keep stirring in between.

- Done. Serve with paratha/roti and curd.

name: Sukha Kheema (Mince)
ingredients:
- 250gms mince (cook and keep aside)

- 1 tsp ginger-garlic paste

- 1 big tomato cut into 4 pieces

- few green chillies cut into big pieces

- 1/4-1/2 tsp red chilli powder

- salt to taste

- 1/4 tsp garam masala

- 1 pc ginger cut into julienne

- 2 tbsp chopped coriander leaves (optional)

- 2 tbsp of oil

- spices to be coarsely pounded and kept aside

- 3-4 whole red chillies

- 1/2 tsp whole coriander seeds

- 1/2 tsp whole cumin seeds

- 1/2 tsp whole peppercorns
method:
- Take a kadhai add the oil, warm the oil a little.

- Then add the mince to it and cook till done (can pressure cook the mince if it is of lamb /pork/beef can cook for 10 minutes with 1/2 cup of water for 10 minutes on low flame after first whistle. Let it open naturally).

- Now in the same kadhai add 1 tsp ginger garlic paste to the cooked mince. Saute till the raw smell of the ginger garlic goes.

- Then add the cut tomato and green chillies. Saute for few minutes can add few tbsp of water if it starts catching.

- Then add the red chilli powder and mix it in. Next add the salt and saute for few minutes.

- Now remove the skin of the tomato and discard it. Saute till the mince turns a nice beige brown colour.

- Next add the coarsely pounded masala and saute for few minutes.

- Then add 1/2 cup water and the garam masala and saute for few minutes.

- To this now add the ginger julienne and mix it in. Saute for few minutes till you get a nice colour of the mince.

- Lastly add the chopped coriander leaves (optional)and mix it in. Saute for few minutes .

- Done .

name: Chatpatta Pumpkin (Orange Pumpkin) Ki Sabzi
ingredients:
- 500gms orange pumpkin (peel and cut the pumpkin in cubes and keep aside)

- 3-4 whole red chillies

- few green chillies cut into big pieces

- 1/2 tsp sugar

- 1/2 panch phoren

- 1/4 tsp asafoetida

- 1/2 tsp turmeric powder

- 1/2 tsp chilli powder

- 1/2 tsp kashmiri red chilli powder (optional)

- 1/2 tsp cumin powder

- 1/2 tsp dry mango powder

- 1/2 tsp chat masala

- salt to taste (when adding salt keep in mind that chat masala has salt )

- 2 tbsp oil/ghee

- 1 big onion finely sliced

- 3-4 tbsp of chopped coriander leaves
method:
- Take a kadhai add the oil and warm it a little. Then add the whole red chillies. Next add asafoetida then after few seconds.

- Add the panch phoren and stir for few seconds. Then add sliced onion and stir fry till little translucent.

- Now add the dry spices, turmeric powder, chilli powder, kashmiri red chilli powder, tsp cumin powder, dry mango powder, chat masala and salt to taste (when adding salt need to keep in mind that chat masala has salt). Stir fry for few seconds on low flame then add the sugar and 2-3 tbsp of water and then saute for few seconds.

- To this masala add the cut pumpkin and stir fry for few seconds.

- Then add the salt and saute for few minutes.

- Then add the cut green chillies and mix it in well.

- Now cover the pumpkin and cook on low flame till 90 % done.

- Do keep stirring in between.

- Finally add the chopped coriander leaves. Mix it in and cook till done.

- Done. Serve with roti, paratha and raita.

name: Gajar Matar (Carrots And Green Peas) Ki Sabzi
ingredients:
- 500gms carrots, peel and cut into cubes and keep aside

- 2-3 tbsp of oil/ghee

- 1 tsp whole cumin

- 1/4 tsp asafoetida

- 1 tbsp grated ginger

- 2-3 green chillies chopped

- 1 medium-big tomato chopped

- 1/2 tsp turmeric powder

- 1/2 tsp chilli powder

- salt to taste

- 2 tsp of crushed dry kasturi methi leaves

- 2 tbsp chopped coriander leaves
method:
- Take a kadhai add the oil/ghee and let it become warm

- Then add the whole cumin and asafoetida. Stir fry for 30-40 seconds.

- Then add the grated ginger and stir fry for a minute or so.

- Next add the chopped green chillies. Stir fry for on medium to low flame for a minute or so.

- Now add the chopped tomato. Saute for few minutes till the tomato becomes mushy.

- Then add the turmeric powder and red chilli powder and saute till starts seeping from the sides.

- To this masala add the cut carrots and mix it in well with the masala. Stir fry for few minutes.

- Then add peas and mix it in well. Stir for few minutes then add salt to taste.

- Now cover the carrots and cook on low flame till the carrots are cooked. Do keep stirring in between, if required do add few tbsp of water.

- When the carrots are 90% done. Add the crushed kasturi methi leaves. Mix it in well and stir for few minutes.

- Lastly add the chopped coriander leaves (this is optional). Mix it in well Keep for few minutes and done .

name: Masaledar Dahi Baigan (Yogurt Brinjal)
ingredients:
- 12-15 pieces of brinjal to be cut/slit into four pieces, taking care not to reach the bottom

- 3 tbsp oil

- 10-12 curry patta leaves

- salt to taste

- 1/2 tsp of whole cumin

- 1/4 tsp asafoetida

- 1 onion chopped

- 1 tsp ginger-garlic paste

- few chopped green chillies to taste

- 2 tsp dry kasturi methi leaves

- 1 tomato grated

- 3 tbsp of curd

In a bowl put

- 1/4 tsp turmeric powder

- 1/2 tsp coriander powder

- 1/2 tsp cumin powder

- 1/4 tsp red chilli powder

- 1/4 tsp kashmiri red chilli

- mix above in 5-7 tbsp of water and keep aside
method:
- Take a kadhai add 1 tbsp of oil, warm the oil a little.

- Add the curry patta and stir fry for 30-40 seconds.

- Then add the slitted brinjal to the kadhai. Stir fry for few minutes.

- Then add salt to taste.

- Now cover and cook the brinjal on low flame till 80-90% done. Do gently stir in between.

- When the brinjal is more or less done.

- Remove the brinjal from the kadhai and keep aside.

- In the same kadhai add the remaining oil.

- Warm the oil a little, then add the whole cumin.

- When the cumin starts spluttering, add the asafoetida and keep for few seconds.

- Then add the chopped onion and stir fry till it becomes translucent and starts changing colour.

- Then add the ginger-garlic paste and saute till the raw smell goes.

- Now add the chopped green chillies. After few minutes add the kasturi methi leaves and stir fry for few seconds.

- Then add the infused masala in the bowl. Saute for few minutes till the water dries up now add the puree of the grated tomato. Saute till the water from the tomato dries up

- Next add the yogurt/curd. Saute till the water dries up. Do mix really well so that the masala and yogurt/curd mix well.

- When the water dries up, add the cooked brinjal. Mix it in well gently taking care not to break the brinjal.

- Cover and cook on low flame for few minutes so that the brinjal gets coated nicely with the masala. Do stir in between gently.

- Done.

name: Fish Kalia
ingredients:
- 5 pcs of fish/500 gms of fish

- 4 tbsp of oil (preferable mustard oil)

- 2 bay leaf

- 3-4 whole red chillies

- 2 pieces of cinnamon stick of 1/2 each

- 2 green cardamom

- 4 cloves

- 1/2 tsp whole cumin

- 1 medium to big size onion sliced fine

- 1 onion grated

- 1 tsp ginger garlic paste

- 1 tomato grated

- 2 tbsp curd /yogurt

- 1/2 tsp turmeric powder

- 1/4 tsp red chilli powder

- 1/4 tsp kashmiri red chilli

- 1/2 tsp coriander powder

- salt to taste

- 1/2 tsp sugar

- 1/4 tsp garam masala

- 1/2 cup peas (optional)

- few slitted whole red chillies
method:
- Marinate fish with pinch of turmeric and salt and keep aside for few minutes.

- In a kadhai add 2 tbsp oil, heat the oil then add one piece of fish, let it cook on one side then flip the side and do the same on the other side, when all are done, keep aside.

- In the same kadhai add the oil, heat the oil, when the oil is hot, add the bay leaves.

- Then add the whole red chillies. Next add the pieces of cinnamon stick, green cardamom and the cloves, stir it for few seconds.

- Next add the whole cumin seeds. Stir for 30-40 seconds.

- Now add the finely sliced onion. Stir fry till the onion becomes beige brown.

- Then add the grated onion. Saute for few minutes till the water from the grated onion dries up and the masala turns a nice brown, then add the ginger garlic paste. Saute till the raw smell from the ginger-garlic goes, can add few tbsp of water in between if the masala starts catching at the bottom. Saute till the masala becomes soft.

- Now add the turmeric powder, red chilli powder, kashmiri red chilli powder and coriander powder. Add a little water and saute for few minute.

- Then add salt to taste and saute for a minute or so. When the oil starts seeping from the sides, masala is ready.

- To this masala now add add the grated tomato. Saute for few minutes.

- When the water from the tomato dries up, the masala is ready.

- Next add the curd. Saute till the masala becomes soft and the water from the curd dries up. Masala is ready.

- To the masala add the peas (these are frozen peas ,if using fresh need to semi cook it first, this is completely optional). Saute for few minutes.

- Then add the sugar. Now add water and let it come to a boil, can add more or less according to the gravy you would like.

- When the water starts boiling ,lower the flame and add the cooked fish. Cover and cook for few minutes on low flame.

- Open the cover and add garam masala and few whole slitted green chillies. Mix it in gently.

- Lastly add 1 tsp ghee on top. Keep for few seconds and ready.

- Done.

name: Chicken Kadhai
ingredients:
- 500-600 gms of chicken

- 3tbsp of oil

- 1/2 tsp whole cumin

- 1 1/2 bid size onion sliced fine

- 1 1/2 tsp ginger-garlic paste

- few slitted green chillies

- 2 tomatoes cut into thick slices

- 2 onions cut into 4 pieces each

- 2 tbsp chopped coriander leaves

- 2 tbsp curd/yogurt

- salt to taste

- 1/4 tsp red chilli powder

- 1/4 tsp kashmiri red chilli powder

- 1/4 tsp turmeric powder

Dry roast

- 1 1/2 tsp whole coriander seeds

- 1 tsp whole black peppercorns

- 4 whole red chilli

- 2 bay leaves

- 2 green cardamom

- 4-5 cloves

- when cooled down coarsely pound in a mortar pestal and keep aside
method:
- Take a kadhai add the oil and heat the oil.

- When the oil becomes hot add the chicken to it. Stir fry on full flame for few seconds.

- Then add the whole cumin and continue stir frying. Next add the finely sliced onions. Stir fry till onions become translucent.

- Now add the coarsely pounded masala to the chicken. Stir fry for few minutes.

- Then add few slitted green chillies.

- Next add the salt to taste, red chilli powder, kashmiri red chilli powder and turmeric powder.

- Mix the masala in well and stir fry for 5-7 minutes.

- Then add 11/2 tsp ginger-garlic paste. Saute till the raw smell of the ginger garlic goes.

- Now add 2 tomatoes cut into thick slices. Mix the tomatoes in and cook for few minutes. Lower the flame and cover and cook till chicken becomes tender.

- Open the cover and stir in between.

- Take out/remove the skin of the tomato and discard it.

- Then add 2 tbsp of curd to the chicken. Saute till you get a nice reddish brown colour.

- Then add the cut onion pieces and slitted green chillies. Saute for few minutes Then add the chopped coriander leaves. Mix it in well and ready. Done.

name: Stir Fry Button Mushrooms And Vegetables
ingredients:
- 2 tbsp of oil

- 10-12 pieces of button mushrooms cut into 4 pieces each

- 1 medium to big size carrot cut into circles

- 12-15 pieces of french beans cut in slant

- 2 onions cut into 4 pieces each

- 1 big bell pepper cut into cubes

- 1/2-3/4 tbsp of sugar

- Pinch of salt keeping in mind that the sauces have salt

- 1 piece of ginger of 2 cut in circles

- 15-20 pods of garlic cut in circles

- few green chillies cut in slant

Mixture to be mixed in a bowl and kept ready

- 1 tsp dark soya sauce

- 1 1/2 tsp of oyster sauce

- 1/4 tsp of white pepper

- 1/2 tsp of black pepper

- 1/2 tsp of cornflour and 3-5 tbsp of water
method:
- Take a kadhai and add the oil to it.

- When the oil becomes hot add the ginger and stir fry for a minute or so.

- Then add the chopped garlic and stir fry for a minute or two ,will get a nice garlic aroma.

- Next add the green chillies, stir fry for a minute.

- To this add the cut carrot and stir for few seconds.

- Then add the cut french beans and stir fry for few minutes.

- Now add the cut onions and stir for 30-40 seconds.

- To this add the sugar and mix it in well.

- Now add a pinch of salt.

- To the kadhai add the button mushrooms and stir fry for a minute or so.

- Then add the cut bell pepper. Stir fry for few minutes.

- Lastly add the sauce mixture and mix it in well. Stir for few minutes then done .

name: Sukha Masala Ki BhindiI (Ladyfinger)
ingredients:
- 500gms bhindi (ladyfinger)

- 3 tbsp oil

- 1 big onion sliced

- few green chillies chopped

- 1/4 tsp asafoetida

- 1/2 tsp whole cumin

- 1/2 tsp turmeric powder

- 1/2 tsp coriander powder

- 1/2 tsp dry mango powder

- red chilli powder to taste

- salt to taste

For the tarka

- 1 tsp ghee/oil

- 10-12 or more whole pods of garlic

- 1 big onion cut into 6 pieces

- 1 tomato cut into 4 pieces

- 1-2 whole green chillies sliced
method:
- Wash and wipe the bhindi well and cut and discard the head. Then cut it into 1 piece and keep aside.

- Take a kadhai add the oil and warm the oil a little, add to the oil the asafoetida and the whole cumin. Stir for few seconds.

- Then add the sliced onion. Stir fry for few minutes.

- Then add the chopped green chillies. Stir for few minutes.

- Then add the turmeric powder. Stir for few minutes.

- Then add the cut bhindi (ladyfinger). Mix it in well and fry for few minutes.

- Then cover and cook on low flame for few minutes. Next add the red chilli powder, mix it in.

- Now add the salt to taste. Then add the coriander powder and mix it in.

- After that add the dry mango powder and mix it in well. Now Stir fry well for few minutes.

- Then cover and cook on low flame till the bhindi is cooked, do stir in between.

- Now to ready the tarka, take a pan add the ghee/oil, when the ghee/oil become warm add the pods of garlic. Stir fry for 30-40 seconds.

- Then add the cut onion pieces. When the garlic starts changing colour.

- Add the cut tomato pieces. Stir fry for few minutes.

- Lastly add 1-2 slitted vertically green chillies. Fry for a minute or so Then add to the cooked bhindi. Mix it in well and cook for few minutes and done.

name: Keema Do Pyaza
ingredients:
- 500 gms of mince (chicken/pork/lamb/beef)

- 3 tbsp oil

- 2 green cardamom

- 1 black cardamom

- 4 cloves

- 1 pc cinnamon stick

- 1 whole red chilli

- 1 1/2 - 2 tsp of grated ginger-garlic

- 1 big onion cut into 2 halves and then cut thick slices

- 1 medium tomato chopped

- 1/4 tsp turmeric powder

To be dry roasted and then coarsely pounded in a mortar pestal

- 1 tbsp of whole coriander seeds

- 3/4 tbsp of whole cumin seeds

- 2 tbsp of yogurt

- 5-6 chopped green chillies

- 2 tbsp of chopped coriander leaves

- 1-2 tbsp of chopped mint leaves
method:
- Dry roast the coriander and cumin seeds till the coriander seeds change to a nice beige colour. Remove and keep aside, when it cools down transfer to a mortar pestal and pound it coarsely and keep aside.

- In the same pan add the oil. When the oil is warm add the green and black cardamom, cinnamon stick, cloves and whole red chilli.

- After few seconds Add the mince and roast it till it starts changing colour. Then add the grated ginger garlic and saute till the raw smell goes.

- Next add the turmeric powder and the pounded coriander cumin seeds. Saute on low flame for 5-7 minutes, can add few tbsp of water if it starts catching at the bottom.

- Now add the chopped tomato and saute till it becomes soft. To this add the yogurt and saute for few minutes.

- If cooking chicken mince can continue in the kadhai.

- For lamb/pork/beef can transfer the mince to a pressure cooker and cook for 10 minutes on low flame after the first whistle.

- Add 1/2 cup water to it. Let the cooker open naturally.

- Then transfer the mince to the kadhai. Saute for few minutes. Now add the thick onion slices. Mix it in.

- To this now add the chopped green chillies. Mix it in.

- Now cover and cook for few minutes so that the onion becomes a little translucent.

- Lastly remove the cover and add the chopped coriander leaves and the chopped mint leaves. Check for salt add if required. Mix everything in well and saute for few minutes.

- Done.

name: Snake Gourd Ki Sabzi
ingredients:
- 500 gms of snake gourd

- 2 tbsp oil

- 1 onion sliced fine

- 1 tsp ginger-garlic paste or grated

- 1 tomato chopped

- 1/4 tsp cumin powder

- 1/4 tsp turmeric powder

- 1/4 tsp sugar

- salt to taste(keeping in mind that a pinch of salt has been added to the raw snake gourd)

- few slitted green chillies

- 2 tsp mustard paste (grind or pound 1 tbsp mustard seeds with a little salt and 1 green chilli, use only 2 tsp )

- 2 tbsp of chopped coriander leaves
method:
- Peel or scrape the skin and cut into half vertically and then cut into 1-2 pieces, then sprinkle with 1/4 tsp turmeric and a pinch of salt and keep for 5-10 minutes.

- Take a kadhai add the oil, when the oil becomes warm.

- Add the sliced onion. Stir fry for few minutes, when the onion starts changing colour, it starts become beige brown. Then add the grated ginger garlic or paste. Saute for few minutes till the raw smell of the ginger garlic goes and it turns into a nice light brown colour.

- Then add the chopped tomato. Saute for few minutes. Then add the cumin powder
Mix it in.

- Next add salt to taste ,keeping in mind that salt has been sprinkled on the raw snake gourd.

- Add the turmeric powder, mix it in well.

- Now add the sugar and saute for few minutes.

- Then add 1/4 cup water and mix the masala well ,saute till the water dries up and the masala turns soft.

- When the water dries up add few slitted green chillies.

- Then add the mustard paste and saute for a minute or so.

- Now add the cut snake gourd and mix it in. Stir fry for few minutes. Cover and cook till it is done, do keep stirring in between. Snake Gourd leaves a lot of water, if it does not do so then add 1/2 cup of water and let it cook on low flame.

- When done can leave a little gravy or dry it up is on personal choice.

- Add the chopped coriander leaves and mix it in and done.

name: Pudina Dahi Chicken
ingredients:
- 500gms chicken

- 1 1/2 tbsp oil

- 1 1/2 tbsp ghee

- 2 1 /2 tbsp of grated ginger-garlic

- 1/4 tsp turmeric powder

- 1/4 tsp red chilli powder

- 1/2 tsp coriander powder

- 1/2 tsp cumin powder 1-2 bay leaf

- 3-4 whole red chillies

- 2 green cardamom

- few slitted green chillies

- 2 tbsp of coriander mint and green chillies paste

- 2 tbsp of chopped coriander leaves

- 2 tbsp of yogurt

- 1 tsp sugar

- 1/4 tsp white pepper

- 1/4 tsp black pepper

To be ground to a paste

- grind 1/4 cup mint leaves and little less than 1/4 cup of coriander leaves and 3-4 whole green chillies. Keep aside.
method:
- Take a kadhai add the ghee and oil. Warm it a little, then add the grated ginger garlic. Saute for few minutes till it becomes beige in colour.

- Then add turmeric powder, red chilli powder and saute for few minutes.

- Then add the coriander powder and cumin powder. Saute for few minutes.

- Now add the chicken to the masala and stir fry the chicken for few minutes. Then add the slitted green chillies, the bay leaf, whole red chilli and the green cardamom. Saute for few minutes.

- Then add the coriander mint chilli paste. Mix it in well and stir fry for few minutes.

- To the chicken now add the chopped coriander leaves. Mix it in nicely then add the yogurt. Mix it in, then cover and cook on low flame till chicken is done, do keep stirring in between.

- Lastly add the sugar Mix it in and then.

- Add the white and black pepper. Saute on low flame for few minutes.

- When the oil starts seeping from the sides. It's done.

name: Afghani Chicken
ingredients:
- 500gms chicken

- 1 1/2 tbsp oil

- 1 1/2 tbsp ghee

- 2 1 /2 tbsp of grated ginger-garlic

- 1/4 tsp turmeric powder

- 1/4 tsp red chilli powder

- 1/2 tsp coriander powder

- 1/2 tsp cumin powder 1-2 bay leaf

- 3-4 whole red chillies

- 2 green cardamom

- few slitted green chillies

- 2 tbsp of coriander mint and green chillies paste

- 2 tbsp of chopped coriander leaves

- 2 tbsp of yogurt

- 1 tsp sugar

- 1/4 tsp white pepper

- 1/4 tsp black pepper

To be ground to a paste

- grind 1/4 cup mint leaves and little less than 1/4 cup of coriander leaves and 3-4 whole green chillies. Keep aside.

- next take 2 tbsp cashews soak it in warm water for 10-15 minutes, drain that water, then put the cashews in a grinder add few tbsp of water and grind to a paste. Keep aside.
method:
- Take a kadhai add the ghee and oil. Warm it a little, then add the grated ginger garlic. Saute for few minutes till it becomes beige in colour.

- Then add turmeric powder,red chilli powder and saute for few minutes.

- Then add the coriander powder and cumin powder. Saute for few minutes.

- Now add the chicken to the masala and stir fry the chicken for few minutes.

- Then add the slitted green chillies, the bay leaf, whole red chilli and the green cardamom. Saute for few minutes.

- Then add the coriander mint chilli paste. Mix it in well and stir fry for few minutes.

- To the chicken now add the chopped coriander leaves. Mix it in nicely then add the yogurt.

- Mix it in, then cover and cook on low flame till chicken is done, do keep stirring in between. Lastly add the sugar Mix it in and then.

- Add the white and black pepper. Saute on low flame for few minutes.

- When the oil starts seeping from the sides. Lastly add 3 tbsp of the cashew paste. Mix it in thoroughly. Saute on low flame for few minutes.

- When the oil starts seeping from the sides it's done.

name: Long/String Beans Stir Fry
ingredients:
- 300-350 gms of long/string beans

- 1 1/2 tbsp of oil

- 1 tbsp of chopped ginger

- 1-2 tbsp of chopped garlic

- 1 big onion cut into half then cut into thick slices

- 1 tsp brown sugar

- 1 tbsp oyster sauce

- 1 tbsp light soya sauce

- 2 tsp rice wine

- 1 tsp red chilli flakes

- 1/4 tsp sesame oil

- pinch of salt
method:
- Wash and cut the string beans to 2 pieces, discard the edges from both ends and keep aside.

- Take a kadhai add oil, when it becomes warm add the chopped ginger and stir fry for a minute use or so.

- Now add the string beans and stir fry for few minutes.

- Then add the chopped garlic and stir fry for few minutes.

- Cover and cook just for few minutes as the crunchiness should remain, do stir in between.

- Remove cover then add the thickly sliced onion, cook on medium heat.

- Then add the brown sugar and stir fry for few seconds.

- Now add the oyster sauce and the light soya sauce. Cook for few minutes.

- Then add the rice wine and mix it in thoroughly. Next add the red chilli flakes and mix it in.

- Lastly add the sesame oil and a pinch of salt, keeping in mind that the sauces have salt. Stir fry for 30-40 seconds and done.

- Ready.

name: Chicken Roast With Vegetables
ingredients:
- 500gms chicken

- 3 tbsp of oil

- 10-12 pods of garlic chopped

- 6 whole red chillies

- 1 carrot cut into big pieces of 1 each

- 10-12 french beans cut in a slant of 1 each

- 1 big onion cut into big pieces

- pinch of salt

- 1/2 tsp pepper

- 2 tbsp of oyster sauce

- 2 tbsp of tomato ketchup
method:
- Take a kadhai add the oil, heat the oil, then add the chicken, keep for few minutes on one side then flip the side. Stir fry for few minutes.

- Then add chopped garlic. Stir fry for 5-7 minutes.

- Then add the whole red chillies. Cover and cook for few minutes on low flame.

- Add the cut carrot and beans to the chicken. Add pinch of salt and mix it in ,add less salt as sauces have their own salt.

- Add the black pepper and stir fry for 30-40 seconds.

- Next add the oyster sauce and mix it in.

- Then add the tomato sauce and mix it in. Stir fry for few minutes, then add the cut onions.

- Mix it in well, stir fry for a minute or so and Done.

name: Sukha Masala Bitter Gourd (Karela)
ingredients:
- 300-350 gms bitter gourd cut in circles

- 3 tbsp oil

- 1/4 tsp whole fennel (sauf)

- 1/2 tsp whole cumin

- 1/4 tsp asafoetida

- 1/4 tsp turmeric powder

- 1/2- 1tsp red chilli powder

- 1 tsp coriander powder

- 1 tsp sugar

- salt to taste

- 1 tbsp of pounded garlic

- 1 tbsp lemon juice

- 1 tbsp gram flour (besan )

- 1 tbsp rice flour
method:
- Cut the bitter gourd into circles and keep aside.

- Take a kadhai add the oil, warm the oil a little, then add whole fennel seeds.

- Then add whole cumin seeds.

- Then add asafoetida. Stir fry for 20-30 seconds.

- Then add bitter gourd cut into circles, remove the centre part. Stir fry for few minutes, cover and cook on low flame for few minutes.

- Then add 1 tbsp of pounded garlic. Stir fry for few minutes.

- Next add the lemon juice and mix it in.

- After this add salt to taste. Then add 1 tsp sugar and stir fry for few minutes.

- Now add the turmeric, red chilli powder and coriander powder. Mix everything in well and cook for few minutes.

- Now add 1 tbsp of besan and 1 tbsp of rice flour mix it in well with the bitter gourd. Stir fry till all the masala, besan and rice flour coat the bitter gourd. Keep for few seconds.

- Now Done.

name: Hara Bhara Saag - Mix veg with Spinach
ingredients:
- 1 bundle spinach (approximately 500-600 gms)

- Few whole green chillies

- 1 carrot cut into sem circles

- 1/2 green capsicum cut into cubes

- 1/2 red capsicum cut into cubes

- 1 onion cut into 4(optional)

- 5-8 mushrooms cut into 4 pieces each

- 1/2 cup cooked peas

- 8-10 cashews

- 2 tsp melon seeds

- 1 tsp whole cummin

- 2 tsp whole coriander seeds pounded coarsely

- Few whole red chillies

- 1 onion chopped

- 1 tsp ginger garlic paste

- 2 tomatoes chopped

- Red chilli powder to taste

- Salt to taste

- 1/2 tsp garam masala

- 1/4 tsp turmeric powder

- 1/2 tsp coriander powder

- 1/2 tsp cummin powder

- 1 tbsp of dry kasturi methi leaves

- 2 1/2 tbsp of ghee / oil

For the tadka (optional )

- 1/2 tbsp of ghee

- 5-6 whole pods of garlic

- 1/2 tsp kasmiri red chilli

- 1 tomato cut into big pieces
method:
- Blanch the spinach

- Clean and cut the spinach coarsely

- Place it in a pan on low flame

- Cover and keep for few minutes

- Flip the spinach and cook for few minutes

- Remove from flame and let it cool down

- Then grind the spinach with few green chillies and keep aside .

- Grind the cashews and melon seeds together in a grinder to make a paste .

- Keep aside .

- Take a pan add 1 tsp of ghee/oil

- Warm the oil and swirl it around

- Add the cut vegetables with a pinch of salt and stir fry on full flame till the vegetables are more than half done .

- Remove and keep aside

Method

- Take a kadhai

- Add the ghee

- When the ghee in warm add the whole red chillies, cummin seeds and the ground coriander

- Stir till the cummin starts spluttering

- Add the chopped onion

- Stir fry till the onions become beige

- Then add the ginger-garlic paste

- Saute till thee raw smell of the ginger garlic goes

- Now add the chopped tomatoes

- Saute till the tomatoes become mushy

- Can add 2-3 tbsp of water to saute

- Now add the salt ,turmeric, red chilli powder, cummin powder, coriander powder

- Saute for few minutes

- Can add few tbsp of water and saute

- When the masala becomes a nice reddish colour

- Add 1/2 tsp garam masala

- Saute for few minutes

- Now add the dry kasturi methi leaves

- Saute for few minutes

- Add the ground spinach

- Mix it in well in the masala

- When the spinach starts bubbling

- Lower the flame and cook till the water of the spinach dries up

- Keep stirring

- When the spinach becomes thick

- Add the cashews melon paste mixed with a little water

- Mix it in well

- Cook for few minutes

- Now add the vegetables and cook on low flame for few minutes

Now the tadka

- Take a small kadhai

- Add the ghee

- When the ghee is warm add the whole cummin and garlic

- Stir for few minutes and red chilli powder and cut tomato

- Stir fry few seconds

- Now add to the spinach .

- Done

- Serve with rotis.

name: Truly Chilli Chicken
ingredients:
- 350 gms of chicken, boneless, cut into thin pieces ( or paneer / mushroom / baby corn)

- 1/2 tsp oyster sauce

- 1 1/2 tsp light soya sauce

- 1/2 tsp dark soya sauce

- 1/2 tsp sesame oil

- 1/2 tsp cornflour

- Pinch of salt

- 1/4 tsp sugar

- Marinate all of the above and keep aside for 20-30 minutes

Remaining ingredients

- 1 tsp chopped garlic

- 6-8 whole pods of garlic sliced

- 1/4 cup scallions cut in 1"pieces

- 12-15 green chillies cut in diagonal, in 1 " pieces

- 1/4 tsp oyster sauce

- 1 tsp light soya

- 1/4 tsp sugar

- 3 tbsp oil
method:
- Take a wok or pan and add 2 tbsp of oil

- Heat the oil ,when the oil is hot add the marinated chicken and stir fry continuously on high flame

- When the chicken is more or less done

- Add all the green chillies and stir fry for a minute or two

- Remove from wok and keep aside

- In the same wok add the remaining oil, when the oil is warm add the chopped garlic, stir then immediately add the sliced garlic

- Stir fry for 30-40 seconds

- Now add the scallions and stir fry for few seconds

- Switch of the flame and add the light soya and the oyster sauce

- Mix it in well

- Put on the fame stir for few seconds

- Then add the chicken ,sugar and pinch of salt .

- Stir fry on high flame for few seconds.

- Done

- Serve with rice or fried rice

name: Achari Nimbu Dal
ingredients:
- 1/2 cup raw moong dal

- 10 -12 pieces of french beans cut into 1"pieces

- 1 medium to small carrot cut into cubes

- 1 medium tomato cut into cubes

- 1 tbsp chopped ginger

- 2 tbsp chopped coriander leaves

- Few slitted green chillies

- 3/4 of a small lemon (soft one with yellow skin ) sliced with skin

- salt to taste

- 1/2 tsp turmeric powder

- 1/2 tsp chilli powder

- 1/2 tsp coriander powder 1/2 tsp cumin powder

- water 1:3 (1 1/2 cups of water)

- 1/4-1/2 cup etc of water for the vegetables

For the tarka

- 1/2 tsp ghee/oil

- 2-3 whole red chillies

- 2-3 green chillies slitted 8-10 cloves of garlic

- 1/4 tsp whole cumin

- 1/4 tsp coriander seeds

- 1/4 lemon sliced

- 1/4 tsp red chilli powder
method:
- Take the raw dal and wash and soak for 1/2 n hour

- Then place the washed dal in the pressure cooker

- Add the cut carrot,french beans,tomato ,chopped coriander leaves ,chopped ginger and 3/4 of the sliced lemon

- To this add salt to taste , turmeric powder , chilli powder ,coriander powder and cumin powder

- Now add water for the dal and vegetables

- Close the lid of the cooker and place on the stove ,

- Cook till the start of a whistle on full flame .

- Then remove from stove and keep aside .

- Let it open naturally .

- When done open the lid

- Mix it in gently

- Lastly do the tarka

- Add ghee/oil in a kadhai

- When the oil/ghee is warm add the whole red chillies and green chillies

- Then add the cloves of garlic

- Stir fry for few seconds

- Then add the whole cumin and coriander seeds

- Stir fry for a minute or so then add the remaing lemon slices

- Now add the red chilli powder

- Stir fry for 20 -30 seconds

- Then add to the cooked dal and mix it in

- Serve hot

- NB : if you have this dal with rice/roti then omit the carrots .

- Other vegetables that can be added include a few florets of cauliflower,1 capsicum cut in cubes and 1 cup of bottle gourd cut in cubes .

name: Tuvar Beans ki Subzi
ingredients:
- 1 kg cluster beans (with the pods)

- 1 1/2 tbsp oil

- 1/4 tsp whole cumin

- 1/4 tsp whole black mustard

- 1/2 -1 tsp urad dal

- 2-3 green chillies chopped

- 1 onion chopped (medium to big)

- Salt to taste

- 1/4 tsp turmeric powder

- 1/2 tsp cumin powder

- 1/2 tsp coriander powder

- 2 1/2 tbsp grated coconut

- 2 1/2 tbsp peanuts ,roasted and crushed

- 1 cup chopped spinach
method:
- Remove beans from inside the pods and keep aside

- Then put the beans in a pressure cooker with little salt and water just enough to cover it and cook to one whistle. Then remove from stove and keep aside .Let the pressure cooker open naturally.

- Now done keep aside

- Take a kadhai add the oil.

- Warm the oil a little then add the whole cumin, whole black mustard seeds and the urad dal .

- Stir fry for 1 minute .

- Next add 2-3 green chillies chopped

- Stir fry for few seconds

- Then add the chopped onion

- Stir fry for few minutes

- Stir fry till onions become a little translucent

- Then add salt to taste ,keeping in mind that salt was put during the cooking of the beans .

- Stir fry for few seconds

- Then add the turmeric powder, cumin powder and coriander powder

- Stir fry for few minutes

- Now add the cooked beans to the kadhai ,if there is any residue water in the cooker ,can add that too .

- Stir fry for few minutes

- To this now add the grated coconut

- Then add the crushed roasted peanuts

- Mix it in well

- Add the chopped spinach

- Stir fry for few minutes

- and cook till the spinach is done .

- Ready .

name: Pepper Stir Fried Chicken
ingredients:
500 gms chicken (preferably boneless)
1 medium onion cut into thick slices
1/2 red bell pepper cut into thick pieces
1 full pod of garlic peeled (whole)
1 " pc of ginger cut into half then into thin slices
5-6 whole red chillies cut into pieces
1 tsp whole peppercorns
1/2 tsp chilli flakes
1/2 tsp pounded peppercorns
Salt to taste
2 tbsp oil

For the sauce :
Mix these sauces together and keep aside
1 tsp dark soya
1/2 tsp oyster sauce (optional)
2 tsp light soya
1/2 tsp vinegar
1/2 tsp sugar
1 tsp cornflour

For the chicken
Marinate chicken in salt and pepper to taste ,1 tsp cornflour,1/2 an egg and 1 tsp oil
Keep for 15-20 minutes
Then take a pan add 1 tbsp of oil
Heat the oil ,when the oil is warm
Add the chicken and stir fry till it becomes a little brown ,then let it cook on low flame till done .
Remove from pan and keep aside
method:
Take a pan put 2 tbsp of oil
Add the whole peppercorns
Stir fry for few seconds
Add the ginger slices
Stir fry for 30-40 seconds
Add the pods of garlic
Stir fry fora minute or so
Add the cut whole red chillies
Stir fry for few minutes till the ginger ,garlic and chillies get roasted
Add the thickly sliced onion
Stir fry for few seconds
Add the cut bell peppers
Stir fry for few minutes
Add the salt and stir fry for a minute or so
Add the stir fried chicken
Mix it in well
Stir fry for few minutes
Add the mixed sauces (at this point I put of the flame as the sauces thicken immediately)
Mix it in well
When the sauces are mixed in well
Restart the flame and stir fry for a minute or so
Add the chilli flakes and pounded peppercorns
Mix it in well
Stir fry for few minutes .
Done .

name: Stir Fry Green Dal With Greens
ingredients:
- 1 cup raw whole green dal

- 1 bunch of amaranth leaves (any green of your choice approximately 2-3cups of chopped greens )

- 2-3 tsp oil

- 1/2 tsp mustard seeds

- 1/2 tsp whole cumin 1 tsp raw chana dal

- 2 tsp urad dal

- 4-5 pounded garlic cloves

- Few slitted green chillies

- according to taste

- 1 big onion chopped

- Salt to taste

- 1/4 tsp turmeric powder

- 1/2 tsp coriander powder

- 1/2 tsp cumin powder

- 1 1/4 tbsp roasted peanut powder

- 1 1/2 tbsp grated coconut

- 3/4-1 tbsp lemon juice
method:
- Take the whole green dal /lentil ,wash it throughly ,then place in a cooker ,add 2 cups of water ,add a pin h of salt.

- Close the lid of the cooker and cook till one whistle .Then remove from stove and keep aside .Let the cooker open naturally.

- Strain the dal/lentil and keep aside .

- The lentil should be firm but soft ,should not be too soft .

- Wash the amaranth leaves throughly (or any greens of your choice ) Let it drain so that the excess water goes out ,then chop the leaves and stem into small pieces

- Brush a kadhai with oil .Now place the chopped leaves in it and cook till the leaves and stems are cooked and the water dries up completely.

- Now add the cooked dal/lentil to the cooked green leaves in the kadhai

- Mix it in well and keep aside

- Now take another kadhai or the same kadhai add the oil and warm it for 20-30 seconds

- Now add the mustard seeds

- Next add the whole cumin

- To this add the raw channa dal and the raw urad dal

- Stir fry for 30-40 seconds

- Add the pounded garlic

- Stir fry for 15-20 seconds

- Add few slitted green chillies according to taste

- Now add the chopped onion to the kadhai

- Stir fry till it becomes a little soft

- Add salt to taste keeping in mind that salt has been added to the dal/lentil

- Next, add the turmeric powder

- Add the coriander powder

- Add the cumin powder

- Stir fry for few minutes, 4-5 minutes

- Now add the roasted peanut powder

- Also add the of grated coconut

- Stir fry for few minutes

- Now add the mixed cooked dal/lentil and greens

- Mix it in well

- Stir fry for few minutes

- Lastly, add the lime juice

- Mix it in well

- Can add 2-3 tsps of water if it starts catching at the bottom.

- Keep for few minutes .

- Done .

name: Spinach Kadhi
ingredients:
- 1 bunch spinach (raw)

- 500-600 gms curd (homemade)

- 3 1/2 tbsp besan/gram flour

- 1 tsp salt ,

- 1 tsp kashmiri red chilli powder,

- 1 tsp red chilli powder

- 1/2-1tsp chilli flakes

- 1 tsp turmeric powder

- 1 tbsp oil

- 2-3 bay leaves

- 3-4 whole red chillies

- 2-3 tsp finely chopped garlic

- 2 tbsp ginger julienne

- 1/4- 1/2 tsp asafoetida

- 1/2 tsp whole cumin ,

- 1/2 tsp black mustard seeds,

- 1 tbsp whole coriander seeds

- 4-5 cloves

- 15 -20 curry patta leaves

- 3 -5 cups water

- 1 tsp dry kasturi methi leaves
method:
- Blanch the spinach and keep it aside

- Take 500

- Take the home made curd and beat it to a smooth consistency

- Then add the besan/gram flour to it

- Mix it in

- Then the salt , kashmiri red chilli powder, red chilli powder ,chilli flakes and turmeric powder

- Mix it throughly and keep aside

- Take a kadhai add the oil ,warm it a little

- Then add the bay leaves and whole red chillies

- Stir fry for 20-30 seconds

- Next add the finely chopped garlic and ginger julienne

- Stir fry for 20-30 seconds

- Push everything to one side and add the asafoetida, stir for few seconds

- To that add the whole cumin, whole black mustard seeds, whole coriander seeds and the cloves

- Stir fry till the garlic starts becoming beige in colour, then add the curry patta leaves

- Stir fry for 10-15 seconds

- Then add the curd mixture along with 3-5 cups of water

- Can add a little more chilli flakes ,gives a nice colour

- When the kadi starts bubbling lower the flame and cook ,as the kadi will rise ,keep stirring, or else it might spill over .

- When the kadhi stops rising its cooked

- Chop the blanched spinach into small pieces

- Add it to the kadi

- Cook for 7-8 minutes o low to medium flame

- Sprinkle the dry kasturi methi leaves (crush it first in your palm)

- Mix it in well and cook for few minutes on low flame

- and done .

- Done .

- NB: can make kadi thinner by adding more water and cooking it ,to make thicker ,cook for 5-7 minutes more and remove from stove .

- On cooling kadi becomes thicker .Can check for salt and chilli now .

name: Onion Chutney
ingredients:
- 2 big onions

- 1 tbsp coriander seeds

- 1 tsp cumin seeds

- 1/4 tsp fenugreek seeds

- 1 full garlic (15-20 pods)peeled

- 1- 11/2" pc ginger cut into pieces

- 4-6 whole red chillies

- 1/4 cup coriander leaves

- 11/2 tbsp of soaked seedless tamarind

- 1 1/2 tsp powdered jaggery

- Salt to taste
method:
- Take a kadhai add the coriander seeds

- Stir fry for few seconds

- Then add the cumin seeds and the fenugreek seeds

- Stir fry for 30-40 seconds till a nice fragrance emits and the colour starts changing a little

- Then add the peeled garlic, cut ginger and the whole red chillies

- Stir fry for few minutes

- Should get a nice fragrance and when the seeds , chillies change colour and the garlic and ginger get a little roasted .

- Remove from the stove and let it cool down

- Then put in a grinder and dry grind it and when done keep aside

- Next Take a kadhai add the oil in it warm the oil a little then add the sliced onions

- Stir fry for few minutes then add salt to taste

- Stir fry till onions become soft and little translucent

- Now add the coriander leaves

- Stir fry Stir fry the onions for few more minutes Then add the soaked seedless tamarind

- Stir fry till the onions starts changing colour slightly

- Then add the powdered jaggery

- Stir fry for 30-40 seconds

- Switch of the flame and when it cools down add to the grinder with the powdered ground ingredients and grind to a smooth paste

- At this stage can taste and adjust , salt , sweet, chilli and sourness (tamarind) .

- Done and Ready to serve

name: Stir Fry Kadhai Paneer
ingredients:
- 200 gms paneer cut into cubes

- 2 medium size onions sliced

- 1 big tomato sliced

- 2 green bell peppers cut in cubes

- 1/2 tsp whole cumin

- Salt to taste

- 1/4 tsp turmeric powder

- 1/2 tsp kashmiri red chilli powder

- 1 ½ tsp coriander powder

- 3 tbsp of milk

- 2 tbsp of oil
method:
- Take a kadhai, add oil, Warm the oil a little

- Then add the whole cumin , when the cumin starts spluttering

- Add the sliced onions, stir fry till onions become soft

- Add the cut bell pepper and stir fry for 30-40 seconds

- To this add the turmeric powder, red chilli powder and coriander powder

- Mix it in well and saute for few minutes

- Next add the milk and cook for a minute or so

- Now add the sliced tomato and mix it in, stir fry for a minute or so

- Finally add salt to taste and the paneer cubes

- Mix it in well but gently taking care not to break the paneer

- Cook for 30- 40 seconds and done .

name: Sukha Masala Bitter Gourd (Karela)
ingredients:
- 300 - 350 gms bitter gourd cut in circles

- 3 tbsp oil

- 1/4 tsp whole fennel (saunf)

- 1/2 tsp whole cumin

- 1/4 tsp asafoetida

- 1/4 tsp turmeric powder

- 1/2 - 1 tsp red chilli powder

- 1 tsp coriander powder

- 1 tsp sugar

- Salt to taste

- 1 tbsp of pounded garlic

- 1 tbsp lemon juice

- 1 tbsp gram flour (besan)

- 1 tbsp rice flour
method:
- Cut the bitter gourd into circles and keep aside

- Take a kadhai, add oil, warm the oil a little, then add whole fennel seeds

- Then add whole cumin seeds

- Then add asafoetida

- Stir fry for 20-30 seconds

- Then add bitter gourd cut into circles, remove the centre part

- Stir fry for few minutes

- Cover and cook on low flame for few minutes

- Then add 1 tbsp of pounded garlic, stir fry for few minutes

- Next add the lemon juice and mix it in

- After this add salt to taste

- Then add 1 tsp sugar and stir fry for few minutes

- Now add the turmeric, red chilli powder and coriander powder

- Mix everything well and cook for few minutes

- Now add 1 tbsp of besan and 1 tbsp of rice flour, mix it in well with the bitter gourd

- Stir fry till all the masala, besan and rice flour

- Coat the bitter gourd. Keep for few seconds

- And Done

name: Cluster Beans Ki Sabzi
ingredients:
- 1 kg cluster beans (with the pods)

- 1 ½ tbsp oil

- 1/4 tsp whole cumin

- 1/4 tsp whole black mustard

- 1/2 -1 tsp urad dal

- 2-3 green chillies chopped

- 1 onion chopped (medium to big)

- Salt to taste

- 1/4 tsp turmeric powder

- 1/2 tsp cumin powder

- 1/2 tsp coriander powder

- 2 1/2 tbsp grated coconut

- 2 1/2 tbsp peanuts ,roasted and crushed

- 1 cup chopped spinach
method:
- Remove beans from inside the pods and keep aside

- Then put the beans in a pressure cooker with little salt and water just enough to cover it and cook to one whistle. Remove from stove and keep aside. Let the pressure cooker open naturally. Now done keep aside

- Take a kadhai add the oil

- Warm the oil a little then add the whole cumin, whole black mustard seeds and the urad dal. Stir fry for 1 minute

- Next add 2-3 green chillies chopped. Stir fry for few seconds

- Then add the chopped onion. Stir fry for few minutes till onions become a little translucent

- Then add salt to taste, keeping in mind that salt was put during the cooking of the beans. Stir fry for few seconds

- Then add the turmeric powder, cumin powder and coriander powder. Stir fry for few minutes

- Now add the cooked beans to the kadhai, if there is any residue water in the cooker, can add that too. Stir fry for few minutes

- To this now add the grated coconut

- Then add the crushed roasted peanuts. Mix it in well

- Add the chopped spinach. Stir fry for few minutes and cook till the spinach is done.

- Ready

name: Cauliflower Stems and Leaves ki Sabzi
ingredients:
- Stems and leaves from 6-8 cauliflower

- 1 big onion chopped in cubes

- 10-12 pods of garlic cut into small pieces

- 1-2 medium size potatoes cut into strips

- 1 ½ tbsp of oil (preferably mustard oil)

- Few green chillies according to taste

- Salt to taste

- Red chilli powder to taste

- 1/2 tsp turmeric powder

- 1/4 tsp cumin powder (optional)

- 1/4 tsp coriander powder (optional)
method:
- Remove the stems and leaves from the cauliflower. Wash the stems and leaves well then cut both into small pieces

- Wash and cut again after cutting and keep in a strainer so that excess water drains off. Keep aside

- Cut the potatoes into strips, not very thin or thick. Keep aside

- Take a kadhai add the oil, preferably mustard oil

- Heat the oil, then add the chopped onion and garlic

- Stir fry till onion becomes translucent then add the cut potatoes

- Add the slitted green chillies according to taste

- Next add salt to taste

- Then add red chilli powder to taste

- Add turmeric powder and mix it in. Stir fry for few minutes

- Add cumin powder, this is optional

- Add coriander powder, this is optional

- Now add the chopped cauliflower leaves and stem

- Mix it in nicely and stir fry for 4-5 minutes

- Cover and cook on low flame stirring in between

- Cook till done.

- NB: the stems and leaves used here is the stems of 5-8 cauliflower.

name: Jade Noodles
ingredients:
- 1 pkt raw noodles (400- 450 gms)

- 1 small bunch of spinach (after blanching should be 1/2 cup)

- 1/2 green big bell pepper cut in pieces

- 3-4 green chillies (can be adjusted according to personal choice)

- 2 tbsp of chopped coriander leaves

- 1/2 cup chopped spring onions

- 3-4 tbsp chopped garlic

- 1-2 tbsp of oil

- 2 tbsp sesame oil

- 2 tbsp oyster sauce

- 1/2 tsp dark soya sauce

- 2 tbsp light soya sauce

- 1 - 1 ½ tsp sugar

- Salt to taste
method:
- Boil/cook the noodles as per instructions on the packet.

- Wash spinach and blanch it and keep aside

- To blanch the spinach, put the spinach in a pan, cover with a lid and cook on low flame for few minutes, turn sides in between. Done!

- Grind to a paste and keep ready the :
cut green bell pepper into pieces, green chillies, chopped coriander leaves, chopped spring onions and the blanched spinach

- Take a wok / kadhai add the oil , warm the oil , then add the chopped garlic and stir fry till it slightly changes colour

- Now add the ground paste to the wok

- Stir fry for few minutes so that the paste takes on the flavour of the garlic and the rawness goes

- To this add the sesame oil

- Add the oyster sauce

- Add the dark soya sauce. Add the light soya sauce and sugar

- Add salt to taste keeping in mind that the sauces have salt. Stir fry for 30-40 seconds

- Next add the boiled noodles to the wok

- Mix the noodles in well with the sauce taking care not to break the noodles

- Now add the chopped spring onions

- Mix it in well, but gently

- Stir fry for few minutes on medium flame

- And done!
Serve with a side dish of your choice.

name: Dhoodwala Beans
ingredients:
- 750 - 800 gms french beans

- 1-2 tbsp oil

- 1 tsp whole cumin

- 1 ½ medium onion sliced

- 2 medium tomatoes sliced

- Salt to taste

- Red chilli powder to taste

- 1/4 tsp turmeric powder

- 2 ½ cups of milk

- Pinch of garam masala (optional )
method:
- Take french beans cut the heads and tail and discard it. Then cut the french beans into thin fine diagonal pieces. Keep aside

- Take a kadhai add the oil. Warm the oil a little then add the whole cumin seeds

- Stir the cumin seeds for 30-40 seconds

- Then add the sliced onion. Stir fry till onions become translucent

- Add the sliced tomatoes. Stir fry for few minutes

- Then add salt to taste

- Saute till tomatoes become totally soft and mushy

- Then add the beans. Mix it in and stir fry for 1-2 minutes

- Now add salt to taste add turmeric powder

- Add red chilli powder to taste. Stir fry for few minutes

- Then add the milk. Mix it in well, when the milk starts bubbling cover the kadhai and cook on low flame

- Do keep stirring in between

- Cook till the milk dries up and the beans are cooked

- Lastly can add a pinch of garam masala, this is optional

- Done ready to serve with roti / paratha

name: Basil Chicken
ingredients:
For Marination -

- 750 gms of chicken

- 1 egg white /whole egg

- 2 tsp cornflour

- 1 tsp flour and pinch of salt

- 1/2 tsp pepper

- 2 tbsp finely chopped spring onions

Keep aside for 15-20 minutes
Brush a little oil in an air fryer, place the chicken pieces in it and cook till done. Then keep it aside.

Ingredients to keep ready

- 20-25 garlic pods

- 8-10 green chilies
Pounded together in a mortar pestle and kept aside

Sauces to be mixed together and kept ready
In a bowl mix

- 3 tsp of oyster sauce

- 2 tsp of light soya sauce

- 1 tsp dark soy sauce

- 1 ½ tsp sugar

Remaining ingredients

- 1 tbsp oil

- 15-20 basil leaves
method:
- Take a wok add the oil and heat the oil 40-50 seconds

- Then add the pounded garlic chili paste

- Stir fry for few minutes till the garlic starts changing colour

- Will get a nice fragrance

- Then add the cooked chicken to the wok and mix it in well, cook on medium heat as you don't want the garlic to burn

- Then add the mixed sauces to the chicken and stir fry for 20-30 seconds

- Then add the basil leaves, can chop the stems of the basil and add the stems too

- Stir fry for few seconds and done!

name: Egg Cabbage Fried Rice
ingredients:
- 1 cup (raw) rice

- 1 tbsp oil

- 4 eggs

- 2-3 cups of finely cut cabbage

- 1 cup chopped spring onions

- 2 tbsp light soya sauce

- 2 tbsp oyster sauce

- 1 -1 ½ tsp dark soya sauce

- ½ tsp pepper powder (black/white)
method:
- Cook the rice and keep aside, should be little on the firmer side, preferably if it can be made couple of hours before so that it becomes firm, cold rice from day before works well too.

- Beat four eggs with a pinch of salt keep aside

- Take a kadhai or wok and add the oil, heat the oil till little smoke starts coming out

- Add the beaten eggs to the hot oil in the kadhai

- Do not stir the eggs, when it starts browning from below but the egg is still soft on the top, Then add the cooked rice

- Mix the rice and egg together and stir fry for 5-7 minutes

- Next add 2 -3 cups of finely cut cabbage, mix it well and stir fry for 5 minutes

- The cabbage should remain crunchy

- Next add the finely chopped spring onion. Mix it in well and stir fry for 5 minutes\

- Now add the light soya sauce and mix it in

- Next add the oyster sauce and 1-1 ½ tsp of dark soya sauce. Mix well

- Lastly add the black / white pepper , and mix it in. Stir fry for few minutes and ready to serve.

NB : if you want to add any form of non veg, need to

- cook and stir fry chicken/prawn/meat and keep aside.

- Add to the fried rice at the end, just few minutes before removing from the stove.

- Cook the entire dish on medium heat.

name: Soya Nuggets in Garlic Sauce
ingredients:
- 200 gms pkt soya chunks

- 1 cup tomato puree (packaged one)

- 1/4 cup tomato sauce

- 1/3 cup chopped garlic

- 1 tbsp oil

- 1 tsp dark soya sauce

- 2 tbsp red chilli sauce

- Salt to taste

- 1 ½ tsp sugar

- ½ cup chopped spring onions

- 3 cups hot water

- 1 tbsp cornflour slurry

Ingredients for Soya chunks

- 1 tbsp flour

- 1 ½ tbsp cornflour

- Salt to taste

- 1/4 tsp pepper

- 1/4 cup chopped spring onions

Soya Chunks Marination and Cooking

- Cook soya chunks as per instruction on the packet

- Squeeze out all the water

- Let it stay for 15-20 on a strainer so that any excess water can drain out

- Marinate the soya chunks with 1 tbsp flour, 1 ½ tbsp cornflour, salt, ¼ tsp pepper and ¼ cup of the chopped spring onions

- Mix everything together, then brush oil in a pan, place the soya chunks on it and cook on low flame till it browns and becomes crisp

- Need to repeat process the same way for all the soya chunks

- When done keep aside

- Can cook the soya chunks in an air fryer also, brush the pan of the fryer with oil and place the soya chunks, cook till it becomes crisp

- Keep aside.
method:
- Take a wok / kadhai add the oil, heat the oil for 30-40 seconds

- Then add the chopped garlic and stir fry till it starts changing colour

- Now remove wok / kadhai from the stove and add the red chilli sauce, tomato sauce, soya sauce, salt, sugar and spring onions, mix it in. Then place the wok/kadhai back on the stove and stir fry for 30-40 seconds.
(This is done so that while we are putting the sauces, it should not catch)

- Then add the tomato puree stir for 30-40 seconds then add the hot water, when the sauce starts bubbling add the cornflour slurry to the sauce, stirring continuously.

- Add slurry according to the thickness of the gravy you would like.

- At this stage check for salt, sweet, sour and chillies, adjust according to taste.

- For more sweetness add tomato sauce, for a little more sour add little tomato puree and for more chillies add the red chilli sauce.

- Next add the cooked soya chunks to the sauce and cook for 20-30 seconds. Remove from stove.

- Done!

- Garnish with chopped spring onions .

NB : if 1 egg is added in the soya chunks marination, the soya chunks become crisper.

name: Rajma Brownie
ingredients:
- 1.5 cups rajma (kidney beans) soaked overnight boiled and drained

- 3 large eggs

- 1/4 cup dates jaggery crumbled

- 1/4 cup honey

- 1/3 cup unsweetened cocoa powder

- 1 tsp. baking soda

- 3 Tbsp. coconut oil, melted

- 1 tsp. vanilla extract

- 1/3 cup chopped walnuts (optional)

- 1/2 cup dark chocolate chunks
method:
- Preheat oven to 180° C.

- Prepare tray/dish by applying oil and dusting with a flour of choice.

- Place rajma, eggs, honey, jaggery, cocoa powder, baking soda, coconut oil, and vanilla extract in blender and blend until smooth.

- Mix in chopped walnuts and half the chocolate chunks.

- Pour the batter into the prepared dish.

- Top with remaining chocolate chunks and gently push them into the batter.

- Bake on the lower rack for 10 to 12 minutes, or until the toothpick inserted in the center comes out clean.
Cool completely and enjoy!

TIPS
Cocoa Powder : use Hersheys unsweetened or Happy Healthy Me organics
Nuts : these are optional and can be avoided for people with nut allergies
Oil : can be reduced by half for a lower calorie version
Dates jaggery : can be replace with 1/4 cup honey making that a total of 1/2 cup honey

name: Avarekai Pualo / Rice
ingredients:
- 200 grams avarekai beans

- 1 1/2 cups rice (raw)

- 1 1/2 tbsp oil

- 1/2 tsp whole cumin

- 1 tsp garlic paste

- 1 tsp ginger paste

- 3-4 slitted green chilies

- 8-10 curry leaves

- 1 onion, medium size, chopped

- 1tomato medium-large size, chopped

- Salt to taste

- 1/2 tsp turmeric powder

- 1 1/2 cups of water
method:
- Wash the rice well and keep it aside.

- In a pressure cooker add the oil , warm the oil a little then add the whole cumin,
When the cumin starts spluttering and changing color add the garlic and ginger paste

- Then add the slitted green chilies and curry leaves, stir fry for 1 minute or so

- Add the chopped onion and stir fry, If the ginger garlic paste starts catching add a few tbsps of water.

- Saute for a few minutes on low flame till the onion becomes soft.

- Then add the chopped tomato and saute till tomato becomes soft

- Next add the avarekai beans, and saute for few minutes

- Add salt to taste and turmeric powder. Stir fry for few minutes

- Then add the washed rice to the pressure cooker and mix the rice well with the masala.

- Now add the water, and mix everything together gently.

- Can check for salt at this stage.

- Then close the lid of the cooker and cook till 1 whistle then remove from the flame and let the cooker open naturally.

- When the cooker opens fluff up the rice a bit.

Done

name: Jhatpat Paneer
ingredients:
- 500 gms of paneer, cut into cubes

- 1"pc ginger ,cut into small julienne

- 3-4 green chilies, cut into big pieces

- 1 onion cut into cubes

- 1 green capsicum, cut into cubes

- 1 tsp garlic paste

- 1tsp ginger paste

- Salt to taste

- Red chilli powder to taste

- 1/4 tsp turmeric powder

- 1/2 tsp cumin powder

- 1/2 tsp coriander powder

- 1 1/2 tbsp oil
method:
- Take a kadhai add oil, warm the oil a little, then add the small ginger julienne and the green chillies (to be cut into big pieces ). Stir fry for a few seconds.

- Then add cut onion and stir fry for a few seconds.

- Then add the capsicum cubes and the ginger garlic paste, and stir fry for a few minutes so that the raw smell of the ginger garlic goes.

- Next add salt to taste, red chilli powder according to taste, turmeric powder, tsp cumin powder, coriander powder, mix everything in well and saute for a few minutes .

- Then add the cut paneer cubes to the masala.

- Mix it in gently and cook on low flame for a few minutes so that the masala infuses with the paneer.

- Can sprinkle a little water,so that the paneer remains moist, cook on low flame for few minutes.

And done.

name: Masaledar Bitter Gourd / Kerela
ingredients:
- 500gms kerela

- 1 tbsp oil

- 1/2 tsp whole cumin

- 1/4 tsp asafoetida

- 1 onion, big, chopped

- Few slitted green chillies

- 5-7 curry leaves

- 1 tomato, big, chopped

- 3-4 garlic pods pounded

- Salt to taste

- Red chilli powder according to taste

- 1/4 tsp turmeric powder

- 1/2 tsp cumin powder

- 1/2 tsp coriander powder

- 1/2 tsp dry mango powder

- 1 1/2 tsp jaggery powder
method:
- Wash the kerela then cut it in circles, remove the seeds, then sprinkle little salt, rub it in and leave it aside for 1/2 n hour

- Take a kadhai add the oil, warm the oil a little then add the whole cumin and cook till it starts spluttering and the cumin changes colour.

- Then add the chopped onion, few slitted green chillies and curry patta leaves.

- Add salt, keeping in mind that the raw kerela has been kept for sometime in salt.

- Add asafoetida, sa tir fry for few seconds.

- Add chopped tomatoes with few pounded garlic pods (optional) and stir fry till the tomatoes become a little mushy.

- Wash the kerala and add it to the masala mix it well and cover and cook on low flame for 5-7 minutes, do stir in between

- Then add red chilli powder according to taste, 1/4 tsp turmeric powder,1/2 tsp of cumin, coriander and aamchur/dry mango powder each.

- Mix it in well, If the spice starts catching at the bottom can add few tbsps of water .

- Cover and cook till 90% done, do keep stirring in between.

- Then add the jaggery powder and mix it in and cook till done

Ready

name: Spinach and Black Eyed Beans (lobia)
ingredients:
- 1 bunch of spinach

- 1/2 cup black eyed beans

- 1 small onion chopped

- 6-8 whole pods of garlic pounded

- Salt to taste

- Red chilli powder to taste

- 1/4 tsp turmeric powder

- 1/4 tsp coriander powder

- 1/4 tsp whole cumin

- 1 tbsp oil
method:
- Wash and soak the black eyed beans overnight or for 6-8 hrs.

- Drain that water then cook the black eyed beans in a pressure cooker with one cup of water and a pinch of salt.

- Cook till one whistle then lower the heat and cook for 10 mins.

- The beans should be soft but not become mushy, when done keep aside.

- Next, wash the spinach thoroughly and cut it into strips .

- Take a kadhai add the oil, warm it a little, then add the whole cumin.

- When the cumin starts spluttering then add the pounded garlic pods . Stir fry for a minute or so

- Now add the chopped onion, saute till it becomes soft.

- Then add the chopped spinach and mix it in.

- To this add the salt ,red chilli powder, turmeric, coriander powder and stir fry well.

- Cook on low flame ,can add the water from the black eyed beans .

- When the spinach is 90 % done add the cooked black eyed beans and mix everything together.

- Stir fry till spinach is cooked and there is no water left.

Ready to serve with dal and rice .

name: Saibhaji
ingredients:
- 1 cup channa dal

- 4 tomatoes

- 10-12 french beans

- 1 potato

- 3-4 small brinjal

- 1 bunch spinach /3 cups chopped spinach

- Few green chillies

- 2 medium carrots cut (optional)

- Salt to taste

- 1 tbsp oil

- 1 tsp whole cumin

- 1/4 tsp asafoetida

- 8-10 garlic pods roughly chopped

- 1/2 onion chopped

- 10-12 curry patta leaves

- Red chilli powder to taste

- 1/2 tsp turmeric powder

- 1 tsp coriander powder

- 1/2 tsp cumin powder
method:
- Take the chana dal wash and soak for 15-20 minutes, then place the soaked dal in a cooker.

- Add the cut tomatoes ,french beans, potato ,small brinjal ,chopped spinach,carrots, few green chillies and salt according to taste.

- Put 1/2 cup water and cook to 1 whistle and cook at sim for 5-7 minutes

- Let the cooker open naturally when done.

- On opening the cooker, let it cool down ,then roughly grind it ,can use a hand blender also.

- Roughly grind 3/4 of it ,and leave 1/4 of it as it is.

- When it is roughly ground, keep aside

- Rinse the grinder with 1 cup of water and add the liquid to the ground saibhaji.

- Then take a pan add the oil Let the oil warm a little, then add the whole cumin.

- When the cumin starts spluttering and changes colour add the asafoetida.

- Then add the roughly chopped garlic. Stir fry till garlic changes colour.

- Then add the chopped onion and the curry patta leaves. Stir fry till onion becomes translucent/soft.

- Then add red chilli powder according to taste, turmeric powder, coriander powder, and cumin powder.

- Mix everything together and stir fry for few minutes.

- Now add the ground vegetable and dal ,mix it in well and let it simmer for few minutes.

Done
NB: this dish has a thick consistency, can add warm water to it if you want to change the consistency.

name: Sindhi Tomato Kadhi
ingredients:
- 3 cups water

Cut vegetables and keep aside :

- 10 tomatoes (medium size)

- 2 drumsticks cut into 2 " pieces

- 2 radish cut into big pieces

- 2 carrots cut into thick strips

- 250gms guvar ,remove the heads and tails

- 1 potato cut into pieces (optional)

Can use lots of different vegetables also like,

- 10-12 small Ladyfingers

- 2-3 small brinjals cut into big pieces

- 1 lotus stem cut in slant

- Take a pressure cooker add 2 tbsp of oil/ghee

- 1 tsp whole cumin ,

- 1 tsp fenugreek seeds ,

- 1 tsp mustard seeds ,

- 1/2 tsp asafoetida

- 1"piece ginger chopped, 10-12 curry patta leaves

- 2-3 green chillies chopped.

- 1 cup besan /gram flour

- 1 tsp turmeric powder,

- red chilli powder

- salt to taste,

- 2 tsp cumin powder

- 1-2 tsp dry mango powder (optional)
method:
- Take the tomatoes cut each into two, put it in a pressure cooker, and add 3 cups of water, when done keep aside.

- Close the lid and cook for 1 whistle, remove the cooker from the stove and let it open naturally.

- Remove the tomato from the water, keep the water aside.

- Put the tomatoes in a grinder and make a puree.

- Put the puree in a strainer and strain it really well, discard the skin and pulp. Should be a smooth puree. When done keep it aside.

- Take a pressure cooker add the oil/ghee ,warm it a little, then add the whole cumin , fenugreek seeds , mustard seeds and asafoetida When these start spluttering add the chopped ginger ,the curry patta leaves and the chopped green chillies. Stir fry the above for 30-40 seconds.

- Then add the besan /gram flour and immediately stir fry.

- Stir fry till the besan/ gram flour become fragrant and the colour changes very slightly.

- Now add the water from the boiled tomato to the tomato puree and add it to the besan in the pan and mix it in throughly.

- Make the flame low at this point as it will splash.

- Cook for few minutes then add the cut vegetables.

- Next add the turmeric powder, red chilli powder,cumin powder and salt to taste.

- Mix everything in well, cook for few minutes.

- Close the lid and pressure cook for 1 -2 whistles, remove the pressure cooker from the stove and let it open naturally.

- It's ready, now can check for sourness,salt and chilli.

- Can add the dry mango powder if you want it a little more sour.

- Mix it in ,simmer for 30-40 seconds and done.

Ready to serve .

name: Andhra Biryani
ingredients:
- 2 cups rice (raw)
(Wash and soak 2 cups of rice for 20-30 minutes)

- 750 gms chicken

- 2 tbsp oil

- 2-3 bay leaf

- 1 cinnamon stick of 2"

- 2-4 whole dry red chillies

- 2 star anise

- 2 medium tomatoes chopped

- 1 medium-big onion chopped

- Few slitted green chillies

- 1/4 cup coriander leaves chopped

- 1/4 cup mint leaves chopped

- 1 tsp ginger paste

- 1 tsp garlic paste

- Juice of 1 lemon / 1 tbsp lemon juice

- 1/2 tsp turmeric powder

- 1 tsp red chilli powder

- 1 tsp coriander powder

- Salt to taste

- 1 tsp garam masala

- 1 tsp cumin powder

- 2 1/2 cups of water

Marinate chicken:

- 3-4 tbsp curd

- 1/2 tsp ginger

- 1/2 tsp garlic

- 1 tsp kashmiri red chilli

- 1/4 tsp pepper

- Little salt

Marinate the chicken in all of the above and keep for 15-20 minutes
method:
- Take a pressure cooker add the oil and warm the oil Then add the bay leaves , cinnamon stick , whole red chillies , and star anise.

- Stir fry for a minute or so Then add the chopped onions and slitted green chillies.

- When the onion becomes soft Add the chopped coriander and mint leaves. Stir fry for few minutes.

- Then add the chopped tomatoes, saute for a few minutes till the tomatoes become soft.

- Next add the ginger garlic paste, saute till the raw smell of the ginger-garlic goes.

- Then add the turmeric powder , red chilli powder , coriander powder , garam masala powder ,cumin powder and salt to taste.

- Saute for few minutes till the spices are infused with the masala.

- Now add the marinated chicken and saute for 5-7 minutes.

- Next add the lime juice, saute for a minute or so.

- Now add water in accordance to the rice and chicken used. Here I have used 2 cups of rice, so water Put in is 2 cups and 1 cup for the chicken. Cook for a few minutes on low heat.

- Now add the washed rice and mix it in well.

- Check the salt at this stage

- Put the lid on the cooker and cook on full flame to a whistle, then remove from heat after few seconds.

- Keep aside .Then let the cooker open naturally.

And done.
Serve with salad and curd /onion+tomato +cucumber raita

Note :
Can use a big pan to cook the biryani, If you do not want to use a pressure cooker.
When the water starts bubbling in the pan put the heat to low and cover the pan and cook till the rice and chicken is cooked.
Do put a skillet/tava underneath the pan.
The heat then will come thru the skillet.

name: Masala Andhra Chicken
ingredients:
- 750 gms chicken

- 1 ½ tbsp oil

- 1 big onion sliced

- Few slitted green chillies

- 1 tomato chopped

- Salt to taste

- 1 tsp kashmiri red chilli powder (for colour)

- 1/2 tsp red chilli powder

- 1/2 tsp cumin powder

- 1 tsp coriander powder

- ¼ -½ tsp garam masala

- 1/4 cup curd

- 1 cup chopped methi (fenugreek) leaves

To be ground :
In a grinder add

- 1 big tomato cut

- 1 medium size onion cut 12-15 garlic pods

- 1 "piece ginger cut

- 1 "piece cinnamon stick

- 4-5 pieces cloves

- 15-20 whole peppercorns

- Grind the above together and keep aside
method:
- Marinate the chicken in a little salt and turmeric and cook in a pan till it is 3/4 done. Keep aside

- In a grinder add the tomato , onion , garlic pods , ginger , cinnamon stick , cloves and whole peppercorns

- Grind the above and keep aside

- Take a kadhai , and add the oil to it then add the sliced onion and few sliited green chillies

- Stir fry for few minutes till onion becomes translucent

- Then add the chopped tomato and salt and stir fry for few minutes

- Cover and cook the onion tomato on low flame. Do keep stirring in between

- When the tomatoes become a little mushy ,then add the ground paste. Saute for few minutes

- Put 1 cup water in the grinder and mix it well then add to the masala in the kadhai

- Cover and cook on low flame till the water dries up and the masala gets mushy. Open and stir in between

- Now add the kashmiri red chilli , red chilli powder , cumin powder, coriander powder and garam masala. Saute for few minutes

- Beat the curd in a mixer to make a smooth paste

- Then add to the sauted masala

- Saute masala for few minutes till oil comes up ,then add the chopped methi leaves. Saute for few minutes

- To the masala now add the semi cooked chicken

- Mix it in well and saute for few minutes

- Cover and cook on low flame till chicken is done

- Do keep stirring in between

- Ready

- NB : If you want a little gravy can add 1/2 cup of hot water and let it cook on low flame, when oil comes on top. It's done.
